name: Ski video editing and online marketing
description: On the evenings of January 19 and 20, Lei Mingxuan used his evenings to edit the skiing footage into a 1-minute short video, adding narration to introduce the charm of outdoor sports, and subtly embedding the store's winter jackets' windproof and waterproof selling points. After the video was posted in the store's WeChat group and WeChat Moments, it received many likes from customers. Regular customer Qian Duoduo commented, 'Boss Lei is personally promoting it, now I want to buy it even more,' which led to many inquiries. This content marketing gave him a taste of the benefits of the 'sports + products' promotion, and also set the stage for the later introduction of the mountain-style functional trend.

subevent.name: Editing skiing video footage
subevent.description: On the evening of January 19, Lei Mingxuan used video editing software on his computer in his home study to edit the skiing footage into a 1-minute short video. He carefully added narration introducing the charm of outdoor sports and cleverly incorporated the windproof and waterproof selling points of the store's winter coats. During the editing process, he repeatedly adjusted the visuals and sound effects to ensure the video quality.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Short-video online publishing and interactive marketing.
subevent.description: On the evening of January 20, Lei Mingxuan published the one-minute short skiing video he had made to the clothing store's WeChat group and Moments, with a short caption. After the video was uploaded, it received many likes and comments. Regular customer Qian Duoduo commented, "Boss Lei is selling it himself, I want to buy it even more." Lei Mingxuan actively replied to customer comments, answered product questions, and facilitated multiple inquiries and subsequent sales.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

name: Interviewing a part-time store clerk
description: On the afternoon of January 21, Lei Mingxuan interviewed three candidates who had previously submitted resumes at the store, assessing their retail experience and knowledge of outdoor apparel. He ultimately selected a young man with sales experience in sports brands and agreed that he would join after the Chinese New Year, building up staffing in advance for the store upgrade.

subevent.name: Interviewing the first candidate
subevent.description: From 1:30 to 2:00 p.m., Lei Mingxuan received the first candidate (resume submitter A) at the store for a one-on-one interview. He asked in detail about the candidate's past retail work experience, understanding of outdoor apparel brands, sales skills, and availability. Candidate A showed some experience but lacked a sports brand background.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Interview the second candidate
subevent.description: From 2:00 to 2:30 p.m., Lei Mingxuan interviewed the second candidate (resume submitter B) in the store. He focused on the candidate’s sensitivity to fashion trends and communication skills. Candidate B had clothing sales experience but a slightly lower education level, and gave an average performance.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Interviewed the third candidate and impressed them
subevent.description: From 2:30 to 3:00 pm, Lei Mingxuan interviewed the third candidate (applicant C) in the store. The candidate was a young man who had worked as a sales associate at a well-known sports brand. He was passionate about outdoor functional apparel and had solid sales skills. Lei Mingxuan had an in-depth conversation with him about the store upgrade plan. The two talked happily, and he made a good impression on the spot.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Comprehensively evaluate and confirm hiring
subevent.description: From 3:00 to 3:30 p.m., Lei Mingxuan was alone in the store reviewing the performance of the three candidates. Weighing retail experience, sports-brand background, communication skills, and work attitude, he finally decided to hire the third candidate—a young man with experience in sports-brand sales—and planned to contact him to finalize the details for joining after the New Year.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Notify the hiring result
subevent.description: From 3:30 to 4:00 p.m., Lei Mingxuan called the young candidate he had hired, informed him that he had passed the interview, and briefly discussed the start date (tentatively the eighth day of the first lunar month after the Chinese New Year), salary and benefits, and job responsibilities. The candidate accepted and said he was looking forward to joining. At the same time, Lei Mingxuan politely sent rejection text messages to the other two candidates.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Sudden power outage at the mall and emergency response
description: On the morning of January 22, the mall where Lei Mingxuan worked experienced a sudden power trip due to aging electrical wiring, cutting off power to the entire floor and forcing the store to close. Property manager Zheng Kai organized emergency repairs, and it was expected to take two days. Lei Mingxuan used the closure time to organize inventory at home, analyze online operation strategies, and took the opportunity to discuss Moments promotion optimization with staff member Xiao Lin. On the afternoon of January 23, power was restored and the store resumed normal operations. Although the outage caused two days of revenue loss, it gave him firsthand experience in emergency management.

subevent.name: Sudden power outage at the mall and emergency communication
subevent.description: On the morning of January 22, the mall where Lei Mingxuan's clothing store was located suddenly lost power after the circuit breakers tripped due to aging wiring, cutting electricity to the entire floor and forcing the store to close. Lei Mingxuan immediately contacted Zheng Kai, the mall property manager, to find out what happened, and learned that emergency repairs were needed because of the aging circuits, with power expected to be restored in about two days. After coordinating with the property management to complete a power-safety inspection of the store, he decided to use the closure time to go home and handle work.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Organizing inventory at home and analyzing online operations
subevent.description: That afternoon and evening, Lei Mingxuan was in his home study, using the closure time to organize the store's inventory list, identify bestsellers and slow-moving items, and open his computer to analyze online operations data, studying how to boost sales through social media and online channels. He was also thinking about future strategies combining offline and online channels.
subevent.location: Shanghai, Pudong New Area - home study at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road

subevent.name: Discussed WeChat Moments promotion optimization with the store clerk
subevent.description: That evening, Lei Mingxuan had a video call with store assistant Lin Yue (Xiao Lin) via WeChat to discuss how to optimize the store's WeChat Moments promotion content, including image selection, copy, and posting times, and assigned specific tasks to be executed immediately after business resumed.
subevent.location: Home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (online)

subevent.name: Restore power and reopen the store for business
subevent.description: On the afternoon of January 23, the mall's power was restored. After receiving a notice from Zheng Kai, Lei Mingxuan rushed to the store, checked whether the electrical equipment and goods were damaged, and after confirming everything was normal, opened the store and resumed normal business. Although the accident caused a loss of two days' revenue, it gave him first-hand experience in emergency management and made him pay more attention to the store's safety plans.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning walk with father Lei Jianguo
description: On the morning of Saturday, January 10, Lei Mingxuan accompanied his father, Lei Jianguo, for a walk in Century Park in Pudong. Father and son talked about store operations and family financial plans; his father reminded him to sort out the accounts before Spring Festival, and Lei Mingxuan agreed to go home at the end of the month to organize them. After the walk, the two bought two cups of soy milk and fried rice cakes at the park gate and went home.

subevent.name: Got up in the morning and prepared to go out for a walk
subevent.description: At 6:30 a.m., Lei Mingxuan got up, washed up, changed into sportswear, put on his running shoes, and got ready to go for a walk with his father at Century Park.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

subevent.name: Heading to Century Park
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan and his father Lei Jianguo set off on foot from their home on Zhangyang Road, chatting about the day's plans along the way, and arrived at the entrance of Century Park in Pudong after about 15 minutes.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - Zhangyang Road to Century Park section

subevent.name: Walking and chatting in Century Park.
subevent.description: The father and son walked slowly along the lakeside path in Century Park for about 40 minutes. During the walk, Lei Jianguo asked with concern about the recent performance of the shop and reminded Lei Mingxuan to carefully sort out the accounts and recover funds before the Spring Festival. Lei Mingxuan listened carefully to the advice and said he would go home at the end of the month to organize the finances.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New District - Century Park

subevent.name: Buying breakfast after a walk
subevent.description: After the walk, Lei Mingxuan and his father stopped at a breakfast stall at the entrance of Century Park, bought two cups of fresh soy milk and two pieces of fried sticky rice cake, and Lei Mingxuan rushed to pay.
subevent.location: Breakfast stall at the entrance of Century Park, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Returned home to enjoy breakfast.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan and his father walked back to their home on Zhangyang Road carrying the breakfast they had bought. In the kitchen, he poured the soy milk into bowls and cut the fried sticky rice cake into small pieces. The two sat at the dining table, eating breakfast and continuing their chat.
subevent.location: Shanghai, Pudong New Area - home dining room

name: Ski preparation and equipment purchase
description: In early January, roller-skating partner Song Jia suggested going skiing in Anji on the weekend in the outdoor group. Attracted by the thrilling sense of speed, Lei Mingxuan immediately responded. Over the next week or so, he bought basic protective gear online, such as ski goggles and knee pads, and consulted his billiards friend Han Dong about how to mount a sports camera, preparing to shoot material.

subevent.name: Decided to participate and confirmed the preliminary itinerary.
subevent.description: After seeing Song Jia's proposal, Lei Mingxuan was drawn to the thrill of speed and immediately replied in the group chat to say he would join. He then privately messaged Song Jia to confirm the approximate departure time, meeting point, and ski resort choice, initially agreeing to leave on the weekend (January 11-12).
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Bought ski goggles, knee pads, and other basic protective gear online.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan searched for ski equipment on Taobao and JD.com, compared many brands and prices, and then placed an order for basic protective gear including ski goggles (anti-fog model), knee pads, and elbow pads. After placing the order, he waited for delivery.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Searching Taobao and ordering ski goggles
subevent.description: At home, Lei Mingxuan opened Taobao on his laptop, searched for keywords like ski goggles and protective gear, compared prices and reviews of several brands (such as Decathlon, Nanun, etc.), and finally placed an order for a pair of anti-fog ski goggles.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Searched on JD.com and ordered knee pads and elbow pads
subevent.description: At home, Lei Mingxuan searched for basic protective gear such as knee pads and elbow pads on the JD.com app, compared prices of different brands and bundle combinations, and finally purchased a set of cost-effective protective gear.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Confirm the order logistics and wait for delivery.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan opened Taobao and JD.com at home, checked the logistics status of his orders, confirmed the items had shipped and were out for delivery, and prepared to receive them.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Consulting Han Dong about how to mount the action camera.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan contacted his billiards friend Han Dong via WeChat to ask how to mount an action camera (GoPro) on a helmet or ski goggles to shoot first-person skiing videos. Han Dong shared his own mounting bracket setup and usage experience, and recommended an online shopping link.
subevent.location: Online - WeChat chat

subevent.name: Received the protective gear bought online and tried it on to check
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan received the ski goggles, knee pads, and other gear he had bought online. He tried them on and adjusted them in the living room, confirmed that the sizes fit and the functions worked properly, then packed them into his backpack as final preparation for the weekend ski trip.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Passing by a pour-over coffee equipment shop and developing an interest
description: On February 12 (Lantern Festival), Lei Mingxuan passed by a hand-brewed coffee equipment store. Attracted by beautifully designed drip filters and other tools, he curiously went in to browse but didn't buy anything, thinking to himself, 'This set of drip filters looks like an industrial design piece—pretty interesting.' It planted a seed for his future exploration of coffee skills.

subevent.name: Passed by a coffee equipment store while out for a walk.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of February 12, Lantern Festival, Lei Mingxuan was walking along a commercial street in Pudong New Area, Shanghai. Passing a pour-over coffee equipment store, he was drawn to the uniquely shaped dripper and pour-over kettle in the window and stopped to look.
subevent.location: Commercial Street, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Enter the store to look at coffee equipment.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan walked into the store out of curiosity, carefully looked at the different styles of pour-over drippers, server carafes, pour-over kettles, and other equipment on display, briefly chatted with the staff about the design and use of the equipment, but did not buy anything.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area Pour-over Coffee Equipment Store

subevent.name: Got interested in coffee equipment
subevent.description: After leaving the store, Lei Mingxuan thought this dripper set was like an industrial design piece and found it quite interesting, which sparked the idea of trying pour-over coffee himself one day, planting a seed for future exploration of coffee skills.
subevent.location: Commercial Street, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Chinese New Year's Eve family reunion dinner
description: In the afternoon of Chinese New Year's Eve, his mother, Wang Xiuying, was preparing the reunion dinner at home in Pudong, specially making dishes such as Shanghai-style braised pork and pan-fried buns that Lei Mingxuan loves. On the night of Chinese New Year's Eve, Lei Mingxuan sat with his parents enjoying the reunion dinner, drank a few cups of yellow wine with his father, and listened to his mother talk about his cousin Shen Jie's new job. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.

subevent.name: Mother prepares the New Year's Eve dinner.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of Chinese New Year's Eve, his mother Wang Xiuying was busy in the kitchen of their home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, preparing the New Year's Eve dinner. She specially prepared Lei Mingxuan's favorite Shanghai-style braised pork and pan-fried buns, along with other sumptuous dishes, to get ready for the family reunion.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: The whole family sits around the table for the New Year's Eve dinner
subevent.description: On Chinese New Year's Eve, Lei Mingxuan, along with his father Lei Jianguo and mother Wang Xiuying, sat around the table in the dining room at their home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, sharing the New Year's Eve dinner carefully prepared by his mother. During the meal, Lei Mingxuan had a few glasses of yellow wine with his father, while his mother Wang Xiuying talked about the new job of her cousin Shen Jie. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Arranged a dinner with childhood friend Zhang Wei and discussed the store renovation plan
description: On January 10, 2025, Lei Mingxuan contacted his childhood friend Zhang Wei on WeChat and arranged to meet for dinner on the evening of the 11th at a hot pot restaurant near Century Avenue in Pudong New Area to exchange ideas about store operations. On the evening of the 11th, the two had an in-depth discussion at the hot pot restaurant. Zhang Wei suggested building a personal IP and using short videos to attract customers, and reminded him to reserve a budget of 200,000-300,000 yuan. Lei Mingxuan was deeply inspired. After returning home that night, he recorded the key points and made a preliminary plan for the renovation.

subevent.name: Arranged to have dinner with Zhang Wei.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan contacted his childhood friend Zhang Wei on WeChat to discuss the time and place for a dinner. The two finally agreed to meet on the evening of January 11, 2025, at a hotpot restaurant near Century Avenue in Pudong New Area, and planned to use the gathering to exchange ideas about store management.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Home (WeChat online)

subevent.name: Discussing the store renovation plan during the group meal.
subevent.description: During the hot pot meal, Lei Mingxuan gave Zhang Wei a detailed account of the recent decline in store foot traffic. Zhang Wei suggested he build a personal IP and attract young customers through short-video platforms (such as Douyin and Xiaohongshu), and reminded him that a comprehensive store upgrade might require reserving a budget of 200,000 to 300,000 yuan. The two exchanged in-depth views on renovation styles, online operation strategies, and more. Lei Mingxuan was deeply inspired and decided to carefully plan the upgrade.
subevent.location: Shanghai - a hotpot restaurant on Century Avenue, Pudong New District

subevent.name: After going home, record the key points and make a preliminary plan
subevent.description: After the dinner ended around 9 p.m., Lei Mingxuan returned home. He immediately opened his laptop in the study, wrote down Zhang Wei's key suggestions (building a personal IP, budget range), and began searching for operational case studies on short-video platforms, making a preliminary estimate of the funds and time needed for the store renovation. He also listed a simple action plan: inspect the decor of other trendy stores next week and consult supplier Zhou Tao about information on the new fabrics.
subevent.location: Home study, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Made an appointment with store clerk Xiao Lin and had lunch together to discuss store upgrades
description: On Friday afternoon, Lei Mingxuan arranged with Xiao Lin at the store to have a simple meal at the mall food court after the evening rush hour. After the rush, the two chatted while eating. Lei Mingxuan asked Xiao Lin for his views on upgrading the store. Xiao Lin suggested strengthening online promotion and shared what young customers like. Lei Mingxuan encouraged Xiao Lin to take part in the upcoming renovation, and their relationship shifted from boss-employee to partners.

subevent.name: Agreed on lunch time and place.
subevent.description: On Friday afternoon, Lei Mingxuan agreed with store clerk Xiao Lin verbally or via WeChat to have a simple meal together in the mall's fast-food area during the break after the evening rush hour, and to discuss store upgrade matters.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - inside a mall on Century Avenue

subevent.name: Had lunch together and discussed store upgrades.
subevent.description: After the evening rush hour on Friday, Lei Mingxuan chatted with clerk Xiao Lin over a simple meal in the mall's fast-food area. Lei Mingxuan seriously asked Xiao Lin for his opinion on the store upgrade. Xiao Lin suggested strengthening online promotion and shared what young customers liked. Lei Mingxuan encouraged Xiao Lin to participate in the later renovation, and the relationship between the two shifted from superior-subordinate to partners.
subevent.location: Shanghai – Pudong New Area – fast-food court in a shopping mall on Century Avenue

name: High school classmates reunited during the Spring Festival.
description: On the evening of January 31, Lei Mingxuan, Liu Yang, and Chen Hao gathered at a Shanghai-style restaurant in Pudong New District. As they toasted one another, they recalled embarrassing moments on the high school basketball court and funny stories about their homeroom teacher. Chen Hao shared examples of internet product iteration, Liu Yang talked about his experience with IP collaborations in game development, and Lei Mingxuan spoke about how his shop was doing and the writing plan he had recently come up with. Liu Yang mentioned that his game company was looking for a supplier for IP collaborations in Chinese-style apparel, thought Lei Mingxuan's shop might be worth a try, and encouraged him to expand online. After dinner, the three walked to the playground of their renovated alma mater and took a group photo beside the basketball stand where they used to play. In the early morning, they said goodbye and each went home, agreeing to meet again soon.

subevent.name: Had dinner with high school classmates at a restaurant to catch up.
subevent.description: On the evening of January 31, 2025, Lei Mingxuan met for dinner with high school classmates Liu Yang, who had returned to Shanghai from Shenzhen, and Chen Hao, who had returned from Hangzhou, at a Shanghainese restaurant in Pudong New Area, Shanghai. The three toasted and reminisced about embarrassing moments on the basketball court and funny anecdotes about their homeroom teacher in high school. Chen Hao shared cases of internet product iteration, Liu Yang talked about IP collaboration experience in game development, and Lei Mingxuan talked about the operation of his clothing store and his budding writing plan. Liu Yang also mentioned that his game company was looking for suppliers for Chinese-style apparel co-branding and encouraged Lei Mingxuan to expand his online business. The dinner lasted about two hours, with a lively and pleasant atmosphere.
subevent.location: A local Shanghainese restaurant in Pudong New District, Shanghai.

subevent.name: After dinner, took a walk to his alma mater's playground and took a group photo.
subevent.description: After the dinner gathering, Lei Mingxuan, Liu Yang, and Chen Hao walk together to the renovated alma mater high school (located in Pudong New Area, Shanghai). The three stroll to the playground, stand by the basketball hoop where they used to play, recall their high school days, and take a group photo on their phones. During this time they also talk about the school's changes in recent years and their respective life updates. The whole process takes about forty minutes.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area: a middle school playground

subevent.name: Late-night gathering ends, everyone returns home
subevent.description: In the early morning hours, Lei Mingxuan said goodbye to Liu Yang and Chen Hao at the gate of their alma mater. After exchanging New Year greetings, they each took transportation back to their residences: Liu Yang returned to his home on Jinqiao Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai; Chen Hao went to his temporary accommodation in Shanghai (or a relative's or friend's home); Lei Mingxuan walked back to his home at Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road. Although it was already late at night, all three felt the reunion had been very enjoyable and agreed to meet again.
subevent.location: Streets in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and their respective homes

name: Play basketball with basketball buddies.
description: On Saturday afternoon, Lei Mingxuan left home for Yuanshen Sports Center, where he played a basketball game with his ball-playing friends including Xie Fei. Afterward, he returned home to clean up and relax, exercising, relieving stress, and enjoying the fun of sports and socializing.

subevent.name: Pre-departure preparations
subevent.description: On Saturday afternoon, Lei Mingxuan, at his home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, changed into his sportswear and basketball shoes, checked his equipment including the basketball, water bottle, and towel, confirmed his phone had enough battery, and prepared to go to Yuanshen Sports Center to play basketball.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

subevent.name: Going to Yuanshen Sports Center
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan set out from home on foot or by car, heading along Zhangyang Road to the outdoor basketball court at Yuanshen Sports Center in Pudong New Area, a trip of about 15 minutes. On the way, he thought about the meeting time agreed with his basketball buddy Xie Fei.
subevent.location: On the way to Yuanshen Sports Center, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Play a basketball scrimmage
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan, Xie Fei, and other basketball buddies split into groups for half-court 4-on-4 or full-court 5-on-5 competitive games. In about 2 hours of intense play, they fully exercised, released stress, and enjoyed the fun of sports socializing.
subevent.location: Outdoor basketball court, Yuanshen Sports Center, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Return home.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan left Yuanshen Sports Center and returned along the same route to his home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area. On the way, he bought a sports drink at a convenience store to replenish his energy and arrived home in the evening.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - on the way from Yuanshen Sports Center to home

subevent.name: Post-workout cleanup and relaxation
subevent.description: After returning home, Lei Mingxuan took a hot shower, changed into clean clothes, and put his sports gear away. He then rested in the living room and had fruit salad to complete his post-exercise relaxation and recovery.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

name: Part-time staff recruitment launch and initial screening
description: To implement his plan for upgrading the store, Lei Mingxuan decided to add staff. On January 20, 2025, in his home study, he drafted the part-time recruitment requirements, including working hours, skill requirements (retail experience, with preference for those interested in outdoor gear or clothing), and salary package, and checked his recruitment platform account. He then edited and published a part-time store clerk job posting on major recruitment platforms (such as BOSS Zhipin and 51job). The next day (January 21), he screened the resumes he received, selected qualified candidates, and prepared to arrange interviews.

subevent.name: Draft part-time recruitment requirements
subevent.description: Based on his store upgrade plan, Lei Mingxuan considered that he needed to add part-time staff familiar with trendy clothing who could receive customers. In his home study, he drafted the recruitment requirements, including working hours, skill requirements (retail experience, interest in outdoor wear or clothing), salary and benefits, and checked the status of his account on the recruitment platform to prepare for posting.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - home study

subevent.name: Posted recruitment information for part-time store staff
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan edited and posted a part-time store clerk job posting on mainstream recruitment platforms (such as BOSS Zhipin and 51job). The job description included work duties, qualifications, salary and benefits, etc., and he set resume submission rules to add staff for the upcoming store renovation.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - home study

subevent.name: Initial screening and resume submission
subevent.description: After the job posting was released, Lei Mingxuan gradually received application resumes. He spent time in his home study reviewing the applicants' information, shortlisting candidates who met the requirements (retail experience, interest in outdoor wear or clothing), and planned to contact them later to arrange interviews.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - home study

name: Store year-end inventory review and strategic thinking on breaking new ground
description: On January 1, 2025, Lei Mingxuan organized the full-year 2024 sales data in his clothing store and created summary tables; on January 2, he analyzed the data and, by comparing with 2023, found that the sales growth rate had declined and the profit margin had fallen by about 5%, realizing that the traditional offline retail model had hit a bottleneck; on January 3, based on these conclusions, he thought repeatedly and drafted breakthrough strategies such as introducing live-streaming sales, adjusting product selection, and membership offers, planning to conduct further research.

subevent.name: Compile 2024 sales data
subevent.description: At the clothing store on the 2nd floor of a mall on Century Avenue in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Lei Mingxuan spent the whole day exporting and organizing the full-year 2024 sales data, purchase costs, and profit details from the cash register system and supplier reports, compiling them into a summary table to prepare for subsequent analysis.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - Shop A-208, 2nd floor of a shopping mall on Century Avenue (clothing store)

subevent.name: Sales data analysis shows sluggish growth
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan carefully analyzed the 2024 sales data table he had organized the previous day. By comparing it with the same period in 2023, he found that the sales growth rate had dropped significantly and the profit margin had fallen by about 5%. He realized that the traditional offline retail model had hit a bottleneck, and that the loss of regular customers and slow growth of new customers were the main reasons.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - Shop A-208, 2nd floor of a shopping mall on Century Avenue (clothing store)

subevent.name: Thinking about strategies for the store to break through and grow
subevent.description: Based on data analysis conclusions, Lei Mingxuan repeatedly thought about new growth points in the store, including introducing live-streaming e-commerce, adjusting product selection strategies, launching member repeat-purchase discounts, or holding offline community activities. He briefly recorded his draft ideas and planned to conduct deeper research later.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - Shop A-208, 2nd floor of a shopping mall on Century Avenue (clothing store)

name: Bought camping gear at the market and got an initial introduction to outdoor knowledge.
description: On February 1, Lei Mingxuan was attracted by lightweight camping gear at the outdoor market along the Pudong riverfront and bought a beginner tent and stove. That evening, he showed his new gear to his sports buddy Han Dong in a WeChat group. From February 2 to 3, he learned basic knowledge such as setting up camp and making fire through video websites. He happened to see an outdoor pour-over coffee video and felt that 'brewing coffee and selecting fabric textures have something in common,' which sparked his interest in outdoor coffee.

subevent.name: Stroll the outdoor market at Pudong Riverside
subevent.description: On February 1, while wandering around the outdoor market on the Pudong riverside, Lei Mingxuan was drawn to a booth selling lightweight camping gear. After carefully comparing and consulting the vendor, he decided to buy an entry-level tent and a portable stove set in preparation for future outdoor activities.
subevent.location: Shanghai – Pudong Riverside Outdoor Market

subevent.name: Showed off his new gear to his ball-game friends in the WeChat group.
subevent.description: That evening, in the billiards friends WeChat group, Lei Mingxuan showed photos of the tent and stove he had just bought to his billiards friends including Han Dong, shared his shopping experience at the market and the features of the equipment, and discussed the possibility of going camping together in the future.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Learn camping setup and fire-making skills
subevent.description: On February 2, Lei Mingxuan used his free time to search and watch beginner camping tutorials on video websites (such as Bilibili), focusing on the correct steps for setting up a tent, site selection tips, and various outdoor fire-starting methods (such as using a fire starter, lighter, etc.), and noted down key points.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Discovered outdoor pour-over coffee and became interested in it
subevent.description: On February 3, Lei Mingxuan continued watching outdoor skills videos and happened to see a tutorial on outdoor pour-over coffee. Attracted by its simple equipment and ritual-filled process, he thought of the fabric texture judgment he used when selecting materials for his store and felt the two had something in common, so he saved the video and began following information about coffee equipment.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

name: Preparing for and holding the high school classmates' Spring Festival gathering
description: On January 27, Chen Hao proposed a gathering in the high school trio's WeChat group; Liu Yang and Lei Mingxuan responded, and they agreed to meet on the evening of January 31 at a local Shanghainese restaurant in Pudong. Liu Yang would bring the latest designer toy news from Shenzhen, and Lei Mingxuan would host. On January 28, Liu Yang organized designer toy new-product materials and expo videos at his home in Shenzhen, preparing to share them at the gathering. On the evening of January 31, the three met as planned at the Pudong Shanghainese restaurant, exchanged New Year greetings, and enjoyed local specialties. Liu Yang shared designer toy news, Lei Mingxuan talked about how his store was doing, and Chen Hao shared internet industry updates from Hangzhou. The gathering lasted about three hours. Lei Mingxuan paid the bill, and the three agreed to meet again next year.

subevent.name: Initiated a discussion about a get-together in the WeChat group.
subevent.description: Chen Hao proposed in the group named "Pudong Three Musketeers" (actually a WeChat group for three high school classmates) to meet up in Shanghai during the Spring Festival. Lei Mingxuan and Liu Yang immediately responded. The three then discussed it in the group and finally agreed to meet on the evening of January 31 (the third day of Chinese New Year) at a Shanghainese restaurant in Pudong. Liu Yang said he would bring the latest designer toy news from Shenzhen, and Lei Mingxuan volunteered to host and treat everyone. The whole discussion lasted about half an hour and finalized the meeting time, place, and initial plan.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Online WeChat group

subevent.name: Liu Yang prepares trendy toy information materials.
subevent.description: At his home in Shenzhen, Liu Yang organized recently collected introductions to new designer toys and exhibition photos, including sample images of several Pop Mart collaboration blind boxes not yet officially released in China, as well as on-site videos from the Shenzhen Designer Toy Exhibition. He classified and packaged them into electronic documents, planning to share them with Lei Mingxuan and Chen Hao at a gathering, especially Lei Mingxuan, who as a designer toy collector was very interested.
subevent.location: Guangdong Province, Shenzhen - Liu Yang's home

subevent.name: Three-Person Spring Festival Gathering Execution
subevent.description: On the evening of the third day of the Chinese New Year, Lei Mingxuan, Chen Hao, and Liu Yang gathered as planned in a private room at a local Shanghainese restaurant in Pudong. The three first exchanged New Year greetings, then chatted about recent news while savoring specialties such as Shanghainese braised pork and pan-fried buns. Liu Yang shared designer toy news and collecting insights he had brought, Lei Mingxuan talked about interesting stories from running his store and future upgrade plans, and Chen Hao shared updates on Hangzhou's internet industry. The gathering lasted about three hours with a lively atmosphere. Lei Mingxuan paid the bill as agreed, and the three agreed to meet again next Spring Festival.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - a local Shanghainese restaurant

name: Establish a Special Fund for Store Renovation
description: After his cousin Shen Jie suggested transitioning to an outdoor style, Lei Mingxuan had an in-depth discussion with Shen Jie at the store during the day on January 30, 2025, and decided to set up a special fund to support the renovation. That evening, at home, he used mobile banking to open a new demand deposit account and deposited 150,000 yuan as initial funds. The next day, during his lunch break at the store, he formulated a supplementary plan: to redeem 50,000 yuan from a fund in mid-February and cut unnecessary expenses, bringing the special fund to 250,000 yuan before the renovation in March.

subevent.name: Communicated transition suggestions with cousin Shen Jie
subevent.description: During the day, at Shen Jie's suggestion, Lei Mingxuan had an in-depth discussion with his visiting cousin Shen Jie at his store in a mall on Century Avenue in Pudong New Area about the direction of the store's transformation. Based on fashion industry trends, Shen Jie suggested that Lei Mingxuan transform the store's style toward outdoor functional clothing. Lei Mingxuan agreed with the suggestion and decided to set up dedicated funding to support the transformation.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Opened a dedicated fund account and made an initial deposit.
subevent.description: That evening, Lei Mingxuan returned to his home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area. Using mobile banking (ICBC app), he opened a new demand deposit account and transferred 150,000 yuan of his savings from his regular account to the new account as special funds for the store's upgrade and transformation. After the transfer, he took a screenshot to save the receipt.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home Study

subevent.name: Formulated a follow-up plan to replenish funds.
subevent.description: The next day, during his lunch break at the store, Lei Mingxuan used the memo app on his phone to organize a supplementary funding plan: he planned to redeem 50,000 yuan from an index fund he had previously invested in by mid-February, while cutting unnecessary personal spending (such as pausing new designer toy collecting and eating out less often), so that before the renovation started in March, the special fund would be topped up to 250,000 yuan. He took a screenshot of the plan and sent it to himself for reference.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lantern Festival family reunion
description: On February 12, the Lantern Festival, Lei Mingxuan went to the supermarket in the afternoon to buy ingredients for tangyuan. In the evening, he prepared dinner with his parents at home and boiled tangyuan. At night, the family sat together to eat tangyuan. During the meal, he shared his ideas for transforming the clothing store. After dinner, his mother urged him to get married by citing a neighbor's wedding, and Lei Mingxuan changed the subject by sharing fun stories about outdoor camping. The atmosphere was relaxed and warm.

subevent.name: Buy ingredients for tangyuan
subevent.description: On the afternoon of February 12, Lei Mingxuan went to a supermarket near his home in Pudong New Area and selected ingredients such as frozen tangyuan, glutinous rice flour, and red bean paste to prepare for the Lantern Festival family reunion that evening.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New District - supermarket near home

subevent.name: Cooking tangyuan and setting the table
subevent.description: In the evening, Lei Mingxuan and his mother Wang Xiuying cooked tangyuan together in the kitchen, while his father Lei Jianguo helped set out the bowls, chopsticks, and the table. The three of them divided the work and soon prepared the Lantern Festival dinner.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - Home kitchen and dining room

subevent.name: Lantern Festival dinner and store transformation sharing
subevent.description: In the evening, Lei Mingxuan sat at the dining table with his parents, eating steaming hot tangyuan and chatting. Lei Mingxuan explained in detail his idea of transforming the clothing store into an integrated online-offline model, including introducing new brands and expanding online channels. His parents listened carefully and gave him encouragement.
subevent.location: Shanghai, Pudong New Area - home dining room

subevent.name: After-dinner chat: pressure to get married and camping anecdotes
subevent.description: After the meal, his mother Wang Xiuying brought up the news that the neighbor's son was getting married and took the opportunity to indirectly ask Lei Mingxuan about his personal life. Sensing this, Lei Mingxuan cleverly turned the topic to the outdoor camping event he had recently planned, sharing some interesting preparations and experiences, successfully diverting the conversation. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cook a gratitude dinner for parents on Valentine's Day
description: On Valentine's Day, February 14, Lei Mingxuan deliberately closed the store early and went to the market to buy ingredients, clumsily recreating his mother's braised pork and pan-fried buns. His mother tried to step in several times, but he smiled and persuaded her not to. When his father came home, he was surprised and moved. The braised pork was a little sweet and the pan-fried buns were slightly burnt on the bottom, but his parents ate with great satisfaction. His mother's eyes moistened as she said, 'My son has grown up.'

subevent.name: Close the shop and buy ingredients
subevent.description: On the afternoon of Valentine's Day 2025, Lei Mingxuan closed his clothing store early and went to a vegetable market near Pudong New Area. He carefully selected and bought pork belly and seasonings for red-braised pork, as well as flour, ground meat, scallions, ginger, and other ingredients for pan-fried buns, to prepare for that evening's gratitude dinner.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - vegetable market

subevent.name: Cook braised pork belly and pan-fried buns
subevent.description: In the evening, Lei Mingxuan started cooking in the kitchen. From memory, he recreated his mother's method: first braised pork belly, then made pan-fried buns. The finished braised pork was slightly sweet, and the bottom of the pan-fried buns was a little charred, but the whole meal was made with his heart and was completed successfully.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home kitchen.

subevent.name: Have a gratitude dinner with parents.
subevent.description: In the evening, Father Lei Jianguo came home from work and was surprised and moved to see the sumptuous dinner prepared on the table. The family of three sat around the table, enjoying the braised pork and pan-fried buns made by Lei Mingxuan's own hands. His parents ate with great satisfaction. His mother Wang Xiuying's eyes welled up as she said with emotion, “My son has grown up.” The meal was filled with warmth and touching moments.
subevent.location: Shanghai, Pudong New Area - home dining room

subevent.name: After-dinner cleanup and family conversation.
subevent.description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to clear the dishes and tidy the kitchen, then sat in the living room with his parents for a while, chatting about the shop's recent situation, daily trivialities, and feelings about Valentine's Day. The family was immersed in a happy atmosphere, further deepening their bonds.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Fabric sample selection for mountain-style techwear
description: On January 10, 2025, Lei Mingxuan had a video call with Hangzhou supplier Zhou Tao to discuss introducing mountain-style functional fabrics. Zhou Tao agreed to send samples. On January 16, Lei Mingxuan signed for the sample package at his store. On January 17, Lei Mingxuan tested and evaluated the samples, initially shortlisting 3 candidate fabrics.

subevent.name: Video call with supplier Zhou Tao to discuss mountain-style techwear fabric samples.
subevent.description: On January 10, 2025, Lei Mingxuan, in his clothing store on the second floor of a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, had a video call via WeChat with Hangzhou supplier Zhou Tao (partner of Taosheng Apparel Co., Ltd.) to discuss in detail the feasibility of introducing mountain-style technical fabrics. Zhou Tao showed sample images and performance parameters of several waterproof and abrasion-resistant fabrics. The two exchanged views on pricing, minimum order quantity, and market prospects. In the end, Zhou Tao agreed to provide fabric samples and promised to send them to the store within a week. Lei Mingxuan planned to start selecting products after receiving the samples.
subevent.location: Shanghai - own clothing store

subevent.name: Lei Mingxuan signed for the fabric sample package
subevent.description: On January 16, 2025, Lei Mingxuan signed for an SF Express parcel from Zhou Tao at his clothing store on the 2nd floor of a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai. He opened the package on the spot and checked that the number of samples matched the list Zhou Tao had sent via WeChat. After confirming all fabric samples were intact, he took photos for the record. He then stored the samples temporarily in the store's shelf area, ready for detailed selection the next day.
subevent.location: Shanghai - own clothing store

subevent.name: Lei Mingxuan evaluated the samples and made an initial product selection.
subevent.description: On January 17, 2025, at his own clothing store, Lei Mingxuan laid out the five techwear-style fabric samples he had received one by one on the workbench. He tested their water resistance and durability by touching, stretching, and dripping water on them, and compared whether the colors and textures matched the current mountain-style trend. Based on the store's customer profile and summer new product plans, he initially selected three fabrics as candidates, recorded his product selection opinions and styling suggestions on his phone, and planned to discuss formal ordering with Zhou Tao later.
subevent.location: Shanghai - own clothing store

name: Take my parents out for a walk and have a heart-to-heart talk
description: On the morning of February 10, Lei Mingxuan noticed his parents were tired, so he took the initiative to propose and accompany his father Lei Jianguo and mother Wang Xiuying from their home in Pudong New Area to the nearby Century Park for a walk. On a park bench, he sincerely apologized for his impulsiveness during the marriage-urging argument last month, and shared his plan to transform his shop and his interest in camping, saying he would give serious thought to the major matters in life. His parents were deeply moved. His mother Wang Xiuying held his hand and said, "As long as you are safe and happy, that's enough." The family atmosphere noticeably eased. Afterwards, the three continued walking for a while and then walked home together in a warm and harmonious mood.

subevent.name: Propose and Prepare for a Walk
subevent.description: On the morning of February 10, 2025, at his home (No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai), Lei Mingxuan noticed that his father Lei Jianguo and mother Wang Xiuying seemed tired from household chores, and took the initiative to suggest taking them to nearby Century Park for a relaxing walk. His parents readily agreed, and after a quick tidy-up, the three got ready to head out.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

subevent.name: Walking to Century Park
subevent.description: On the morning of February 10, 2025, Lei Mingxuan set out from home with his father Lei Jianguo and mother Wang Xiuying, walking along Zhangyang Road to the nearby Century Park. On the way, the three chatted casually and the atmosphere was relaxed.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - Zhangyang Road, Century Park entrance.

subevent.name: Having a heart-to-heart apology on a park bench.
subevent.description: On the morning of February 10, 2025, Lei Mingxuan and his parents arrived at Century Park and sat down on a quiet bench. Lei Mingxuan sincerely apologized to his parents for the argument last month over their urging him to get married, and proactively shared his plan for the upcoming brand transformation of his clothing store, as well as his new interest in camping in western Sichuan. He said he would seriously consider major life decisions and no longer let his parents worry. His father, Lei Jianguo, nodded in understanding; his mother, Wang Xiuying, was moved and held Lei Mingxuan's hand, saying, "As long as you are safe and happy, that's enough." The family atmosphere noticeably eased.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New District - Century Park

subevent.name: Returned home after a walk.
subevent.description: After the heart-to-heart talk, Lei Mingxuan, together with his father Lei Jianguo and mother Wang Xiuying, continued walking for a while in Century Park, enjoying the winter sunshine. Then the three walked back together to their home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
subevent.location: Century Park, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to home

name: Catching up on anime and organizing blind boxes
description: On the evening of February 22, after finishing a day's work, Lei Mingxuan returned home. He first brewed a cup of hot tea, then sat on the living room sofa and watched new anime episodes. After watching a few episodes, he took out his collection of Pop Mart blind boxes, rearranged and displayed the hidden figure he had recently pulled, and took photos to share in the trendy toy group. This quiet evening made him feel relaxed and satisfied, and rekindled his passion for anime and collecting.

subevent.name: Returned home and prepared to brew tea.
subevent.description: After finishing a day's work at the clothing store on the evening of February 22, Lei Mingxuan returned to his home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai. After resting for a while, he took out his favorite tea leaves, brewed a cup of hot tea, and prepared for the leisure time ahead.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Watch new anime
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan sat down on the living room sofa, turned on his computer or TV while drinking hot tea, and started watching the latest Japanese anime he had been following, immersing himself in the exciting plot and enjoying a relaxing evening.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Organize blind boxes and rearrange the display.
subevent.description: After watching a few episodes of anime, Lei Mingxuan took out his collection of Pop Mart blind boxes, including a recent hidden style. In front of the display cabinet in his study or bedroom, he carefully rearranged and displayed the blind boxes by theme or preference, adjusting their positions to make the display more attractive, while handling and admiring his collection.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Take photos and share them to the trendy toy group.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan used his phone to take photos of the rearranged blind boxes, especially close-ups of the hidden style. Then he opened WeChat and shared the photos to his designer toy collector group (including fellow collectors like Lin Jing), adding a text description of his recent blind box unboxing experiences, and interacted with the group members.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

name: Hangzhou product selection advances the mountain-style transformation
description: From February 17 to 18, Lei Mingxuan went to Hangzhou to meet with supplier Zhou Tao and select the first batch of mountain-style techwear clothing samples, including shell jackets and multi-pocket cargo pants. The two discussed fabric performance and pricing in detail, and Zhou Tao promised to prioritize supplying new styles. That evening, Lei Mingxuan met his cousin Yang Fan near West Lake for Japanese ramen, catching up on each other's lives and asking some technical questions about online operations. The next day, he returned to Shanghai, bringing several samples with him.

subevent.name: Meeting supplier Zhou Tao to select products
subevent.description: After arriving in Hangzhou, Lei Mingxuan went to Hangzhou Taosheng Apparel Co., Ltd., where Zhou Tao was, and met with the supplier Zhou Tao. The two jointly selected the first batch of mountain-style functional clothing samples, including styles such as shell jackets and multi-pocket cargo pants, and discussed in detail fabric performance, pricing strategy, and supply priority. Zhou Tao promised to prioritize supplying the new styles and displayed some samples on site.
subevent.location: Hangzhou - Xiaoshan District, Hangzhou Taosheng Garments Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Dinner with cousin Yang Fan to discuss operational issues.
subevent.description: That evening, Lei Mingxuan met his cousin Yang Fan, and the two had dinner at a Japanese ramen restaurant in Xihu District. During the meal, Lei Mingxuan shared his store transformation plan, and Yang Fan gave practical advice on technical issues in online operations, such as optimizing the store's mini program and social media traffic-generation strategies. They also caught up on their recent lives and work.
subevent.location: A Japanese ramen shop in Xihu District, Hangzhou

subevent.name: Returning to Shanghai and organizing samples
subevent.description: The next day, Lei Mingxuan took several mountain-style utility samples (jackets, cargo pants, etc.) obtained from Zhou Tao and took the high-speed rail from Hangzhou back to Shanghai. After returning to his clothing store in the Century Avenue mall in Pudong New Area, he immediately sorted out the samples, checked fabric details, and planned the follow-up display and sales strategy, laying a physical foundation for the store's mountain-style transformation.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area, Century Avenue Mall, own clothing store

name: Annual investment review and asset rebalancing
description: On the afternoon of Friday, February 28, Lei Mingxuan met with financial advisor Xu Feng at a café in Xuhui District for an annual investment review. Xu Feng showed him a chart of last year's returns for the funds he held and suggested cutting the excessively high technology sector allocation to below 15% and increasing allocations to conservative hybrid funds and bond funds. After thinking it over, Lei Mingxuan decided to redeem some of the profitable technology-themed funds and reallocate them into a balanced portfolio. The two also briefly mentioned the funds that might be needed for the store upgrade, and Xu Feng reminded him to reserve liquidity. That evening, after returning home, Lei Mingxuan carried out the redemption and subscription transactions via mobile banking, completed the asset reallocation, and sent a screenshot of the new portfolio to Xu Feng for confirmation.

subevent.name: Met with Xu Feng at a café for an investment review
subevent.description: On the afternoon of February 28, 2025, Lei Mingxuan went to a reserved café in Xuhui District to meet with his financial advisor Xu Feng. Based on the holdings data Lei Mingxuan provided, Xu Feng showed the yield curve charts for each fund from the past year and pointed out that the technology sector accounted for too large a share, recommending reducing it to below 15% while increasing allocation to conservative balanced funds and bond funds. After listening carefully to the analysis, Lei Mingxuan decided to redeem part of his profitable technology-themed funds and reallocate them into a balanced portfolio. The two also briefly discussed the funds that might be needed for the store upgrade, and Xu Feng reminded Lei Mingxuan to reserve sufficient liquidity. The entire meeting lasted about two hours in a rational and relaxed atmosphere.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Xuhui District - a cafe

subevent.name: Execute asset reallocation
subevent.description: On the evening of February 28, 2025, Lei Mingxuan returned home and, following the plan agreed with Xu Feng that afternoon, used the mobile banking app to redeem the profitable portion of his technology-themed fund holdings and purchased a stable mixed fund and a bond fund recommended by Xu Feng. At the same time, he adjusted the holding ratios of the funds in his account to ensure the technology sector's share dropped to below 15%. After completing the operations, Lei Mingxuan sent a screenshot of the new portfolio to Xu Feng via WeChat for confirmation, and noted the amount of working capital reserved.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home Study

name: Explore and research mountain-style techwear and coffee culture, and preliminarily formulate store renovation ideas.
description: On January 13, regular customer Qian Duoduo came to the shop and shared her mountain-style techwear outfits and coffee check-in experiences, and Lei Mingxuan became very interested. That evening, Lei Mingxuan did in-depth online research into the related style and coffee culture. The next day, he further asked Qian Duoduo via WeChat about styling details, brand recommendations, and coffee shop operation advice, and discussed the feasibility of combining them with the shop. On January 15, based on the research and conversations, Lei Mingxuan drafted a preliminary renovation plan at the shop to introduce a mountain-style techwear clothing line and a coffee bar.

subevent.name: Qian Duoduo visits the store to share mountain-style techwear and coffee culture
subevent.description: Regular customer Qian Duoduo came to Lei Mingxuan's clothing store at A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, showed photos on her phone of mountain-style techwear outfits, and shared her recent check-in visits to several specialty coffee shops in Pudong New Area, Shanghai. The two discussed in the store how outdoor-style fashion and the coffee experience could blend. Lei Mingxuan became very interested and casually expressed a longing for coffee culture.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Lei Mingxuan searched online for mountain-style techwear and coffee culture
subevent.description: After returning home that evening, Lei Mingxuan sat in his study at his home in Pudong New Area, browsing platforms such as Xiaohongshu and Zhihu on his phone and laptop. He searched for outfit tutorials for mountain-style techwear brands (such as Arc'teryx and The North Face) and business models for coffee culture (such as pour-over coffee and neighborhood coffee shops), reading relevant articles and watching videos to gain a deeper understanding of market trends and the potential for integration.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - home study

subevent.name: Lei Mingxuan had an in-depth WeChat exchange with Qian Duoduo.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan contacted Qian Duoduo via WeChat to ask further questions about specific styling details and fabric features of the mountain-style functional look, as well as café operating experience. Qian Duoduo enthusiastically shared several brand recommendations they had purchased and the addresses of cafés they frequented, and suggested that Lei Mingxuan could set up a coffee bar area in the store or introduce outdoor installations. The two also discussed how to combine this style with the store's current positioning.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Online

subevent.name: Lei Mingxuan initially conceived a plan for remodeling the shop
subevent.description: Combining the collected materials and suggestions from relatives and friends, Lei Mingxuan took out his notebook during the store's rest time and drafted a preliminary store renovation plan, involving introducing mountain-style utility clothing collections, setting up a coffee bar in the corner, changing the lighting and display style, and noting cost and supplier information that needed further investigation.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Try home yoga to compensate for missed exercise.
description: On February 9, because the outdoor temperature was too low for a morning run, Lei Mingxuan searched for and downloaded a yoga app in his bedroom, chose a beginner course, then laid out his yoga mat and followed the video to complete a 30-minute beginner yoga session. Although his movements were clumsy, he felt his body loosen up after stretching, so he decided to do yoga twice a week as a substitute for morning runs and checked in on WeChat Moments.

subevent.name: Planning to try yoga
subevent.description: Because the outdoor temperature was too low for a morning run, Lei Mingxuan searched for and downloaded a yoga app on his phone in the bedroom, chose an entry-level yoga course, and decided to replace today's morning run with at-home yoga for stretching.
subevent.location: Shanghai – bedroom at home

subevent.name: Performed the first yoga practice.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan laid out a yoga mat in the bedroom and opened a yoga app. Following the video guide, he completed a 30-minute beginner yoga session. His movements were a bit clumsy, but after stretching he felt his body loosen up and fully relax.
subevent.location: Shanghai – bedroom at home

subevent.name: Make a yoga plan and check in
subevent.description: After the practice, Lei Mingxuan felt that yoga was quite effective and decided to use it as a substitute for his morning run, planning to incorporate two yoga sessions into each week. He also posted a selfie and some thoughts after practice on his Moments to check in.
subevent.location: Shanghai – bedroom at home

name: Accompany Mother to the Vegetable Market
description: On the morning of Saturday, February 25, Lei Mingxuan took time out specifically to accompany his mother to the nearby Zhangyang Road vegetable market to buy groceries. His mother taught him how to pick fresh vegetables and pork ribs. He listened patiently and took the initiative to carry the basket. The two bought ribs and greens, planning to make a pot of soup for lunch. His mother happily said it had been a long time since they had gone to the market together like this.

subevent.name: Pre-departure preparation and communication.
subevent.description: On the morning of Saturday, February 25, Lei Mingxuan got up and talked with his mother Wang Xiuying, and they decided to go together to the Zhangyang Road food market near their home to buy groceries. His mother made a list of the ingredients she wanted to buy. Lei Mingxuan put on his jacket, took a shopping bag and some change, and his mother reminded him to remember to take the vegetable basket. The two changed their shoes at the door, ready to go out.
subevent.location: Home, Lane 1589 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Selecting ingredients at the vegetable market
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan and his mother entered the Zhangyang Road food market and moved through the stalls. His mother first took him to the vegetable section, teaching him how to check whether the leafy greens were fresh and the roots dry, and picked out two bunches of tender greens. Then, in the meat section, she taught him how to judge the freshness of pork ribs: look at the color, smell the odor, and press for springiness. Lei Mingxuan listened carefully and proactively helped carry the basket. His mother bought about half a kilogram of ribs and the greens she needed, and also picked up a few scallions and ginger. During this, she ran into an acquaintance and chatted for a bit. The whole process took about 40 minutes.
subevent.location: Shanghai, Pudong New Area - Zhangyang Road Wet Market

subevent.name: Go home to organize ingredients and prepare stewed soup
subevent.description: Around 10 a.m., Lei Mingxuan and his mother returned home carrying the ingredients they had bought. His mother blanched the pork ribs and skimmed off the scum, while Lei Mingxuan helped wash the greens and cut them into sections. His mother put the prepared ribs into a pot, added ginger slices, scallion knots, and water, then brought it to a boil over high heat before reducing to a simmer. Lei Mingxuan helped on the side, watching his mother and writing down the steps. His mother happily said it had been a long time since they had gone to the market together, and Lei Mingxuan promised to accompany her more often. The soup was expected to be done around noon and become the lunch soup of the day.
subevent.location: Home kitchen, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cold wave interrupted morning run; weight rose back to 81 kg.
description: In early February 2025, a prolonged cold wave hit Shanghai, forcing Lei Mingxuan to interrupt his outdoor morning running habit; his exercise frequency plummeted from five times a week. On February 15, he tried an indoor basic workout of about 20 minutes at home (push-ups, squats, etc.), but did not stick with it because he lacked equipment and motivation. At the end of the month, when he weighed himself, he found his weight had gone back up from 79 kg to 81 kg, his belly fat had increased, and his cardiovascular fitness had declined noticeably when climbing stairs, triggering anxiety over his declining physical fitness. That night he sat in his bedroom reflecting and realized that weather could not be used as an excuse to give up exercise. He immediately made a recovery plan: resume morning runs as soon as the temperature warms up, buy a jump rope and yoga mat for supplementary indoor training, and send a screenshot of the plan to his childhood friend Zhang Wei, asking him to supervise its execution.

subevent.name: Morning Run Paused Due to Cold Wave
subevent.description: On the morning of February 1, 2025, Shanghai was hit by a persistent cold wave. After the alarm went off at his home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Lei Mingxuan saw through the window that it was cold and windy outside. Concerned that outdoor exercise might cause physical discomfort, he decided to suspend that day's morning run plan. Throughout the rest of early to mid-February, for the same reason, he did not resume outdoor morning running, and his daily exercise frequency plummeted from five times a week to nearly zero.
subevent.location: Home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Try basic indoor exercise
subevent.description: On the afternoon of February 15, 2025, Lei Mingxuan did a basic indoor workout in his living room, including push-ups, squats, and sit-ups, lasting about 20 minutes. However, because there was no professional equipment at home and space was limited, the exercise intensity was far lower than outdoor morning runs, and he felt he lacked motivation, then returned to a sedentary state. This attempt failed to form a lasting habit.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: At the end of the month, I weighed myself and found my weight had gone back up.
subevent.description: On the evening of February 28, 2025, Lei Mingxuan weighed himself using an electronic scale in his home bathroom and found that his weight displayed 81 kg, an increase of 2 kg from 79 kg at the end of January. He lifted his clothes and saw that his belly fat had clearly increased. Then, when he tried climbing the stairs (from the 1st to the 6th floor), he felt short of breath and weak in the legs, and felt that his cardiopulmonary function had declined. This result made him realize the negative impact of lack of exercise during the cold wave on his physical fitness.
subevent.location: Home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Reflecting on anxiety and making a recovery plan
subevent.description: After weighing himself on February 28, 2025, Lei Mingxuan sat at his desk in the bedroom and reflected, feeling anxious and believing that he should not have stopped exercising because of the weather. He opened his phone's memo app and made a recovery plan for when the weather warmed up: first, resume outdoor morning running immediately when the temperature rises above 5°C and there is no strong wind; at the same time, plan to buy an indoor jump rope and yoga mat as supplementary training during the ongoing cold snap, to make sure he doesn't skip workouts because of the weather again. He also sent a screenshot of the plan to his childhood friend Zhang Wei, asking him to help supervise his execution.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Adjusted dinner structure to reduce oil and sugar.
description: On February 16, 2025, after discussing with his mother Wang Xiuying at their home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Lei Mingxuan decided to adjust the family dinner structure: reduce heavy-oil dishes such as braised pork belly, and add steamed fish, blanched vegetables, and multigrain rice. In the morning, they communicated the plan; in the afternoon, he went to the nearby food market to buy healthy ingredients such as sea bass, vegetables, and multigrain; in the evening, he cooked a low-oil, low-sugar dinner with his mother and enjoyed it together with his father Lei Jianguo. He also put a sticky note on the refrigerator to remind himself to eat until 70% full at every meal.

subevent.name: Discussing the adjustment plan with my mother.
subevent.description: On the morning of February 16, 2025, Lei Mingxuan had a face-to-face discussion with his mother Wang Xiuying (59 years old, retired primary school teacher) at home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai. He proposed a plan to reduce the frequency of heavy-oil dishes such as braised pork and increase steamed fish, blanched vegetables, and multigrain rice. His mother expressed support and agreed to help adjust the family dinner structure.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Purchase healthy ingredients
subevent.description: On the afternoon of February 16, 2025, Lei Mingxuan went to a vegetable market or supermarket near Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to buy light-flavored fish (such as sea bass), fresh vegetables (such as broccoli and lettuce), and whole grains (such as brown rice and oats) for that evening's dinner, ensuring the ingredients fit the low-oil, low-sugar plan.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area vegetable market

subevent.name: Cook dinner according to the new structure.
subevent.description: On the evening of February 16, 2025, Lei Mingxuan and his mother Wang Xiuying cooked together in the kitchen of their home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai. Following the oil and sugar reduction plan, they made steamed sea bass, blanched broccoli, and mixed-grain rice, reducing oil and sugar throughout the process. At dinner, the family enjoyed the adjusted healthy meal.
subevent.location: Home kitchen in Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Join the night roller-skating activity along the riverside
description: On the evening of Friday, March 21, Lei Mingxuan, at the invitation of his roller skating partner Song Jia, joined a small night skating event along the river. He skated about 12 kilometers along the Huangpu River cycling path. Along the way, he met two new friends, and they talked about a possible roller skating trip during the May Day holiday. Lei Mingxuan expressed interest and joined the discussion group.

subevent.name: Preparing roller skating gear before departure
subevent.description: At his home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Lei Mingxuan checked and organized his roller skates, protective gear, backpack and other equipment, changed into sportswear, and made sure his phone and power bank were fully charged, preparing for the evening riverside night skating event.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

subevent.name: Head to the Binjiang roller skating meetup point.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan brought his roller skating gear and set off from home, taking the subway or cycling to the agreed meeting point on the Pudong riverside (such as the Lujiazui riverside section). On the way, he confirmed the meeting time and location with Song Jia via WeChat, and arrived at the meeting spot in the evening.
subevent.location: Meeting point, Riverside Roller Skating Track, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Join the riverside night skate event.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan, Song Jia, and other rollerblading companions (including two newly made friends) went on a night skating session along the cycling path beside the Huangpu River, covering about 12 kilometers. Along the way, they exchanged skating tips, shared anecdotes, and enjoyed the night scenery of the river, in a relaxed and cheerful atmosphere.
subevent.location: Riverside Cycling Path, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Lujiazui to Houtan section)

subevent.name: Socializing and joining groups after the event
subevent.description: After the night skating event ended, Lei Mingxuan rested by the river with two roller-skating friends he had just met. They discussed roller-skating trip plans for the May Day holiday, such as going to Qiandao Lake in Zhejiang or the outskirts of Shanghai. Lei Mingxuan was quite interested, and then, at Song Jia's invitation, joined a roller-skating enthusiasts discussion group to keep up with future event arrangements.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - Riverside rest area (e.g., Houtan Park)

name: Soaking feet before bed to relax and improve sleep
description: On the evening of February 22, feeling tired from the day's bootcamp, Lei Mingxuan tried soaking his feet in hot water for 15 minutes and added a mugwort foot bath bag. After soaking, his body relaxed, he fell asleep faster, and was full of energy the next day. He decided to make foot soaking before bed a habit to relieve work stress and improve sleep quality.

subevent.name: Attend the special training camp during the day
subevent.description: During the day on February 22, Lei Mingxuan went to a bootcamp venue in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and took part in high-intensity physical or skill training. The intense training left him physically exhausted, setting the stage for the foot-soaking relaxation in the evening.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Special training camp venue.

subevent.name: Soak feet in hot water
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan soaked his feet in hot water with a mugwort foot bath bag for about 15 minutes. During this time, he felt his body gradually relax and broke into a light sweat.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - bathroom at home

subevent.name: Relaxing after a foot soak and deciding to make it a habit
subevent.description: After the foot soak, Lei Mingxuan dried his feet and felt relaxed all over and in a good mood. He realized that soaking his feet helped relieve fatigue and improve sleep, so he decided to make it a habit before bed starting tonight to ease daily work stress and improve sleep quality.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - bedroom at home

subevent.name: The next day, he was full of energy.
subevent.description: On the morning of February 23, Lei Mingxuan woke up feeling energetic and noticed significantly improved sleep quality, which confirmed the positive effect of the foot soak the previous night and further boosted his confidence in sticking with foot soaking.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - bedroom at home

name: Attend the physical store new retail breakout special training camp and formulate an action plan.
description: On February 20, 2025, Lei Mingxuan searched online and registered for the 'New Retail Breakthrough for Physical Stores' in-person intensive training camp held at a business hotel in Shanghai. From February 22 to 23, he attended the full two-day program, learning community marketing, private-domain traffic building, and experiential consumption design. He actively asked questions during the interactive sessions and had a one-on-one conversation with the lead instructor after class, presenting his 'coffee + clothing' concept and receiving specific suggestions. On February 24, he organized his notes in his home study and drafted an initial action plan to upgrade the clothing store into a multi-functional space.

subevent.name: Sign up for and prepare for the intensive training camp.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan searched online and found information about the offline special training camp Brick-and-Mortar New Retail Breakthrough held at a business hotel in Shanghai. After learning about the course schedule, instructor lineup, and fees in detail, he completed online registration and payment, prepared a notebook, power bank, and other carry-on items in advance, and planned the transport route from home (Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area) to the hotel.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Attend the first day of the intensive training camp
