subevent.description: On the morning of February 22, Lei Mingxuan went to a business hotel in Shanghai to attend the all-day 'Brick-and-Mortar Stores: New Retail Breakthrough' intensive training camp. The content covered community marketing strategies, methodologies for building private-domain traffic, and experiential consumption design cases. He listened attentively, took notes, actively asked questions during the afternoon interactive session, and exchanged business experiences with other store owners.
subevent.location: Shanghai - A Business Hotel

subevent.name: Attend the second day of the special training camp and exchange ideas
subevent.description: On February 23, Lei Mingxuan continued with the second day of the intensive training camp. In the morning, he attended a case-sharing session on the coffee + apparel integrated retail format, and in the afternoon, he did hands-on work in an experiential consumption design workshop. After the class, he proactively had a one-on-one discussion with the lead instructor, explaining in detail his vision for integrating coffee and apparel in his store's business model, and received specific suggestions on customer flow, product pairing, and customer acquisition plans.
subevent.location: Shanghai - A Business Hotel

subevent.name: Organized the notes and action plan from the training camp.
subevent.description: The day after the training camp ended, Lei Mingxuan organized two days' worth of course notes in his home study, sorting core knowledge points such as community marketing and private traffic building into a document. Combining suggestions gained from exchanges with the instructor, he drafted an initial action plan to upgrade his clothing store into a 'coffee + clothing' hybrid space, including product selection adjustments, area division, and promotional milestones.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - home study

name: Shoot short videos of spring new-arrival outfits and post them on Xiaohongshu.
description: On March 24, Lei Mingxuan used his phone to shoot three short videos of mountain-style functional outfits in the store's fitting room. After editing, he posted them on Xiaohongshu and the store's WeChat Moments. He specifically marked the prices and styling tips for each item. That day he received 12 private message inquiries and 5 new followers, and he felt the online content was quite effective at driving traffic.

subevent.name: Prepare shooting materials and the fitting room
subevent.description: Before the store opened, Lei Mingxuan selected 3 sets of spring new arrivals in mountain-style functional wear from inventory, tidied the fitting room background and lighting, and checked the stability of the phone camera to ensure shooting quality.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - a shopping mall, 2F, Shop A-208 - fitting room

subevent.name: Shoot a short video of spring outfits
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan was in the store's fitting room. Using his phone, he shot three sets of outfit display videos in sequence, each including front, side, and back views from multiple angles, and he verbally introduced the name, price, and styling tips for each item.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - a shopping mall, 2F, Shop A-208 - fitting room

subevent.name: Edited short videos and added annotations.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan used a mobile video editing app to briefly edit three groups of videos, adjusted the order of shots, added text labels displaying item prices and styling tips in the videos, added background music, and exported the final cut.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall - back area

subevent.name: Publish content to social media.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan uploaded the three edited short videos to his personal account on Xiaohongshu and the store's WeChat Moments, wrote and posted captions emphasizing the spring new arrivals and the mountain-style techwear features, and set topic hashtags.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall - in-store checkout counter

subevent.name: Replying to private messages and tracking feedback
subevent.description: On the day of posting, Lei Mingxuan received 12 private-message inquiries and 5 new followers. He replied to each private message, answering questions about sizes, materials, prices, and so on, and recorded the inquiry conversion situation to evaluate the online traffic-generating effect.
subevent.location: Shanghai, Pudong New Area — Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall — inside the store.

name: First pour-over coffee experience
description: On February 23, Lei Mingxuan researched pour-over coffee tutorials and equipment reviews at home, then ordered entry-level pour-over equipment and coffee beans. The delivery arrived on the 24th. After unboxing and cleaning the equipment, he clumsily made his first cup of pour-over coffee in the home kitchen. Because the water flow was not controlled well, the coffee was slightly bitter, but he found it novel and interesting. After reflecting, he decided to keep practicing, and planned to practice daily to cultivate a new hobby.

subevent.name: Researching pour-over coffee and placing an order
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan, at home, used his phone and computer to look through various pour-over coffee tutorials, equipment reviews, and coffee bean recommendations. He eventually decided to buy a beginner pour-over kit (including a V60 dripper, gooseneck kettle, and filter paper) and a bag of medium-roast Colombian coffee beans, then placed the order and paid on Taobao.
subevent.location: Shanghai - living room at home

subevent.name: Receiving the package and unboxing
subevent.description: On the morning of February 24, a courier delivered the package to the home. After signing for it, Lei Mingxuan opened it in the kitchen right away, took out the drip filter cup, pour-over kettle, filter paper, and coffee beans one by one, checked the accessories against the instruction manual and checklist, and briefly cleaned the equipment.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home kitchen

subevent.name: Making pour-over coffee for the first time
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan weighed the coffee beans and ground them into powder. Following the tutorial on his phone, he placed the filter paper in the dripper, rinsed it with hot water and discarded the water, then added the coffee grounds and began pouring. In this first attempt, he tried hard to control the stream from the pour-over kettle, but the stream was sometimes strong and sometimes weak, and he could not get the timing of the bloom and the pour right. The whole process lasted about ten minutes and was full of ceremony.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home kitchen

subevent.name: Tasting and reflection.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan poured the brewed coffee into a cup and took the first sip. It tasted somewhat bitter and slightly astringent, and he realized that uneven water flow control had caused over-extraction. He reviewed the whole brewing process; although the result was unsatisfactory, he found it novel and interesting. Lying on the sofa, he sipped the coffee while watching other tutorial videos in search of ways to improve.
subevent.location: Shanghai - living room at home

subevent.name: Decided to continue practicing pour-over coffee.
subevent.description: In the evening, Lei Mingxuan packed up his equipment, noted the problems and takeaways from his first brew in his phone memo, and planned to practice once a day for the next week. He also ordered new coffee beans and a digital scale to improve precision. He felt this experience had successfully cultivated a new hobby.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

name: Contact supplier Zhou Tao to confirm the first batch of mountain-style clothing order and pay the deposit.
description: On March 6, Lei Mingxuan first organized order-related materials in the clothing store, then called Hangzhou supplier Zhou Tao by phone to confirm the styles, quantities, and delivery dates of the first batch of mountain-style techwear jackets and cargo pants, and immediately paid a 30% deposit via bank transfer, officially starting the procurement process.

subevent.name: Organizing order-related materials
subevent.description: At his clothing store on the second floor of a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Lei Mingxuan organized the specific style codes, quantity lists, and cost calculations for the mountain techwear jackets and cargo pants he needed to order, based on the sample records previously selected with supplier Zhou Tao, in preparation for the phone call with Zhou Tao.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Clothing Store

subevent.name: Discussed order details with supplier Zhou Tao over the phone.
subevent.description: At the clothing store, Lei Mingxuan called Zhou Tao (Taosheng Apparel), a supplier in Hangzhou, on the phone. The two sides confirmed in detail the styles, quantities, and delivery schedules for the first batch of mountain-style techwear jackets and cargo pants, and finalized a 30% deposit ratio and payment method, formally reaching a purchase intent.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Clothing Store

subevent.name: Paid the order deposit via bank transfer.
subevent.description: After finishing the phone call, Lei Mingxuan immediately used his mobile banking app to transfer 30% of the total order amount as a deposit to the corporate account of Hangzhou Taosheng Apparel Co., Ltd. provided by Zhou Tao, and saved a screenshot of the transfer receipt.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Clothing Store

name: Cousin Shen Jie came to the store to help select styles and discuss fashion trends
description: On the afternoon of March 14, my cousin Shen Jie came to the store to help evaluate the mixing effect of mountain-series samples and spring new arrivals. From a fashion buyer's perspective, she suggested “integrating techwear style with urban commuting.” The two had an in-depth discussion at a café in the mall about the season's trending colors and fabric trends. Shen Jie also recommended several independent designers worth following. Lei Mingxuan organized the suggestions into notes as a basis for future selection.

subevent.name: Welcomed cousin Shen Jie and started evaluating samples
subevent.description: On the afternoon of March 14, 2025, Lei Mingxuan welcomed his cousin Shen Jie to the clothing store at Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai. Shen Jie is a fashion buyer; the purpose of this visit was to help evaluate the mix-and-match effect of the mountain-style samples and the spring new arrivals. In the store, the two tried on the newly arrived mountain-style jackets with spring key T-shirts, cargo pants, and other items, and began preliminary outfit combinations and effect observation.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Discussed the mix-and-match effect in the store and exchanged preliminary suggestions.
subevent.description: From a fashion buyer's perspective, Shen Jie had an in-depth discussion with Lei Mingxuan in the store about the mixing-and-matching effect of the mountain-style samples and the new spring collection. She proposed an outfit concept that blends functional-style elements (such as multi-pocket vests and tactical belts) with everyday urban-commuter pieces (such as minimalist hoodies and straight-leg pants), and demonstrated several combinations on the spot. Lei Mingxuan listened carefully to her opinions, and the two discussed the visual coordination of different outfits and their acceptance by the target customer base. Shen Jie also shared her observations on this season's fashion trends.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Move to a café for an in-depth discussion of fashion trends
subevent.description: After the preliminary discussion in the store, Lei Mingxuan and Shen Jie went to a café in the mall. Over coffee, they had an in-depth exchange about this season's popular color schemes (such as soft sand, mint green, and electric blue) and fabric trends (such as lightweight waterproof nylon and eco-friendly recycled fibers). Shen Jie analyzed from a professional perspective how these trends are presented in mainstream brands, and strongly recommended three independent designers worth following (specializing in deconstructed tailoring, digital printing, and ecological fabrics respectively), suggesting that Lei Mingxuan pay attention to their work for selection inspiration. Lei Mingxuan recorded key information in his phone notes.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - cafe in a shopping mall on Century Avenue

subevent.name: Returned to the store to organize the style selection notes
subevent.description: After the café discussion, Lei Mingxuan returned to the clothing store and systematically organized all the suggestions from his conversation with Shen Jie that day into written notes, including the mixed-match plans for mountain style and urban commuting, trends in popular colors and fabrics, and the independent designers she recommended. In the notes, he marked the categories to prioritize for future purchases (such as utility vests and lightweight waterproof jackets) and the directions of designers worth trying to collaborate with, for future reference. After tidying up, Lei Mingxuan filed the notes in the store's selection reference folder.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Develop the spring store display and community operation plan

Then, on March 4, he used the low-traffic period to design a spring display renovation plan. On March 5, he further drafted a WeChat community operations plan, planning to add outdoor outfit sharing and limited-time flash sales to prepare for the store's transformation.

subevent.name: Organizing samples and training notes
subevent.description: At the workbench in his clothing store, Lei Mingxuan sorted through the mountain-tech style samples he had brought back from Hangzhou, reviewed the display and community-operation knowledge from the new retail boot camp, and selected usable elements and ideas to prepare for the upcoming design work.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Design the spring display renovation plan.
subevent.description: Combining the selected mountain-style functional samples and what he learned in training, Lei Mingxuan drew a display renovation sketch at the store's workbench, planned the spring new-product display area, mannequin styling, and window decoration, and recorded the specific renovation steps and the list of required materials.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Draft a WeChat community operations plan
subevent.description: Using the store’s low-traffic hours, Lei Mingxuan drafted a WeChat community operation plan at his in-store workstation, including planning the themes and formats of weekly outdoor outfit-sharing content, and designing the rules, product selection, and timing for limited-time flash sales, resulting in a preliminary community activity schedule.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Visit the Ancient Egyptian civilization exhibition to gather inspiration and organize materials
description: On Saturday, February 15, Lei Mingxuan went alone to the Shanghai Museum to visit the "Top of the Pyramids: Ancient Egyptian Civilization Exhibition." He set off from home, took the subway, and carefully viewed artifacts such as pharaoh statues and painted mummy coffins, paying special attention to ancient Egyptian clothing and accessory craftsmanship. He took many detail photos and bought a papyrus bookmark at the cultural and creative store. After the visit, he returned home, imported the photos into his computer, organized them into categories, and noted creative inspiration for selecting accessories for his store.

subevent.name: Go to the Shanghai Museum
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan set off from home, walked to the metro station, took Shanghai Metro Line 2 to People's Square Station, and after exiting the station walked to the Shanghai Museum. The whole trip took about 40 minutes.
subevent.location: Shanghai - along Metro Line 2 - People's Square

subevent.name: Visit the Ancient Egyptian Civilization Exhibition
subevent.description: After entering the Shanghai Museum, Lei Mingxuan visited 'Top of the Pyramids: Ancient Egyptian Civilization Exhibition'. He carefully viewed precious artifacts such as pharaoh statues and painted mummy coffins, paying special attention to the accessory craftsmanship of ancient Egyptian clothing. He took a large number of detailed photos with his phone, the entire visit lasting about three hours.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Huangpu District - Shanghai Museum

subevent.name: Purchased souvenirs at a cultural and creative store
subevent.description: After the visit, Lei Mingxuan went to the cultural and creative store inside the Shanghai Museum, selected a papyrus bookmark with Egyptian hieroglyphs and patterns as a souvenir, and completed the purchase with mobile payment.
subevent.location: Shanghai-Huangpu District-Shanghai Museum Cultural and Creative Store

subevent.name: Return home.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan left the Shanghai Museum, walked to People's Square subway station, took Metro Line 2 back to Pudong New Area, and after getting out of the station walked back to his home on Zhangyang Road.
subevent.location: Shanghai - along Metro Line 2 - home in Pudong New Area

subevent.name: Organize and archive inspiration materials
subevent.description: After returning home, Lei Mingxuan imported the photos of ancient Egyptian artifact details he had taken into his computer, organized them by categories such as clothing, accessories, and patterns, noted down creative inspiration that could be used for the store's accessory selection, and carefully stored the papyrus bookmarks he had bought.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home Study

name: Had friction with his friend Han Dong during a billiards session over differing interests, and reflected on it.
description: On March 9, Lei Mingxuan practiced billiards with his billiards buddy Han Dong at a billiards hall in Pudong New Area. During a break, Lei Mingxuan shared his coffee insights and was mocked by Han Dong, causing a minor rift between the two. Afterwards, Lei Mingxuan went home alone to reflect, realized the gap in understanding between different interest circles, and decided to let the matter cool down.

subevent.name: Arranged with Han Dong and started billiards practice
subevent.description: On the afternoon of March 9, during a break in billiards referee training, Lei Mingxuan met his billiards buddy Han Dong at a billiard hall near the training venue, and they practiced American eight-ball together to warm up for the upcoming amateur tournament.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Billiards Hall

subevent.name: Friction arose during break-time chatting due to differing interests.
subevent.description: During a break in billiards practice, Lei Mingxuan excitedly shared with Han Dong his recent insights from studying coffee, but Han Dong sneered and mocked, "No place to play billiards? Switching to coffee?" Lei Mingxuan felt offended, but for the sake of face he just smiled and changed the subject, and the atmosphere between them became subtle.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Billiard Hall Rest Area

subevent.name: Lei Mingxuan's post-event reflection and emotional adjustment
subevent.description: After the friendly billiards session, Lei Mingxuan returned home alone, feeling upset by Han Dong's taunts. He sat in his study reflecting on the conversation, realized the gap in understanding between different interest circles, and thought about how to better handle differences in opinions between friends in the future. He decided to let the matter rest for now.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home Study

name: First-time skiing in Anji
description: On Saturday, January 18, Lei Mingxuan and four others, including Song Jia, drove to Anji Yunshang Grassland Ski Resort. Under the instructor's guidance, he mastered the basic snowplow brake and the falling leaf. Although he fell more than a dozen times, the thrill of high-speed gliding made him exclaim how exhilarating it was. He used an action camera to record clips of his falls and his first successful runs. At noon, he exchanged skiing tips with friends in the rest area and found that the functional design of ski wear had much in common with the outdoor techwear style he followed.

subevent.name: Pre-departure preparation and gathering
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Lei Mingxuan sorted out his skiing equipment (ski suit, protective gear, and action camera) at home (No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai), and confirmed the meeting time and place with Song Jia, Zhang Wei, and Han Dong through a WeChat group. At 7:00, Lei Mingxuan drove his own car and picked up Zhang Wei (Jinqiao Road, Pudong) and Han Dong (Hongmei Road, Minhang) in turn, finally meeting up at 7:30 near Song Jia's home (Qixin Road, Minhang). The four set off together for Anji.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and along the pick-up/drop-off route in Minhang District

subevent.name: Drive to Anji Cloud Grassland Ski Resort.
subevent.description: At 7:30, they set off from Minhang District, Shanghai, with Lei Mingxuan driving. They took the Shanghai–Chongqing Expressway and then the Hangzhou–Changxing Expressway to Anji, Zhejiang. Along the way, everyone chatted and played music in the car, and Han Dong used his phone for navigation and alerted others to traffic conditions. After about 2.5 hours, they arrived at the parking lot of Anji Yunshang Grassland Ski Resort around 10:00.
subevent.location: Shanghai to Anji County, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province - expressway and ski resort parking lot

subevent.name: Arrive at the ski resort and handle equipment rental and admission.
subevent.description: At 10:00, they arrived at Anji Yunshang Grassland Ski Resort. Lei Mingxuan and his friends bought all-day ski tickets (including ski equipment rental) at the ticket hall. Lei Mingxuan rented a snowboard, snowboard boots, helmet, and protective gear; Song Jia rented skis; and Zhang Wei and Han Dong each chose their own equipment. The four changed into ski suits and headed to the beginner slope to start skiing. Lei Mingxuan used an action camera to capture the snow-covered scenery.
subevent.location: Anji County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province - Yunshang Grassland Ski Resort ticket hall and beginner slope entrance.

subevent.name: Morning introductory skiing training (with instructor guidance)
subevent.description: At 10:30 on the beginner slope, Lei Mingxuan hired a ski instructor for one-on-one coaching. The instructor first explained safe falling and standing-up techniques for snowboarding, then taught basic braking (heel-side sideslip) and falling leaf (oblique descent). Lei Mingxuan fell more than ten times during practice, but gradually gained balance and was able to complete a short-distance falling-leaves maneuver. He used a sports camera mounted on his helmet to record his falls and early successful runs. Song Jia, Zhang Wei, and Han Dong practiced on their own nearby.
subevent.location: Zhejiang Province, Huzhou City, Anji County - Cloud Grassland Ski Resort Beginner Ski Slope

subevent.name: Lunch break and sharing skiing experiences
subevent.description: At 12:00, the four went to the restaurant in the ski resort rest area. Lei Mingxuan ordered a bowl of beef noodles and a hot drink, and sat around a table with Song Jia, Zhang Wei, and Han Dong, sharing their morning skiing experiences. Lei Mingxuan showed the videos of their falls recorded on his action camera, and everyone laughed. He also noticed the windproof and waterproof fabric and pocket design of the ski suit, and thinking of the outdoor techwear clothing he follows, discussed the design details with his friends. The lunch break lasted about 40 minutes.
subevent.location: Cloud Grassland Ski Resort Rest Area Restaurant, Anji County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

subevent.name: Afternoon independent skiing practice.
subevent.description: At 13:00, the four returned to the ski slopes. Lei Mingxuan no longer hired an instructor and independently practiced the falling leaf and tried changing edges on the beginner slope. After the morning training, he fell less often, was able to complete continuous diagonal glides, and experienced the thrill of high-speed riding. During this period, Song Jia coached him on some balance techniques, and Lei Mingxuan also recorded a video of his afternoon progress. Zhang Wei and Han Dong practiced on the adjacent slope. At 15:30, they decided to end the ski session, packed up their equipment, and prepared for the return trip.
subevent.location: Zhejiang Province, Huzhou City, Anji County - Cloud Grassland Ski Resort Beginner Ski Slope

subevent.name: Driving back to Shanghai
subevent.description: At 16:00, the four of them returned the rented ski equipment, changed back into their own clothes, and departed from the parking lot of Anji Yunshang Grassland to return to Shanghai. Zhang Wei drove (Lei Mingxuan rested), following the same route back. They took one short rest at a service area along the way, and everyone discussed plans for the next ski trip. They arrived in Shanghai at about 18:30. Lei Mingxuan took Han Dong and Zhang Wei home one by one, finally said goodbye to Song Jia, and returned to his home in Pudong at 19:00.
subevent.location: Anji County, Zhejiang Province to Pudong New Area, Shanghai - along the expressway and on the return trip

subevent.name: Organizing materials and sharing after returning home.
subevent.description: At 19:00, Lei Mingxuan returned home. He first sorted through the videos and photos shot on his action camera, selected a few clips of spectacular falls and successful slides, and did simple editing on his phone. He then posted the video to his Moments and the "Pudong Three Musketeers" WeChat group, with the caption "Anji skiing first experience, fell till it was awesome!" He interacted with Song Jia, Zhang Wei, and Han Dong in the group, recalled the day's funny moments, and briefly talked about the skiing experience with his parents. Around 21:00, he finished, then bathed and rested.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - living room and study at home

name: Received the business annual report reminder.
description: On April 10, Lei Mingxuan received a text message from the Market Supervision Administration reminding him that the annual report deadline for individual businesses was June 30. He made a note of it and decided to deal with it as soon as he had time.

subevent.name: Check annual report reminder text message
subevent.description: When Lei Mingxuan checked his phone on the morning of April 10, 2025, he found an annual report reminder text message from the Market Supervision Administration for his individual business, confirmed the deadline was June 30, 2025, made a note of it, and decided to handle it when he had time soon.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - inside own store

name: Attend amateur billiards referee training and pass the assessment
description: Over the three weekends from March 1 to 16, Lei Mingxuan attended amateur billiards referee training, systematically studying competition rules, officiating procedures, and case decisions, and finally passed the assessment and obtained the qualification certificate. The training was held all day on Saturdays and Sundays, and he devoted himself seriously, making up for his lack of theoretical knowledge.

subevent.name: Register and prepare training materials.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan contacted the Pudong New Area Billiards Association in Shanghai by phone, completed the registration procedures for amateur referee training, and paid the training fee. Then at home he organized the notebook, pens, and billiards rulebook needed for the training, getting ready for the upcoming session.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Week 1, Day 1 training: Basics of the rules
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan arrived at the Pudong New Area Billiards Association Training Center at 8:30 on Saturday morning to attend the first day of training. Senior chief referee and instructor Li Xiaoyang lectured on the general rules of billiards competitions, foul penalty standards, and referees' professional ethics. In the afternoon, group discussions and case simulations were held, and he devoted the whole day to learning.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area Billiards Association Training Center

subevent.name: Week 1, Day 2 training: Refereeing procedure drill
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan continued attending the training on Sunday. In the morning he studied standard officiating procedures, including breaking order, score sheet filling, and timeout and timing rules. In the afternoon he practiced actual officiating in a simulated match, received on-site comments from the instructor, and consolidated his refereeing moves.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area Billiards Association Training Center

subevent.name: Week 2, Day 1 training: penalty decision case analysis
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan attended the second Saturday training session, which focused on analysis of typical penalty cases, including controversial balls, interference with opponents, and illegal strokes. The morning was spent on theoretical explanations, and the afternoon on group discussions and writing penalty opinions, to improve adjudication accuracy.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area Billiards Association Training Center

subevent.name: Second week, second day training: practical simulation assessment
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan attended training on Sunday, with multiple rounds of practical simulation assessments throughout the day. In the simulated competition scenarios, he refereed fully in accordance with referee standards, and the instructor scored each item and gave improvement suggestions, focusing on reaction speed and decisiveness in judging.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area Billiards Association Training Center

subevent.name: Week 3 Day 1 Training: Comprehensive review and Q&A
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan attended the Saturday training in the third week. In the morning, he systematically reviewed all the knowledge points from the first three weeks; in the afternoon, there was an open Q&A session. The instructor focused on correcting common mistakes and handed out mock exams for the final assessment for self-study.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area Billiards Association Training Center

subevent.name: Took the final assessment and obtained the qualification certificate.
subevent.description: On Sunday morning, Lei Mingxuan took the closed-book written exam for the amateur referee qualification, and in the afternoon he underwent the on-site practical officiating assessment. He completed all assessment items with a serious and dedicated attitude. After evaluation by the instructor, he was announced to have passed the assessment on the spot and was issued an amateur referee qualification certificate certified by the Chinese Billiards Association.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area Billiards Association Training Center

name: After organizing the fund data, he called the financial advisor and recorded the key points of the conversation.
description: Ippudo Ramen, LG2 floor, IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Organize fund performance data and key communication points.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan, in the study of his home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, opened the mobile banking app to check the drawdown data of the technology-themed fund and the unit net value changes of the mixed fund after last month's rebalancing. He recorded key metrics and questions to ask, preparing to call his financial advisor Xu Feng.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Called the financial advisor to discuss fund performance.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan proactively called financial advisor Xu Feng on his phone, asking in detail about the recent drawdown reasons for the technology-themed fund and the return performance of the balanced fund. Xu Feng analyzed that the overall portfolio was stable, advised keeping the current allocation unchanged, and reminded Lei Mingxuan to set aside 30,000 to 50,000 yuan in liquid working capital for the clothing store's summer stocking. Lei Mingxuan confirmed that no adjustment was needed for now, and the call ended.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Organizing communication records and follow-up plans
subevent.description: After ending the call with Xu Feng, Lei Mingxuan noted the key points of the conversation in his notebook: the pullback in technology-themed funds is manageable, mixed fund performance is in line with expectations, maintain current positions, and reserve 30,000-50,000 yuan of liquid funds. He also marked Xu Feng's suggestion as an important reminder and planned to check the store's cash flow before summer stocking.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

name: Qingming Festival family tomb-sweeping
description: On the morning of April 4, the family of three drove to a cemetery on the outskirts of Pudong. Lei Mingxuan carefully wiped the dust off the tombstone and retraced the inscriptions with red paint, feeling deep respect for the hardships his ancestors had endured. As his mother placed out qingtuan and quietly talked about everyday matters, Lei Mingxuan suddenly thought: if these fragments of family stories could be written into a novel, how warm they would be. When leaving the cemetery, he made a point of taking a photo of the skyline in the direction of the old longtang.

subevent.name: Prepared tomb-sweeping offerings.
subevent.description: Early in the morning, Lei Mingxuan, together with his parents Lei Jianguo and Wang Xiuying, prepared the offerings needed for tomb sweeping in the kitchen and living room at home—including the green rice balls Wang Xiuying had made in advance, flowers, incense and candles, and red paint—and packed everything into bags.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Drove to a cemetery on the outskirts of Pudong.
subevent.description: The family of three drove a family sedan from their home on Zhangyang Road to the family cemetery in the outskirts of Pudong. Lei Mingxuan was driving, while his parents chatted in the back seat. They arrived at the cemetery about 40 minutes later.
subevent.location: Shanghai - suburban cemetery road in Pudong New Area

subevent.name: Wiped the tombstone and traced the inscription in red.
subevent.description: After arriving at the cemetery, Lei Mingxuan carefully wiped the dust and stains off the tombstone with a damp cloth, then carefully traced the inscription in red paint to make his ancestors' names more prominent. During the process, he felt deep respect for the hardships his ancestors had endured in building their business.
subevent.location: Shanghai - family cemetery in the outskirts of Pudong New Area

subevent.name: Set out qingtuan and shared what's been happening lately.
subevent.description: Wang Xiuying placed the qingtuan and flowers she had brought in front of the tombstone and softly told her ancestors about the family's recent situation, including the business of Lei Mingxuan's shop and family life. Lei Mingxuan stood nearby, listening to his mother, and suddenly had the idea of turning the family story into a novel.
subevent.location: Shanghai - family cemetery in the outskirts of Pudong New Area

subevent.name: Took photos of the skyline and left the cemetery.
subevent.description: When the tomb sweeping was over and they were about to leave, Lei Mingxuan deliberately took out his phone and took a photo of the skyline in the direction of the old longtang as a souvenir. Then the family of three packed up their things and drove home.
subevent.location: Family cemetery on the outskirts of Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the return route

name: Regretted and reflected after returning home late from camping and arguing with his mother.
description: On the evening of March 30, Lei Mingxuan drove back from camping in Chongming to his home in Pudong and got home around 10 p.m. His mother complained that he was never home on weekends and brought up marriage again. Emotionally, she recounted how she had come from Nantong to Shanghai to work as a teacher back in the day, and demanded to know who would take care of him now. Exhausted and irritated, Lei Mingxuan retorted, and an argument broke out. Seeing his mother's lonely figure from behind, he felt regret. That night he reflected on his own and planned to apologize and improve their communication.

subevent.name: Drove back from camping on Chongming Island
subevent.description: On the evening of March 30, Lei Mingxuan finished his camping trip on Chongming Island and drove alone in his family car from Chongming back to his home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai. The drive took about an hour and a half, and he arrived at his residence at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road shortly before 10 p.m.
subevent.location: On the way from Chongming District, Shanghai, to Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area

subevent.name: Mother's complaint triggered an argument.
subevent.description: As soon as Lei Mingxuan stepped through the door, his mother Wang Xiuying complained that he had been out all weekend and only came back late at night, and brought up the matter of settling down again. Wang Xiuying was emotional and told of how she had come to Shanghai from Nantong back then to become a teacher, saying that no matter how hard it was, there was always someone to help her. She demanded to know who would take care of Lei Mingxuan now. Tired and irritable from camping, Lei Mingxuan retorted on the spot in a bad tone, and the two had a fierce argument in the living room.
subevent.location: Living room at home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Felt regret upon seeing his mother's lonely back
subevent.description: After the quarrel ended, Lei Mingxuan saw his mother Wang Xiuying turn and walk silently toward the bedroom, her back looking especially forlorn. In an instant, strong regret surged in Lei Mingxuan's heart. He realized that his harsh words had hurt his mother, but his pride prevented him from apologizing on the spot.
subevent.location: Living room and hallway at home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Self-reflection and self-reproach in solitude
subevent.description: Before going to bed that night, Lei Mingxuan sat alone on the bed in his room reflecting on the whole incident. He recalled his mother's usual care and devotion, realized that he shouldn't have vented his negative emotions at her when he was tired, and planned to apologize to her the next day, while thinking about how to better communicate his lifestyle with her.
subevent.location: Home bedroom, 12 Lane 1589 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Shop assistant Xiao Lin proposed and began managing the store's WeChat Moments
description: On April 20, Xiao Lin, a shop assistant, proactively suggested to Lei Mingxuan that she take charge of the shop's WeChat Moments daily operations, including photographing new products, writing copy, and replying to interactions. After getting approval, she immediately started preparing that afternoon, photographing the new autumn jackets, writing the first piece of copy, organizing customer groups, and setting up reply templates, with Lei Mingxuan providing guidance alongside her.

subevent.name: Xiao Lin began preparing for WeChat Moments operations.
subevent.description: After gaining Lei Mingxuan's consent, Lin Xiaoyu started preparations that same afternoon: she used her phone to photograph several new fall coats in the store, wrote the first draft of a WeChat Moments post, organized WeChat contact groups of past customers, and set up basic templates for interactive replies. Lei Mingxuan observed from the side and gave brief guidance on how to phrase the product selling points.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (inside Lei Mingxuan's clothing store)

name: Regular customer Qian Duoduo came by to talk about designer toys and store decoration
description: On the morning of February 16, 2025, Lei Mingxuan was organizing spring clothing and the rest area in his clothing store at Shop A-208, Level 2, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, preparing to receive a regular customer, Qian Duoduo. In the afternoon, Qian Duoduo arrived, and the two shared newly purchased trendy toy blind boxes in the rest area, discussing IP collaborations and blind box drawing tips. Qian Duoduo then suggested setting up a small outdoor experience area in the store to display clothing, and Lei Mingxuan said he would consider it.

subevent.name: In-store stocking and reception preparation
subevent.description: From the morning to early afternoon on February 16, 2025, at his clothing store, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Lei Mingxuan organized the newly arrived spring clothing racks, checked the blind box and badge displays, and specially set up the tea table and refreshments in the lounge area, preparing to welcome return customer Qian Duoduo for an afternoon chat.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Qian Duoduo came to the store and shared trendy toy blind boxes
subevent.description: On the afternoon of February 16, 2025, Qian Duoduo, a regular customer, came to Lei Mingxuan's clothing store. After greeting Lei Mingxuan, she sat down in the store's rest area. Qian Duoduo took out her newly bought trendy toy blind box series. The two opened the boxes together and shared collecting insights, discussing the latest popular IP collaboration styles and their own blind-box drawing experiences. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Discuss suggestions for the store's outdoor experience area
subevent.description: After the blind box exchange, Qian Duoduo, drawing on the recent camping outfit trend, suggested to Lei Mingxuan that they could set up a small outdoor experience area in the store, placing props such as tents and folding chairs to display outdoor-style clothing and accessories. The two discussed feasibility, cost, and space utilization for about fifteen minutes. Lei Mingxuan took careful notes and said he would consider it.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Plan and advance the joint weekend market traffic-driving plan.
description: On March 16, 2025, after receiving an invitation from Zheng Kai, the mall property manager, Lei Mingxuan began preparing for the quarterly merchant exchange meeting on March 18. At the meeting, he had in-depth discussions with neighboring store owners on how to deal with declining customer traffic, and proposed the initial idea of jointly holding a weekend market, which received a positive response from some merchants. After the meeting, he organized his meeting notes, sketched out the preliminary framework of the plan, and on March 19 communicated the specific details with three interested merchants, reaching a cooperation consensus. Finally, Lei Mingxuan summarized the communication results, wrote a formal proposal, submitted it to the mall management office on March 21, and scheduled a follow-up review meeting.

subevent.name: Received the invitation and prepared for the exchange meeting.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan received a WeChat invitation from the mall property manager Zheng Kai and confirmed he would attend the quarterly merchant exchange meeting organized by the mall on March 18. During slow periods at the store, he organized recent foot traffic data, inventory turnover, and operational issues, and drafted key talking points in preparation for discussing traffic-driving strategies at the meeting.
subevent.location: Shanghai - inside my own clothing store

subevent.name: Attend the mall's quarterly merchant exchange meeting
subevent.description: As agreed, Lei Mingxuan went to the mall's meeting room to attend the quarterly merchant exchange meeting, which was hosted by the property manager, Zheng Kai. At the meeting, he had in-depth exchanges with the owners of neighboring shops on ways to cope with declining customer traffic, and proactively proposed the preliminary idea of jointly holding a weekend market, which received positive responses and support from some merchants.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Century Link Mall meeting room

subevent.name: Organize meeting notes and brainstorm a plan
subevent.description: After the exchange meeting ended, Lei Mingxuan returned to his store and systematically organized the key points recorded during the meeting, focusing on sorting out the suggestions proposed by various merchants, potential collaborative resources, and customer-flow pain points. Combining his own experience, he initially conceived a framework plan for the joint weekend market, including booth layout, theme positioning, and promotional methods.
subevent.location: Shanghai - inside my own clothing store

subevent.name: Communicating market details with interested merchants.
subevent.description: Following the leads from the networking event, Lei Mingxuan visited or called several merchants who had shown strong interest in participating. He discussed details with them, such as the specific time for the joint market (suggesting a weekend), the stall allocation plan, the cost-sharing ratio, and preparation of promotional materials, and finally reached an initial cooperation agreement with three merchants.
subevent.location: Inside various stores at Century Link Mall, Shanghai

subevent.name: Submit the joint market proposal to the mall.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan summarized the results of his communication with merchants and wrote a formal joint weekend market event plan, including the event purpose, schedule, booth layout, expected customer traffic, and required mall support. He first discussed the plan outline with Zheng Kai via WeChat, and after receiving initial approval, he took the printed plan to the mall management office to submit it and scheduled a follow-up plan review meeting.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Century Link Mall Management Office

name: Launch the monthly family plan to cook for parents
description: On the evening of March 5, 2025, at his home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Lei Mingxuan promised his parents that he would cook for them at least once a month. Since then, he gradually fulfilled the promise: on March 8, Women's Day, he made steamed sea bass for his mother; on April 20, the Guyu (Grain Rain) solar term, he cooked seasonal dishes; and on June 15, Father's Day, he made four-joy braised gluten for his father. The ingredients were chosen with both health and the season in mind, and the family atmosphere was warm.

subevent.name: After dinner, promised to cook for my parents every month.
subevent.description: At home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, after dinner, Lei Mingxuan solemnly promised his parents, Lei Jianguo and Wang Xiuying, that he would cook for them at least once a month from now on to express his filial piety. His parents were gratified and encouraged him.
subevent.location: Home dining room, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Cooked steamed sea bass for Mom on Women's Day.
subevent.description: On International Women's Day, Lei Mingxuan specially made a steamed sea bass for his mother, Wang Xiuying. He went to the nearby market in the morning to buy fresh sea bass and seasonings, and after returning home, he cooked it with care. He served the healthy and delicious dish at dinner. His mother was very happy, and the whole family enjoyed it together.
subevent.location: Home kitchen and dining room in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Made seasonal dishes for parents during the Guyu (Grain Rain) solar term
subevent.description: On the day of the Grain Rain solar term, Lei Mingxuan carefully prepared Grain Rain specialty dishes for his parents, such as stir-fried seasonal vegetables and spring bamboo shoots. He bought fresh seasonal ingredients in advance and focused on nutritional balance to suit his parents' health needs. The whole family enjoyed this spring-filled dinner.
subevent.location: Home kitchen and dining room in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Made braised gluten with four delicacies for Father's Day
subevent.description: On Father's Day, Lei Mingxuan made a classic Shanghainese dish, four-joy braised gluten, for his father, Lei Jianguo. He bought gluten, wood ear mushrooms, day lily flowers, and other ingredients in advance, and cooked it carefully following the traditional method. At dinner, the family sat together; after tasting it, his father praised it endlessly, and the family atmosphere was warm.
subevent.location: Home kitchen and dining room in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Taking stock of spring inventory, packing out-of-season items, and adjusting purchase orders based on sales data.
description: On March 20, after the store closed, Lei Mingxuan took stock of the spring inventory, packed and stored the out-of-season items, and then analyzed sales data. He found that small-size cargo pants and bright-colored jackets were selling faster, so he increased the order proportion of these two categories in the purchasing system, reduced other styles, and submitted a modification request.

subevent.name: Take inventory of spring stock.
subevent.description: After the clothing store closed, Lei Mingxuan began categorizing and counting all the spring clothing in the store, checking the inventory quantities one by one against the purchase, sales, and inventory records, calculating the total inventory, and recording the remaining number of pieces for each style, in preparation for the subsequent packing and data analysis.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Pack up out-of-season spring clothing and put it into storage.
subevent.description: After the inventory count, Lei Mingxuan folded and sorted the spring out-of-season clothing that had been confirmed as no longer suitable for the current season (such as heavy coats and long-sleeve sweatshirts) one by one, put them into storage bags or cardboard boxes, labeled each with the item name and quantity, and then moved them all to the storage shelves in the warehouse at the back of the store.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Analyze spring sales data and identify best-selling items.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan exported the spring (January to March) sales detail data from the inventory management system and compared the sales volume, return rate, and gross profit of each style one by one. Through filtering and sorting, he noticed that the sell-through rate of small-size cargo pants and bright-color outerwear was much higher than other categories, confirming these two as the main bestsellers of spring.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Adjust subsequent purchase orders.
subevent.description: Based on the sales data analysis results, Lei Mingxuan opened the supplier's procurement system on his computer (e.g., Zhou Tao of Hangzhou Taosheng Apparel Co., Ltd.) and modified the spring replenishment orders that had not yet been shipped: he temporarily increased the purchase quantities of small-size cargo pants and bright-colored jackets (by about 30% each), while correspondingly reducing quantities of other slow-moving styles, then saved and submitted the modification request.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Create a one-week fat-loss diet plan.
description: On the evening of March 10, Lei Mingxuan used a mobile app to search for healthy fat-loss recipes, and referring to the light dishes his mother Wang Xiuying made, he wrote down a week-long fat-loss meal plan at his desk, specifying the ingredients for three meals a day, reducing takeout and high-calorie foods such as braised pork, and increasing protein and vegetable intake.

subevent.name: Look up healthy recipes
subevent.description: On the evening of March 10, Lei Mingxuan used a mobile app at home to look up healthy fat-loss recipes, searched for low-calorie, high-protein dish pairings, and browsed success stories in preparation for making a personal plan.
subevent.location: Shanghai - living room at home

subevent.name: Discuss light dish cooking methods with mother
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan referred to the light home-style dishes his mother Wang Xiuying usually cooked (such as steamed fish and blanched vegetables), and asked her about the specific cooking methods and seasoning techniques, in order to incorporate her light dishes into his fat-loss diet plan.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home kitchen

subevent.name: Make a fat-loss diet plan and write it out.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan, drawing on healthy recipes from the app and inspiration from his mother's light dishes, wrote down a one-week fat-loss diet plan on paper at his desk. He specified the food combinations for each of the three daily meals, reduced high-calorie foods such as takeout and braised pork, increased intake of protein (such as chicken breast, fish, and shrimp) and vegetables, and set a daily calorie target.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

name: Attended a specialty coffee tasting event and made friends with barista Xiao Ma.
description: On March 6, college classmate Zhao Min invited Lei Mingxuan via WeChat to a specialty coffee tasting event, and Lei Mingxuan readily agreed. On the afternoon of March 8, Lei Mingxuan went to an independent specialty coffee shop in Pudong New Area for the tasting. Accompanied by Zhao Min, he sampled several coffees from different origins and was deeply impressed by the layers of flavor. During the open discussion session, he took the initiative to talk with the barista Xiao Ma and learned that Xiao Ma had worked at several independent coffee shops. They had a very pleasant conversation, and Xiao Ma gave a detailed introduction to beginner pour-over equipment and demonstrated the brewing method. Lei Mingxuan immediately added Xiao Ma on WeChat. After the tasting, Lei Mingxuan and Zhao Min reviewed and shared their impressions outside the coffee shop and agreed to visit equipment stores together later. When he got home that night, Lei Mingxuan continued to ask Xiao Ma on WeChat for advice on buying beginner equipment, received detailed recommendations, and the two agreed to learn again on the weekend.

subevent.name: Zhao Min invited me to a coffee tasting event.
subevent.description: On March 6, college classmate Zhao Min contacted Lei Mingxuan via WeChat, saying there was a specialty coffee tasting event over the weekend, thought he would be interested, and warmly invited him to attend together. Lei Mingxuan had always been interested in coffee, so he agreed immediately and asked about the specific time, location, and cost of the event. Zhao Min explained in detail that the tasting would be held on the afternoon of March 8 at an independent café in Pudong New Area, and each person would need to pay a small material fee. Lei Mingxuan said he was looking forward to it, and they agreed to meet at the café at two o'clock that afternoon.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home (WeChat communication)

subevent.name: Heading to the specialty coffee tasting event.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of March 8, Lei Mingxuan set out from home at the agreed time, walked to the subway station, and took the subway to an independent specialty coffee shop near Zhangyang Road in Pudong New Area (about three subway stops from home). Along the way, he confirmed his location with Zhao Min via WeChat, and arrived at the coffee shop entrance around 13:50. The shop had an elegant atmosphere and full professional coffee equipment, and several participants were already seated. Lei Mingxuan checked in, received a tasting cup and note paper, and sat down with Zhao Min to wait for the event to start.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - an independent specialty coffee shop

subevent.name: Tasted coffee from multiple origins at the tasting session
subevent.description: The tasting session officially started at 14:00. The barista Xiao Ma demonstrated the pour-over process for more than ten participants and served five coffees from different origins, including Ethiopia Yirgacheffe, Colombia Huila, and Costa Rica honey-process. Under Zhao Min's guidance, Lei Mingxuan carefully smelled the dry aroma and wet aroma, took small sips to taste, and was amazed by the complexity and layering of the coffee flavors, carefully recording his impressions on the tasting form. During the session, he actively chatted with those around him, immersed in the experience of new knowledge.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - an independent specialty coffee shop

subevent.name: Had an in-depth conversation with barista Xiao Ma and exchanged WeChat contacts.
subevent.description: During the free-exchange session of the tasting event, Lei Mingxuan proactively walked up to the coffee bar and chatted with Xiao Ma. He first expressed his appreciation for the brewing flavor, then asked about the selection and techniques of entry-level pour-over equipment. Xiao Ma was enthusiastic and explained the basics of the V60 dripper, gooseneck kettle, grind size, and more, and on the spot demonstrated how the same beans taste different with different brewing methods. The two chatted for nearly half an hour, moving from coffee to the culture of independent cafés in Shanghai, in a congenial atmosphere. Lei Mingxuan immediately took out his phone to add Xiao Ma on WeChat. Xiao Ma happily agreed and promised to guide him in practicing pour-over later. The two agreed to meet again at the store next weekend to learn more.

Zhao Min also shared her earlier experiences with coffee, and the two agreed to visit a coffee equipment store together next time. Lei Mingxuan also showed Zhao Min the WeChat contact he had just added for Xiao Ma, and Zhao Min said Xiao Ma was a well-regarded barista in the circle, so learning from him was reliable. After saying goodbye, they each went home.

Xiao Ma quickly replied, recommending in detail the moderately priced Hario and Timemore series, and shared links to several reliable Taobao stores. The two chatted for another half hour about coffee bean storage and grind size. Lei Mingxuan carefully took notes and decided to order a basic set over the weekend. Xiao Ma also sent several short videos of his own brewing for reference.

name: Mother made green rice balls and recounted memories of Grandmother; Lei Mingxuan recorded his reflections.
description: On the evening of April 3, while making qingtuan in the kitchen of their Pudong home, his mother, Wang Xiuying, told her son Lei Mingxuan the story of how his grandmother, after coming to Shanghai from Nantong, had supported her children by setting up a stall in a longtang. Lei Mingxuan was deeply moved. Afterwards, in the living room, he jotted down key words in the memo app on his phone and helped arrange the qingtuan on plates, and the whole family enjoyed them together.

subevent.name: Mother making green rice balls
subevent.description: On the evening of April 3, Lei Mingxuan's mother Wang Xiuying made qingtuan by hand in the home kitchen, preparing the seasonal food for the Qingming Festival. She took out glutinous rice flour, mugwort juice, red bean paste filling and other ingredients from the refrigerator, skillfully kneaded the dough, wrapped the filling, rolled the balls, and put the qingtuan into the steamer one after another. A rich aroma of mugwort spread throughout the process.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - home kitchen

subevent.name: Mother recounts Grandmother's past
subevent.description: While making qingtuan, his mother Wang Xiuying, busy with her work, told her son Lei Mingxuan about his grandmother's (Wang Xiuying's mother) early experience of coming to Shanghai alone from Nantong, Jiangsu to make a living. She vividly described how his grandmother used to set up a stall at the entrance of an alley in Pudong to sell homemade snacks, the hard years when she single-handedly supported her children's schooling, and the scenes of life in Shanghai's alleyways in those days. Lei Mingxuan sat on a small stool in the kitchen listening intently, deeply fascinated by his mother's story.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - home kitchen

subevent.name: Lei Mingxuan records his thoughts

He took out his phone, opened the memo app, and jotted down keywords such as 'Grandmother · Nantong → Shanghai · alley stall · supporting her children' to organize and review later. Then he helped his mother arrange the steamed green rice balls on plates, and the whole family enjoyed them together.

name: Restore fitness training for the weekend basketball game.

Out of practice, he was slightly short on stamina, but several fast-break layups awakened his muscle memory. After the game, everyone agreed to have a group session at least once a week as cross-training alongside running to improve overall athletic performance and cardiorespiratory fitness.

subevent.description: From 9:20 to 10:50 a.m. on March 23, Lei Mingxuan participated in a four-on-four full-court basketball game. The game consisted of four quarters (20 minutes each, running clock). Lei Mingxuan scored on a fast-break layup in the first quarter, waking up his muscle memory; but having been out of practice for a long time, his stamina declined in the third quarter and he made two turnovers. Throughout the game, the red and blue teams stayed close on the scoreboard, and in the end the red team narrowly won 62:58. Lei Mingxuan personally contributed 8 points, 4 rebounds, and 2 assists.

In the evening, he chatted with his mother, Wang Xiuying, about how the game went, saying he still needed to build up his stamina, and planned a recovery jog for the next day.

On April 18, Lei Mingxuan personally wrote the copy, released the first introduction to the mountain-style new collection, and launched an appointment-based try-on event in the WeChat group, which received a positive response.

Lei Mingxuan and his shop assistant Xiao Lin (Lin Xiao) unpacked the boxes together, inspected the quality, fabric, and workmanship of each item one by one, and counted the quantities after confirming everything was correct. The two then discussed how to display the new mountain-style items, deciding to replace the entire central display area with the new pieces, and pair them with existing outdoor backpacks and accessories to create an outdoor scene, emphasizing the techwear style and visual impact.

name: Family spring trip to Suzhou to mend relationships
description: To make up for last month's argument with his mother and honor his promise of a monthly family gathering, Lei Mingxuan planned a one-day trip to Suzhou. On the morning of April 19, he drove his parents to Suzhou, visited the Humble Administrator's Garden and Pingjiang Road, and at noon tasted authentic Suzhou cuisine at a restaurant on Pingjiang Road. He personally poured tea and served food for his parents, creating a warm atmosphere. In the afternoon, they strolled along Jinji Lake and took a family photo. During the spring outing, the mother-son rapport was restored. His mother smiled and chatted about the past, and Lei Mingxuan felt the importance of family support.

subevent.name: Drive to Suzhou
subevent.description: In the morning, Lei Mingxuan drove his family car from his home on Zhangyang Road in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, carrying his father Lei Jianguo and mother Wang Xiuying, and headed to Suzhou along the Shanghai-Nanjing Expressway to start a family spring trip to mend their relationship.

subevent.name: Visit the Humble Administrator’s Garden.
subevent.description: After arriving in Suzhou, Lei Mingxuan accompanied his parents into the Humble Administrator's Garden and enjoyed the pavilions, towers, rockeries, and streams of the classical Jiangnan garden together. He took the initiative to explain the history of the sights and stopped many times to help his parents take photos. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant, and the rift between mother and son caused by last month's argument gradually disappeared.
subevent.location: Suzhou - Humble Administrator's Garden

subevent.name: Stroll along Pingjiang Road and enjoy lunch.
subevent.description: Around noon, Lei Mingxuan took his parents to the Pingjiang Road Historical and Cultural Block, strolling along and enjoying the water-town charm of Suzhou. Then they chose an authentic local Suzhou restaurant on Pingjiang Road. Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to pour tea and serve food for his parents, ordering dishes they loved, such as squirrel mandarin fish and water shield soup. At the table, the three recalled old times, and his mother, Wang Xiuying, fondly talked about funny stories from Lei Mingxuan's childhood. The atmosphere was warm.
subevent.location: Suzhou - Pingjiang Road

subevent.name: Stroll around Jinji Lake and take family photos
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Lei Mingxuan drove his parents to the shore of Jinji Lake. They strolled along the lakeside path, enjoying the modern lake view and the city skyline. In front of an iconic view, Lei Mingxuan asked a passerby to take a family photo of the three of them. His mother, Wang Xiuying, beamed with joy, and his father, Lei Jianguo, also showed an unusually relaxed expression. Lei Mingxuan felt the importance of family support, and the silent understanding between him and his mother was fully restored.
subevent.location: Suzhou - Jinji Lake

subevent.name: Drove back to Shanghai.
subevent.description: In the evening, Lei Mingxuan drove his parents from Suzhou back to their home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai. Along the way, the three continued to talk happily, sharing the day's experiences and photos, and the mother-son relationship was effectively repaired.

In the afternoon, in the uncle's living room, Lei Mingxuan had a deep conversation with his younger cousin Shen Jie (a fashion buyer). Shen Jie shared outdoor-style clothing trends and suggested he bring them into his store, promising to provide sourcing channels once back in Shanghai. On the afternoon of the fourth day (February 1), Shen Jie sent him information on several suppliers via WeChat. Lei Mingxuan thanked her and planned to investigate them after the holiday.

The visits were compact, with about an hour spent at each home, and they returned home in the evening.

description: On Saturday afternoon, April 11, Lei Mingxuan saw his mother Wang Xiuying preparing to make pan-fried buns in the kitchen and offered to help. While kneading dough and chopping filling, they chatted about the funny stories of his mother learning to make dim sum when she was young. Lei Mingxuan tried wrapping pan-fried buns for the first time; although the shapes were crooked, his mother encouraged him to practice more. In the evening, the family enjoyed the hot pan-fried buns, and Lei Mingxuan felt a warmth of family he hadn't felt in a long time.

She repeatedly kneaded the fermented dough while chopping pork filling and adding seasonings such as chopped scallions and minced ginger. Lei Mingxuan studied carefully at her side and tried kneading the dough. During the process, Wang Xiuying brought up amusing stories about learning to make local Shanghainese snacks from her grandmother when she was young. Lei Mingxuan listened and asked questions, and the mother and son chatted and laughed in a warm atmosphere.

Lei Mingxuan tried making shengjian buns for the first time. Because he was unfamiliar with the technique, the shengjian buns he made were misshapen and leaking filling. His mother Wang Xiuying didn’t scold him; she patiently encouraged him to practice more and corrected his pleating technique hand over hand. The two continued working together and made about two baskets of shengjian buns.

Although the ones Lei Mingxuan had wrapped were misshapen, they tasted good. The family ate and chatted, and Lei Mingxuan felt the warmth and contentment of family that he had long missed.

subevent.name: Watch the sunrise in the early morning
subevent.description: On the early morning of March 30, Lei Mingxuan got up very early, walked out of the tent, and waited for the sunrise. As the eastern sky gradually brightened, the sunrise at Dongtan on Chongming Island was magnificent, with orange-red light flooding the mudflats and reed marshes. He felt extremely awestruck and fulfilled, believing that this camping trip was well worth it.
subevent.location: Shanghai – Dongtan, Chongming Island

subevent.name: Closed up the shop and returned to his home in Shanghai.
subevent.description: After watching the sunrise, Lei Mingxuan began to pack up the campsite: he took down the tent, folded the stove, cleaned up trash, and packed all the equipment, making sure to leave no trace. He then drove back along the same route to his home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, ending this unforgettable first camping trip.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Clean gear and organize photos after returning home
subevent.description: Back home that afternoon, Lei Mingxuan washed and air-dried the camping equipment such as the tent, ground cloth, and stove, then organized the photos he had taken of the starry sky, sunrise, and campsite on his phone, posted them on WeChat Moments to record the camping trip, and meanwhile started searching online for professional pour-over coffee sets to plan his next outdoor coffee experience.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Completed the annual health check-up, and BMI dropped to the normal range.
description: On April 5, Lei Mingxuan booked an annual health checkup at Gongli Hospital in Pudong New Area and confirmed it for the morning of April 8. As required, he fasted and brought his ID before the checkup, then went to the hospital on the morning of April 8. After completing blood routine, liver function, blood lipids, electrocardiogram, and other tests, he got the report about an hour later: his weight was 78 kg, his BMI had dropped from 27.0 to 26.3, and all indicators were normal except for mild fatty liver. The doctor advised him to keep exercising and watching his diet, and he felt more confident about his weight-loss plan.

subevent.name: Schedule and confirm the physical exam time
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan made an appointment for the annual health check-up at Gongli Hospital in Pudong New Area by phone or online platform, confirmed the check-up time for the morning of April 8, and learned the precautions before the check-up, such as the fasting requirement.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home

subevent.name: Preparation before the physical exam.
subevent.description: Following the physical examination requirements, Lei Mingxuan fasted after dinner on April 7 and drank only water on the morning of April 8. He brought his ID card and medical insurance card and set off for Gongli Hospital in Pudong New Area before 7:30.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home

subevent.name: Completed the annual health checkup.
subevent.description: On the morning of April 8, 2025, Lei Mingxuan had his annual health checkup at Gongli Hospital in Pudong New Area, including complete blood count, liver function, blood lipids, electrocardiogram, and other items. The checkup went smoothly and took about 1.5 hours.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Gongli Hospital Physical Examination Center

subevent.name: Obtain the physical exam report and listen to the doctor's advice.
subevent.description: About one hour after completing the physical examination, Lei Mingxuan received the paper medical report, showing a weight of 78 kg and a BMI of 26.3 (down 0.7 from before). All indicators were normal except for mild fatty liver. The attending physician advised him to continue doing aerobic exercise at least three times a week and reduce high-fat foods to further improve the fatty liver and lose weight.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Gongli Hospital doctor's office

name: Had a frank conversation with Xie Fei; the basketball circle relationship entered an adjustment period.
description: Continuing the agreement made at the end of May, on the afternoon of June 1 (Sunday), Lei Mingxuan met Xie Fei at the small noodle shop next to the basketball court. He explained in detail how his new hobbies—camping, coffee, and writing—had squeezed his time, and sincerely expressed how much he valued their brotherhood. Xie Fei said he understood but admitted he needed time to adapt. The two reached a consensus of 'don't force it, keep in touch,' and the old friend circle relationship shifted from tension to a respectful, gently distant warmth.

subevent.name: Set off to the noodle shop
subevent.description: After confirming his appointment with Xie Fei at home, Lei Mingxuan set off that afternoon for the small noodle shop next to the basketball court, preparing for a frank face-to-face talk with Xie Fei. Dressed in casual clothes, he walked there, thinking on the way about how to explain to Xie Fei that his schedule had changed because of new hobbies such as camping, coffee, and writing.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home to the small noodle shop next to the basketball court

subevent.name: Have an honest face-to-face talk with Xie Fei.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan and Xie Fei met and sat down in a small noodle shop next to the basketball court. After ordering their noodles, they began an in-depth conversation. Lei Mingxuan explained in detail that his time was being squeezed by new hobbies such as camping, coffee, and writing, and sincerely expressed how much he valued the many years of brotherhood with Xie Fei. Xie Fei listened seriously and said he understood the changes in Lei Mingxuan's life, but admitted that he needed some time to adapt to this new pace. In the end, the two reached a consensus of "don't force it, keep in touch," and the old-friend-circle relationship shifted from the earlier tension to a respect embedded in gentle distance.
subevent.location: Shanghai - small noodle shop beside the basketball court

subevent.name: Ended the face-to-face meeting and said goodbye.
subevent.description: After the meeting ended, Lei Mingxuan and Xie Fei finished their noodles and paid the bill. The two walked out of the noodle shop together, shook hands or high-fived again at the door, and confirmed they would stay in touch. Lei Mingxuan then walked home, while Xie Fei left on his own, each returning to the rest of the day's schedule.
subevent.location: Shanghai - in front of the small noodle shop next to the basketball court

name: Organized a camping outing to practice outdoor pour-over coffee and refine preparations for the western Sichuan trip
description: To deepen his interest in outdoor pour-over coffee and test equipment for a road trip in western Sichuan, Lei Mingxuan organized a weekend camping trip. He contacted barista Xiao Ma and college classmate Zhao Min in advance and invited them to join him at the Gulf National Forest Park campsite on the outskirts of Shanghai. They set out on the morning of April 26. After setting up the tent, Xiao Ma guided Lei Mingxuan on stabilizing pour-over parameters in outdoor conditions, using portable pour-over equipment, and comparing how different grind sizes affected flavor. Zhao Min was responsible for taking photos and recording. In the afternoon, the three hiked through the woods, and in the evening they chatted around the campfire. Lei Mingxuan shared stories about his family in the longtang, while Xiao Ma talked about what he had seen in coffee-growing regions. On the morning of April 27, Lei Mingxuan went for a solo run and practiced pour-over by the lake again, feeling the fusion of nature and coffee. They packed up camp and returned in the morning. This camping trip not only strengthened their friendship but also brought him a breakthrough in pour-over technique, while the practical testing of camping gear provided valuable experience for the western Sichuan trip.

subevent.name: Going to Bay National Forest Park.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan drove his own car, carrying camping gear and portable pour-over coffee equipment, departing from his home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and heading to the Bay National Forest Park campsite in Fengxian District. Traveling with him were barista Xiao Ma (Ma Lei) and college classmate Zhao Min. On the way, the three discussed the camping plan and pour-over coffee techniques.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Bay National Forest Park, Fengxian District

subevent.name: Setting up the tent and settling the equipment
subevent.description: After arriving at the campsite at Bay National Forest Park, Lei Mingxuan, Zhao Min, and Xiao Ma (Ma Lei) set up a two-person tent in the designated camping area, laid out ground mats and sleeping bags, and arranged the outdoor tables, chairs, and cooking utensils. Lei Mingxuan specially tested his newly purchased windproof stove and portable kettle to test the durability of the equipment for the western Sichuan road trip.
subevent.location: Shanghai Fengxian District - Bay National Forest Park Campsite

subevent.name: Outdoor pour-over coffee hands-on practice
subevent.description: After the tent was set up, Xiao Ma, the barista, guided Lei Mingxuan in front of the camping table and chairs on how to keep pour-over parameters stable in outdoor conditions. Using the portable pour-over equipment Lei Mingxuan had brought (such as a pour-over kettle, dripper, and filter paper), they tried coarse, medium, and fine coffee grounds, comparing water flow speed and flavor differences. Zhao Min stood by, using her phone to document the process, and helped with timing and tasting. Lei Mingxuan focused on practicing the stability of circular water pouring, while Xiao Ma corrected issues with pouring height and speed.
subevent.location: Shanghai Fengxian District - Bay National Forest Park Campsite

subevent.name: Forest hike and nature observation
