subevent.description: In the afternoon, Lei Mingxuan, Zhao Min, and Xiao Ma hiked along the wooded trails in the park, enjoying the wetland and forest scenery. Along the way, Lei Mingxuan took photos of plants and birds with his phone, while Zhao Min shared outdoor photography tips. After about two hours of hiking, they returned to the campsite to rest.
subevent.location: Fengxian District, Shanghai - Forest Trail in Bay National Forest Park

subevent.name: Campfire chat and story sharing.
subevent.description: In the evening, the three sat around a campfire they had lit and enjoyed a simple outdoor dinner. Lei Mingxuan shared family stories from his childhood in a Shanghai alleyway, while Xiao Ma talked about what he had seen in Yunnan's coffee-growing region. Zhao Min was in charge of grilling food and adding firewood. They exchanged travel experiences and their expectations for the self-drive trip to western Sichuan.
subevent.location: Bonfire area of the campsite at Bay National Forest Park, Fengxian District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Early morning lakeside run
subevent.description: At 5:30 AM on April 27, Lei Mingxuan got up alone, put on his workout gear, and jogged about 5 kilometers along the lake near the campsite, enjoying the quiet morning air and the lake scenery. After the run, he returned to the tent to stretch and relax.
subevent.location: Lakeside trail in Shanghai Bay National Forest Park, Fengxian District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Practice pour-over coffee by the lake again.
subevent.description: After the morning run, Lei Mingxuan took his portable pour-over coffee kit and walked alone to a flat rock by the lake, where he brewed a cup of coffee. Immersed in the natural surroundings with the breeze and birdsong, he practiced precise water control once again and appreciated the blend of coffee and nature. This session brought him a new breakthrough in pour-over technique and increased his confidence in practicing it during the self-drive trip to Western Sichuan.
subevent.location: Fengxian District, Shanghai - lakeside of Bay National Forest Park

subevent.name: Striking camp, packing up, and returning to Shanghai.
subevent.description: Around 9 a.m., Lei Mingxuan, Zhao Min, and Xiao Ma began dismantling the tent and packing all gear and trash into separate categories. After confirming nothing was left behind, Lei Mingxuan drove back to his home in Pudong, Shanghai. On the way, the three summarized their camping experience, and Lei Mingxuan confirmed that all the camping equipment (tent, sleeping bags, stove, etc.) functioned properly and was suitable for a self-drive trip to western Sichuan.
subevent.location: From Bay National Forest Park, Fengxian District, Shanghai, to home in Pudong New Area

name: Comprehensive vehicle maintenance and installation of protective plates cost 2,800 yuan
description: On April 23, Lei Mingxuan booked a full maintenance service and installation of an engine underguard at He Zhiqiang Auto Care Center via WeChat. On April 24, he drove the car to the center in Minhang District, Shanghai, where a long-distance inspection and maintenance were carried out, including an oil change, brake system inspection, tire rotation, cooling system check, and installation of the engine underguard, for a total of 2,800 yuan. During the process, Master He shared his driving experience in western Sichuan, and after it was done, Lei Mingxuan felt confident about the condition of the car.

subevent.name: Schedule a car maintenance appointment
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan contacted He Zhiqiang, the owner of Zhiqiang Auto Care Center, via WeChat to make an appointment for the morning of April 24 for a full vehicle maintenance and installation of an engine underguard, and briefly explained the need for a long-distance trip inspection. Master He said no problem and confirmed the time.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Home (contacted via WeChat)

subevent.name: Send the car to the maintenance center and communicate the requirements
subevent.description: On the morning of April 24, Lei Mingxuan drove his family car to Zhiqiang Auto Care Center in Minhang District, Shanghai. After arriving, he handed the car to the owner, He Zhiqiang, and explained in detail the maintenance requirements: changing the engine oil, checking the brake system, rotating the tires, inspecting the cooling system, and installing an engine underguard. After Master He recorded the requirements, he asked Lei Mingxuan to wait in the lounge.
subevent.location: Zhiqiang Auto Maintenance Center, Minhang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Carrying out comprehensive vehicle maintenance
subevent.description: Master He Zhiqiang and his staff performed comprehensive maintenance on Lei Mingxuan's car: replaced the engine oil and oil filter, checked and topped up the brake fluid, rotated the four tires and adjusted the tire pressure, and checked and topped up the coolant. Lei Mingxuan watched part of the process through the glass window from the waiting area and chatted with Master He a few times, asking about maintenance details.
subevent.location: Repair bay at Zhiqiang Auto Care Center, Minhang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Paid the fee and retrieved the vehicle
subevent.description: After all maintenance and installation work was completed, He Zhiqiang gave Lei Mingxuan a detailed cost list: full maintenance (including engine oil, brake fluid, tire service, cooling system inspection, etc.) came to 1,800 yuan, and installing the engine underguard (including labor) was 1,000 yuan, for a total of 2,800 yuan. Lei Mingxuan paid by mobile banking transfer, carefully inspected the vehicle's exterior and maintenance results, and after confirming everything was correct, picked up the car and left the service center.
subevent.location: Front desk of Zhiqiang Auto Maintenance Center, Minhang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Checked the vehicle and recorded maintenance information after getting home.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan drove the maintained vehicle back to his home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai. In the parking lot downstairs, he checked the vehicle's systems again, confirming that the oil level was normal, the brakes were responsive, and the engine guard was securely installed. Very satisfied with the car's condition, he recorded the maintenance items and costs in his phone memo and felt confident about the upcoming long-distance road trip.
subevent.location: Parking lot below No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After the mother unilaterally arranged a blind date and sparked a fierce argument, a father-son heart-to-heart brought a temporary understanding.
description: On the evening of Friday, May 9, Lei Mingxuan had planned to leave for camping at Moganshan, but his mother Wang Xiuying had secretly arranged for him to meet the daughter of a relative's colleague at a restaurant that evening. Lei Mingxuan was forced to cancel the trip and broke into an argument with his mother on the spot. His mother said, "Your father also worked this hard when he was young, and his health broke down later. I'm afraid no one will take care of you." After the intense conflict, on the morning of Saturday, May 10, the whole family sat down for a serious talk. Lei Mingxuan said frankly, "I want to build my career first and consider starting a family after completing the trip to western Sichuan." His mother reluctantly accepted but stressed that he must maintain his health. After a silence, his father said, "You are responsible for your own life." The family relationship moved toward a new balance through the clash.

subevent.name: Mother secretly arranged a blind date.
subevent.description: During the day on May 9, his mother, Wang Xiuying, privately contacted the daughter of a relative's colleague and arranged to meet at a restaurant in Pudong that evening, intending to arrange a blind date for Lei Mingxuan, all without informing Lei Mingxuan himself.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

subevent.name: Lei Mingxuan learned about the matchmaking arrangement and had a heated argument with his mother
subevent.description: On the evening of May 9, when Lei Mingxuan was preparing to set off for camping in Mogan Mountain, his mother Wang Xiuying told him that she had arranged a blind date for him. Lei Mingxuan angrily canceled the camping plan and had a fierce quarrel with his mother on the spot. His mother said with tears, 'Your father worked just as hard when he was young, and later his health collapsed. I'm afraid no one will take care of you.' Lei Mingxuan insisted on building his career first. His father Lei Jianguo witnessed the conflict.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: After the conflict, family members each calmed down
subevent.description: After the argument on the evening of May 9, Lei Mingxuan returned to his own room to calm down. His father, Lei Jianguo, comforted his mother, Wang Xiuying. The family atmosphere was tense, and the three of them went the whole night without speaking.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - room at home

subevent.name: The whole family sat together for a deep conversation and reached a tentative understanding.
subevent.description: On the morning of May 10, Lei Mingxuan, his mother Wang Xiuying, and his father Lei Jianguo sat together in the living room at home for a frank, in-depth family conversation. Lei Mingxuan clearly said that he wanted to focus on his career first and planned to consider marriage only after completing the Western Sichuan road trip. His mother Wang Xiuying reluctantly accepted but stressed that he must pay attention to his health. His father Lei Jianguo was silent for a moment, then said that he respected his son's choice: 'You are responsible for your own life.' In the end, the family relationship moved toward a new balance through this clash.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Plan the budget for a self-driving trip in western Sichuan and set up a dedicated savings account
description: On the evening of May 20, Lei Mingxuan used Excel at home to list in detail the estimated expenses for a self-driving trip to western Sichuan, including car rental, fuel, accommodation, meals, tickets, and emergency reserve funds, with a total budget of about 25,000 yuan. He decided that from that day on, he would set aside 3,000 yuan each month from the store's profits into a dedicated bank card as a travel reserve. When his father Lei Jianguo learned of this, he offered to contribute 5,000 yuan, but Lei Mingxuan politely declined, though he agreed he would consider accepting it if the budget was exceeded.

subevent.name: Itemize the costs of the western Sichuan self-drive trip and calculate the total budget.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan itemized the estimated expenses for the self-driving trip to western Sichuan in Excel, including about 8,000 yuan for car rental, about 3,000 yuan for fuel, about 6,000 yuan for accommodation, about 4,000 yuan for meals, and about 2,000 yuan for attraction tickets, and set aside 2,000 yuan as emergency reserve. After calculation, the total budget was about 25,000 yuan. He also recorded the basis and sources for each cost estimate.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - home study

subevent.name: Communicated the budget with father Lei Jianguo and politely declined his sponsorship
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan walked out of the study with the completed budget sheet and showed it to his father Lei Jianguo in the living room, explaining the detailed cost plan for the self-driving trip to western Sichuan. After listening, Lei Jianguo offered to sponsor 5,000 yuan to support his son's trip. Lei Mingxuan thanked his father for the kindness but politely declined, saying he could afford it himself, and promised that if the trip really went over budget, he would consider accepting his father's help.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Set up a dedicated savings plan and keep records
subevent.description: After talking with his father, Lei Mingxuan returned to his study, took out a bank card he rarely used, and added a new worksheet in Excel as a dedicated savings tracking sheet. He decided that starting this month, he would set aside 3,000 yuan from the clothing store's profits each month and deposit it into that card, with the 5th of every month set as the fixed deposit day. At the same time, he recorded this savings plan in his financial management software as a fixed expense item for the next 12 months.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - home study

name: Pulled a hidden figure from a blind box at a designer toy store
description: On the evening of May 19, Lei Mingxuan went alone to the Pop Mart store in the mall and bought two boxes of blind boxes from the new series. He opened them on the spot and unexpectedly got a hidden figure. Excited, he took photos and sent them to the collector group, drawing envy from Lin Jing and others. This little surprise reminded him of the joy of collecting designer toys, and he carefully placed the hidden figure in his display cabinet at home.

subevent.name: Going to the Pop Mart store at the mall
subevent.description: On the evening of May 19, 2025, Lei Mingxuan left alone from a clothing store on the 2nd floor of a mall on Century Avenue in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, or from his home, and walked or drove to a Pop Mart physical store in the same business district, planning to buy blind boxes from the new series.
subevent.location: A shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Purchased and unboxed blind boxes.
subevent.description: At a Pop Mart store, Lei Mingxuan selected two blind boxes from a newly launched series. After paying, he opened them right away in the store's lounge area. When he opened one of the boxes, he discovered he had pulled the hidden figure from the series. He was pleasantly surprised and examined it closely to confirm.
subevent.location: Pop Mart store, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Took a photo and shared it in the collector friends group
subevent.description: Excitedly, Lei Mingxuan took out his phone and shot several close-up photos of the hidden edition figure from different angles. He immediately uploaded them to the WeChat group named 'Trendy Toy Collectors Circle' with a text message sharing the surprise. Collectors in the group, including Lin Jing and Gao Yuan, liked and commented one after another, expressing envy and congratulations. The group was lively.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - POP MART store rest area

subevent.name: Returned home and placed the hidden figure in the display cabinet
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan left the mall with the hidden-edition blind box and returned to his home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai. He opened his designer toy display cabinet, carefully took the hidden-edition figure out of its packaging, and placed it in a prominent spot, adjusting its angle to look good with his other collectibles. He then admired it with satisfaction for a while.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - by the display cabinet in the living room at home

name: Finalized and followed up on summer new-season orders.
description: From May 4 to May 6, 2025, Lei Mingxuan carried out a series of tasks for the summer new product orders. On May 4, he organized past sales data and customer feedback in the store office and listed communication points such as functional fabrics, price ranges, and minimum order quantities. On May 5, he had a video conference with Hangzhou supplier Zhou Tao, selected five new styles, and confirmed the first order of 300 pieces. On May 6, he sent the order confirmation, paid a 30% deposit, and completed pre-entry records in the internal inventory system. The whole process smoothly consolidated the supply chain relationship and laid a foundation for summer sales.

subevent.name: Pre-meeting preparation
subevent.description: In the office of his own shop, Lei Mingxuan sorted through the sales data of the store's summer clothing over the past two months and browsed customers' feedback on fabric preferences and style suggestions on WeChat. Based on this, he listed the key points to discuss with supplier Zhou Tao, including the desired functional fabrics, price range, and minimum order quantity, making full preparations for the next day's video conference.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Finalized the order via video conference.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of May 5, Lei Mingxuan had a video meeting with Zhou Tao, a supplier from Hangzhou, via WeChat video in the store office. Zhou Tao showed several techwear-style fabric samples. Combining the store's positioning and customer feedback, Lei Mingxuan discussed style details, color schemes, and costs in detail with Zhou Tao. In the end, the two parties finalized five new styles and confirmed a total first order of 300 pieces, agreeing to ship before the end of the month. Lei Mingxuan was satisfied with the communication and thanked Zhou Tao for his cooperation.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Order follow-up and confirmation
subevent.description: The day after the video meeting, Lei Mingxuan communicated with Zhou Tao again on WeChat and formally sent an order confirmation containing the detailed specifications, quantities, and delivery dates for the 5 new styles. He paid a 30% deposit via bank transfer and reminded Zhou Tao to pay attention to fabric quality and delivery schedule. At the same time, Lei Mingxuan created a pre-inbound record for this batch of goods in the store's inventory management system, making backend preparations for putting them on sale at the end of the month.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - home study

name: Communicated with financial advisor Xu Feng and set up a regular fund investment plan.
description: On May 12, Lei Mingxuan made an appointment with financial advisor Xu Feng via WeChat, and they agreed to meet at a Starbucks near Jing'an Temple on the afternoon of May 14 to discuss the regular fund investment plan. On May 14, Lei Mingxuan met Xu Feng for an in-depth talk, accepted his suggestion to adjust the fund portfolio, converted some actively managed funds into index fund regular investments, and added a recommended conservative bond fund as an anchor. He set up a plan on the spot through the mobile app to invest 3,000 yuan monthly starting next month, accumulating funds for the Western Sichuan road trip and long-term entrepreneurship.

subevent.name: Make an appointment to meet financial advisor Xu Feng.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan contacted financial advisor Xu Feng via WeChat to schedule a meeting at a Starbucks near Jing'an Temple on the afternoon of May 14 to discuss a fund dollar-cost averaging plan. Xu Feng confirmed the time was feasible, and the two agreed to meet.
subevent.location: Shanghai - online communication

subevent.name: Go to Starbucks for a face-to-face meeting with Xu Feng
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan, as scheduled, left from his home or store in Pudong New Area and took the subway or drove to the Starbucks near Jing'an Temple. In the afternoon, he met Xu Feng and had an in-depth exchange about current market fluctuations. Xu Feng suggested adjusting the fund portfolio, converting some actively managed funds into regular index fund investments, and recommended a steady bond fund as a ballast.
subevent.location: Starbucks at Jing'an Temple, Jing'an District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Accepted the advice and set up a regular investment plan.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan took Xu Feng's advice and, right there on his phone, used the fund app to set up a monthly auto-investment plan starting next month: 3,000 yuan per month in a combination of an index fund and a bond fund, aiming to accumulate funds for the Western Sichuan self-driving trip and long-term entrepreneurship.
subevent.location: Starbucks at Jing'an Temple, Jing'an District, Shanghai

name: Launched a WeChat community and held the first flash sale
description: On March 10, Lei Mingxuan created the store's WeChat community. After preparing a welcome message and group rules, he invited more than 30 regular customers into the group. Over the next few days, he built community atmosphere through interactive topics, outfit sharing, and coupon distribution, and previewed the flash sale. On the evening of March 14, he successfully held the first limited-time flash sale of mountain-style jackets, selling 12 units and gaining positive reviews. On March 15, he reviewed the event data, thanked customers, and planned to update the community weekly.

subevent.name: Preparing to create WeChat communities
subevent.description: On the morning of March 10, in the office of his own store, Lei Mingxuan, based on the community operation plan he had drafted earlier, prepared the WeChat group QR code, welcome message template, group rules description, and personalized scripts for inviting regular customers, and also set up the group admin role.
subevent.location: Unit A-208, Level 2, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (the office of his own clothing store).

subevent.name: Invite regular customers to join the group
subevent.description: On the afternoon of March 10, Lei Mingxuan contacted more than 30 long-term regular customers one by one via WeChat, sent personalized invitation messages and the group QR code, and successfully invited them to join the newly established store WeChat community. During the invitation, he briefly introduced the community functions—regular outfit sharing, benefit distribution, and flash-sale events.
subevent.location: A-208, Floor 2, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (own clothing store)

subevent.name: Posting a community interaction topic
subevent.description: On the morning of March 11, Lei Mingxuan posted the first interactive topic in the newly created WeChat group, asking customers about their preferences and needs for spring jackets and encouraging group members to share photos of their outfits. At the same time, he shared detailed real shots of the new mountain-style jackets in the group, replied to customer questions, and created a lively group atmosphere.
subevent.location: A-208, Floor 2, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (own clothing store)

subevent.name: Mountain-style jacket outfit sharing content
subevent.description: On March 12, Lei Mingxuan published meticulously crafted outfit content featuring mountain-style jackets in the community, including multiple styling options and the effect on different body types, along with a store promo code. At the same time, he announced the first flash sale to be held at 8 PM on March 14, and collected customers' feedback on which flash sale styles they were interested in.
subevent.location: A-208, Floor 2, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (own clothing store)

subevent.name: Flash sale event preview and coupon distribution
subevent.description: On March 13, Lei Mingxuan officially released the details of the flash sale at 8 p.m. on March 14 in the community: the first batch of mountain-style jackets would be available for a limited-time flash sale, with prices directly reduced and additional coupons stacked. He distributed exclusive flash-sale coupons in the group, reminded customers to set their alarms, and shared outfit posts again to maintain momentum.
subevent.location: A-208, Floor 2, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (own clothing store)

subevent.name: Final checks and preparations before the flash sale event
subevent.description: On the morning of March 14, Lei Mingxuan checked the flash sale inventory, coupon system settings, and product link validity in the store, and prepared the sales scripts and interactive segments. He also did a final countdown reminder in the community group to make sure everything was in order.
subevent.location: A-208, Floor 2, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (own clothing store)

subevent.name: Held the first WeChat community flash-sale event
subevent.description: At exactly 8:00 p.m. on March 14, Lei Mingxuan launched the flash sale on schedule in the community group, posting the flash sale link for the mountain-style jackets and the coupon code. He updated the sold-out progress in real time, interacted with customers in the group, answered questions about sizes and fabrics, and shared styling advice. The event lasted about an hour, and he successfully sold 12 mountain-style jackets that evening. Customers gave positive feedback in the group, with a steady stream of praise.
subevent.location: A-208, Floor 2, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (own clothing store)

subevent.name: Flash sale follow-up: data statistics and customer appreciation
subevent.description: On the morning of March 15, Lei Mingxuan did a data review of the first flash sale in the shop office, calculating sales revenue, order volume, coupon usage rate, and sorting through customer feedback. He posted a thank-you letter in the group, teased that content would continue to update next week, and collected customer suggestions for the next round of activities.
subevent.location: Unit A-208, Level 2, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (the office of his own clothing store).

name: Father takes the initiative to care about the store's operations, and the father-son relationship improves.
description: On the evening of May 13, 2025, his father Lei Jianguo took the initiative for the first time to ask about the operations of Lei Mingxuan's clothing store, breaking his usual silence. On May 15, his father further offered to go to the store over the weekend to help with sorting goods, and Lei Mingxuan happily agreed. On Saturday, May 25, his father arrived at the store as promised, carefully helped organize the shelves and check stock, and the father and son had lunch together in a warm atmosphere. This series of interactions marked a thaw and improvement in their father-son relationship.

subevent.name: Father took the initiative to care about the shop's business for the first time.
subevent.description: After dinner, Lei Jianguo, no longer silently reading the newspaper as usual, took the initiative to ask Lei Mingxuan about the recent performance, customer traffic, and sales of his clothing store. Lei Mingxuan was surprised but pleased, and answered his father's questions in detail, mentioning that the store had recently introduced some trendy outdoor functional apparel. His father expressed concern after hearing this, but made no comment.
subevent.location: Home dining room, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Father offered to help out at the store on the weekend.
subevent.description: Lei Jianguo told Lei Mingxuan at dinner that since he was so busy with work every week and had nothing to do on weekends, he could help at the store with restocking, tidying clothing racks, and so on. Lei Mingxuan readily agreed and thanked his father for the support, saying the store had recently received a lot of stock and really needed the extra help.
subevent.location: Home at Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Father helped at the store for the first time, tidying up the goods.
subevent.description: On Saturday morning, Lei Jianguo arrived as agreed at Lei Mingxuan's clothing store in Century Avenue Mall. Lei Mingxuan showed his father around the store layout and the rules for merchandise placement. His father carefully organized the shelves as required, checked inventory, and helped wipe the display cabinets. The father and son had takeout lunch together in the store in a warm atmosphere.
subevent.location: Shop, Century Avenue Mall, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: During the camping trip, shop assistant Xiao Lin handled a customer dispute independently and gained more trust.
description: On the afternoon of May 17, a customer came to the store to complain about clothing dye staining. Xiao Lin handled the situation calmly and resolved the dispute properly through careful communication and a flexible compensation plan. Lei Mingxuan only learned about it afterward when he returned from camping and heard the details. He was impressed by Xiao Lin's ability to handle unexpected situations and decided to delegate more of the store's daily management.

subevent.name: Customer came to the store to complain about clothes being stained
subevent.description: On the afternoon of May 17, an emotionally agitated customer came to the clothing store located in a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to complain about fading and color bleeding in clothes previously bought at Lei Mingxuan's store, and demanded an explanation from the store owner. At the time, Lei Mingxuan was out in the suburbs attending a camping event and was not in the store, so the shop assistant Xiao Lin received the customer.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Xiao Lin handling a customer dispute
subevent.description: Store clerk Xiao Lin stayed calm and composed in the face of an agitated customer. He first calmed the customer down, asked in detail about how the staining happened, and inspected the stain on the clothing. He then proposed a reasonable compensation plan, such as a return and refund or a replacement of equal value plus a coupon. After patient communication and negotiation, the customer finally accepted the plan and left satisfied. The whole process lasted about an hour.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Lei Mingxuan listened to the report and decided to delegate authority.
subevent.description: After Lei Mingxuan returned to the store from the campsite, Xiao Lin proactively gave him a detailed report on the whole process and result of handling a customer dispute that afternoon. Lei Mingxuan was very satisfied and pleasantly surprised by Xiao Lin's ability to handle unexpected situations independently, communication skills, and sense of responsibility, and felt that Xiao Lin was fully capable of independently managing daily affairs. He immediately decided to further delegate the store's daily operations, giving Xiao Lin more decision-making power (such as return authorization and small compensation authorization) to encourage his growth and improve the store's operating efficiency.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Solo hiking and camping at Moganshan and trying outdoor pour-over coffee, exposing physical fitness weaknesses
description: A week after the blind date incident, on the evening of Friday, May 16, Lei Mingxuan drove alone to Mogan Mountain. Early on the morning of the 17th, he brewed pour-over coffee outside his tent, took a photo, and posted it on Moments, earning many likes from friends. Later he did a 10-kilometer weighted hike, during which his legs ached severely. Exhausted, he returned to camp in the evening, keenly feeling his lack of physical fitness. He couldn't help thinking about the tough physical demands of a self-driving trip in western Sichuan, and decided to put physical training on his agenda.

subevent.name: Preparing Departure Gear and Supplies
subevent.description: During the day on May 16, at his home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Lei Mingxuan sorted and packed the equipment needed for a solo hiking and camping trip to Moganshan, including a tent, sleeping bag, hiking backpack, weighted sandbag, pour-over coffee set, freshly ground coffee, thermos, food supplies, first-aid medicine, and an action camera. He checked the vehicle's fuel level and tire condition, then loaded everything into the trunk.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Drove alone to Mogan Mountain
subevent.description: On the evening of Friday, May 16, Lei Mingxuan drove alone from his home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, taking the Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway and then the Changshen Expressway, and drove about 3 hours to Mogan Mountain Scenic Area in Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province. Along the way, he took a short break at a service area, refreshed himself, and confirmed the navigation route. It was about 9 p.m. when he reached the foot of Mogan Mountain.
subevent.location: Shanghai to Mogan Mountain, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province (expressway and scenic area entrance).

subevent.name: Arrived at the campsite and set up the tent
subevent.description: At about 9:30 p.m. on May 16, Lei Mingxuan arrived at the designated camping site in the Mogan Mountain scenic area. He turned on his car headlights for lighting and spent about 40 minutes leveling the ground on a fairly flat lawn, setting up a double-layer tent, laying out a ground mat and sleeping bag, and briefly checking the safety of the surrounding campsite. Afterwards, he sat in the tent and read a paper map of the hiking route by flashlight for a while, planning the next day's itinerary.
subevent.location: Camping site at Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province

subevent.name: Made pour-over coffee in the early morning and took a photo to post on Moments.
subevent.description: Around 6 a.m. on May 17, Lei Mingxuan set up a portable stove outside the tent at the Moganshan campsite and brewed coffee with pour-over equipment. He spread the coffee grounds evenly over the filter and slowly poured in 85°C water, extracting a cup of richly aromatic pour-over coffee. Holding the coffee, he took a photo with his phone against the backdrop of the rising sun and the morning mist among the mountains (in the photo, the coffee cup, tent, and backpack formed a layered composition). He then posted the photo to WeChat Moments with the caption 'The first sip of wakefulness in the mountains,' and within a short time it received likes and comments from many friends, including Zhang Wei, Li Na, Zhao Min, and Shen Jie.
subevent.location: Camping site at Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province

subevent.name: Do a 10-kilometer weighted hike.
subevent.description: At about 8 a.m. on May 17, after breakfast at the camp, Lei Mingxuan packed his hiking gear (a backpack weighing about 15 kg, including 4 liters of water and dry food for lunch) and set off from the camp, entering the trail along the loop mountain road planned by the scenic area. The first 5 kilometers were mainly gentle slopes, and he maintained a fairly fast pace. From the 6th kilometer, the trail entered a continuous steep slope section; he felt his thigh muscles gradually sore but kept going. Along the way, he passed two observation decks and a stream, recording several hiking videos with his action camera.
subevent.location: Hiking trail in Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province

subevent.name: Returned to camp with severe leg soreness and exhaustion.
subevent.description: At about 2 p.m. on May 17, after covering about 8 kilometers, Lei Mingxuan encountered a continuous uphill section. His quadriceps and calves became severely sore, and he had to stop and stretch every 200 meters. Realizing he was nearing his physical limit, he decisively gave up the final 2 kilometers of the out-and-back route, rested in place for 20 minutes, and then slowly descended along the same path. At about 5:30 p.m., he returned to camp exhausted, immediately took off his hiking shoes, applied ice packs to his legs, and consumed energy gels and electrolyte drinks to recover.
subevent.location: Camping site at Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province

subevent.name: Reflected on lack of physical fitness and decided to make a workout plan.
subevent.description: On the evening of May 17, in the camp tent, Lei Mingxuan relaxed his sore legs while recalling the entire hiking process. He strongly felt that his current physical fitness (BMI 27.04) could not support high-intensity outdoor activities. Thinking of his planned in-depth self-driving tour of western Sichuan, which would put even more severe demands on his stamina, he felt a strong sense of crisis. He immediately wrote down an initial fitness goal in his phone memo: must do aerobic plus strength training at least three times a week and lower his BMI below 24 within three months, and he decided to officially start a systematic physical training plan from next Monday.
subevent.location: Camping site at Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province

subevent.name: Drive back home in Shanghai.
subevent.description: At about 9 a.m. on May 18, Lei Mingxuan finished a simple breakfast at the campsite, took down his tent, and cleaned up the campsite trash, then loaded all the gear into the trunk. At 10 a.m. he drove back to Shanghai from Mogan Mountain and arrived safely at his home on Zhangyang Road in Pudong New Area around 12:30 p.m. He took out the gear and clothes used during the hike, washed and air-dried them, and shared a summary of the hike with his childhood friend Zhang Wei and his cousin Shen Jie.
subevent.location: Moganshan Scenic Area, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province to home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Night chat with Han Dong over billiards: the way to balance old and new hobbies.
description: On the evening of Friday, June 13, Lei Mingxuan invited Han Dong to their usual billiard hall for a game. After two rounds, Han Dong teased him that his recent camping and coffee hobbies made him seem to be living a retirement life. Lei Mingxuan took the opportunity to honestly admit that his interests had shifted, but stressed that their billiards friendship remained unchanged. The two chatted over drinks. Han Dong expressed understanding, and they agreed they could still arrange a billiards game about once a week. This deep conversation made Lei Mingxuan feel that he had found a balance between his old and new circles.

subevent.name: Invited Han Dong to play billiards.
subevent.description: On the evening of Friday, June 13, Lei Mingxuan contacted Han Dong via WeChat and invited him to play billiards at the usual billiard hall on Zhangyang Road in Pudong New Area. Han Dong readily agreed. The two agreed to meet at the billiard hall at 8 p.m.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - home (contact)

subevent.name: Head to the billiard hall and start playing
subevent.description: At 8 p.m., Lei Mingxuan and Han Dong met at a billiards club on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area. The two picked a table in the back, played a half-hour warm-up round, chatted about how things were going, and the mood was relaxed.
subevent.location: A billiards club on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Half-time break, honest exchange about changing interests
subevent.description: After two games, the two of them sat in the rest area by the table drinking beverages. Han Dong teased Lei Mingxuan that he was into camping and coffee like he was living a retired life. Lei Mingxuan took the opportunity to honestly admit his interests had shifted, but stressed that his billiards friendship with Han Dong would not change. Han Dong said he understood, and they agreed to still schedule a game about once a week.
subevent.location: A billiards club on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Continued playing ball and ended the evening's activities.
subevent.description: After a break, they played another three or four games until the billiard hall closed at 11 p.m. Lei Mingxuan felt that through this in-depth conversation, he had found a balance between his old and new hobbies, and was in a good mood. They each went home and agreed to play again at the same time next week.
subevent.location: A billiards club on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Took the initiative to invite Song Jia for a night rollerblading session along the riverside, successfully repairing their roller skating friendship.
description: On Friday evening, June 20, Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to contact Song Jia and invited her to join the night skating event from Pudong Riverside to the Bund. Dozens of roller skating enthusiasts glided along the riverside path under the bright lights. Lei Mingxuan and Song Jia skated side by side the entire way, and during a break they shared what they had recently gotten into — he talked about pour-over coffee, and Song Jia showed off a skateboard trick she had just learned. After turning down several invitations before, this warm companionship was his way of actually mending the relationship, and their friendship clearly warmed up.

subevent.name: Proactively contacted Song Jia to invite her for a night ride.
subevent.description: On the evening of Friday, June 20, at his home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Lei Mingxuan proactively contacted his roller skating partner Song Jia via WeChat, inviting her to join that evening's night skating event from Pudong Riverside to The Bund. He sent a message asking if Song Jia was available, briefly explained the meeting time and place, and expressed his hope of repairing their relationship, which had become somewhat distant because he had turned down several invitations before.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Gathered with Song Jia at the Pudong riverside to prepare for a night skating session
subevent.description: At 7:30 p.m., Lei Mingxuan arrived early at the designated meeting point at Pudong Riverside with his roller skating equipment and met up with Song Jia, who arrived soon after. The two greeted each other, briefly caught up, and checked their roller skates and protective gear together. Around them, about twenty roller skating enthusiasts gathered one after another, and the organizer was taking roll call and explaining the night skating route and requirements.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong Riverside meeting point

subevent.name: Night skate along the Pudong Riverside to the Bund
subevent.description: At 8 pm, the night skating event officially began. Lei Mingxuan and Song Jia skated side by side near the front of the group, heading west along the riverside path of the Pudong waterfront toward the Bund. The lights were dazzling along the way, offering a panoramic view of the city nightscape on both banks of the Huangpu River. The two kept a similar pace and occasionally signaled each other to adjust their positions. The 10 km skate took about 40 minutes.
subevent.location: Shanghai - along the riverside path from Pudong Riverside to the Bund

subevent.name: Sharing new hobbies during a break
subevent.description: When they skated to a viewing platform midway, the group took a short rest. Lei Mingxuan and Song Jia stopped by the railing to drink water. Lei Mingxuan proactively talked about his recent passion for pour-over coffee and shared his experience exploring different coffee beans; Song Jia enthusiastically showed off a few tricks she had just learned, trying spinning in place and one-footed gliding on roller skates. The two chatted happily in a relaxed atmosphere, gradually clearing up the estrangement between them.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong Riverside Observation Platform

subevent.name: Night ride ended; bid farewell to Song Jia; friendship rekindled
subevent.description: At 9:30 p.m., the night skate group arrived at the Bund finishing point. Lei Mingxuan and Song Jia took a photo together there to remember the occasion and agreed to go night skating together every week from now on. Song Jia thanked Lei Mingxuan for taking the initiative to invite her and said she had a great time tonight. Before taking separate taxis nearby, they chatted on WeChat to set a specific time for the next gathering. This night skate clearly repaired their friendship, bringing it back to its former closeness.
subevent.location: Shanghai – The Bund

name: Conducted targeted physical training for the western Sichuan self-driving trip
description: Lei Mingxuan did special physical training for the western Sichuan road trip: On April 15, he made a training plan at home, including rowing machine and weighted stair climbing, and planned to test it during camping. On the evening of April 16, he did a 30-minute rowing machine workout at the community gym. On the afternoon of April 21, he did weighted stair climbing in the residential area (carrying a 10kg backpack up 20 floors × 3 sets). On the evening of April 22, he did his second rowing machine workout. On April 26, while camping in the outskirts, he tested the training effect by carrying heavy gear and hiking to scout routes, and felt his physical fitness had clearly improved.

subevent.name: Create a tailored physical training plan for the Western Sichuan self-driving trip.
subevent.description: At home, Lei Mingxuan used his computer and notebook to plan in detail a physical training program for the self-driving trip to western Sichuan, including 30 minutes of rowing machine training at the community gym every Wednesday evening and weighted stair climbing in the residential compound every Saturday afternoon (carrying a 10 kg backpack up 20 floors × 3 sets). He also planned to test the training results by camping on the weekend of April 26.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Zhangyang Road - home study

subevent.name: First rowing machine training.
subevent.description: At 7 p.m., Lei Mingxuan went to the community gym and used the rowing machine for 30 minutes of moderate-intensity training, focusing on his back and core muscles, with heart rate controlled at 140-160 beats per minute. After training, he did 10 minutes of stretching.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - a community gym

subevent.name: First weighted stair-climbing workout
subevent.description: At 3 p.m., Lei Mingxuan did weighted stair-climbing training in the residential building of his neighborhood, carrying a 10 kg backpack. He climbed from the 1st to the 20th floor for 3 sets, with 2 minutes of rest between sets, taking about 45 minutes in total. After training, he checked the backpack load and knee response, and recorded his heart rate.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - corridor in the residential community at Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road

subevent.name: Second rowing machine workout.
subevent.description: At 7 p.m., Lei Mingxuan went to the community gym again for his second rowing machine training session. His technique was more proficient, the intensity was slightly increased, and he expanded his training volume.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - a community gym

subevent.name: Camping trip to test the results of physical training
subevent.description: On the weekend, Lei Mingxuan went camping with friends on the outskirts of Shanghai. He voluntarily took on carrying the heavy equipment such as tents and food, and hiked ahead to scout the best campsite, practically testing the results of nearly two weeks of physical training. He felt his cardiovascular and muscle strength had improved noticeably.
subevent.location: Shanghai – a suburban campsite

name: Regular climbing day with Zhao Min: completed the V3 and expanded my social circle.
description: After that, Lei Mingxuan and Zhao Min had a fixed climbing day every two weeks. On May 10 (the day after the family argument), he successfully completed a V3 route and exchanged WeChat contacts with Xiao Wang, a regular climber at the gym. In June, climbing was interrupted once due to camping; in July, he resumed and incorporated climbing into cross-training, and the improved upper-body strength helped with carrying loads while camping.

subevent.name: First regular climbing day · Completed V3
subevent.description: As planned, I participated in the first biweekly climbing session with Zhao Min at a climbing gym on Zhangyang Road, Pudong. Encouraged by Zhao Min and guided by fellow climber Xiao Wang, Lei Mingxuan successfully completed the V3 route and felt elated. During the break, he exchanged WeChat contacts with regular climber Xiao Wang, expanding his social circle. Afterward, the two replenished their energy together and exchanged climbing skills.
subevent.location: A climbing gym on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Second regular rock climbing day
subevent.description: Had the second climbing day with Zhao Min. The two focused on improving technique at the Pudong Climbing Gym. Lei Mingxuan tried the V3 route but couldn't complete it, and focused on practicing dynamic power. Afterward, he caught up with Zhao Min in the gym's rest area and scheduled the next climbing date.
subevent.location: A climbing gym on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Resumed training in July · first cross-training session
subevent.description: After a climbing session was interrupted by the June camping trip, Lei Mingxuan and Zhao Min resumed their regular climbing day. This week, climbing was incorporated into the cross-training plan, and his upper-body strength noticeably improved compared to before. Lei Mingxuan successfully completed several V2 routes and attempted V3 routes. After climbing, he discussed with Zhao Min a plan to combine climbing with weighted training for camping.
subevent.location: A climbing gym on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Second Rock Climbing Day in July: Consolidation and Improvement
subevent.description: Following a biweekly routine, Lei Mingxuan did climbing training with Zhao Min at the Pudong Climbing Gym. This session focused on dynamic grip and footwork. Lei Mingxuan was in excellent form, completing two V3 routes in a row. After climbing, the two took a photo together in the gym and agreed to bring their climbing buddy Xiao Wang next time to take on new routes.
subevent.location: A climbing gym on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Night skating with Song Jia on the Pudong riverside skating path
description: On the evening of May 14, Lei Mingxuan invited his roller skating partner Song Jia to go night skating on the Pudong Riverside roller skating path. They contacted each other in the afternoon to confirm the plan. Lei Mingxuan prepared his gear and set off, meeting Song Jia on Binjiang Avenue. After nightfall, they skated along the river, chatting about recent news as they went. Song Jia recommended a roller skating route. After the night session, they each went home, and Lei Mingxuan felt physically and mentally relaxed.

subevent.name: Contact Song Jia to confirm the night skating plan.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of May 14, Lei Mingxuan contacted his roller skating partner Song Jia via WeChat, confirmed the plan to go night skating along the Pudong riverside roller skating path that evening, and agreed to meet at 7 PM on Binjiang Avenue. Song Jia replied to confirm and reminded Lei Mingxuan to bring his protective gear.
subevent.location: Home, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road)

subevent.name: Prepared night-riding gear and set off.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan sorted out his roller skates, protective gear, headlamp and other equipment at home, changed into light sportswear, then left home and walked to the Pudong Riverside roller-skating track, a journey of about 15 minutes.
subevent.location: On the way from home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to the riverside roller skating track

subevent.name: Meet up with Song Jia and start night skating.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan arrived at the meeting point of the Pudong Riverside roller skating track and met up with Song Jia, who was already waiting. The two put on protective gear, adjusted their roller skates, and started skating along the riverside track as night fell, chatting and discussing their recent lives and hobbies.
subevent.location: Riverside Roller-Skating Trail (near Lujiazui), Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: The late-night skating session ended and everyone went home.
subevent.description: After about 1.5 hours of night running, Lei Mingxuan and Song Jia said goodbye near the finish point. Lei Mingxuan felt relaxed in both mind and body, expressed interest in the route Song Jia recommended, and agreed to try it next time. Then Lei Mingxuan returned home, washed up, and rested.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - Riverside Roller Skating Trail to Home

name: Took the initiative to arrange a late-night talk with Xie Fei about missing basketball and the shift in life priorities
description: After missing three consecutive weeks of community basketball games, Lei Mingxuan felt guilty when he saw a shooting video and teasing messages from his basketball buddy Xie Fei in the group chat on May 28. On the evening of May 31, he went alone to Yuanshen Basketball Court in Pudong and sent Xie Fei a message, and Xie Fei happened to be nearby. The two sat by the court and had an honest conversation. Lei Mingxuan explained that he had missed the games because of family conflicts and being distracted by physical training. Xie Fei said he understood but hoped Lei Mingxuan would keep up his exercise habits. Lei Mingxuan promised to return the following Wednesday and shared some amusing stories from his camping trip to Mogan Mountain. The deep conversation restored their rapport, and they agreed to sign up together for the amateur basketball tournament in June.

subevent.name: Felt guilty after seeing a video from a sports buddy
subevent.description: On the evening of May 28, Lei Mingxuan saw a shooting video and a teasing message about his absence shared by his basketball buddy Xie Fei in a WeChat group. Recalling that he had missed the community basketball game for three consecutive weeks, he felt guilty and decided to find an opportunity to talk openly with Xie Fei.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home

subevent.name: Have a candid conversation with Xie Fei at the court.
subevent.description: On the evening of May 31, Lei Mingxuan went alone to the outdoor basketball court at Yuanshen Sports Center in Pudong and sent a message to Xie Fei, who happened to be nearby too. The two sat by the court and had a candid conversation. Lei explained that he had been absent because he was distracted by family conflicts and fitness training. Xie said he understood but hoped Lei would maintain his exercise habits. Lei promised to return the following Wednesday and shared amusing stories from the Mogan Mountain camping trip. They also agreed to sign up together for the June amateur basketball tournament, restoring their rapport as basketball buddies.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Yuanshen Sports Center Basketball Court

name: Initiated the Shanghai-Hangzhou billiards friendly match and shared coffee, gaining inspiration for e-commerce operations.
description: In early May, Lei Mingxuan contacted his Hangzhou billiards friend Qin Lang and Shanghai friend Han Dong to plan a cross-city billiards friendly match. The match went smoothly on May 24, with Lei Mingxuan serving as referee and bringing his own hand-brewed coffee to share. Qin Lang was pleasantly surprised, while Han Dong was indifferent. In the post-match exchange, Qin Lang gave a detailed analysis of the trend of live-stream commerce for physical stores, bluntly saying, "If you don't go online, you're waiting to die." Lei Mingxuan was deeply moved. On May 26, Lei Mingxuan organized Qin Lang's suggestions in his clothing store and began seriously planning the online branch.

subevent.name: Plan the Shanghai-Hangzhou billiards friendly match
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan contacted his billiards buddies Qin Lang from Hangzhou and Han Dong from Shanghai via WeChat to discuss holding a Shanghai-Hangzhou billiards friendly match. After discussion, the three decided the match would take place on May 24 at a billiards hall in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and preliminarily agreed on the rules and process.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - home study (online contact)

subevent.name: Prepare competition supplies and coffee equipment
subevent.description: The day before the competition, Lei Mingxuan went to his home in Pudong New Area to sort out his pour-over coffee equipment, and went to a nearby coffee shop to buy fresh coffee beans, planning to share them with his billiards friends while serving as referee at the friendly match. He also checked his personal gear, such as the pool cue, to confirm everything was ready.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - home and nearby coffee shop

subevent.name: Hold a Shanghai-Hangzhou billiards friendly match and share coffee
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan, Qin Lang, and Han Dong met at a billiard hall in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and officially started the Shanghai-Hangzhou billiards friendly match. Lei Mingxuan served as the referee and, during the breaks, used his own equipment to make pour-over coffee for Qin Lang and Han Dong to taste. Qin Lang was pleasantly surprised, while Han Dong was indifferent. After the match, the three chatted in the lounge area of the billiard hall. Qin Lang gave a detailed analysis of the trend of livestream e-commerce for physical stores, bluntly saying, 'If you don't go online, you're waiting to die.' Lei Mingxuan was deeply moved.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - a billiard hall

subevent.name: Sorting out the inspiration and planning the store's online layout.
subevent.description: After closing the clothing store for the day, Lei Mingxuan stayed alone in the shop organizing Qin Lang's suggestions on livestream e-commerce. Based on his store's actual situation, he began seriously thinking about how to introduce livestream equipment, train staff for online sales, and made an initial plan to start preparations for an online branch within the next month.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - clothing store (2nd floor of Century Avenue Mall)

name: Organize family story notes and plan the creative direction
description: The story of family changes told by his mother while visiting the grave during the Qingming Festival in April lingered in Lei Mingxuan's mind. On the evening of May 13, after his father proactively asked about the store's situation, he suddenly felt that the older generation's struggle history echoed his own entrepreneurial journey. Over the following days, he used time before bed to record key people, timelines, and scenes in his memo app, and considered whether to write a novel about the transformation of Shanghai's longtang neighborhoods from the perspective of three generations of the family. After returning from Mogan Mountain on May 18, inspiration struck while organizing his gear, and he decided to make writing a long-term plan after returning from the self-driving trip to western Sichuan.

subevent.name: Conversation with father sparks writing idea
subevent.description: On the evening of May 13, Lei Mingxuan chatted with his father Lei Jianguo after dinner at their home on Zhangyang Road in Pudong New Area. His father asked about the recent performance of the shop. While talking about his entrepreneurial experience, Lei Mingxuan suddenly thought of the story his mother told during Qingming tomb-sweeping about three generations of the Lei family going from Shanghai alleys to the business world, and felt a spiritual resonance between his elders' struggles and his own entrepreneurship. He began to have a preliminary idea of recording the family story and trying to write a novel.
subevent.location: Shanghai - living room at home

subevent.name: Record key material for family stories before bed
subevent.description: For four consecutive nights from May 14 to May 17, after finishing work at the store or social activities, Lei Mingxuan spent 30 to 60 minutes before sleep using the memo app on his phone to record the key figures in the family's changes that his mother had told him about (such as his grandfather, father, and aunt), important milestones (such as his father entering the factory and the store opening), and typical scenes (such as the old lane, the vegetable market, and the state-owned factory workshop). He recalled and added details as he went, gradually outlining a story framework of changes in Shanghai's lanes centered on three generations. All the recording took place in his own bedroom.
subevent.location: Shanghai – bedroom at home

subevent.name: Finalize the writing plan after returning from Mogan Mountain
subevent.description: On the afternoon of May 18, Lei Mingxuan returned home in Shanghai after a short trip to Mogan Mountain. While sorting through his backpack and travel gear, he was moved by the scenes and connected the planned self-driving trip to western Sichuan with the way the older generation ventured out in his family stories. Struck by inspiration, he officially decided to make writing a long-term project to start after returning from the western Sichuan road trip. That evening, he created a new writing folder named 'A Hundred Years of the Longtang' in his memo app, listed an initial chapter outline for three generations, and marked historical details that needed further verification with his mother.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

name: Declining the roller skating invitation twice disappointed Song Jia; Lei Mingxuan felt guilty and planned to make it up to repair the relationship.
description: On June 3, Song Jia invited Lei Mingxuan to go roller skating on June 7, but he declined because of camping; on June 10 she asked again for June 14, and he refused again citing a writing class. On June 15, Song Jia expressed her disappointment via voice message. Lei Mingxuan felt guilty and realized that their old friendship was being affected, and secretly resolved to make it up to her. On June 16, he took the initiative to apologize and proposed a regular roller skating activity. Song Jia's mood softened, and the relationship began to heal.

subevent.name: Declined the roller-skating invitation for the first time
subevent.description: On June 3, roller-skating partner Song Jia invited Lei Mingxuan via WeChat to go skating together on the Pudong Riverside roller-skating path on the weekend of June 7. Because he had already arranged his first camping activity, Lei Mingxuan politely declined, said they could arrange another time next week, and expressed his apology. At the time, Lei Mingxuan did not realize this would affect their relationship.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home (WeChat call)

subevent.name: Declined the roller skating invitation for the second time
subevent.description: On June 10, Song Jia once again invited Lei Mingxuan via WeChat to go roller skating together on the weekend of June 14. Lei Mingxuan declined again, citing that he had already registered for a writing course, and apologized again. Song Jia did not express dissatisfaction on the spot, but her tone was somewhat flat. Lei Mingxuan did not notice anything wrong.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home (WeChat call)

subevent.name: Song Jia expresses disappointment, and Lei Mingxuan feels guilty.
subevent.description: On the evening of June 15, Song Jia contacted Lei Mingxuan via WeChat voice message and said dejectedly, “It’s so hard to make plans with you these days,” expressing her disappointment and sense of distance after being turned down twice in a row. Lei Mingxuan quickly apologized and explained that his schedule had been too full recently, but he felt deeply guilty, realizing that his new hobby was straining his old friendship with Song Jia. He silently resolved to take the initiative to make it up to her and restore the relationship.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Home (WeChat voice call)

subevent.name: Plan to take the initiative to make up for the roller skating invitation.
subevent.description: On June 16, driven by guilt, Lei Mingxuan proactively contacted Song Jia on WeChat, sincerely apologized, and promised to make time to go roller skating together next week, hoping to repair their relationship. He proposed making roller skating a fixed activity every two weeks and asked for Song Jia's understanding. Song Jia's mood softened and she said she would be willing to meet up again.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Home (WeChat chat)

name: Completed the first closed loop from online recommendations to offline conversion
description: On June 19, Lei Mingxuan noticed that a 'Summer Techwear Outfit' post he had previously published on Xiaohongshu had received over 1,000 likes, and two local followers left comments asking for the store address. That afternoon, the two followers came to the store especially to try on clothes and each bought an outfit. This was the first time the Xiafeiji account had achieved direct online-to-offline sales since it was launched. Lei Mingxuan excitedly took photos of them in their new outfits and, with their permission, posted them on the account, further strengthening its local identity.

subevent.name: Discovered that a Xiaohongshu post had over 1,000 likes
subevent.description: On the morning of June 19, during a break at the store, Lei Mingxuan opened Xiaohongshu and found that his previously posted “summer techwear outfit” note had received over 1,000 likes, and two local fans left comments asking for the store’s exact address and business hours.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Xiafei Ji Clothing Store)

subevent.name: Replied to fans' questions and invited them to the store
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan replied to two fans one by one in the comment section, giving them detailed information about the store address and business hours, warmly inviting them to come to the store for try-ons, and saying he could reserve the corresponding sizes for them.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Xiafei Ji Clothing Store)

subevent.name: Two fans came to the store to try on clothes.
subevent.description: That afternoon, two local fans (Zhou Yue and Chen Li) found the store by the address. Lei Mingxuan personally received them and helped them pick out suitable summer techwear outfits. They each tried on multiple items.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Xiafei Ji Clothing Store)

subevent.name: Completed the first conversion from online traffic to an in-store sale.
subevent.description: The two fans each selected a complete outfit combination, decided to buy, and completed payment at the cashier. This was the first time since the Xiafei Collection account was launched that a Xiaohongshu post directly drove traffic to the physical store and generated actual sales. Lei Mingxuan was very excited.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Xiafei Ji Clothing Store)

subevent.name: Take a buyer show photo and post it on Xiaohongshu.
subevent.description: After obtaining the consent of the two customers, Lei Mingxuan took customer-showcase photos for them in the store, edited the images and text on the spot, and posted them to Xiafeiji's Xiaohongshu account, with a caption emphasizing "Shanghai local fans checking in at the store," further strengthening the account's local positioning.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Xiafei Ji Clothing Store)

name: Monthly summary, authorize store clerk Xiao Lin, and complete the first weekly communication
description: On the morning of May 20, Lei Mingxuan sorted through sales data, customer complaint records, and other materials at the clothing store to prepare for the monthly summary meeting that afternoon. In the afternoon, he held a work summary with store clerk Lin Xiao, acknowledged her performance in handling customer disputes, granted her authority over daily scheduling, customer complaint handling, and partial incoming goods inspection, and agreed to have weekly communication. On May 27, Lei Mingxuan and Lin Xiao held their first weekly communication meeting to review progress on the delegated work and provide guidance, promoting standardized store operations.

subevent.name: Prepare monthly summary materials.
subevent.description: On the morning of May 20, Lei Mingxuan organized May's sales data, customer complaint records, inventory lists, and staff attendance sheets at his clothing store, in Shop A-208 on the 2nd floor of a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to fully prepare for the monthly summary meeting with store clerk Lin Xiao in the afternoon.
subevent.location: Inside the clothing store, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Conducted monthly summary and delegation with clerk Xiao Lin.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of May 20, Lei Mingxuan held a monthly work summary meeting with store clerk Lin Xiao (Xiao Lin) in the store. Lei Mingxuan first praised Lin Xiao for her excellent handling of customer disputes, then officially granted Lin Xiao the authority to manage daily scheduling, customer complaint handling, and part of goods receiving and inspection, and agreed to hold a weekly communication meeting. Through this delegation, Lei Mingxuan hoped to lighten his own workload, develop Lin Xiao's management skills, and take an important step toward standardized store operations.
subevent.location: Inside the clothing store, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: First weekly communication meeting
subevent.description: As agreed, on May 27, Lei Mingxuan held the first weekly communication meeting with store clerk Lin Xiao. He reviewed Xiao Lin's work progress for the week in scheduling, customer complaint handling, and merchandise receiving and inspection, discussed the problems encountered, and gave guidance to ensure the smooth transition of the delegated work.
subevent.location: Inside the clothing store, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Discussed and adjusted the fund portfolio with financial advisor Xu Feng.
description: On the evening of June 12, Lei Mingxuan had a video call with financial advisor Xu Feng on WeChat, reported on last month's fund investment plan, and asked for strategies to cope with recent market volatility. Xu Feng suggested adding a bond fund to reduce volatility. Lei Mingxuan took the advice and adjusted the investment plan the next day through mobile banking, increasing the monthly investment amount from 3,000 yuan to 4,000 yuan.

subevent.name: Video discussion with financial advisor Xu Feng on fund adjustment strategy.
subevent.description: On the evening of June 12, 2025, Lei Mingxuan had a WeChat video call with financial advisor Xu Feng at his home, reporting on last month's systematic fund investment and asking for strategies to cope with recent market volatility. Xu Feng suggested adding a bond fund to reduce volatility. Lei Mingxuan said he would consider it and decided to adopt the suggestion.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Adjust the regular fund investment plan.
subevent.description: On June 13, 2025, Lei Mingxuan adjusted his fund auto-investment plan at home through the mobile banking app. Following Xu Feng's suggestion, he added a bond fund and increased the monthly auto-investment amount from 3,000 yuan to 4,000 yuan.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

name: Father's Day family gratitude dinner and gift-giving
description: At noon on June 15, Father's Day, Lei Mingxuan prepared a new shirt as a gift for his father Lei Jianguo in advance. At noon, he deliberately closed the store for two hours and took his parents to a nearby time-honored Shanghainese restaurant for a meal. During the meal, he thanked his father for his usual attention to the store and said he would spare more time to be with his family in the future. The family get-together made the atmosphere warmer and his father was very happy.

subevent.name: Took his parents to a long-established Shanghainese restaurant for a family dinner
subevent.description: Around 12:00 noon that day, Lei Mingxuan set out from home with his father Lei Jianguo and mother Wang Xiuying, and walked to a nearby time-honored local Shanghainese restaurant (such as “Shanghai Old Restaurant”). After the three sat down, Lei Mingxuan ordered dishes his father loved, such as Shanghainese braised pork and pan-fried buns, and the family enjoyed lunch together in a harmonious atmosphere.
subevent.location: A time-honored local Shanghainese restaurant in Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Giving his father a shirt and expressing gratitude
subevent.description: During the meal, Lei Mingxuan took out the shirt gift box he had bought the day before and handed it to his father, Lei Jianguo, thanking him for his usual care and support for his clothing store business, and promising to spend more time with the family in the future. Lei Jianguo was very happy to receive the gift and tried it on right away, bringing the warm family atmosphere to a high point.
subevent.location: A time-honored local Shanghainese restaurant in Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Calculate June's operating profit and loss, formulate July's marketing plan, and communicate details with partners.
description: On the evening of June 30, Lei Mingxuan calculated the clothing store's June profit and loss in his home study in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and found a net profit of about 21,000 yuan (a slight increase of 5%). He then drafted a July marketing calendar (camping-themed displays and a joint sharing event with the book club). The next day (July 1), he contacted his cousin Shen Jie and regular customer Qian Duoduo via WeChat and phone to discuss the details of the joint sharing event, inviting them to participate in planning and promotion.

subevent.name: Calculate the operating profit and loss for June.
subevent.description: In the study of his home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Lei Mingxuan used spreadsheet software to summarize the store's June income and expenses, including revenue, purchasing costs, labor, rent, and marketing investment (Xiaohongshu promotion, etc.), and calculated that the month's net profit was about 21,000 yuan, a slight increase of 5% from the previous month.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Develop the July marketing plan.
subevent.description: After completing the financial accounting, Lei Mingxuan continued drafting the July marketing calendar at home. He planned to continue the weekend camping-themed display and co-host with the Jing'an District book club a sharing session on 'historical fiction + outdoor styling', aiming to drive traffic to the store.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Discussing marketing details with Shen Jie and Qian Duoduo
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan contacted his cousin Shen Jie (a fashion buyer) and regular customer Qian Duoduo (a new media operations manager) via WeChat and phone to discuss the details of the July joint sharing session, inviting them to participate in planning and promotion to jointly drive traffic to the store.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Home / Online

name: Community health check-up raised a health alarm; his mother's concern triggered reflection, leading to a systematic fitness plan.
description: On June 18, Lei Mingxuan took part in a free community health check-up. On the 19th, the report showed high total cholesterol and a tendency toward mild fatty liver. The doctor seriously advised him to increase aerobic exercise and control his diet. On the evening of June 20, his mother saw that he had lost weight and asked worriedly, "Is it because running the store is too tiring that you've lost weight?" Lei Mingxuan explained that he had been exercising, but privately admitted that the real problem was his irregular routine and diet. For the first time, he felt nervous about his health and began to seriously consider a systematic fitness plan. On June 21, based on the check-up report and the doctor's advice, he used a fitness app to formulate an initial systematic fitness plan, including aerobic exercise four times a week, adjusting his diet structure, and planning to buy a body fat scale and set a goal for a follow-up check-up one month later.

subevent.name: Attended the free community health checkup
subevent.description: On the morning of June 18, 2025, Lei Mingxuan attended a free health checkup organized by the community at the Community Health Service Center near Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, where he underwent routine checkups such as height, weight, blood pressure, and blood draw.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - Community Health Service Center

subevent.name: Review the physical examination report and follow the doctor's advice.
subevent.description: On June 19, 2025, Lei Mingxuan checked his electronic physical examination report on his phone and found that his total cholesterol was high and there was a trend toward mild fatty liver. He then called a doctor at the community hospital for consultation. The doctor seriously advised him to increase the frequency of aerobic exercise (such as jogging and swimming), control a high-fat and high-sugar diet, and have regular follow-ups. Lei Mingxuan felt nervous and began to take it seriously.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

subevent.name: Mother's concern about weight changes and personal reflection.
subevent.description: At dinner on June 20, 2025, his mother Wang Xiuying noticed that Lei Mingxuan seemed to have lost some weight recently and asked with concern, ‘Is it because running the store is too tiring that you’ve lost weight?’ Lei Mingxuan explained that he had been exercising recently, but inwardly admitted that the real problem was irregular sleeping and eating. After dinner, he thought seriously about the health risks in his bedroom, decided to face his lifestyle problems, and began planning a systematic fitness program.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Formulated an initial fitness and diet adjustment plan
subevent.description: On June 21, 2025, Lei Mingxuan used a mobile fitness app to look up information and, combined with his physical examination report and doctor's advice, formulated a preliminary systematic fitness plan: schedule aerobic exercise four times a week (running or swimming), reduce eating out and late-night snacks, increase vegetable and fruit intake, and plan to buy a body fat scale to track progress. He also set a goal to have a follow-up checkup in one month.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - home study

name: Adopting the stray cat Afu, adding a new member to the family
description: From June 25 to 27, Lei Mingxuan took time every day to visit the kitten at the hospital. The kitten went from being wary to actively rubbing against his hand, and he felt affection for it. On June 28, the cat was discharged, and he formally completed the adoption procedures, naming it 'Afu,' meaning it brings good fortune.

subevent.name: First visit to the hospital to see the stray cat
