subevent.description: On June 25, Lei Mingxuan took time to go to the pet hospital to visit the stray cat he was about to adopt for the first time. The kitten was very wary at first, hiding in a corner and not daring to come close. Lei Mingxuan crouched outside the cage, called to it softly, and tried to lure it with treats, but the cat still didn't fully let its guard down. He stayed at the hospital for about half an hour, asked the doctor about the cat's recovery and personality, and then left.
subevent.location: A pet hospital in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Second visit: the cat is starting to warm up
subevent.description: On June 26, Lei Mingxuan went to the hospital again to visit the cat. This time the kitten recognized him. Although it was still a bit nervous, it no longer avoided him and even walked to the edge of the cage to rub against his hand. Lei Mingxuan was very happy, stroked the cat's head, and the cat purred. He shared the progress with his parents via WeChat and confirmed his intention to adopt.
subevent.location: A pet hospital in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Third visit, confirming the adoption details
subevent.description: On June 27, Lei Mingxuan went to the hospital for the third time. The cat now completely trusted him and jumped onto his lap to play on its own. Lei Mingxuan discussed the adoption procedure with the hospital staff, filled out a preliminary application form, and agreed to complete the formalities the next day. He also asked about the cat's vaccinations and follow-up care, getting ready to welcome the new family member.
subevent.location: A pet hospital in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Complete the adoption procedures, bring the cat home, and name it.
subevent.description: On June 28, the cat met the discharge criteria, and Lei Mingxuan officially went to the hospital to complete all the adoption procedures, signed the agreement, and paid the medical expenses. He named the male cat “Ah Fu,” which means it would bring good fortune. He then put the cat in an airline crate, took a taxi home, and placed it beside the pre-prepared cat bed, food bowl, and litter box. His parents welcomed it, and after surveying the new home, Ah Fu gradually relaxed.
subevent.location: Home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Established a weekend camping plan and executed it for the first time; his weight dropped due to the outdoor activity.
description: In early June, Lei Mingxuan made a plan to camp every two weeks in the nearby suburbs, aiming to build up his physical strength and accumulate outdoor experience. On June 7-8 (Saturday and Sunday), he drove to Sheshan for his first camping trip: hiking, setting up camp, and trying outdoor coffee brewing. For the second camping trip on June 21-22, he went to Dianshan Lake and added a morning run. The regular outdoor activities over the month reduced his weight from 81.2 kg at the end of May to 80.5 kg on June 30. He felt lighter, but the soreness in his legs still pointed to a gap in physical fitness.

subevent.name: First camping: a weekend trip to Sheshan.
subevent.description: On Saturday morning, Lei Mingxuan drove from his home in Pudong to Sheshan National Forest Park in Songjiang District, Shanghai, for his first weekend camping trip. Carrying the equipment he had prepared in advance, he hiked in the designated area of the park for about 2 hours before choosing a campsite, setting up his tent, and laying out the ground mat. In the afternoon, he tried brewing coffee with an outdoor stove and enjoyed the natural scenery. In the evening, after preparing a simple dinner, he rested in the tent. The next morning, he packed up the campsite, cleaned up the trash, and drove home. Through this activity, he built his physical fitness and outdoor skills.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Sheshan National Forest Park

subevent.name: Drive to Sheshan
subevent.description: On Saturday morning, Lei Mingxuan set out from his home in Pudong, driving a family car to Sheshan National Forest Park in Songjiang District, Shanghai, carrying the camping gear he had prepared in advance (tent, ground sheet, outdoor stove, food and water, etc.).
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area to Sheshan, Songjiang District

subevent.name: Hiking up the mountain and selecting a campsite.
subevent.description: After arriving at Sheshan National Forest Park, Lei Mingxuan hiked for about 2 hours in the designated area with his gear, enjoying the natural scenery along the way, and finally selected a flat, safe campsite in a suitable area.
subevent.location: Sheshan National Forest Park hiking trail, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Set up camp and try outdoor cooking
subevent.description: After choosing a campsite, Lei Mingxuan set up the tent himself, laid out the ground mat, and organized his belongings. He then used a portable stove to brew coffee, enjoyed the natural scenery, and in the evening cooked a simple dinner with the ingredients he had brought.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Sheshan National Forest Park Camping Area

subevent.name: Nighttime rest and recharging in the tent.
subevent.description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan relaxed in the tent by reading a historical novel or listening to music, experiencing his first night of camping and recovering his energy for the next day's activities.
subevent.location: Inside a tent in Sheshan National Forest Park, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: In the early morning, pack up the campsite and clean up the trash.
subevent.description: Early the next morning (June 8), Lei Mingxuan got up and packed up camping gear such as the tent and moisture-proof mat. He sorted and bagged all the waste he had generated, ensuring the campsite was restored to its original state and demonstrating environmental awareness.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Sheshan National Forest Park Camping Area

subevent.name: Drive back home to Pudong.
subevent.description: After packing up, Lei Mingxuan left Sheshan National Forest Park with all his gear and drove back to his home on Zhangyang Road in Pudong New Area, ending his first camping trip.
subevent.location: Sheshan, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to home in Pudong New Area

subevent.name: Second camping trip: Dianshan Lake morning run.
subevent.description: On Saturday morning, Lei Mingxuan drove to Dianshan Lake Scenic Area in Qingpu District, Shanghai, for his second weekend camping trip. After choosing a lakeside campsite and setting up the tent, he went for a morning run at 6 a.m. on Sunday, jogging about 5 kilometers along the lakeshore to strengthen his physical training. After the run, he returned to the campsite and prepared breakfast with ingredients he had brought. In the morning, he packed up camp and cleaned the area, then drove home before noon. This camping trip added a morning run, further challenging his physical fitness.
subevent.location: Dianshan Lake Scenic Area, Qingpu District, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Go to Dianshan Lake and set up a tent.
subevent.description: On Saturday morning, Lei Mingxuan drove from his home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to the Dianshan Lake Scenic Area in Qingpu District. After arriving, he chose a flat campsite near the lakeshore in the scenic area, skillfully set up the double-layer tent, laid out the ground pad and sleeping bag, and organized his personal camping gear, getting ready for evening leisure and a night's sleep.
subevent.location: Qingpu District, Shanghai - Campsite by Dianshan Lake

subevent.name: Morning 5 km run along the lake route
subevent.description: At 6 a.m. on Sunday, Lei Mingxuan set out from the campsite and jogged along the shoreline of Dianshan Lake. Wearing professional running shoes and sportswear, he ran along the lakeside track at a steady pace, covering about 5 kilometers. Along the way, he enjoyed the morning mist over the lake and the rising sun, breathing fresh air. After finishing, he stretched by the lake and felt his physical fitness had improved.
subevent.location: Lakeside running track at Dianshan Lake, Qingpu District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Made and enjoyed breakfast at the campsite
subevent.description: After the morning run, Lei Mingxuan returned to the campsite. He took out his portable gas stove, cookware, and ingredients (eggs, bread, milk, fruit salad), and started preparing breakfast on the picnic mat next to the tent. He fried two eggs, warmed the milk, and paired them with bread and salad. He sat by the lake and enjoyed the meal at a leisurely pace, replenishing the energy spent on the morning run and enjoying the tranquility of nature.
subevent.location: Dianshan Lake Campsite, Qingpu District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Close up, clean, and drive home
subevent.description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan began to pack up camp. He carefully folded and stored the tent, sleeping bag, moisture-proof mat, and other gear, and collected all the trash in garbage bags, confirming the campsite was restored to its original state. At around 10 a.m., he drove his family car away from Dianshan Lake and returned home to Pudong, Shanghai along the Huqingping Highway, stopping briefly at a service area on the way, and finally arriving at his home on Zhangyang Road before noon.
subevent.location: Qingpu District, Shanghai - Dianshan Lake Campsite to home in Pudong New Area

subevent.name: End-of-month weight recording and fitness assessment
subevent.description: On the evening of June 30, Lei Mingxuan weighed himself at home using an electronic scale. The result was 80.5 kg, a decrease of 0.7 kg from 81.2 kg at the end of May. He felt lighter, but his leg muscles were still clearly sore. He realized that he had insufficient endurance reserves and a physical fitness gap, and planned to strengthen stretching and strength training in the future.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

name: Executed the monthly fund automatic investment plan and special savings for the western Sichuan self-driving trip.
description: On June 5, payday, Lei Mingxuan completed the monthly financial management operation via mobile banking according to the plan agreed with financial advisor Xu Feng: he set aside 3,000 yuan from his income for a regular investment in a combination of index funds and bond funds, and transferred another 3,000 yuan to a dedicated savings account for the western Sichuan self-driving trip. He recorded the expense and briefly reviewed May's fund performance, feeling satisfied with his progress in sticking to his savings plan.

subevent.name: Received the June salary deposit
subevent.description: June 5, payday: Lei Mingxuan's bank card received the clothing store's operating income and a personal salary transfer. Confirm this month's incoming amount to prepare for subsequent financial management.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Execute the regular fund investment operation
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan, via mobile banking, transferred 3,000 yuan from his income into a combination of index funds and bond funds according to the plan agreed with his financial adviser Xu Feng, completing this month's scheduled fund investment.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Transferred into special savings for the Western Sichuan self-driving trip
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan transferred 3,000 yuan via mobile banking to a dedicated savings account for a self-driving trip to western Sichuan, reserving funds for the trip within the next six months and continuing his savings plan.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Record wealth-management expenses and review May's fund performance.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan recorded this month's regular investment and savings expenses in his ledger, opened the financial management app to review the May performance of his fund account, and felt satisfied with his progress in sticking to his savings plan.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

name: Won a Dyson vacuum cleaner in the mall's anniversary celebration
description: On June 14, after buying goods at a mall on Century Avenue, Lei Mingxuan filled in a raffle ticket using his purchase receipt to take part in the anniversary event, and unexpectedly won the first prize—the latest Dyson cordless vacuum cleaner. That evening, he showed off the prize on WeChat Moments, drawing teasing and envious responses from friends. On the morning of June 16, he handed the vacuum cleaner to his mother, Wang Xiuying, for household cleaning; in the afternoon, he shared the lucky story in his clothing store’s customer WeChat group, and the group members responded enthusiastically.

subevent.name: Fill out the raffle ticket and participate in the mall's anniversary lucky draw

description: On the evening of July 25, Lei Mingxuan returned home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and found his father Lei Jianguo smoking on the balcony. He walked over and sat down beside him. After a moment of silence, Lei Mingxuan spoke first and apologized, admitting that he had been too impulsive in his proposal and had not fully considered the family’s financial situation. Lei Jianguo sighed and said he knew his son wanted to do well at the store, but the risk was too great. The two talked about the store’s history and the idea of relocating. In the end, Lei Jianguo relented: wait until autumn and see the store’s performance; if it is stable, he could take out part of the savings for a small-scale trial. Lei Mingxuan felt his father’s understanding, and the relationship between father and son took a turn for the better.

After purchasing it, he organized and archived the policy information, and explained the necessity of risk hedging to his father, which gained his father's approval.

subevent.name: Identify risks and decide to purchase insurance
subevent.description: At his clothing store in Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Lei Mingxuan recalled the asset-risk lesson he had faced at the start of the month when working with supplier Lao Zhou without buying insurance. He became keenly aware of the importance of safeguarding the store's assets and immediately decided to purchase commercial property insurance for the store.
subevent.location: Inside the clothing store, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Consulting financial advisor Xu Feng
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan contacted his financial advisor Xu Feng via WeChat call in the store, explained his idea of taking out commercial property insurance for the store, and asked about insurance types suitable for a clothing store (fire, theft, water damage, etc.), coverage recommendations, and choice of insurance company. Xu Feng gave professional advice and recommended several reputable online platforms.
subevent.location: Inside the clothing store, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Walk 12,000 steps
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan, following Xu Feng's advice, visited an insurance company's online platform on the store computer, selected a commercial property insurance product, filled in the store address, business scope, asset valuation and other information, chose a basic plan covering accidents such as fire, theft, and water damage, confirmed the annual premium of 3,800 yuan, completed online payment with a bank card, and successfully purchased the insurance.
subevent.location: Inside the clothing store, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Organized and filed insurance policies.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan downloaded the electronic insurance policy sent by the insurance company to his computer, created a "Commercial Insurance" subfolder under the store's dedicated "Important Documents" folder for safekeeping, and recorded key information such as the policy number, insurance purchase date, insurance period, coverage, and claims phone number in his store operations notebook for easy reference later.
subevent.location: Inside the clothing store, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Explain insurance matters to father
subevent.description: In the evening, back at his home at No. 12, Lane 1589 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Lei Mingxuan chatted with his father Lei Jianguo after dinner. He explained in detail his decision to purchase commercial property insurance for the store, the reasons (the risk lesson from the beginning of the month), the risks covered by the insurance, and the annual premium of 3,800 yuan, and laid out the necessity of risk hedging for the store's stable operation. After listening, his father Lei Jianguo expressed understanding and support and endorsed his approach.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

name: Completed the advanced pour-over coffee course and planned the store experience area
description: On August 2, 2025, Lei Mingxuan received the certificate of completion for the 'Qiyun' advanced hand-drip coffee course at home, and reviewed and summarized the Golden Cup theory and the swirl technique, internalizing them into his personal system. On August 3, he measured the southwest corner of his clothing store, located in a shopping mall on Century Avenue in Pudong New Area, to plan a hand-drip coffee experience area, consulted on renovation and equipment supply, and estimated the renovation cost at about 50,000 yuan and monthly material costs of about 3,000 yuan.

subevent.name: Receive the certificate of completion for the advanced pour-over coffee course.
subevent.description: At home, Lei Mingxuan received the completion certificate for the advanced 'Qiyun' hand-brewed coffee system course online, and spent time reviewing and summarizing the golden cup theory and swirl technique, internalizing them into his own brewing system to prepare for planning the store's experience area.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Zhangyang Road - home study

subevent.name: Survey the store and estimate the renovation cost for the experience area.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan, in his clothing store located in a mall on Century Avenue in Pudong New Area, carefully measured the southwest corner area, planned the spatial layout for the pour-over coffee experience zone, and consulted renovation companies and equipment suppliers. He calculated the initial renovation cost (renovation materials and professional equipment about 50,000 yuan) and the monthly material operating cost (about 3,000 yuan).
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Playing basketball with a fellow player to fulfill a promise
description: To fulfill his promise to keep playing basketball after the 'farewell game' with Xie Fei in July, Lei Mingxuan contacted his basketball buddy Xie Fei and childhood friend Zhang Wei on August 22, 2025, and agreed to play basketball at Yuanshen Sports Center the next day. On the afternoon of August 23, Lei Mingxuan, Xie Fei, Zhang Wei, and other friends had a satisfying basketball game at the outdoor court of Yuanshen Sports Center. Afterward, they shared a late-night meal at a nearby barbecue restaurant. Lei Mingxuan proactively talked about the fun stories of the store upgrade, and their old friendship was strengthened.

subevent.name: Organized a ball game and notified the participants
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan contacted basketball buddies Xie Fei and childhood friend Zhang Wei via WeChat, informed them of the plan to play basketball at Yuanshen Sports Center on Saturday afternoon, confirmed the number of participants and the time, and reminded everyone to bring their gear and drinking water.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Home (Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area)

subevent.name: Set off for Yuanshen Sports Center
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan changed into his basketball jersey and shoes, took his basketball and towel, left home around 2 p.m., and took the subway or drove to the outdoor basketball court at Pudong Yuanshen Sports Center.
subevent.location: Shanghai - from home to Yuanshen Sports Center

subevent.name: Play a basketball game with basketball buddies
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan, Xie Fei, Zhang Wei, and other basketball friends played an intense basketball game on the outdoor court at Yuanshen Sports Center. They took turns splitting into teams to compete, and the atmosphere was lively, fulfilling the promise made after the farewell game in July to keep exercising. The game lasted about two hours, with short breaks and water refills in between.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Yuanshen Sports Center Outdoor Basketball Court

subevent.name: Post-match dinner and late-night snack.
subevent.description: After the match, Lei Mingxuan went with fellow players Xie Fei and Zhang Wei to a barbecue restaurant near the court for a late-night meal. As they ate and chatted, Lei Mingxuan proactively shared amusing stories about upgrading his clothing store, strengthening the old friendships among the players.
subevent.location: Shanghai - barbecue restaurant near Yuanshen Sports Center.

name: Start planning a self-driving trip to western Sichuan
description: On Sunday, August 24, Lei Mingxuan spent the whole day systematically planning an in-depth autumn road trip through western Sichuan. He looked up travel guides, marked destinations such as Daocheng Yading and Seda, refined his equipment list, and saved distinctive guesthouses in a travel app. This planning marked his short-term goal moving from a dream to the actual preparation stage.

subevent.name: Planning preparation and information gathering
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan opened his laptop in his home study, connected to the internet, and opened travel guide websites such as Baidu Maps and Mafengwo. He began systematically collecting information on road conditions, attractions, weather, and precautions for a fall self-drive trip to western Sichuan, laying the foundation for subsequent planning.
subevent.location: Home study in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Mark core destination
subevent.description: Based on the collected information, Lei Mingxuan used the mobile map app (Amap) to mark key scenic spots and waypoints one by one, including Yading in Daocheng, the Larung Gar Five Sciences Buddhist Academy in Seda, Xinduqiao, and Litang, and optimized the route to ensure the itinerary was reasonable and covered the desired natural scenery.
subevent.location: Home study in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Refine equipment and supplies list
subevent.description: Considering the special climate of the Western Sichuan Plateau and the needs of self-driving, Lei Mingxuan took out his notebook and itemized a supplies checklist including vehicle inspection items (tires, brakes, snow chains), high-altitude medicine (rhodiola, oxygen tanks), warm clothing, outdoor gear (tent, sleeping bags), food and water, and marked the items that needed to be purchased or rented.
subevent.location: Home study in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Saving featured guesthouses and accommodation options
subevent.description: On travel apps such as Ctrip and Airbnb, Lei Mingxuan searched and browsed highly rated Tibetan-style guesthouses at the destinations marked along his route. He added several favorite accommodations in Daocheng, Seda, and Kangding to his favorites, compared prices and locations, and prepared for later bookings.
subevent.location: Home study in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Planning summary and preliminary schedule draft.
subevent.description: Based on all the information collected that day, Lei Mingxuan drafted a preliminary 7-10 day self-driving itinerary for Western Sichuan on his computer using Excel or hand-drawn methods, including daily start and end points, estimated driving time, scenic spots to visit, and accommodation arrangements, marking the planning moving from concept to executable stage.
subevent.location: Home study in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Reflected on insufficient home strength training and adjusted the plan to combine it with morning runs
description: After starting home strength training on July 5, the completion rate was only 60% due to interruptions from camping and novel updates. On July 28, after his morning run, Lei Mingxuan reviewed the training plan and decided to adjust strength training to 6:00 a.m. every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday, alternating with morning run days, and set set and rep goals for each exercise (squats 3 sets × 15 reps, push-ups 3 sets × 12 reps, plank 3 sets × 45 seconds). By July 31, he had completed it twice, and the quality of movements had improved significantly.

subevent.name: Started a home strength training plan and completed the first session
subevent.description: At 6 a.m. on July 5, Lei Mingxuan started his home strength training plan in the living room of his home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai. Following the initial plan, he completed squats (3 sets of 15 reps), push-ups (3 sets of 12 reps), and planks (3 sets of 45 seconds), and recorded how each movement felt for later optimization.
subevent.location: Living room at home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Reflect on training gaps after morning run and adjust the plan
subevent.description: At 6 a.m. on July 28, after finishing a 5 km morning run on the riverside walkway in Pudong New Area, Lei Mingxuan sat on a bench by the river and reviewed his training over the past three weeks. He found that due to interruptions such as camping and novel updates, his completion rate was only 60%, so he decided to readjust his plan: schedule strength training for 6 a.m. every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday, alternating with morning running days, and set target sets and reps for each exercise (squats 3 sets × 15 reps, push-ups 3 sets × 12 reps, planks 3 sets × 45 seconds) to ensure systematic and consistent training.
subevent.location: Shanghai – Pudong New Area Riverside Promenade.

subevent.name: Carried out the first strength training session under the new plan
subevent.description: At 6 a.m. on Tuesday, July 29, Lei Mingxuan performed his first strength training session in the living room of his home on Zhangyang Road, strictly following the newly adjusted plan. He completed squats for 3 sets × 15 reps, push-ups for 3 sets × 12 reps, and planks for 3 sets × 45 seconds, with standard form and steady rhythm. After training, he recorded his completion and self-assessed that his movement quality had improved significantly compared to before.
subevent.location: Living room at home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Carried out the second strength training session according to the new plan.
subevent.description: At 6 a.m. on Thursday, July 31, Lei Mingxuan did his second strength training session of the week in the living room of his home on Zhangyang Road. He completed the scheduled sets of squats, push-ups, and planks in order, keeping his form at a high level. After the training, he felt moderate muscle soreness, thought the adjusted plan was more scientific and effective, and decided to keep following it to reach his fitness goals.
subevent.location: Living room at home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Went to Shanghai New International Expo Center to attend the ChinaJoy expo
description: From July 29 to August 1, Lei Mingxuan went to the Shanghai New International Expo Center to attend the ChinaJoy exhibition. As a hardcore anime fan, he specially took two days off to visit the expo with his online fellow enthusiast Gao Yuan for the first time in person. The two focused on anime merchandise, figures and models, and game experience areas. Lei Mingxuan took the opportunity to observe the design of co-branded apparel featuring popular anime IPs and searched for fashion trends. In addition, he tried out several new games in the indie game area and traded for several rare Pop Mart blind boxes in the designer toy zone. The four-day expo gave him a full haul, expanding not only his collection but also giving him a more intuitive understanding of IP commercialization.

subevent.name: Preparation and online communication ahead of the ChinaJoy expo
subevent.description: One week before the expo, Lei Mingxuan explained his leave arrangement to his parents Lei Jianguo and Wang Xiuying, and packed his expo backpack (power bank, water bottle, portable stool, etc.). Through WeChat, he confirmed with Gao Yuan, a fellow enthusiast from Hangzhou, the exact meeting spot for their first in-person meetup (Entrance Hall 2 of the Shanghai New International Expo Center) and the daily meeting time (10 a.m.). The two agreed to jointly plan a four-day exhibition route, focusing on anime merchandise, figures and models, game experiences, indie games, and designer toys.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Explain the leave arrangement to his parents
subevent.description: At home, Lei Mingxuan spoke with his parents Lei Jianguo and Wang Xiuying, explaining that he planned to attend the ChinaJoy expo and needed to take four days off. He also explained that he would be leaving early and returning late every day during the expo, and asked for his parents' understanding. His father, Lei Jianguo, asked about the expo and reminded him to stay safe; his mother, Wang Xiuying, expressed support and reminded him to bring his water bottle.
subevent.location: Home at Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Confirm meeting details and route plan with Gao Yuan online.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan contacted his anime fan friend Gao Yuan in Hangzhou via WeChat. The two agreed to meet for the first time in person at the Entrance Hall 2 of Shanghai New International Expo Center, with a daily meet-up time of 10 a.m. They then planned a four-day exhibition route based on the event schedule, focusing on anime merchandise, figurines, game experiences, indie games, and designer toy areas, and saved a screenshot of the route to their phones.
subevent.location: At home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (via WeChat)

subevent.name: Pack the backpack for ChinaJoy.
subevent.description: On the evening before departure, Lei Mingxuan packed his exhibition backpack at home, putting in a power bank, charging cable, large water bottle, portable folding stool, sunscreen, umbrella, snacks, and wallet, and checked the battery levels of his camera and phone. He also put a notebook and pen in the outer pocket of the backpack, ready to jot down interesting new product information. His father, Lei Jianguo, passed by and reminded him not to forget his ID card.
subevent.location: Home at Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.description: After taking leave, Lei Mingxuan arrived on time at 10 a.m. at Entrance 2 of the Shanghai New International Expo Center and met Gao Yuan for the first time offline. The two entered Halls W1-W3, focusing on the anime merchandise and figure model exhibition areas, exchanged insights on their collections, and recommended the latest limited-edition figures to each other. After a quick meal at the exhibition hall's dining area at noon, they continued browsing the expo until it closed in the afternoon, then returned to their respective lodgings in the evening.
subevent.name: ChinaJoy Day 1: Anime merchandise and figurine models
subevent.location: Shanghai - Shanghai New International Expo Center (2345 Longyang Road, Pudong New Area).

subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan and Gao Yuan focused on the N1-N3 game experience zones in the morning and tried out several upcoming new games. During the process, Lei Mingxuan paid special attention to the display of apparel co-branded with popular anime IPs, took multiple photos of design details with his phone, and noted down trendy keywords for future store selection reference. At noon he and Gao Yuan exchanged game experiences and business insights at the exhibition hall's café, and continued trying games in the afternoon until closing.
subevent.name: ChinaJoy Day 2: Game Experience and IP Apparel Observations
subevent.location: Shanghai - Shanghai New International Expo Center (2345 Longyang Road, Pudong New Area).

subevent.description: In the morning, Lei Mingxuan and Gao Yuan went to the indie game exhibition area, tried out several creative new titles, and joined the developer exchange to get game-culture merchandise. In the afternoon, they moved to the designer toy area, where Lei Mingxuan used a prepared trade list to successfully trade with three fellow collectors for rare Pop Mart blind boxes, and also purchased an extra limited-edition figure. In the evening, the two took a group photo outside the exhibition hall and shared the day's gains.
subevent.name: ChinaJoy Day 3: Indie game demos and designer toy trading
subevent.location: Shanghai - Shanghai New International Expo Center (2345 Longyang Road, Pudong New Area).

subevent.description: On the last day of the expo, Lei Mingxuan and Gao Yuan spent the morning visiting the cosplay performance area and the fan art exhibition area they had missed earlier, collecting brochures and posters. Before parting in the afternoon, the two bought expo-exclusive merchandise at the souvenir shop, exchanged small gifts, and agreed to stay in touch online. Lei Mingxuan returned home in the evening and briefly shared his expo experiences with his parents.
subevent.name: ChinaJoy Day 4: Catching Up and Saying Goodbye
subevent.location: Shanghai - Shanghai New International Expo Center (2345 Longyang Road, Pudong New Area).

name: Hand-brewed coffee for Mom's birthday; a mother-son heart-to-heart touches on old memories.
description: August 20 was his mother Wang Xiuying's birthday. Lei Mingxuan no longer cooked; instead, he used a cup of hand-brewed Yirgacheffe in place of a dish, elevating the clumsy cooking skills from earlier in the year into a warm transmission of craft. His mother held the coffee, her eyes slightly moist, and said, "My son has grown up." That night, she rarely reminisced about her 'rebellious' youth, when she left the Nantong countryside alone to go to Shanghai to take the teacher training entrance exam, and for the first time poured out the lonely courage and grievances she had buried for many years. Lei Mingxuan listened intently, and the mother-son relationship moved closer through mutual understanding.

subevent.name: Brewing coffee by hand on his birthday
subevent.description: On the morning of August 20, in his own kitchen, Lei Mingxuan used a pour-over kettle and freshly ground Yirgacheffe coffee beans to brew a cup of aromatic coffee with precise water temperature and a circular pouring technique, as a birthday gift for his mother Wang Xiuying. He carefully poured the coffee into his mother's usual mug and placed a handwritten greeting card beside it.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home kitchen

subevent.name: Mother and son deep talk touches on past events
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan placed the freshly brewed coffee in front of his mother, Wang Xiuying. After tasting it, she was moved to tears and praised her son for being thoughtful. That evening, the mother and son sat together on the living room sofa for a long, heart-to-heart talk. His mother uncharacteristically took the initiative to recall her 'rebellious' past, when she left the countryside of Nantong, Jiangsu and went alone to Shanghai to take the entrance exam for a normal school, confiding in him the loneliness, courage, and grievances of that time. Lei Mingxuan listened carefully throughout, offering comfort and responses at the right moments. The mother–son relationship grew even closer through mutual understanding and empathy.
subevent.location: Shanghai - living room at home

name: Preparing store upgrade and renovation plans, property management communication, and follow-up tidying.
description: On August 25, Lei Mingxuan drew preliminary renovation sketches for the café experience area and the complex in his home study and made a list of materials. On August 26, he took the sketches to the property management office of Century Link Mall and formally discussed the renovation plan with property manager Zheng Kai. He submitted the sketches and asked about regulations such as the approval process and construction time limits. The two sides agreed on a construction period of about two weeks, to be completed before National Day. After the discussion, Lei Mingxuan returned to the clothing store, organized the meeting minutes, recorded the key approval points and design adjustment details, and made a schedule for submitting the formal application.

subevent.name: Prepare a sketch of the store renovation plan
subevent.description: In his home study, Lei Mingxuan drew a preliminary renovation sketch based on his earlier ideas for a café experience area and a combined-space transformation, marking the locations of the coffee bar counter, rest area, and display adjustment zone, and listing the required materials in preparation for a meeting with the mall property manager on August 26.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - home study

subevent.name: Discussing the renovation plan with the shopping mall property manager
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan took the renovation proposal sketches to the shopping mall property management office for a formal discussion with the property manager Zheng Kai. He explained in detail the design ideas for the café experience area and the complex renovation, submitted the sketches for review, and asked about specific regulations such as the renovation approval process, construction time limits, and noise control. Zheng Kai gave the proposal an initial review and raised precautions regarding construction access and fire safety. The two sides agreed on a renovation period of about two weeks, with completion planned before National Day.
subevent.location: Property management office at Century Link Mall, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Organizing meeting notes and follow-up plans
subevent.description: After finishing the communication with Zheng Kai, Lei Mingxuan returned to his clothing store and recorded in his notebook the renovation approval process, construction time limits, and design details that needed adjustment (such as fire escape requirements) confirmed during the discussion, and briefly made a schedule for submitting formal application materials to the mall later, preparing to contact the renovation construction team.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - Century Link Mall, Lei Mingxuan's clothing store

name: Second meeting with Lao Zhou to test the waters with Southeast Asian brands; first encounter with a color discrepancy, turned the crisis into an opportunity
description: On August 5, as agreed last month, Lei Mingxuan met Lao Zhou formally for the second time and selected three Southeast Asian niche designer brands for small-batch trial sales. On August 10, the first batch arrived with batch-related color differences. After comparing item by item, he decided to accept them, made color-swatch explanations overnight, and patiently explained them to the first in-store customers on August 11-12. Through transparent communication, he maintained the partnership and established a color-difference spot-check file, gaining his first experience in external brand quality control.

subevent.name: Second meeting with Lao Zhou to select brands for trial sales
subevent.description: On August 5, according to last month's agreement, Lei Mingxuan held a second formal meeting with supplier Lao Zhou at his own clothing store. The two discussed in detail and finally selected three garments from niche Southeast Asian designer brands, deciding to introduce them to the store in small trial batches to test market response.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store

subevent.name: The first batch arrived with color discrepancy and was handled.
subevent.description: On August 10, the second batch of orders for the three trial-sale brands arrived. Lei Mingxuan opened the boxes in the store and compared each item with the samples, finding that some batches had obvious color differences. After evaluating, he decided to accept the flawed goods, and stayed up overnight to hand-make a detailed color chart explanation, marking the color-difference range of each item so he could explain to customers.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store

subevent.name: Explaining color difference to customers to maintain trust.
subevent.description: On August 11, the first batch of customers to arrive at the store expressed doubts after seeing the color-difference products. Lei Mingxuan proactively showed the color chart he had made the day before, explaining to each customer in a candid manner the characteristics of Southeast Asian hand-dyeing craftsmanship and batch differences, and promised unconditional exchanges if customers were not satisfied. Through patient communication, most customers expressed understanding and continued to buy, so the cooperative relationship was maintained.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store

subevent.name: Establish a color-difference sampling inspection file
subevent.description: On August 12, Lei Mingxuan continued explaining the color difference issue to subsequent in-store customers, and while free, organized the lessons learned from this color difference incident into a document, establishing a standard color difference sampling inspection file. The file includes color difference grading standards, sampling inspection procedures, and customer communication scripts, accumulating his first quality-control experience and standardized operating procedures for introducing more external brands in the future.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store

name: Had a heart-to-heart talk with father before bed and understood generational differences.
description: On the evening of August 21, the day after his mother's birthday, Lei Mingxuan saw his father Lei Jianguo drinking tea alone on the balcony, so he moved a small stool over and sat down. The father and son chatted from the store complex plan to the father's hard-working days at the machinery factory when he was young. Lei Jianguo admitted that he had initially worried about his son taking risks, but seeing how attentively his son made coffee on his mother's birthday, he felt the child had truly matured. Lei Mingxuan also heard for the first time that his father had once given up a promotion opportunity for the family. The two fell silent for a while, then Lei Mingxuan held his father's hand and said, “Dad, let's discuss family matters more from now on.” Lei Jianguo patted him on the shoulder, and the father-son relationship quietly warmed in the night.

subevent.name: Found his father alone on the balcony.
subevent.description: On the evening of August 21, 2025, the day after his mother's birthday, Lei Mingxuan walked out of his room and saw his father Lei Jianguo sitting alone on the balcony drinking tea. He decided to go over and chat with his father, so he carried a small stool from the living room and walked toward the balcony.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home balcony

subevent.name: Father and son had a heart-to-heart talk late at night.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan placed a small stool next to his father and sat down. The father and son started by talking about Lei Mingxuan's plan for a store complex. Lei Jianguo recalled his experience working at a state-owned machinery factory in Shanghai when he was young. Lei Jianguo admitted that he had initially worried that his son's entrepreneurial venture was too risky, but when he saw how attentively his son brewed coffee for his mother's birthday, he felt his son had truly matured. Lei Mingxuan learned for the first time that his father had once given up a promotion opportunity for the sake of the family. After a moment of silence, Lei Mingxuan held his father's hand and said, "Dad, from now on let's discuss family matters more." Lei Jianguo patted his shoulder.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home balcony

subevent.name: After the heart-to-heart talk, they each returned to their rooms.
subevent.description: After the heart-to-heart talk, Lei Mingxuan and Lei Jianguo each put away their teacups and small stools, said goodnight, and returned to their own rooms. Lying in bed, Lei Mingxuan thought back on his father's stories and felt warm inside. The father-son bond quietly deepened in the night.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

name: Follow-up health checkup showed blood lipids were still high, and the fitness plan was squeezed out by writing.
description: Continuing from July's home workouts, but in August, the daily updates of “Afternoon in Xiafei Lane” took up a lot of his evenings, reducing strength training to twice a week, and the APP data plummeted. On August 25, a follow-up physical exam still showed blood lipid levels above the warning line. The doctor warned: “If it keeps rising, it will become moderate fatty liver. You must exercise systematically.” The next day, he included a morning run in his schedule for the first time and decided to adjust his writing time to protect his health.

subevent.name: Go to the hospital for a blood lipid recheck.
subevent.description: On the morning of August 25, 2025, Lei Mingxuan went alone to the physical examination center of a general hospital in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, such as Renji Hospital East Campus, for a follow-up blood draw for lipid levels and a routine check-up. Because recent writing had squeezed out exercise time, he had a hunch about the results, but still wanted to know the specific changes in the numbers.
subevent.location: Shanghai – Pudong New Area – Hospital Physical Examination Center

subevent.name: Listened to the doctor explain the report and health warnings.
subevent.description: That afternoon, Lei Mingxuan returned to the hospital to get his follow-up report. The attending physician pointed out that his blood lipid indicators were still above the warning line and warned solemnly: 'If they go any higher, it will become moderate fatty liver; you must exercise systematically.' The doctor asked in detail about his recent exercise and diet, and advised him to develop a regular aerobic exercise plan and adjust his daily routine. Lei Mingxuan was deeply moved and decided to act immediately.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - hospital clinic room

subevent.name: First morning run and adjusted creative time plan
subevent.description: At 6 a.m. on August 26, 2025, Lei Mingxuan ran for the first time on the outer track of Century Park near Zhangyang Road in Pudong New Area, lasting 30 minutes, as the start of resuming systematic exercise. After running, he returned home and replanned his daily writing time in his notebook, deciding to change the daily update of 'Afternoon in Xiafei Lane' to a concentrated period, leaving mornings and evenings fixed for fitness, and set a goal of five aerobic sessions per week.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Century Park perimeter running track / home study.

name: Explained the complex project plan to Zhang Wei in detail; after encountering rigorous financial scrutiny, he started the business plan.
description: On August 22, Lei Mingxuan met Zhang Wei at a Japanese restaurant to catch up and laid out his concept of a 'coffee + trendy toys + clothing' complex. Zhang Wei, as a marketing manager, made precise calculations on a napkin, pointing out that the initial renovation would cost at least 250,000 yuan, monthly operating costs would increase by 20,000 yuan, and daily sales would need to rise by 15% to break even. Lei Mingxuan was momentarily at a loss for words. That evening, after reflecting at home, Lei Mingxuan began organizing the data, and on August 25 he started writing a business plan at the clothing store, collecting industry data and conducting a cost-benefit analysis.

subevent.name: Meet with Zhang Wei to catch up and prepare for the talk
subevent.description: On August 22, Lei Mingxuan contacted his childhood friend Zhang Wei via WeChat during the day and agreed to meet at a Japanese restaurant near Century Avenue in Pudong New Area that evening to catch up. At home in his study, he briefly organized the notes on his initial thoughts for a 'coffee + designer toys + clothing' complex, planning to explain them in detail to Zhang Wei over dinner.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Detailed discussion with Zhang Wei about the complex plan
subevent.description: That evening, Lei Mingxuan and Zhang Wei had dinner at a Japanese restaurant. During the meal, Lei Mingxuan described in detail his vision for a combined store that fuses coffee, trendy toy blind boxes, and clothing sales into an immersive experience space. Zhang Wei, a marketing manager, stopped smiling and did precise calculations on a napkin. He pointed out that the initial renovation would need at least 250,000 yuan, monthly operating costs would increase by 20,000 yuan, and daily sales would need to rise 15% just to break even. Then he asked Lei Mingxuan whether he could guarantee that. Lei Mingxuan was stumped, realized he needed a detailed business plan, and agreed to talk again next month with data.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Century Avenue, a Japanese restaurant

subevent.name: Reflecting on Zhang Wei's challenge and sorting out initial thoughts
subevent.description: After the meeting, Lei Mingxuan returned to his home on Zhangyang Road in Pudong New Area and carefully reflected in his study on Zhang Wei's financial concerns. He decided to face the problem of missing operational data head-on, began reviewing the store's sales turnover, customer traffic, and cost structure over the past year, and listed the market research items and calculation points that needed to be supplemented in his notebook, preparing for writing a business plan.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Started Writing the Business Plan
subevent.description: During the daytime on August 23, Lei Mingxuan used the gaps between business at the clothing store to collect data on mixed-use complexes using his computer and phone, including average spending per customer at nearby coffee shops, trendy toy consumption trends, and cases of similar integrated business formats, and began drafting the cost-benefit analysis section of a business plan, planning to complete it in the following days.
subevent.location: Inside a clothing store on the 2nd floor of a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Launch the Xiafei Ji Xiaohongshu account operation and test the waters of online product seeding.
description: Starting June 2, Lei Mingxuan officially launched the Xiaohongshu operation plan agreed upon with his cousin Shen Jie, registering the account 'Xiafeiji.' He photographed the store's new mountain-inspired functional-style products and published his first outdoor outfit note. After that, he updated 2-3 posts per week, covering camping gear styling, pour-over coffee vlogs, and behind-the-scenes stories of the store. By the end of the month, the account had gained nearly a thousand followers and hundreds of interactions, beginning to bring online traffic to the physical store. Xiao Lin also helped reply to comments.

subevent.name: Account registration and content planning.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan and his cousin Shen Jie, in the store, followed the previously agreed plan and officially registered the Xiaohongshu account 'Xiafeiji', and jointly planned the first month's content themes (mountain-style techwear outfits, camping gear, pour-over coffee Vlogs, and behind-the-scenes of the store), while also taking the necessary material photos for preparation. Participants were Lei Mingxuan (himself) and Shen Jie (his cousin, fashion consultant).
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area, Century Avenue, a shopping mall, 2nd Floor, Unit A-208 (Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store)

subevent.name: First outdoor outfit note published.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan used the 'Xiafei Ji' account to publish his first note, featuring an outdoor styling demonstration of the store's newly arrived mountain-style techwear jackets and pants, along with in-store photos and simple copy. Shen Jie helped review the copy and layout. After publishing, Lei Mingxuan began following the backend feedback and replied to the first few comments before finishing work.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area, Century Avenue, a shopping mall, 2nd Floor, Unit A-208 (Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store)

subevent.name: Early-stage continuous content creation and updates.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan continued to create and publish notes at a pace of 2-3 per week, including topics such as camping gear pairing recommendations, pour-over coffee making Vlogs (set up in a corner of the shop), and behind-the-scenes stories of daily shop selection. Shen Jie occasionally provided topic suggestions and image optimization advice, and also helped reply to questions in the comment section. At this stage, the account began to accumulate initial followers.
subevent.location: Shanghai—mainly at the store and outdoor shooting locations

subevent.name: Discuss content planning with Shen Jie.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan met his cousin Shen Jie in the store to plan the content themes for the next two weeks of posts. Based on fashion trends, Shen Jie suggested topics, focusing on three directions: camping gear styling, pour-over coffee Vlogs, and behind-the-scenes stories of store selection. She also gave optimization advice on photo angles and editing style. The two arranged their shooting schedules and division of work, and Shen Jie promised to help with post-processing of images.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Filming recommended camping gear combinations
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan brought his camping gear to Century Park, looking for suitable light and backgrounds to shoot recommendation photos and short videos for gear pairings. Following the composition techniques Shen Jie had suggested earlier, he tried shooting from multiple angles, recorded each piece of gear's brand and features, and wrote a draft outline for the captions on the spot. After shooting, he returned to the store and used spare time to do initial editing and photo retouching, then posted the finished work to Xiaohongshu.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Century Park

subevent.name: Filmed a vlog of making pour-over coffee
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan set up his phone and tripod in the pour-over coffee area he had prepared in a corner of the store, and recorded the entire process from grinding beans, warming the cup, and pouring water to extraction, while also introducing the origin of the coffee beans and brewing techniques. After filming, he used a mobile app to do a rough cut, adding subtitles and background music. Shen Jie watched the clips online and suggested adjusting the brightness of some shots; Lei Mingxuan made the changes and finally published the video.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Shoot behind-the-scenes stories of the store's daily product selection.
subevent.description: In the store, Lei Mingxuan used his phone to document the daily product selection process, including unboxing new arrivals, coordinating and trying on outfits, and discussing fabrics and cuts, while also sharing his insights as the store owner on choosing products. He invited a friend who visited the store that day to appear on camera as a temporary partner, trying on outfits together and interacting. The footage also covered display details in the store's corners, and was finally edited into a roughly 3-minute behind-the-scenes story video and published.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Replying to comments and interacting with followers
subevent.description: During a lull at the shop, Lei Mingxuan opened the Xiaohongshu backend to check the comment sections of recently posted notes and replied to fans' questions one by one, such as equipment purchase links and coffee apparatus models. Shen Jie sent him a set of commonly used reply scripts and emoji packs via WeChat, and helped him pin several high-quality comments. The two discussed online how to guide fans to follow, and Lei Mingxuan also replied to several private messages. The interaction lasted about 1 hour.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Film and publish the second outdoor gear content post
subevent.description: Based on the response to the first round of camping content, Lei Mingxuan decided to shoot another set of gear combinations in a different style. He went to the lawn near the roller-skating track on Pudong Riverside, using the golden evening light to take photos, focusing on the combination of newly arrived trendy toy accessories and outdoor equipment. After shooting, he returned to the store to edit the photos and write detailed captions, added hashtags, and finally published. Shen Jie helped guide the discussion in the comments after it was posted.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - riverside roller skating path lawn

subevent.name: Later-stage content development and engagement maintenance.
subevent.description: Based on earlier data feedback, Lei Mingxuan adjusted his content direction, increased fan interaction (such as launching outfit polls and giveaway events), and continued to post new product reviews and store stories. Shen Jie helped design the interactive copy. The account's follower count grew steadily, and a small flow of online customers began to be directed to the physical store. Lei Mingxuan took time every day to reply to comments and direct messages.
subevent.location: Shanghai - (mainly at the store and home)

subevent.name: Analyze data and adjust content direction
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan reviewed metrics for previous content in the store backend and social media analytics tools, such as views, completion rate, likes, comments, and shares. Combining follower profiles and comment feedback, he determined the key directions for the next two weeks: increase styling tutorials and audience interaction content, and reduce the share of pure product displays. While looking at the data, he wrote down the adjustment plan in his notebook and organized a list of interactive copy needs for Shen Jie to help design. The whole analysis process took about 2 hours and took place in the store's rest area.
subevent.location: Shanghai - rest area of the family clothing store

subevent.name: Shen Jie assists in designing interactive event copy
subevent.description: Shen Jie came to Lei Mingxuan's clothing store in the afternoon, and the two met in the store's lounge area. Lei Mingxuan showed her the adjusted content direction and the interactive copy needs, including copy ideas for outfit voting and lucky-draw campaigns. Shen Jie offered suggestions based on her experience as a fashion buyer and immediately wrote three versions of voting campaign copy and two sets of raffle rules on her laptop. Lei Mingxuan picked the version he liked best, and Shen Jie promised to fine-tune it later based on how the posts performed. The entire collaboration took about 3 hours, during which they also discussed plans such as inviting models for future new-product reviews.
subevent.location: Shanghai - leisure area of his own clothing store

subevent.name: Launch an outfit voting activity
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan launched a voting campaign called “You Decide This Week's Best Outfit” on the store's social media account. He had photographed five model looks wearing the season's new items in advance, paired them with carefully designed voting copy (the version finalized with Shen Jie yesterday), and set the voting to end 48 hours later. After publishing, he immediately shared the link in the fan group and to his personal WeChat Moments, and privately messaged several active fans to encourage participation. He then stayed by his phone to check the real-time voting updates and reply to fans' questions in the comments. On the first day, more than 200 people participated, and the results were as expected.
subevent.location: Shanghai - own clothing store and home

subevent.name: Launched a lucky draw event and announced the rules
subevent.description: Taking advantage of the weekend peak traffic, Lei Mingxuan launched a "Summer Refresh Lottery" on social media, with prizes including store clothing vouchers and mystery trendy toy blind boxes. He had prepared the lottery poster and copy in advance, and specified how to participate: follow the account, like the post, and comment with the designated secret code. After the event was posted, he monitored participation in real time and replied to questions in the comments about the lottery rules. At the same time, he placed event posters in the store to guide customers to scan the QR code and participate. On that day, the post received more than 500 interactions, significantly boosting the account's activity.
subevent.location: Shanghai - own clothing store and home

subevent.name: Releasing a new product review video
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan filmed a review video of the newly arrived summer shirts and shorts in the store. Wearing the new items, he did a 360-degree showcase in the fitting room and along the store aisle, explaining in detail the fabric texture, fit design, styling suggestions, and value for money. The video was about five minutes long. He edited it himself, added subtitles and background music, and published it during prime time that evening. After publishing, he promoted it in his fan group and on Moments, and replied to comments asking about sizes and purchase links. The video surpassed 1,000 views within eight hours of being published and brought in three online pre-orders.
subevent.location: Shanghai - photo area at our own clothing store

subevent.name: Publish store story content
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan compiled materials about his journey from working for others to starting his own business, and used photos, videos, and text to create a long-image post telling the store's story, including the preparations before opening, the joy of the first customer, the challenges of the pandemic, and the process of transitioning to social media. He polished the copy and layout in the work area on the second floor of the store, and published it around noon after finishing. After posting, he specifically @'d several regular customers and his relatives and friends, and replied one by one to the encouraging comments in the comment section. The post resonated emotionally with many people, and quite a few followers left comments saying they wanted to visit the physical store to show support.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Work area on the second floor of own clothing store

subevent.name: Continue maintaining fan interaction
subevent.description: During the event period, on each non-batch-publishing day, Lei Mingxuan used free time at the store and time after returning home in the evening to log into social media accounts and view and reply to fans' comments and private messages. He gave detailed advice on outfit questions, explained issues about the giveaway event, and thanked fans for their support. He also proactively browsed fans' pages, liked and interacted with valuable comments, and maintained a good community atmosphere. Through continuous interaction, fans' sense of belonging grew, and some online fans said they planned to visit the physical store on the weekend. Daily interaction time was about 30-60 minutes, location varied (store or home).
subevent.location: Shanghai - own clothing store and home

subevent.name: Month-end data review and retrospective
subevent.description: On June 30, Lei Mingxuan and Shen Jie reviewed the first month's results of the Xiaohongshu account operation together in the store: they counted the number of followers (nearly 1,000), interactions (several hundred), notes (about 10), and the inquiries driven from online traffic to the store. The two discussed the content plan for the following month. Lei Mingxuan noted areas for improvement and planned to introduce more video content in July.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area, Century Avenue, a shopping mall, 2nd Floor, Unit A-208 (Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store)

name: Systematically learned pour-over coffee and successfully mastered the technique
description: On April 4, Lei Mingxuan bought pour-over equipment and light-roast coffee beans on Zhao Min's recommendation. After returning from Qingming Festival tomb sweeping, he tried it for the first time. Although it was bitter, it unexpectedly sparked creative inspiration. He then kept practicing and watching tutorials, and on April 12 he finally brewed a well-balanced cup of coffee, which earned praise from his mother and Zhao Min. By the end of April, he had mastered the pouring technique for the V60 dripper and successfully made pour-over coffee for friends while camping, adding to the enjoyment of the western Sichuan road trip.

subevent.name: Buy pour-over coffee equipment and lightly roasted coffee beans.
subevent.description: On the recommendation of his friend Zhao Min, Lei Mingxuan purchased a V60 pour-over coffee set (including a glass dripper, resin server, filter papers, and a gooseneck kettle) along with a bag of light-roast coffee beans through an online shopping platform. The equipment was delivered to his home the same day, and he immediately checked all the accessories to prepare for the upcoming learning.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

subevent.name: First attempt at pour-over coffee (failed but gained inspiration)
subevent.description: After sweeping the tomb on Qingming Festival, Lei Mingxuan returned home and couldn't wait to try pour-over coffee with his new equipment. He simply followed a video tutorial, but because the water was poured unevenly and the flow was too strong, the coffee was over-extracted and tasted bitter. Although it didn't taste good, the attempt unexpectedly sparked his creative inspiration for new product designs or lifestyle concepts for the store.
subevent.location: Kitchen at home, No. 12, Lane 1589 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Learning Pour-Over Coffee Techniques and Optimizing Parameters
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan practiced pour-over coffee at home on April 6, 8, 10, and 11. On the first day, he watched professional tutorials and tried brewing for the first time, with parameters of 92°C, medium-fine grind, and a 30-second bloom, but the taste was too bitter. On the third day, he focused on experimenting with bloom time: keeping water temperature at 90°C and medium-fine grind fixed, he compared bloom times of 20/30/40 seconds and determined that 30 seconds worked best. On the fifth day, he compared grind sizes, keeping 90°C and a 30-second bloom fixed, and finally chose a medium-fine grind to balance flavor. On the sixth day, he did a comprehensive review, brewed two cups in a row to verify consistency, summarized the standard recipe, and organized it into a document.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

subevent.name: First day practicing pour-over coffee: basic introduction
subevent.description: At 8 PM, in his home kitchen, Lei Mingxuan spent an hour watching several professional pour-over video tutorials (including teaching videos from brands such as Timemore and Fellow) to learn the basic pour-over process: preparing the filter paper, wetting the filter paper, weighing out 15 grams of coffee beans, and grinding to a medium-fine size. He tried pouring water for the first time: using 92°C hot water, he first poured 30 ml in a circular motion to bloom for 30 seconds, then poured in two circular additions until the total water reached 225 ml. He recorded the brewing parameters (water temperature 92°C, grind size medium-fine, bloom time 30 seconds, total time 2 minutes 10 seconds). After tasting, he found it somewhat bitter and suspected over-extraction.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

subevent.name: Third day of pour-over coffee practice: bloom time experiment.
subevent.description: At 9 p.m., Lei Mingxuan did his third practice session, focusing on how the blooming time affects flavor. With water temperature fixed at 90°C and a medium-fine grind, he tried three blooming times—20 seconds, 30 seconds, and 40 seconds—using 15 grams of coffee beans and 225 ml of total water for each. A taste comparison showed that the 20-second bloom produced sharp acidity, the 30-second bloom gave a balanced mouthfeel with prominent sweetness, and the 40-second bloom had a slight bitterness. He ultimately confirmed 30 seconds as the optimal blooming time and noted it down.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

subevent.name: Day 5 of practicing hand-brewed coffee: adjusting the grind size
subevent.description: At 9:15 PM, Lei Mingxuan conducted a grind size comparison test. He kept the water temperature, blooming time, and pouring method fixed at the optimized approach from the previous two days (90°C, 30-second bloom, small circles around the bed), and brewed using three grind sizes: medium-coarse, medium-fine, and fine. The records showed that the medium-coarse grind (about the size of sea salt) produced too fast a flow and a light flavor; the medium-fine grind (like granulated sugar) had an extraction time of 2 minutes 15 seconds and a balanced acidity and bitterness; the fine grind (like fine sand) led to over-extraction and a pronounced bitterness. In the end, he determined that the optimal grind size for this coffee bean was the medium-fine setting, and marked it on the grinder's dial.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

subevent.name: Day 6 of pour-over coffee practice: comprehensive review and consolidation.
subevent.description: At 8 PM, Lei Mingxuan did his last focused practice. Based on the best parameters from the previous five days (90°C water, 30-second bloom, medium-fine grind, small-circle water pouring), he brewed two cups in a row to taste consistency. He also reviewed all his notes and summarized a standard brewing plan for this coffee bean, then filmed a water-pouring video to analyze his technique. Finally, he organized the week's brewing records into a document for future reference.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

subevent.name: Successfully brewed a balanced cup of coffee and was praised by his mother and Zhao Min
subevent.description: After a week of practice, on the afternoon of April 12, Lei Mingxuan brewed a well-balanced pour-over coffee. The coffee had a balanced acidity and bitterness with a distinct sweet aftertaste. He asked his mother, Wang Xiuying, to taste it, and she said it was much better than before. He also took a photo and sent it to Zhao Min, who praised his rapid progress and encouraged him to keep improving. This success greatly boosted his confidence.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Make pour-over coffee for friends while camping
subevent.description: On the weekend of April 26, Lei Mingxuan joined an outdoor camping trip with friends, including his childhood friend Zhang Wei and billiards buddy Han Dong. He made a point of bringing his pour-over equipment and coffee beans, and at the campsite he showed his skillful pour-over technique, brewing fragrant coffee for everyone to share. His friends were full of praise, which added even more fun to the outdoor experience of the road trip in western Sichuan.
subevent.location: A campsite in the suburbs of Shanghai

name: On Qixi Festival, rewatched a classic movie and was urged by his mother to get married.
description: August 29, Lunar Qixi Festival, Moments was full of couples showing off their love. Lei Mingxuan watched the shop as usual during the day, and at night rewatched the classic film "In the Mood for Love" alone at home. His mother Wang Xiuying couldn't help muttering again, "Don't be single next year." He smiled and brushed it off. Although there was a trace of longing inside, he was clearer that starting a business was the priority for now, and he put his energy into the store upgrade he was planning.

subevent.name: Ran the clothing store during the day.
subevent.description: On the day of Qixi Festival, Lei Mingxuan followed his daily routine and went to open his clothing store at Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai. He tidied the shelves, received customers, handled daily sales matters, observed the festive shopping atmosphere, and used spare moments on his phone to browse updates from peers in the industry, gaining inspiration for upgrading the store.
subevent.location: Retail unit, 2nd floor of a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Left work and went home.
subevent.description: After closing in the evening, Lei Mingxuan shut the shop, sorted out the day's accounts and keys, and walked or took the metro back to his home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area. On the way, he stopped at the fruit store at the entrance of the residential complex to buy some fruit. After getting home, he changed into loungewear and greeted his mother Wang Xiuying, who was preparing dinner.
subevent.location: Home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Having dinner with family and dealing with mother's urging to get married
subevent.description: At around 7 p.m., Lei Mingxuan had dinner with his father Lei Jianguo and mother Wang Xiuying in the family dining room. During the meal, his mother saw romantic posts for Qixi on her WeChat Moments and couldn't help nagging, 'Don't stay single next year,' and mentioned that the neighbors' child had gotten married. Lei Mingxuan smiled and brushed it off with 'Let fate decide,' while changing the subject to the recent arrival of new items in the store. After dinner, he took the initiative to clear the dishes to ease the awkward atmosphere caused by the marriage pressure.
subevent.location: Home dining room, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Revisited the classic film In the Mood for Love alone
subevent.description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan returned to his room, closed the door, turned on the projector and speakers, and rewatched the classic film "In the Mood for Love" alone. He curled up on the bean bag sofa and watched quietly, immersed in the nostalgic atmosphere. While watching, he occasionally scrolled through his Moments, and when he saw posts about Qixi, a flicker of longing for a relationship passed through his heart, but he soon turned his attention back to the movie's plot.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Late-Night Planning of the Store Upgrade Plan
subevent.description: At 11 p.m., after the movie ended, Lei Mingxuan opened his laptop and organized the store upgrade ideas he had conceived during the afternoon and dinner into a document. Referring to online trend information, peer activity, and the suggestions previously given by regular customer Qian Duoduo and his cousin Shen Jie, he wrote several keywords in his notes: traffic flow adjustment, new product area, and social check-in zone. He roughly sketched a floor plan and set a plan to visit competitor stores on-site next week. He didn't wash up and go to bed until 12:30 a.m.
subevent.location: Home study on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Celebrate childhood friend Zhang Wei's birthday; three of us video-called to congratulate on the double happiness.
description: August 15 was Zhang Wei's 31st birthday, and it coincided with Lei Mingxuan's novel being recommended by an editor — a double blessing. That evening, Lei Mingxuan hosted a dinner in a private room at a Japanese restaurant he had carefully chosen in Pudong, and gave Zhang Wei a custom designer toy figurine as a birthday gift. Zhang Wei was overjoyed, and the two raised their glasses and drank happily. Because Li Na was in Hangzhou and could not be there, Lei Mingxuan made a video call, and the three cut a cake and hummed the birthday song together across the screen. Moved, Zhang Wei suggested organizing a dinner with his teammates over the weekend to celebrate Lei Mingxuan's novel together. Their friendship grew deeper amid the laughter connecting three places.

subevent.name: Buying a custom designer toy figurine as a birthday gift
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan selected and bought a custom limited-edition designer toy figurine at a trendy toy store in Pudong New Area, intending it as a birthday gift for Zhang Wei. The figurine's design incorporated anime elements that Zhang Wei likes and their shared memories, and Lei Mingxuan specifically asked the store to wrap it beautifully.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - A Designer Toy Store

subevent.name: Reserve a private room at a Japanese restaurant
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan called a highly rated Japanese restaurant in Pudong that he frequently visits, reserved a private room for that evening, and confirmed the menu and arrival time. He specifically chose a private room so he could celebrate quietly with Zhang Wei and video-call Li Na.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - a Japanese restaurant

subevent.name: Arrived at the Japanese restaurant and gave the gift
subevent.description: In the evening, Lei Mingxuan brought the prepared collectible toy figurine to the reserved private room at the Japanese restaurant. Zhang Wei arrived shortly after. Lei Mingxuan handed the gift to Zhang Wei personally. Seeing the custom figurine, Zhang Wei was very surprised and moved, and the two immediately raised their glasses and drank together, reminiscing about their friendship.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - private room at a Japanese restaurant

subevent.name: Video-called Li Na, and the three of us cut the cake and sang the birthday song together
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan made a video call to Li Na from the private room. Li Na joined the celebration from her home in Hangzhou through the screen. Lei Mingxuan and Zhang Wei placed candles on the birthday cake they had prepared in advance. Li Na led the birthday song from the video call, and the three of them blew out candles and cut the cake together across the screen, with endless laughter and joy.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - private room of a Japanese restaurant (Li Na is at home in Xihu District, Hangzhou)

subevent.name: Zhang Wei suggested organizing a weekend dinner gathering with sports buddies to celebrate the novel being recommended.
subevent.description: After the video call ended, Zhang Wei, deeply moved, suggested organizing a dinner among several mutual sports buddies this weekend to celebrate Lei Mingxuan's novel receiving an editor's recommendation.
