Lei Mingxuan readily agreed, and the two then had a preliminary discussion in the private room about the intended time and place for the dinner.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - private room at a Japanese restaurant

name: Buy a DJI drone to upgrade content for camping and the store.
description: On the afternoon of September 21, driven by the need to document his camping trips, Lei Mingxuan went to the digital mall and bought a DJI Mavic 3 drone with accessories for 12,800 yuan. After returning to the store, he immediately studied the operation tutorials and made plans with his camping buddies to test-fly it on the next trip. His mother grumbled about this big purchase, saying he was 'throwing money away,' but he explained that it was for shooting better outdoor content and adding high-quality visual material to the store's social media. After that, the drone became new gear in his camping backpack.

subevent.name: Go to the digital mall to buy a drone.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Lei Mingxuan drove alone to Buynow Digital City in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and bought a DJI Mavic 3 drone set for 12,800 yuan in cash at an authorized dealer. The set included the main unit, remote controller, two batteries, and a charger.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Buynow Digital City

subevent.name: Returned to the store to study the operation tutorial
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan returned to his clothing store in the mall on Century Avenue in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, unboxed and inspected the drone in the store's rest area, searched for official operation tutorial videos on his phone, and learned basic operations such as takeoff, hovering, and filming, preparing for a test flight on the next camping trip.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Clothing Store

subevent.name: Discussing the reason for the purchase with mother.
subevent.description: After getting home that evening, his mother, Wang Xiuying, saw the drone packaging and grumbled about wasting money. Lei Mingxuan explained to her in the living room that he had bought the drone to shoot high-quality outdoor videos on the next camping trip, to upgrade the content on his clothing store's social media accounts and attract more customers.
subevent.location: Shanghai - living room at home

subevent.name: Making plans with camping companions for a test flight
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan contacted Zhang Wei, a friend he often goes camping with, via WeChat. He told him that he had bought a new drone and agreed that Lei Mingxuan would handle aerial photography on the next camping trip. The two had an initial discussion about the camping time and location.
subevent.location: Shanghai – bedroom at home

name: Had a phone review with supplier Lao Zhou and consolidated the cooperative relationship
description: On August 13, Lei Mingxuan proactively called supplier Zhou Tao to thank him for his cooperation on the color difference issue. The two chatted about business and life, and their relationship warmed. Old Zhou promised to add quality inspection procedures and give Lei priority in selecting styles. Afterwards, Lei Mingxuan organized the call notes, sent Zhou a thank-you message, scheduled a visit for the next week, and informed the store staff to cooperate with the new quality inspection process, fully consolidating the partnership.

subevent.name: Phone debrief with supplier Lao Zhou.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of August 13, Lei Mingxuan proactively called Zhou Tao (Old Zhou), a partner of Hangzhou Taosheng Clothing Co., Ltd., from the rest area of the clothing store using his phone. The call lasted 45 minutes. Lei Mingxuan first thanked Old Zhou for his concession and cooperation on the color difference issue, and then the two moved from business to life: Old Zhou mentioned his parents in his hometown of Wenzhou, and Lei Mingxuan shared the story of his mother's birthday. Old Zhou said he greatly appreciated Lei Mingxuan's integrity, promised to add an extra quality inspection step before shipping in the future, and give Lei Mingxuan priority in selecting future new products. The two agreed to strengthen communication going forward, and their relationship warmed significantly.
subevent.location: Clothing store A-208, 2nd floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: After the call, organize the records and follow-up arrangements.
subevent.description: On the evening of August 13, Lei Mingxuan recorded the key points of his call with Lao Zhou in the store operations memo, including Lao Zhou's promised quality inspection process and priority in selecting styles. He then sent Lao Zhou a thank-you message on WeChat, confirmed the details of follow-up cooperation, and planned to visit Lao Zhou in person during his business trip to Hangzhou next week. At the same time, he told the staff to pay attention to cooperating with the supplier's new quality inspection process when stocking up in the future, to ensure product quality. The entire follow-up was concise and efficient, cementing the results of their warmer relationship.
subevent.location: Clothing store A-208, 2nd floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Follow up on the shipping of the new autumn mountain-style functional wear and complete the display arrangement
description: On July 7, 2025, Lei Mingxuan contacted supplier Zhou Tao at the store to confirm the shipment of the new autumn mountain-style functional wear. He learned that the goods had been sent from Hangzhou over the weekend and were expected to arrive in Shanghai on July 10. On July 8, he used his spare time to draw display sketches and plan the entrance theme area. On July 9, he refined the plan and handwrote product story cards. On July 11, after receiving the arrival notice, he unpacked and inspected the goods, verified everything, put the new products on display, fine-tuned the layout according to the plan, and completed the theme area.

subevent.name: Contact the supplier to confirm shipment of autumn new products
subevent.description: On Monday morning, July 7, 2025, Lei Mingxuan used his phone in the store to contact Hangzhou supplier Zhou Tao (Taosheng Apparel) and proactively confirmed the shipment status of the first batch of new autumn mountain-style techwear products. Through the communication, he learned that the goods had been sent from the Hangzhou warehouse last weekend and were expected to arrive at the logistics point in Pudong, Shanghai, on July 10. Lei Mingxuan noted the tracking number and expected arrival time, and reminded Zhou Tao to keep an eye on subsequent delivery issues.
subevent.location: In clothing store A-208 on the 2nd floor of a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Draw a sketch of the autumn new-product display
subevent.description: On July 8, 2025, during a slow period at the store, Lei Mingxuan used the workbench behind the cash register to start hand-drawing a sketch for the autumn new product display. He focused on planning the area to the right of the store entrance as the 'Mountain-Tech Theme Zone.' On the sketch, he marked shelf positions, floor display stand dimensions, and the wall hanging area, and briefly sketched the visual effect with artificial greenery and camping lights, laying the foundation for further detailed planning.
subevent.location: In clothing store A-208 on the 2nd floor of a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Refine the display plan and write product story cards.
subevent.description: On July 9, 2025, Lei Mingxuan continued to refine the display plan during the store's slow hours. Based on yesterday's sketches, he detailed the display layout behind the cash register, determined the specific use of each display position in the theme area, and handwrote several product story cards on cardboard, covering the design inspiration, fabric features, and styling suggestions for the mountain-style functional line to enhance customers' immersive shopping experience. At the same time, he marked a list of artificial plants and camping lights to purchase for the upcoming setup.
subevent.location: In clothing store A-208 on the 2nd floor of a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Unpack and inspect the goods, then put the fine-tuned new products on the shelves
subevent.description: On July 11, 2025, Lei Mingxuan received a delivery notification and personally unpacked and inspected the goods in the back warehouse of the store. He checked the styles, colors, and quantities of the new autumn mountain-style techwear items one by one. After confirming they matched the order exactly, he hung some samples on the display racks and fine-tuned their positions according to the previous display plan, placing the key products in the eye-level golden zone and using hanger spacing and lighting to highlight the theme. He also inserted handwritten story cards into the corresponding rack slots, completing the initial setup of the themed area and preparing to welcome customers.
subevent.location: In clothing store A-208 on the 2nd floor of a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Inline skating with Song Jia along the riverfront
description: On the early morning of Sunday, August 24, Lei Mingxuan invited his roller skating partner Song Jia to go for a morning skate on the roller skating track along Pudong Riverside Avenue. The two skated from Lujiazui along the river to Houtan, about 10 kilometers in total. At rest stops along the way, they chatted about their recent lives and skating skills. Song Jia recommended some new protective gear, while Lei Mingxuan shared his store upgrade plans. After exercising, they had breakfast together at a riverside café and enjoyed the leisurely weekend.

subevent.name: Morning preparation and departure
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan got up at home in the early morning, put on his roller skating gear, took his protective gear and water bottle, then rode a shared bike or walked to the roller skating trail on Pudong Riverside Avenue to meet Song Jia at the agreed meeting point.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home in Pudong New Area to Binjiang Avenue

subevent.name: Met up with Song Jia and started roller skating.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan arrived at the roller skating meeting point on the Lujiazui section of the Pudong Riverside Promenade and met up with Song Jia. After exchanging greetings, the two put on their protective gear and skated east from Lujiazui along the river (toward Houtan).
subevent.location: Lujiazui Section, Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Rest and chat during the trip
subevent.description: After skating about 5 km, Lei Mingxuan and Song Jia stopped at a rest stop along the way. The two sat on a bench by the river, drinking water and resting, chatting about their recent lives and roller-skating skills. Song Jia recommended several new pieces of protective gear she had been using, while Lei Mingxuan shared his plan to upgrade his clothing store's brand.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area, halfway rest stop on Binjiang Avenue

subevent.name: Completed 10 km of roller skating.
subevent.description: After the break, the two continued skating along the river to the finish point at Houtan, completing a roller skating session of about 10 km. At the finish, they did some light stretching to relax and enjoyed the morning river breeze.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Houtan Section, Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area

subevent.name: Having breakfast together at a riverside café
subevent.description: After exercising, Lei Mingxuan and Song Jia went to a café near the Riverside Avenue, ordered coffee and a light meal. They chatted about weekend plans while eating, enjoying a leisurely weekend moment, and ended the get-together about half an hour later to head home separately.
subevent.location: Riverside Café, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family weekend dumpling-making activity.
description: On Saturday, August 7, Lei Mingxuan suggested the whole family make dumplings together. His mother Wang Xiuying prepared the filling, his father Lei Jianguo rolled the wrappers, and he was responsible for wrapping and boiling. The three chatted while they worked. Lei Mingxuan shared new product ideas for the shop, and his parents talked about amusing stories from their youth. They spent a warm afternoon filled with laughter and joy. Some of the boiled dumplings were also given to their neighbor Aunt Zhu, which strengthened neighborly ties.

subevent.name: Making dumplings and conversing
subevent.description: Around 2 p.m., the whole family sat around the dining table and began making dumplings. Father Lei Jianguo skillfully rolled out dumpling wrappers, mother Wang Xiuying was in charge of filling and sealing them, and Lei Mingxuan also joined in, learning his mother's technique. While making dumplings, the three chatted casually: Lei Mingxuan shared the recent new styles and sales ideas for his shop, while his parents recalled amusing stories from their younger days at the factory and school. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious. After about an hour, the cutting board was covered with neatly arranged dumplings.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area: home dining-living room

subevent.name: Boiling and tasting dumplings
subevent.description: At 3:30 p.m., Lei Mingxuan was in charge of boiling the wrapped dumplings in batches, his father helped monitor the heat by his side, and his mother prepared the dipping sauce and bowls and chopsticks. Once the dumplings were cooked, the whole family sat around the table and enjoyed the fruits of their labor together, praising the delicious flavor of the filling his mother had made. During the meal, Lei Mingxuan also took photos of the dumplings and sent them to the family group chat to share with relatives. The tasting lasted about 40 minutes, and everyone ate to their heart's content.
subevent.location: Home dining room, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Delivered dumplings to neighbor Aunt Zhu.
subevent.description: Around 5 p.m., Lei Mingxuan put a plate of freshly boiled dumplings into an insulated lunch box and went to the home of Aunt Zhu, a neighbor who also lived on Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road. When she answered the door, he warmly handed the dumplings to Aunt Zhu and made small talk about weekend life. Aunt Zhu was very happy and gave him some homemade fermented rice ball soup in return as a thank-you. This gesture of delivering dumplings further strengthened the neighborly bond between the two families.
subevent.location: Neighbor Aunt Zhu's home, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Attended a designer toy appraisal lecture to broaden business horizons.
description: On Saturday, September 6, Lei Mingxuan registered for a professional lecture on designer toy authentication and collecting, systematically learning authenticity identification and market trends. He proactively got to know five local collectors; two of them gave suggestions on the store's designer toy selection, and one said he was willing to provide limited-edition products. This learning directly improved his business judgment in the designer toy field.

subevent.name: Pre-departure preparation and confirming lecture information
subevent.description: On the morning of Saturday, September 6, Lei Mingxuan confirmed the venue, time, and registration information for the designer toy appraisal lecture at home. He packed his backpack with a notebook, a phone power bank, and a business card holder, fully preparing for the professional lecture.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Attended a designer toy appraisal lecture to learn
subevent.description: From morning to noon on September 6, Lei Mingxuan attended a lecture on professional designer toy authentication and collecting at a cultural convention center in Shanghai, systematically learning techniques for distinguishing authentic designer toys, methods for analyzing market trends, taking careful notes, and interacting with the lecturer.
subevent.location: Shanghai - a cultural and convention center in Pudong New Area

subevent.name: Proactively connect with local collector friends and exchange ideas
subevent.description: After the lecture ended on the afternoon of September 6, Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to meet five local designer toy collectors during the tea break and free networking session, and they added each other on WeChat. Two of the collectors gave specific suggestions on the store's toy selections, and one said he was willing to provide Lei Mingxuan with sourcing channels for limited-edition items. Through in-depth exchanges, Lei Mingxuan expanded his industry network and business perspective.

subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Hands-on remodeling of the store's coffee experience area
description: On September 7, Lei Mingxuan drew up the renovation plan for the coffee experience area and purchased the required materials. From September 13 to 14, he personally completed the construction and setup of the coffee experience area, using coffee equipment from his collection, including a Kalita copper kettle and a Hario Cloud kettle, as decor. The total renovation cost was kept within the 50,000 yuan budget.

subevent.name: Formulating a renovation plan for the coffee experience area
subevent.description: In the rest area of his clothing store, Lei Mingxuan planned in detail the dimensions, cabinet style, electrical rewiring, and decoration style of the hand-drip coffee experience area based on the store's existing layout and budget, and drew a simple renovation sketch.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Purchasing renovation materials and coffee brewing equipment.
subevent.description: Following the checklist in the plan, Lei Mingxuan went to the Pudong Building Materials Market to purchase light industrial waste materials (such as wood boards, metal racks, screws, etc.), and on the way stopped at a home furnishing mall to buy decorative shelves, storage boxes, and some small coffee equipment accessories, making sure the total renovation cost stayed within the 50,000 yuan budget.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - building materials market and home furnishing mall

subevent.name: First day of remodeling the coffee experience area
subevent.description: Starting at 9 a.m., Lei Mingxuan used the store's closed hours to personally carry out construction with light industrial waste materials in a corner of the shop, including erecting a pillar frame, fixing shelf boards, installing wires and socket positions, and completing the basic structure. Store clerk Xiao Lin helped by handing him tools and clearing waste.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Day two of construction: finished arranging the coffee experience area.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan continued working and finished the final assembly using the purchased light industrial scrap materials. He placed his Kalita copper kettle, Hario Cloud kettle, and other coffee equipment on the shelves as decoration. He also plugged in the sockets, wiped down the countertops, completed the final layout of the entire coffee experience area, and demonstrated the operating process to store clerk Xiao Lin.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Attend the Shanghai International Clothing & Accessories Expo for product selection and follow-up
description: On August 18, 2025, Lei Mingxuan prepared exhibition materials at home and planned his visiting route. On the 19th, he went to the National Exhibition and Convention Center (Shanghai) to attend the CHIC Expo, focusing on the streetwear and designer brand areas. He collected information on more than 20 potential suppliers, held preliminary talks with three brands about possible cooperation, and obtained the latest information on fabrics and design trends. After the expo, he returned to the store to organize the materials. On the 20th, he followed up with the interested brands online to move the cooperation forward.

subevent.name: Pre-exhibition preparation and planning
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan, either at his own store or at home, used his computer and phone to search online the exhibitor list of the Shanghai International Clothing and Accessories Fair (CHIC), focusing on the streetwear and designer brand exhibition zones. He printed business cards, prepared store brochures and fabric sample packs, and planned his visiting route and schedule for August 19 to make efficient use of the exhibition time.
subevent.location: Home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Heading to the National Exhibition and Convention Center
subevent.description: On the morning of August 19, Lei Mingxuan set out from his home in Pudong New Area and drove a private car or took the subway to the National Exhibition and Convention Center (Shanghai) in Qingpu District. On the way, he checked the ID documents and materials he was carrying to ensure a smooth entry.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area to Qingpu District - National Exhibition and Convention Center

subevent.name: Visiting the streetwear and designer brand exhibition areas.
subevent.description: After entering the expo, Lei Mingxuan followed his planned route and focused on the streetwear and designer brand exhibition areas. He browsed the various booths, flipped through product catalogs, proactively communicated with exhibitors, collected promotional materials and business cards from more than 20 potential suppliers, and noted down key information about each brand's design style and cooperation terms.
subevent.location: CHIC exhibition site at the National Exhibition and Convention Center, Qingpu District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Initial discussion with interested brands.
subevent.description: Based on the information he had gathered, Lei Mingxuan selected three brand booths whose styles best matched his store's positioning and took the initiative to approach them for in-depth conversations. He introduced his clothing store's positioning and target customers to the brand representatives, learned in detail about their product lines, minimum order quantities, supply lead times, and pricing systems, and expressed initial interest in cooperation. Both parties exchanged contact information and agreed to follow up later.
subevent.location: CHIC exhibition site at the National Exhibition and Convention Center, Qingpu District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Obtain information on fabrics and design trends.
subevent.description: During the exhibition, Lei Mingxuan made a point of visiting the trend-release area and fabric exhibitors. By viewing display boards, attending mini-lectures, and talking with exhibitors, he obtained information on the latest 2025 autumn/winter fabric compositions, color trends, and design and cutting directions. He took photos and brief notes to serve as references for the store's future product selection.
subevent.location: CHIC exhibition site at the National Exhibition and Convention Center, Qingpu District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Return to the store and organize the exhibition materials
subevent.description: After the exhibition ended, Lei Mingxuan drove back to his clothing store in the Century Avenue mall in Pudong New Area with the thick stack of materials he had collected. At the store, he took out the prepared folders, sorted and filed business cards, brochures, and notes, digitized the key supplier information, and based on the day's observations, began drafting the product selection direction for the next quarter.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Follow-up with prospective suppliers
subevent.description: On August 20, Lei Mingxuan proactively contacted the representatives of the three prospective brand partners he had talked with the day before via WeChat or email during a break at work. He thanked them for their hospitality, reaffirmed his intention to cooperate, and sent the store profile and a preliminary cooperation proposal, inviting them to visit the store or further discuss sending samples to push the cooperation forward.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Replaced with a new phone to improve the quality of store content photography.
description: On the afternoon of September 20, Lei Mingxuan's phone, which he had used for three years, was severely affecting daily store photography and customer replies due to a deteriorating screen and lagging performance, so he went to an electronics mall in Pudong and spent 7,999 yuan on a new flagship domestic phone. He quickly completed data migration, tested the night mode on the store's newly built coffee experience area, and posted on Moments: 'New partner powering up.' The new phone improved product photo quality and social media operations, providing a better tool for driving online traffic to the store.

subevent.name: Go to Pudong Digital City.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan set out from his own store on Century Avenue in Pudong New Area and walked or took a short ride to the nearby Pudong Digital City, planning to choose a new phone.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Pudong Digital City

subevent.name: Select and purchase a new flagship phone
subevent.description: After comparing at several phone counters in Pudong Digital Mall, Lei Mingxuan chose a domestic flagship phone, paid 7,999 yuan on the spot to complete the purchase, and had an invoice issued. The phone focuses on imaging capabilities, which matches his photography needs.
subevent.location: A counter at Pudong Digital City, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Completed data migration
subevent.description: After returning to his own shop, Lei Mingxuan used the phone's built-in data migration tool to fully migrate important data from the old phone to the new one, including contacts, photos, WeChat chat history, and to ensure that the various store operation apps could be used normally.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Own Clothing Store

subevent.name: Trying out the night mode of the new phone for taking photos
subevent.description: In the newly built coffee experience area of the store, Lei Mingxuan took several photos and short videos using the night mode of his new phone to test the image quality and color reproduction, and confirmed he was satisfied with the results.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - coffee experience area in my own clothing store

subevent.name: Post to WeChat Moments to promote the new device
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan chose photos of the coffee experience area taken with the new phone he was trying out, added the words 'New partner helps out,' and posted them to his personal WeChat Moments, demonstrating the store upgrade and the shooting effects to attract customers' attention and interaction.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Own Clothing Store

name: Improv theater experience, creative stress relief
description: On August 30, because her original partner dropped out at the last minute, Shen Jie urgently invited her cousin Lei Mingxuan to fill in for the improvisational theater experience. Lei Mingxuan received the invitation in the morning, quickly adjusted his work schedule, and made simple preparations. He went to the small theater in Huangpu District in the afternoon. During the activity, although he felt it was sudden, once on stage he successfully played multiple roles with his quick wit and desire to perform. His exaggerated acting released the work pressure that had accumulated over several days, and Shen Jie was also very surprised. After the event, the two discussed and exchanged thoughts at a café, agreeing to keep attending similar activities.

subevent.name: Received Shen Jie's temporary fill-in invitation
subevent.description: On the morning of August 30, 2025, Shen Jie (his younger female cousin) urgently contacted her older male cousin Lei Mingxuan because her original partner suddenly could not attend the improv theater experience event. On the phone, she explained the situation and invited him to fill in that afternoon. At the time, Lei Mingxuan was sorting goods at his own clothing store (Booth A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai). Shen Jie sounded anxious and promised the event would be fun.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Decided to participate and made simple preparations
subevent.description: After receiving Shen Jie's invitation, Lei Mingxuan quickly decided to accept the spot. He briefly adjusted his afternoon work schedule at the store, asked the staff to help keep an eye on things, changed into loose, casual sportswear, and brought his water bottle and phone, getting ready for the improvisational theater. The whole process took about 30 minutes.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Heading to the improv theater experience venue
subevent.description: Around 1:30 p.m. on August 30, Lei Mingxuan left his shop and took the subway or a taxi to the improvisational theater studio Shen Jie had agreed on (a small theater in a cultural creative park in Huangpu District, Shanghai). On the way, he messaged Shen Jie to confirm the exact location and start time, and Shen Jie replied telling him to meet directly backstage at the theater.
subevent.location: Huangpu District, Shanghai - small theater in a cultural and creative park

subevent.name: Participated in an improv theater experience and performed improv
subevent.description: From 2 to 4 p.m. on August 30, Lei Mingxuan joined Shen Jie and other participants in an improv theater experience. Initially a bit nervous, he quickly got into the groove under the instructor's guidance, showing quick wit and a flair for performance. He played roles such as a customer, a detective, and an alien, and his exaggerated body language and humorous lines made the whole room laugh, successfully releasing the work pressure that had built up over several days. Shen Jie was pleasantly surprised by his performance, and the two worked in sync during the games.
subevent.location: Huangpu District, Shanghai - small theater in a cultural and creative park

subevent.name: After the event, debriefed and exchanged thoughts with Shen Jie.
subevent.description: After the improv theater experience, Lei Mingxuan and Shen Jie rested and chatted at a café near the theater. Lei Mingxuan remarked that although he had been dragged in to fill a spot, the session was thoroughly enjoyable and his stress had melted away. Shen Jie laughingly called him a 'hidden drama king' and they agreed that she would keep inviting him to similar events in the future. The two discussed improv techniques and shared several funny WeChat Moments posts. Around 6:30 p.m., they each went back.
subevent.location: Cafe near the Cultural Creative Park, Huangpu District, Shanghai

name: Supplier Wu Fang sent samples, and the coffee return gift in return earned a bulk discount.

Li Na showed great interest and finally agreed to go camping together this autumn, with the initial plan set for mid-to-late October.
