description: After that, Lei Mingxuan applied the 'buy only when necessary' principle to store purchasing. During the October procurement, he excluded three non-core functional clothing styles to reduce inventory risk, and began to record personal and store income and expenses, gradually consolidating his rational consumption habits.

subevent.name: Establish the principle of buying only when necessary and make a plan for recording income and expenses.
subevent.description: In his home study, Lei Mingxuan, drawing on his earlier reflections on his spending habits, formally established the rational consumption principle of buying only what is necessary and formulated a specific plan for recording personal and store income and expenses, including bookkeeping templates and classification standards, to prepare for implementation.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - home study

subevent.name: Continue recording personal and store income and expenses
subevent.description: Starting in October, Lei Mingxuan set up an electronic income-and-expense recording system. From then on, at the end of each month he aggregated, entered, and analyzed his personal expenses and the clothing store's operating income and expenses, monitoring cash flow and inventory. At the end of December he completed the fourth-quarter and annual summaries, gradually consolidating rational spending habits.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - clothing store and home

subevent.name: Set up an income and expense recording system and enter the initial data
subevent.description: That evening, in his study at home, Lei Mingxuan opened Excel on his laptop and designed a categorization framework based on the store's and his personal financial characteristics (including personal daily expenses, store purchasing costs, store daily revenue, inventory value, store operating expenses, etc.). He then manually entered initial data—the clothing store's end-of-September inventory records and the beginning-of-October cash and bank card balances—into the spreadsheet and verified it was correct.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - home study

subevent.name: October income and expense summary and analysis
subevent.description: On the evening of the last day of October, after closing the clothing store, Lei Mingxuan stayed at the cash register inside the store, opened the income and expense spreadsheet on his laptop, and entered one by one all personal and store income/expense receipts for October (WeChat Pay bills, purchase invoices, sales receipts, etc.), then calculated the month's total income, total expenses, net profit, and personal consumption share. Afterwards, he adjusted the inventory data in the spreadsheet, generated a simple monthly cash flow trend chart, and thought about next month's purchasing budget and cost control points.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - Clothing Store

subevent.name: Conducted a summary and analysis of November income and expenses.
subevent.description: On the evening of the last day of November, Lei Mingxuan sat at the cash register of his clothing store, opened the income and expense spreadsheet on his laptop, and entered all November financial data (including personal daily expenses, store daily revenue, new inventory costs, automatically deducted property management fees, etc.), then compared it with October data to analyze changes in spending patterns and inventory turnover. He focused on checking the return on investment during the Double 11 promotion and recorded the cash flow situation as a reference for the year-end sprint in December.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - Clothing Store

subevent.name: Conduct a summary of fourth-quarter and annual income and expenses
subevent.description: Throughout December 31, Lei Mingxuan completed the summary in two phases: in the morning, at the computer in the clothing store, he entered December's income and expense data into a spreadsheet, merged it with October and November data, and calculated indicators such as Q4 total revenue, net profit, and personal spending ratio; in the afternoon, in his home study, he reviewed the financial situation for the whole year (2025), sorted out store operating profit and personal savings growth, evaluated the effectiveness of rational spending habits, and set preliminary financial goals for the next year. Finally, he archived and backed up the spreadsheet.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - clothing store and home

name: Weekend rollerblading along the riverside with skating partner Song Jia
description: On the evening of Sunday, September 28, Lei Mingxuan invited his roller-skating partner Song Jia for a skate along Pudong Riverside Avenue. They skated by the river for nearly two hours and caught up with each other. Song Jia shared the creative poster designs she had recently made, while Lei Mingxuan showed videos of the coffee experience area taken on his new phone. After skating, they had a simple meal at the night market, effortlessly keeping up their friendship from the skating circle.

subevent.name: Agreed on roller skating activity with Song Jia
subevent.description: On the afternoon of September 28, Lei Mingxuan contacted roller-skating partner Song Jia via WeChat, confirmed the time and meeting point for roller-skating together on Pudong Binjiang Avenue in the evening, and reminded Song Jia to bring her roller-skating gear. The two briefly caught up on recent news and agreed to meet at the Binjiang Avenue entrance at 5 p.m.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - home on Zhangyang Road / store on Century Avenue

subevent.name: Set off for the Pudong Riverside Avenue.
subevent.description: At 4:50 p.m., Lei Mingxuan changed into his roller skates and sports gear, rode a shared bike from home (Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area) to the roller skating area on Pudong Riverside Avenue, arrived at the meeting point in about 10 minutes, and met Song Jia on time.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Binjiang Avenue

subevent.name: Roller skating on Binjiang Avenue
subevent.description: From 5 p.m. to 7 p.m., Lei Mingxuan and Song Jia went inline skating together along the riverside promenade on Binjiang Avenue in Pudong. They skated for nearly two hours, catching up on each other's recent news as they went. Song Jia showed Lei Mingxuan the creative posters she had recently designed on her phone, while Lei Mingxuan showed her a short video he had shot with his new phone at a coffee experience area on West Nanjing Road, sharing his store-visit experience. As the sun set and the river breeze blew gently, the atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Binjiang Avenue

subevent.name: Simple meal at the night market after roller skating.
subevent.description: After roller skating, Lei Mingxuan and Song Jia walked to an open-air night market near Binjiang Avenue, picked a stall selling pan-fried buns and beef vermicelli soup, and chatted about their feelings after skating and their hobbies while eating. They also browsed stalls selling trendy toys and accessories at the night market, and finished their meal about half an hour later.
subevent.location: Night market on Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: After the event, everyone went home separately.
subevent.description: At around 7:40 p.m., Lei Mingxuan and Song Jia said goodbye at the entrance to the night market. Song Jia took the subway back to her home in Minhang District, while Lei Mingxuan rode a shared bike again back to his residence on Zhangyang Road in Pudong New Area. After arriving home, he sent Song Jia a message to let her know he was safe, and they agreed to go roller skating together next time.
subevent.location: Shanghai-Pudong New Area-Zhangyang Road home / Binjiang Avenue night market

name: Continuing to make the family diet healthier
description: Throughout July, his mother Wang Xiuying proactively developed a low-oil version of red-braised pork and replaced rich, dark-sauce dishes with steamed dishes. Father and son were not used to it at first, but Lei Mingxuan's weight stabilized at 80 kg by the end of July (without rebounding), which let the whole family see the results. The family diet quietly shifted, laying the foundation for long-term health management.

subevent.name: Initial adaptation and trial implementation
subevent.description: His mother, Wang Xiuying, proactively researched healthy recipes such as low-oil braised pork belly, steamed sea bass, and blanched vegetables, and began trying to replace the traditional rich, heavy-sauce cooking style. His father, Lei Jianguo, and Lei Mingxuan felt uncomfortable with the change in taste at first, but persisted under Wang Xiuying's encouragement. During this period, Lei Mingxuan recorded his weight daily and found that it stayed stable at around 80 kg without rebounding, gradually building confidence in healthy eating. During this stage, the family mainly ate at the home kitchen at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai. Apart from eating at home in the morning and evening, Lei Mingxuan still had lunch near the shop.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home

subevent.name: First time trying a healthy dinner
subevent.description: At dinner on July 5, 2025, his mother Wang Xiuying followed the recipe she had researched and made a low-oil version of braised pork, steamed sea bass, and blanched broccoli. His father Lei Jianguo picked up a piece of braised pork and after tasting it said bluntly, 'The taste is different, not as fragrant as before.' Lei Mingxuan also felt the flavor was a bit bland and found it somewhat hard to get used to. But with Wang Xiuying's encouragement, the two persisted and finished the whole meal. After dinner, Lei Mingxuan stood on the electronic scale to record his weight; it showed 80.2 kg, basically the same as his previous stable value. The whole family agreed to continue for another week and observe the results.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - home dining room

subevent.name: Gradually Adapting to Healthier Tastes
subevent.description: On July 7, 2025, mother Wang Xiuying made steamed mandarin fish, blanched prawns, and dressed cucumber salad. Father Lei Jianguo was gradually getting used to lighter flavors and praised the fish for being fresh and the shrimp for being sweet. Lei Mingxuan also felt that although it didn't have the rich, heavy sauce of Benbang cuisine, the natural flavor of the ingredients really stood out. At noon he had a simple salad at a fast-food restaurant near the store, consciously starting to reduce high-calorie intake. When he got home in the evening, he weighed 79.8 kg and was delighted to see his weight had dropped slightly. The whole family discussed the menu adjustment plan for a week later while eating.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - home dining room

subevent.name: Execute mid-term healthy eating plan
subevent.description: On July 8, 2025, his mother Wang Xiuying tried a new recipe: low-oil curried chicken breast with brown rice, and steamed baby cabbage with garlic and vermicelli. His father Lei Jianguo thought the curry tasted good, but asked for less chili next time. Lei Mingxuan offered to cook a stir-fried seasonal vegetable dish on the weekend to show off what he had learned about healthy cooking. That evening he weighed 79.7 kilograms, a slight decrease for the second consecutive day, which strengthened his confidence to keep going. After the meal, Lei Mingxuan shared a screenshot of his weight change in the family WeChat group, and his mother gave it a like.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - home dining room

subevent.name: Midterm Adjustment and Habit Formation
subevent.description: After the first week of adjustment, the father and son gradually got used to the new flavors with less oil and less salt. Mother Wang Xiuying further expanded the variety of healthy dishes, adding steamed vegetable salad, chicken breast dishes, and so on. Lei Mingxuan began to actively adjust his lunch choices, cutting back on fried takeout and instead bringing healthy homemade light meals or choosing light-meal shops. The family dinner menu was fixed as a low-fat combination of two vegetable dishes, one meat dish, and one soup. Lei Mingxuan weighed himself on the home scale every morning and evening and recorded the results, finding that his weight remained stable in the 79.5-80 kg range without any discomfort. The family atmosphere was positive, and his father Lei Jianguo also began to pay attention to his own blood pressure readings. At this stage, the family's dietary adjustments gradually became a habit, laying the foundation for long-term health management.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home

subevent.name: Mother's varied and healthy dishes
subevent.description: Mother Wang Xiuying, in the kitchen at home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, began trying to make healthy dishes with less oil and salt, such as steamed vegetable salad and chicken breast dishes, and brought them to the table. After tasting them together with Lei Mingxuan, father Lei Jianguo gradually accepted the new flavors, and the family's dietary adjustment officially kicked off.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home

subevent.name: Lei Mingxuan adjusts his lunch choice.
subevent.description: Starting that day, Lei Mingxuan gave up the habit of eating out at the mall and no longer chose fried foods. He prepared healthy light meals at home in advance (such as chicken breast salad and whole-wheat sandwiches) and brought them to the clothing store, or ordered meals from light-food shops via food delivery platforms, ensuring his lunch was low-fat and low-salt. This adjustment was carried out in tandem with the family dinner reform.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - home/clothing store

subevent.name: Family's standard dinner pairing
subevent.description: Following the previous day's attempt, mother Wang Xiuying decided to formally establish the family dinner as a low-fat pattern of two vegetarian dishes, one meat dish, and one soup. She worked with Lei Mingxuan and Lei Jianguo to agree on the menu and began shopping and cooking daily according to the new dishes. Lei Mingxuan and Lei Jianguo fully supported it, and the family's dietary structure settled into a steady routine.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home

subevent.name: Lei Mingxuan's daily weight log
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan insists on measuring his weight with an electronic scale at home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai every morning and evening, and records the data in his phone's memo app. After continuous measurement, he found his weight remained stable in the 79.5-80 kg range without any discomfort, which strengthened his confidence in continuing a healthy diet.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home

subevent.name: Lei Jianguo started paying attention to his blood pressure.
subevent.description: Influenced by the family's health-conscious atmosphere, his father, Lei Jianguo, found the idle electronic blood pressure monitor at home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, learned how to use it according to the manual, and began measuring his blood pressure every morning, recording the numbers in a notebook he carried with him. He gained an initial understanding of his blood pressure status and planned to monitor it regularly to support his health management.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home

subevent.name: Later-stage consolidation and emerging results
subevent.description: Mother Wang Xiuying's healthy recipe library expanded further, successfully developing low-fat braised pork, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, mushroom soup and other well-received dishes, and the whole family has fully adapted to the new flavors. Lei Mingxuan weighed in steadily at 80 kilograms at the end of July, with no rebound; this data showed the family the remarkable results of the dietary adjustment. Father Lei Jianguo proactively asked to increase vegetable intake, and the family's dietary structure completely shifted to a low-oil, low-salt, high-protein, high-fiber pattern. Lei Mingxuan began sharing healthy eating insights with friends and occasionally recommended simple recipes in the shop's WeChat group. During this phase, a positive feedback loop formed within the family, laying a solid foundation for long-term health management.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home

subevent.name: Develop a low-fat version of braised pork
subevent.description: Mother Wang Xiuying used an online recipe to improve the traditional red-braised pork in the kitchen, choosing lean pork belly and reducing the oil. She seasoned it with light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, ginger slices, and a little rock sugar, while Lei Mingxuan and Lei Jianguo helped taste and adjust the heat. At lunch, the whole family tasted the low-fat red-braised pork together and agreed it was no less delicious than the original. Wang Xiuying wrote down the recipe and added it to her healthy recipe collection.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home

subevent.name: Developed stir-fried seasonal vegetables and mushroom soup
subevent.description: His mother, Wang Xiuying, was in the kitchen making stir-fried seasonal vegetables (broccoli, carrots, wood ear mushrooms) and mushroom soup (enoki mushrooms, shiitake mushrooms, tofu). Lei Mingxuan helped wash the ingredients, while Lei Jianguo watched and suggested adding a small amount of goji berries for extra nutrition. During dinner, the whole family tasted the food and was very satisfied with the light, delicious flavor. Father Lei Jianguo took the initiative to say that he hoped every meal would include vegetables from now on, and his mother agreed to continue developing more low-salt, low-oil dishes.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home

subevent.name: Weighed in to confirm stable weight
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan weighed himself on the digital scale in the bedroom, which showed 80 kg, consistent with previous data and no rebound. At dinner, he announced the result to his parents. His father, Lei Jianguo, was pleased and again emphasized the importance of vegetables. His mother, Wang Xiuying, planned to continue developing new dishes next week. The whole family was confident in the effectiveness of the dietary changes.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home

subevent.name: Share healthy diet insights
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan wrote a message in the clothing store’s WeChat customer group, sharing how his family had successfully controlled their weight by improving recipes. He especially recommended simple methods for low-fat braised pork and mushroom soup, and included his mother’s saying: “Less oil, less salt, more vegetables.” Several customers in the group responded and discussed, so Lei Mingxuan added tips on stir-frying seasonal vegetables, fostering a positive atmosphere for healthy eating exchanges.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home

name: June: continued pour-over coffee exploration and expansion of socializing and skills
description: In June 2025, Lei Mingxuan continued exploring pour-over coffee and recorded the flavors of different bean varieties. On June 7, he officially began his weekend pour-over ritual for the first time; after brewing pour-over early in the morning on June 13, Han Dong teased him that evening in the billiards group for being 'brainwashed by coffee', and he internally confirmed that his interest had shifted toward coffee culture. After the second writing class on June 17, he went to a specialty coffee shop and talked with barista Zhou Yang, improved his pouring technique, and his pour-over stability clearly improved. On June 28, at the conclusion of the writing class, he had another in-depth discussion with Zhou Yang, and his pour-over skills made a qualitative leap. On June 29, he organized and completed the 'June Coffee Log', summarizing his learning journey, and planned to continue refining his skills.

subevent.name: First weekend pour-over coffee ritual
subevent.description: On the morning of June 7, 2025, Lei Mingxuan officially held his first weekend pour-over coffee ceremony in the kitchen of his home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai. He used the newly purchased V60 dripper and gooseneck kettle, weighed out 15 grams of Colombian Huila specialty coffee beans, ground them to a medium-fine grind, and did the bloom and pour with 90°C water at a 1:16 coffee-to-water ratio. After brewing, he wrote down tasting notes (citrus, caramel, bright acidity) and tasted the coffee. This was the beginning of his exploration of different bean varieties and pour-over techniques.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home kitchen.

subevent.name: Banter in the billiards group and confirming the shift in personal interest
subevent.description: In the early morning, Lei Mingxuan performed a pour-over coffee ritual at home (Ethiopian Yirgacheffe beans), carefully tasting and recording the aromas of jasmine and lemon. At 8 p.m., he chatted with billiards friends in the WeChat group "Pudong Billiards Exchange Group". Han Dong half-jokingly said, "You've been brainwashed by coffee." Lei Mingxuan avoided the topic with stickers and jokes, but he clearly felt inside that his interest had shifted from billiards to coffee culture. He then wrote down his reflections in his diary and decided to devote himself more to learning about coffee.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - home study

subevent.name: Further discussion at the café after the writing class; pour-over skills improved
subevent.description: In the early morning, Lei Mingxuan brewed Costa Rican honey-processed coffee beans at home and noted flavors of honey and nuts. In the morning, he continued to attend the second writing class. After class, he went again to the “Chuncui” specialty coffee shop, where barista Xiao Zhou had prepared lightly roasted Kenyan coffee beans for him. Xiao Zhou guided Lei Mingxuan to adjust the angle and flow rate of the pouring kettle, addressing the unstable water flow he had during the bloom last time, and they brewed together twice. Lei Mingxuan felt that his pour-over consistency had improved significantly, and the coffee had more sweetness. He thanked Xiao Zhou and made an appointment to try new beans together after the next class.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home, writing training center, specialty coffee shop

subevent.name: Writing course wrap-up and in-depth cafe discussion, with a qualitative leap in pour-over stability.
subevent.description: In the early morning, Lei Mingxuan tried brewing Yunnan Pu'er coffee beans and noted flavors of herbal tea and a slight smoky note. In the morning, he attended his last writing class and completed his graduation essay during the class. After class, he hurried to the 'Chuncui' Café and had a nearly two-hour in-depth conversation with Xiao Zhou. Xiao Zhou shared his insights on 'three-stage' pouring and suggested Lei Mingxuan adjust the grind size half a notch finer. After practicing, the coffee he brewed showed significantly improved sweetness and body, and he felt his pour-over technique had made a qualitative leap. They added each other's personal WeChat and agreed to stay in touch.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home, writing training center, specialty coffee shop

subevent.name: Month-end weekend pour-over coffee ritual and review.
subevent.description: On the last Sunday morning of June, Lei Mingxuan performed an extra pour-over ritual at home, using the Costa Rican black honey beans recommended by Xiao Zhou and strictly following the adjusted “three-stage” pouring technique. The resulting coffee had rich layers and a long dark chocolate finish. After tasting it, he organized all of June’s flavor notes into a complete “June Coffee Log,” recording his journey from a pour-over novice to improved stability, and planned to continue exploring beans from more origins and roast levels in the coming month.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - home study

name: Stray cat Afu's adjustment to the family and emotional bonding
description: From early to mid-July, the adopted stray cat A Fu adapted well to the home. His mother, Wang Xiuying, was initially against it, but was soon softened by A Fu's clingy nature and took the initiative to buy a cat bed and toys. After the father-son argument over the shop upgrade in mid-July, Lei Mingxuan returned to his room to pet the cat and ease his mood. A Fu's purring became a pressure release valve during tense family moments, and the cat gradually became an emotional bond for the family.

subevent.name: Daily interactions and deepening feelings
subevent.description: A Fu has completely adapted to family life and moves freely around the house every day: basking in the sun on the windowsill during the day, and jumping onto Lei Mingxuan's bed to sleep at night. The first thing Lei Mingxuan does when he gets home from work every day is pet the cat. A Fu's purring melts away the fatigue of the day. Lei Jianguo initially kept his distance, but gradually he would casually give A Fu a piece of fish during dinner. The whole family has grown used to A Fu's presence, and laughter from playing with the cat often comes from the living room. Daily chats between Lei Mingxuan, Wang Xiuying, and Lei Jianguo now have one more topic, and the family atmosphere is more relaxed and warmer than before A Fu arrived.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

subevent.name: Lei Jianguo's first attempt at feeding fish and interacting
subevent.description: During the day, Afu was still active, chasing light and shadows in the living room and occasionally jumping onto the windowsill to look outside. Lei Mingxuan went to the store as usual for work, and at noon he saw Afu dozing on the sofa through the phone monitor. In the evening, while Lei Jianguo was watching TV, Afu suddenly jumped onto his knee and lay down. Lei Jianguo's body stiffened, but he didn't shoo him away. At dinner, Wang Xiuying made a steamed sea bass. Lei Jianguo hesitated briefly, then picked up a small piece of fish with his chopsticks and put it into Afu's food bowl. Afu immediately ran over and ate it. Lei Mingxuan saw this and jokingly teased his father. Lei Jianguo said, 'I was afraid it was hungry,' but the corners of his mouth showed a smile. In the evening, Lei Mingxuan played with Afu using a cat teaser wand, and Afu pounced around excitedly, filling the whole family with laughter.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

subevent.name: Afu becomes the center of family life and habit formation
subevent.description: That day Lei Mingxuan was off work. In the morning, he took A Fu to the balcony to bask in the sun and took a few photos of A Fu with his phone to post on WeChat Moments. While Wang Xiuying was cooking in the kitchen, A Fu squatted at the kitchen door watching, so Wang Xiuying cut him a small piece of chicken breast. At noon, Lei Mingxuan sat on the sofa reading, with A Fu curled up beside him snoring; Lei Mingxuan occasionally stroked its head. In the afternoon, when Lei Jianguo returned from outside, A Fu took the initiative to rub against his pant leg, and Lei Jianguo bent down to pat A Fu's back. That was the first time Lei Jianguo had voluntarily petted A Fu. At dinner, A Fu had gotten used to waiting on his own mat by the dining table, and Lei Jianguo would occasionally pick out food for him. The whole family now regards A Fu as a full member of the family, and A Fu's toys and food bowl are all kept in their proper places in the living room.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

subevent.name: Strengthened family interaction and emotional connection
subevent.description: When Lei Mingxuan came home from work, he found Lei Jianguo playing with A-Fu in the living room with a string. A-Fu was leaping up and down, while Wang Xiuying laughed and took photos from the side. Lei Mingxuan was pleasantly surprised by his father’s change and joined in. In the evening, he petted the cat and talked with his parents about his childhood memories of keeping pets. Lei Jianguo also recalled his younger days taking care of a guard dog at the factory. A-Fu lay on the coffee table among the three, occasionally letting out a meow as if taking part in the conversation. The family atmosphere was warmer than before A-Fu came, and the three shared many more topics and laughs. Before going to sleep, A-Fu, as usual, jumped onto Lei Mingxuan’s bed, but Wang Xiuying intentionally placed a small blanket beside it, saying it would make A-Fu sleep more comfortably.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

subevent.name: Stable warm family atmosphere and new daily routine
subevent.description: This was a milestone day for A Fu fully integrating into the family. In the morning, A Fu pried open Lei Mingxuan's door with his paws, jumped onto the bed, and rubbed his head against Lei Mingxuan's face. Lei Mingxuan got up with a smile. During the day, A Fu habitually rotated positions among the windowsill, sofa, and bed. Wang Xiuying had become accustomed to preparing fresh water and snacks for A Fu. In the afternoon, Lei Jianguo took A Fu for a walk around the residential compound (A Fu was on a cat leash), attracting the neighbors' attention and praise. Lei Jianguo looked proud. In the evening, after the family had dinner, A Fu lay on Lei Jianguo's lap and watched TV with him, while Lei Mingxuan and Wang Xiuying chatted at the dining table, occasionally bringing up A Fu's funny stories. The whole family had formed a new daily routine: with A Fu's company, everyone's expressions were softer, there was more laughter, and the family bond was clearly warming.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

subevent.name: Afu has become the emotional bond of the family.
subevent.description: After the quarrel the day before, at breakfast on July 15, Wang Xiuying took the initiative to mention Afu’s merits, saying that it had brought liveliness and warmth to the family, and urged Lei Jianguo to accept Lei Mingxuan’s shop upgrade plan, believing that it was a good thing for young people to be enterprising. Lei Jianguo was silent for a moment, then looked at Afu eating cat food at his feet and said in a softer tone that they could discuss it again. Lei Mingxuan felt that the family had become more tolerant because of Afu. That afternoon, Lei Mingxuan bought a new cat tree online, and Wang Xiuying sewed a small cushion for Afu out of an old sweater. Afu became a shared focus of the whole family and truly became an emotional bond connecting family members.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

name: Father and son discussed the store upgrade and worked together to organize the warehouse
description: On September 19, Lei Mingxuan personally bought ingredients and cooked dishes his father loved, such as Shanghainese braised pork belly and pan-fried buns. The father and son had a few drinks at home. Lei Mingxuan reported in detail on the trial operation of the coffee experience area and the back-to-school promotion results, and also revealed his plan for an online branch. His father approved of his pragmatic approach, reminded him to watch costs, and volunteered to help at the store on the weekend. The next day (September 20), his father, Lei Jianguo, came to the clothing store warehouse as promised, carefully counted and organized the inventory. As they worked, the father and son exchanged business details and became more in tune with each other because of their shared business goal.

subevent.name: Buy dinner ingredients.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of September 19, Lei Mingxuan went to the food market near Zhangyang Road in Pudong New Area and carefully selected ingredients for cooking himself in the evening: pork belly for the Shanghai-style braised pork his father Lei Jianguo loved, flour and meat filling for pan-fried buns, and fresh vegetables.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - vegetable market

subevent.name: Cook dinner
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan returned to his home kitchen in the evening, tied on an apron, and started cooking. He skillfully made his father's favorite Shanghai-style braised pork, pan-fried buns, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and a tomato and egg soup, then brought the dishes to the table, setting out two pairs of chopsticks and a bottle of yellow rice wine.
subevent.location: Home kitchen, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Father-son deep conversation over dinner
subevent.description: At around 7 p.m., Lei Mingxuan and his father Lei Jianguo chatted over dinner at the dining table at home. Lei Mingxuan gave a detailed report on the trial operation feedback for the coffee experience area (foot traffic, customer reviews) and the sales data for the back-to-school promotional campaign, and also revealed his preliminary idea of opening an online branch in the future. After listening carefully, his father Lei Jianguo recognized his son's pragmatic progress, reminded him to pay attention to cost control, and proactively offered to go to the store on the weekend to help organize the warehouse. The father and son reached a better understanding on the store upgrade plan.
subevent.location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai - Home Chinese Restaurant

subevent.name: My father came to the store on the weekend to help organize the warehouse.
subevent.description: On the morning of Saturday, September 20, Lei Jianguo came to Lei Mingxuan's clothing store on the 2nd floor of a mall on Century Avenue in Pudong New Area as agreed, to help his son organize the warehouse. He carefully counted the inventory, sorted and categorized the old overstocked styles, and helped clean the warehouse. The father and son worked while continuing to discuss store management details, strengthening their bond.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai - clothing store warehouse

name: Mid-Autumn Family Reunion
description: On October 6, Mid-Autumn Festival, Lei Mingxuan closed the shop early and had a reunion dinner with his parents at home. His mother, Wang Xiuying, made her signature Shanghainese braised pork and mooncakes, while his father, Lei Jianguo, talked about the latest developments in the mall's property management. The family enjoyed the moon and water caltrops together in a warm atmosphere. Lei Mingxuan also video-called his younger cousin Yang Fan, who was away from home, and they exchanged festive greetings.

subevent.name: Closed the store early
subevent.description: To ensure family reunion for the Mid-Autumn Festival, Lei Mingxuan closed his clothing store early in the afternoon of October 6, 2025. The store is located on the second floor of a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai. After organizing the day's accounts, confirming the store was safe, and locking the door, he left about two hours earlier than the usual closing time.
subevent.location: Clothing store at Century Link Mall, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Go home to prepare the reunion dinner
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan returned from the shop to his home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai. After arriving home, he changed into loungewear, greeted his mother Wang Xiuying, who was busy in the kitchen, and helped set the table, arranging bowls, chopsticks, and drinks. His father Lei Jianguo watched the news in the living room, waiting for dinner.
subevent.location: Home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Mid-Autumn Festival family reunion dinner
subevent.description: In the evening, the family of three sat around the dining table for the Mid-Autumn reunion dinner. His mother Wang Xiuying specially cooked her signature Shanghai-style braised pork belly and brought out homemade mooncakes, water caltrops, and other seasonal foods. As they ate, they chatted: his father Lei Jianguo talked about the recent property management changes at the mall, and Lei Mingxuan shared the latest in his shop's operations. The atmosphere was warm and pleasant.
subevent.location: Home dining room, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Had a video call with my younger male cousin, exchanging greetings
subevent.description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan had a video call with his younger male cousin Yang Fan, who was far away in Hangzhou. The two wished each other a Happy Mid-Autumn Festival and talked about what was going on in their lives. Yang Fan showed the moonlight in Hangzhou, and Lei Mingxuan turned the camera toward the full moon outside the window and his parents behind him. The call lasted about ten-plus minutes, with a warm and friendly atmosphere.
subevent.location: Living room at home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: On the balcony, enjoying the moon and eating mooncakes
subevent.description: After the video call, Lei Mingxuan and his parents went to the balcony at home, set out mooncakes, water caltrops, and tea snacks, and chatted while admiring the moon. The night was clear, with a bright moon hanging high. His mother, Wang Xiuying, gave her son a mooncake with salted egg yolk and lotus seed paste; his father, Lei Jianguo, told stories of celebrating the Mid-Autumn Festival in his youth. The family was full of joy.
subevent.location: Home balcony, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Starting the morning running habit
description: After his follow-up physical exam on August 26, Lei Mingxuan resolved to exercise systematically. The next morning at 6:30, he put on running shoes for the first time and set off from the Zhangyang Road residential area, jogging for 20 minutes along the Century Park running track, about 3 km in total. He then persisted daily and checked in on a mobile fitness app, planning to gradually increase distance and frequency, with a goal of at least four times a week.

subevent.name: Follow-up physical exam and a decision to start morning jogs.
subevent.description: On August 26, 2025, Lei Mingxuan went to a physical examination center in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, for a routine checkup follow-up. After receiving the report, he found he was overweight (BMI 27.04), and the doctor advised him to increase systematic exercise. Deeply moved, Lei Mingxuan made up his mind right there at the center to start systematic morning running from the next morning, aiming for at least four times a week and gradually increasing distance.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - a health checkup center

subevent.name: First morning run (3 km)
subevent.description: At 6:30 a.m. on August 27, 2025, Lei Mingxuan put on his running shoes, set out from the community at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, jogged to the track at Century Park, jogged along the park's outer loop for about 20 minutes, and covered about 3 kilometers in total. After his first run, he used a mobile sports app to record and check in, felt good, and strengthened his determination to persist.
subevent.location: Century Park running track, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Morning run: day 2 of sticking with it
subevent.description: At 6:30 a.m. on August 28, 2025, Lei Mingxuan continued his daily morning run, starting from home and jogging along the same route to Century Park for 20 minutes, about 3 kilometers, maintaining the same intensity as the previous day. After the run, he checked in on the mobile fitness app and reviewed the previous day's running data.
subevent.location: Century Park running track, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Morning run, third consecutive day.
subevent.description: At 6:30 a.m. on August 29, 2025, Lei Mingxuan got up on time for his third morning run. He jogged along the Century Park track for 20 minutes, covering about 3 kilometers. Today he felt his stamina had improved. After checking in on the app, he planned to try increasing the distance to 4 kilometers next week.
subevent.location: Century Park running track, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Sticking with morning jogging for the 4th day.
subevent.description: At 6:30 on the morning of August 30, 2025, Lei Mingxuan went for his fourth morning run, maintaining a 3-kilometer jog for 20 minutes. The temperature was pleasant today and the run felt good. He checked in on the app for four consecutive days, which increased his sense of accomplishment.
subevent.location: Century Park running track, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Morning run streak day 5 (extra distance on weekend)
subevent.description: At 6:30 a.m. on August 31, 2025, Lei Mingxuan went for his fifth morning run. Since it was the weekend and his body had adapted, he tried increasing the distance to 4 kilometers, taking about 25 minutes. After finishing, he checked in on the app and summarized this week's running; he had completed 5 morning runs in total, exceeding the goal of at least 4 times per week.
subevent.location: Century Park running track, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: The trial operation of the coffee experience area received praise from regular customers and collector friends, along with a suggestion to hold a gathering.
description: On September 16, the coffee experience area officially entered trial operation. When regular customer Qian Duoduo came to the store, she discovered it with surprise and took photos to post on her WeChat Moments, voluntarily promoting it. On the same day, another regular customer, Feng Xiaoyu, who was on a business trip to Shanghai, was also very interested in the coffee corner and suggested launching a buy clothes and get a coffee tasting campaign. On September 20, a collector friend met at a lecture came to the store to exchange blind boxes and was attracted by the coffee corner, proposing that offline collector meetups could be held there. The store's social potential was beginning to show.

subevent.name: Coffee Experience Area trial operation launched.
subevent.description: At his clothing store on the 2nd floor of a mall on Century Avenue in Pudong New Area, Lei Mingxuan officially launched the newly created coffee experience area, tuned the coffee machine, stocked all the ingredients, and began receiving customers, creating a more comfortable shopping atmosphere.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Regular customer Qian Duoduo experienced it and promoted it.
subevent.description: A regular customer, Qian Duoduo, came to the store to shop. She was pleasantly surprised to find the newly set-up coffee experience area and took the initiative to take photos and post them in Moments to promote it voluntarily, increasing the store's online exposure. Lei Mingxuan expressed his gratitude on the spot.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Feng Xiaoyu suggested a joint activity.
subevent.description: Feng Xiaoyu, a regular customer who was in Shanghai on a business trip, visited the store and showed great interest in the coffee corner. While talking with Lei Mingxuan, she suggested launching a 'buy clothing, get coffee tasting' promotion to boost sales and improve the customer experience. Lei Mingxuan listened carefully and said he would consider it.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Lei Mingxuan evaluates the cross-promotion suggestion
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan carefully considered the 'buy clothing, get coffee tasting' promotion proposed by Feng Xiaoyu while in the store, evaluating the cost, operational difficulty, and potential impact on foot traffic. He initially decided to try it out and planned to refine the rules later.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: A collector friend came to the store to exchange blind boxes and suggested a gathering.
subevent.description: Lu Yao, a collector friend he had met at an earlier lecture (a female pop culture toy enthusiast), came to Lei Mingxuan's shop, and the two exchanged Pop Mart blind box designs. Lu Yao found the newly set-up coffee corner comfortable and suggested holding a small offline collector gathering in the shop. Lei Mingxuan welcomed the idea, and they agreed to discuss details later.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Community Basketball Friendly Match to Rediscover Pure Fun
description: On the morning of September 21, 2025, Lei Mingxuan took part in a 3-on-3 basketball friendly match at the community basketball court. The game had no official scoring; he focused on enjoying running, passing, and shooting, and experienced the pure joy of basketball for the first time in a long while. After the game, he agreed with his neighbors to organize such a relaxed, fun get-together once a month, then walked home, showered, and changed clothes.

subevent.name: Participate in a 3-on-3 basketball friendly match
subevent.description: After the warm-up, Lei Mingxuan and five neighbors freely formed teams and started a three-on-three basketball game. There was no official scoring; everyone chatted while playing, and the atmosphere was relaxed. Lei Mingxuan stopped worrying about his declining stamina or rusty dribbling skills and focused on enjoying the running, passing, and shooting, experiencing the pure joy of basketball for the first time in a long while. The game lasted about an hour and a half, played in several periods with water breaks in between.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Community Basketball Court

subevent.name: Post-race arrangement and return trip.
subevent.description: After the game ended, everyone rested and chatted by the court. Lei Mingxuan and several neighbors agreed to organize this kind of relaxed, fun gathering once a month, with no pressure to win or lose—purely for joy. Then he packed up his things, said goodbye to his neighbors, and walked home. Once home, he showered, changed his exercise clothes, and put his sneakers out to dry.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Community basketball court / home

name: Rent from the family's rental property arrived.
description: On October 26, Lei Mingxuan received this month's rental income share of 11,000 yuan from his parents for two rental properties (after deducting the maintenance fund). This extra income was deposited into his personal demand deposit account and planned as a special reserve for a self-driving trip to western Sichuan.

subevent.name: Received a transfer notification from parents.
subevent.description: At his home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Lei Mingxuan received this month's rent share of 11,000 yuan from his parents Lei Jianguo and Wang Xiuying for two rental properties via mobile banking, and confirmed that the transfer was successful.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Deposit into personal current account
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan used mobile banking to transfer the 11,000 yuan rent share he received into his personal demand deposit account, completing the fund pooling.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Planning the travel fund for a self-driving trip in western Sichuan
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan recorded the 11,000 yuan rental income in his phone's memo or wealth management app, marked it as the dedicated reserve fund for the self-driving trip to western Sichuan, and updated his travel budget plan.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

name: A Fu becomes the store mascot and patrols the store.
description: During the National Day tasting event in October, Lei Mingxuan brought his pet A Fu to the store for the first time. A Fu unexpectedly became popular with customers and became the focus of photos in the trendy toy area. That evening, Lei Mingxuan shared photos on social media and called A Fu the little mascot of Xiafei Ji. On October 5, Lei Mingxuan brought A Fu to the store again for inspection, reinforcing its mascot image, and some customers came specially to interact with it.

subevent.name: Preparing to take Afu to the shop
subevent.description: On the morning of the National Day tasting event on October 3, 2025, Lei Mingxuan put a leash and a decorative bow tie on his pet A Fu at home, prepared the pet carrier and snacks for A Fu, and planned to bring A Fu to the clothing store at Century Link Mall in Pudong New Area to participate as the store's little mascot.
subevent.location: Home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Take Ah Fu to the store and settle him in
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan drove or took a taxi to arrive at the clothing store, Shop A-208, Level 2, Century Link Mall, in the morning with A-fu. He placed A-fu on a pet mat near the designer toy area in the store, prepared water and toys, and made sure A-fu adapted to the store environment.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Century Link Mall, 2nd Floor, Shop A-208.

subevent.name: Afu was popular with customers at the store and had photos taken.
subevent.description: During the National Day tasting event, A Fu was lively and affectionate, drawing many customers to stop and watch. Especially in the trendy toy area, customers took photos of A Fu with their phones and interacted with him. A Fu became the center of attention, increasing customer dwell time and providing material for social media exposure. Lei Mingxuan stayed nearby, looking after A Fu and guiding interactions.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Century Link Mall, 2nd Floor, Shop A-208.

subevent.name: Shared Afu's photos on social media and made him the mascot.
subevent.description: After returning home that night, Lei Mingxuan selected photos of A Fu taken by customers and on-site photos of the store, wrote the caption, and posted them on his WeChat Moments and the store's official social media accounts (such as Xiaohongshu and Douyin), calling A Fu the little mascot of [Xiafei Collection]. The post received many likes and comments, adding online buzz to the store.
subevent.location: Home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Afu made another round of the store and reinforced the mascot image.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 5, 2025, Lei Mingxuan took A Fu to the store again for an 'inspection.' A Fu wandered around the store and interacted with regular customers, while customers continued to take photos and share them, further cementing A Fu's image as the mascot of [Xiafei Collection]. Some customers came specifically to see A Fu.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Century Link Mall, 2nd Floor, Shop A-208.

name: Joined an alternate-history fiction interest group.
description: On October 7, at the tasting event, Lei Mingxuan used the group QR code sent by Qian Duoduo to apply to join the historical alternate-history novel fan group. He sent an introductory message, was approved by the administrator, and officially became a group member.

subevent.name: Request to join the historical alternate-history fiction group
subevent.description: At the tasting event, Lei Mingxuan scanned the group QR code sent by Qian Duoduo to apply to join the Alternate History Novel Enthusiasts Group, and sent a self-introduction. After the group administrator approved, Lei Mingxuan officially became a group member and began browsing the group announcement and recent discussion topics.
subevent.location: A cultural salon in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Formal cooperation with Lao Zhou to introduce niche Southeast Asian brands for trial sales.
description: On October 8, Lei Mingxuan and Lao Zhou formally established a partnership, with Lao Zhou supplying a batch of small-batch trial items from niche Southeast Asian designer brands for the store. Drawing on the experience of introducing external brands last time, Lei Mingxuan specifically strengthened the arrival inspection process to ensure quality and design matched the store's positioning, accumulating experience for the subsequent upgrade to a multi-brand store.

subevent.name: Confirm cooperation details with Lao Zhou and sign the agreement
subevent.description: On the morning of October 8, Lei Mingxuan made final confirmation over the phone with Lao Zhou (Zhou Zhiqiang) at his clothing store regarding the cooperation details for introducing niche Southeast Asian brands on a trial sales basis. The two parties reached agreement on supply prices, trial sales period, return and exchange terms, and signed a formal cooperation agreement via electronic contract.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Receive the trial sales products sent by Lao Zhou.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 8, Lao Zhou delivered a batch of trial-sale clothing from niche Southeast Asian designer brands to the shop by express delivery. Lei Mingxuan signed for the packages at the shop entrance — a total of 3 boxes with about 50 items, including clothing and accessories.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Carry out arrival acceptance according to the enhanced procedure.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 8, Lei Mingxuan, in the store's back warehouse, followed the pre-set enhanced inspection procedure and checked each trial-sale item one by one for fabric quality, workmanship details, and whether the design style matched the store's positioning, and took photos as records. For a defective item with loose threads, he immediately contacted Lao Zhou to discuss an exchange.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Displayed trial-sale items on shelves and tagged them
subevent.description: On the evening of October 8, Lei Mingxuan arranged the trial-sale items that had passed inspection by style on a standalone display rack at the store entrance and put up a label reading "Southeast Asian niche designer brands · trial sale." He also updated the store's inventory management system to record the SKUs and quantities of the trial-sale items.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Received a wedding invitation from college classmate Wang Lei and prepared a gift
description: On September 28, Lei Mingxuan received an electronic wedding invitation at home from his college classmate Wang Lei. The wedding was set for October 19 in Hangzhou, and he immediately replied with congratulations in the WeChat group. On October 5, he discussed gifts with his cousin Shen Jie over WeChat. Shen Jie suggested giving a Pop Mart wedding series blind box, and Lei Mingxuan took her advice. On October 15, he selected a limited-edition Pop Mart wedding series blind box at his own clothing store, handwrote a blessing card, wrapped the gift, and prepared to attend the wedding.

subevent.name: Received wedding invitation and replied
subevent.description: At home, Lei Mingxuan received an electronic wedding invitation from his college classmate Wang Lei via WeChat, and learned that the wedding was set for October 19 in Hangzhou. He promptly replied with congratulations in the class WeChat group, confirmed he would attend the wedding, and briefly interacted with the other classmates in the group.
subevent.location: Home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Discuss gift plans with my cousin
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan used WeChat to talk with his younger female cousin Shen Jie, a fashion buyer, about what gift to pick for Wang Lei's wedding. Shen Jie suggested giving designer toy blind boxes, because Wang Lei also likes collecting, and recommended the Pop Mart wedding series. Lei Mingxuan took the suggestion and decided to prepare a limited-edition blind box set using resources from his own clothing store.
subevent.location: Home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Prepare a wedding gift and wrap it
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan selected a limited-edition Pop Mart wedding series blind box from the inventory in his clothing store and confirmed the packaging was intact. Then he handwrote a blessing card to express congratulations to Wang Lei on his marriage. Finally, he put the blind box and the card into a gift bag, completing the gift preparation, ready to give it at the wedding.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner celebrating Mother's Teacher's Day
description: Ahead of Teacher's Day 2025, Lei Mingxuan made careful preparations: On September 8, he went to the mall and selected and purchased a high-end cashmere shawl for his mother, Wang Xiuying; on September 9, he ordered flowers symbolizing gratitude and reserved a private room at a refined local Shanghai cuisine restaurant. On September 10, Teacher's Day itself, he closed the store early, went home to pick up the gifts, picked up his father Lei Jianguo and his mother, and headed to the restaurant together. During the meal, Lei Mingxuan presented the flowers and shawl, expressing gratitude for his mother's hard work. His mother was moved to tears, and his father also rarely praised him for being thoughtful. The family enjoyed a warm and happy time together. After dinner, they drove home, bringing the perfect day to a close.

subevent.name: Pick out and buy the shawl his mother had her heart set on.
subevent.description: Based on the preference his mother Wang Xiuying had previously mentioned offhandedly, Lei Mingxuan went to a mall near Century Avenue in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, carefully selected at a brand counter, and bought a high-end cashmere shawl suitable for his mother's age and style, as a Teacher's Day gift.
subevent.location: A shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Order flowers for Teachers' Day
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan ordered a bouquet of flowers containing carnations, lilies, and other flowers symbolizing gratitude and blessings through an online flower shop platform, and scheduled delivery to his home on the morning of September 10, preparing it as a Teachers' Day surprise for his mother.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Reserve a dinner table at a Shanghainese restaurant
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan called ahead to a highly rated, refined Shanghai-style restaurant in Pudong New Area, booked a private room for that evening, and told the restaurant that it was to celebrate his mother's Teacher's Day. He asked the restaurant to set up a festive atmosphere and reserved signature dishes.
subevent.location: Shanghai, Pudong New Area - local Shanghai cuisine restaurant

subevent.name: Closed the store early and went home to pick up his parents
subevent.description: On the afternoon of September 10, 2025, Teachers' Day, Lei Mingxuan closed his clothing store one hour earlier than usual, left the mall, and returned to his home on Zhangyang Road in Pudong New Area. He picked up the pre-prepared flowers and shawl, and set out with his father Lei Jianguo and mother Wang Xiuying for the reserved restaurant.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Teachers' Day family dinner
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan and his parents had dinner in a private room at an exquisite local Shanghainese restaurant in Pudong New Area. During the meal, Lei Mingxuan gave his mother Wang Xiuying the prepared flowers and the long-admired cashmere shawl, expressing gratitude for her years of hard work and dedication in raising him. His mother was moved to tears, and his father Lei Jianguo also rarely praised Lei Mingxuan for being thoughtful. The family ate and chatted, with a warm and harmonious atmosphere.
subevent.location: A local Shanghainese restaurant in Pudong New District, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Returned home after the gathering
subevent.description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan drove his parents back to the Zhangyang Road home in Pudong New Area. On the way, the three continued chatting about family matters, and his mother Wang Xiuying was still basking in the joy of receiving the gift. Back home, Lei Mingxuan put the flowers his mother had received into a vase, and the family happily concluded Teachers' Day.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wedding photo sharing and emotional ripples
description: On October 20, Lei Mingxuan shared a few photos from the wedding on Moments with a blessing caption, attracting likes from many friends. Zhao Min replied in the comments, 'I'll come by your shop for some free coffee another day.' He noted the agreement with Zhao Min. At the same time, the lively atmosphere at the wedding made him briefly reflect on where his own love life stood, but thinking about the store upgrade and the western Sichuan plan, he felt that for now he should focus on his career.

subevent.name: Post wedding photos on Moments
subevent.description: That morning, Lei Mingxuan, at his home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, used his phone to select and edit several wedding photos, added a message blessing the newlyweds, and published it to his WeChat Moments.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Interacted with Zhao Min and noted the invitation.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan saw his college classmate Zhao Min comment on his Moments: 'I'll come by your store for coffee another day.' He immediately replied to welcome her and made a mental note of the appointment, planning to treat Zhao Min to coffee and catch up next time she came to the store.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - store or home

subevent.name: Briefly reflected on personal relationships and career plans
subevent.description: While alone at night, the lively atmosphere of the wedding made Lei Mingxuan briefly think about his romantic feelings, but he soon remembered that his clothing store upgrade and the western Sichuan self-driving trip plan were not yet completed, so he decided to focus on his career for now and put aside relationship matters.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - Bedroom at home

name: The novel serialization is steady; advancing the illustration collaboration and considering a co-branded partnership.
description: On October 15, after the serialized novel was updated, the click data grew steadily. During an online discussion, partner Gao Yuan suggested adding illustrations to enhance the work's appeal. On October 18, during a break in the retreat at Mogan Mountain, Lei Mingxuan connected online with the illustrator introduced by Liu Yang and began trial sketching. On October 20, the first draft of the illustration was completed, which happened to be his birthday. The style fit the novel's alleyway theme extremely well. Lei Mingxuan regarded it as a special gift to himself and began to think about the possibility of co-branded products between the novel's characters and the store in the future.

subevent.name: Checked the novel's data and discussed illustration suggestions with Gao Yuan.
subevent.description: At his home study in Shanghai, Lei Mingxuan checked the click data for his serialized novel via the mobile backend and confirmed it was growing steadily. He then chatted online with his partner Gao Yuan (a fellow anime fan). Gao Yuan suggested adding illustrations to the novel to enhance its appeal, and Lei Mingxuan agreed and decided to move forward.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Contact Liu Yang to ask about illustrator resources.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan contacted his high school classmate Liu Yang (a game development engineer currently living in Shenzhen) via WeChat to ask if he knew any suitable illustrator resources. Liu Yang said he knew a freelance illustrator named Chen Yu whose style matched, was willing to introduce them, and sent Chen Yu's WeChat contact to Lei Mingxuan. The two agreed to follow up later.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: During a break in the Mogan Mountain retreat, he got in touch with the illustrator and began a trial drawing.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan is on a short retreat in Moganshan, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province. During a break, he had his first online video meeting with illustrator Chen Yu, who was introduced by Liu Yang. The two discussed the novel's alleyway theme style and specific requirements. Chen Yu said she understood and began sketching a concept piece, and Lei Mingxuan approved the initial direction.
subevent.location: Moganshan Retreat Residence, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province

subevent.name: Received the illustration draft and thought about the possibility of a co-branded collaboration.
subevent.description: That day was Lei Mingxuan's 31st birthday. Illustrator Chen Yu sent a trial illustration draft via WeChat. After looking at it at his home in Shanghai, Lei Mingxuan found that the style matched the novel's alleyway theme perfectly and was pleasantly surprised, treating it as a special birthday gift. He then began to think about whether the novel's characters could be developed into co-branded products with his own clothing store, and sketched out an initial concept in his mind.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

name: Attending an immersive theater exhibition.
description: On the evening of October 13, Lei Mingxuan and his cousin Shen Jie went to an immersive theater space near Century Avenue in Pudong New Area to experience an interactive performance set in Republican-era Shanghai. The two prepared in advance at home and changed into retro Republican-era outfits, then left from their respective homes and met at the theater. During the performance, Lei Mingxuan used his humor to improvise with the actors, while Shen Jie focused on observing the scenes. After it ended, Lei Mingxuan exchanged impressions with the director and received a signed poster. After the event, the two each went home, and Lei Mingxuan recorded his inspiration for use in his historical novel.

subevent.name: Pre-event preparation and costume change
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 13, Lei Mingxuan, at his home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, communicated with his cousin Shen Jie (who lives in Jing'an District) via WeChat about the meeting time and dress code for the evening performance. Lei Mingxuan picked out a Republic-era retro-style long gown and hat from his wardrobe, while Shen Jie prepared a qipao. The two confirmed their respective routes from home to the theater space in Pudong New Area and agreed to meet at the theater entrance at 19:00.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home

subevent.name: Going to the drama space.
subevent.description: At around 18:30 in the evening, Lei Mingxuan left home and took Metro Line 2 to the designated immersive theater space near Century Avenue in Pudong New Area. Shen Jie took the metro from Jing'an District to the same station. The two met at the theater entrance at 19:00 and entered together after ticket check.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Century Avenue - Immersive Drama Space

subevent.name: Experience an immersive theater performance
subevent.description: From 19:30 to 22:00, Lei Mingxuan and Shen Jie fully participated in the interactive performance set in Republican-era Shanghai within the immersive theater space. The two wore vintage costumes and blended into the scenes. During the interactive segments, Lei Mingxuan used his humor to improvise with the actors, drawing laughter from the audience. Shen Jie focused on observing the details of the scenes and enjoyed the theatrical atmosphere. After the performance, both were full of praise for the show.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Century Avenue - Immersive Drama Space

name: Launch healthy eating reform
description: Starting August 1, Lei Mingxuan persuaded his mother to cooperate and began strictly following a high-protein, low-fat healthy diet plan. The family table shifted from traditional Shanghai-style braised pork to chicken breast, fish, shrimp, and fresh fruits and vegetables. He records his diet every day and is determined to thoroughly improve his health indicators, with the plan continuing until the end of the year.

subevent.name: Healthy diet reform: initial implementation
subevent.description: Starting August 1, Lei Mingxuan and his mother, Wang Xiuying, strictly followed a high-protein, low-fat healthy eating plan at home. Three meals a day consisted mainly of chicken breast, fish, shrimp, eggs, soy products, and plenty of fresh fruits and vegetables, completely replacing the original high-oil, high-salt dishes such as Shanghainese braised pork. Lei Mingxuan used a mobile app every day to record the type and portion of each meal, while his mother adjusted the cooking methods according to the recipes (mainly steaming and boiling with less oil). In the first week, Lei Mingxuan felt slight discomfort, but he gradually adapted through adjusted cooking flavors. He also measured his weight and waist circumference on the bathroom scale every week and recorded the changes. The goal of this stage was to build new habits and overcome reliance on traditional flavors.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home Dining Room and Kitchen

subevent.name: Launch and early adaptation execution
subevent.description: On the morning of August 1, Lei Mingxuan and his mother Wang Xiuying discussed a healthy eating plan together in the kitchen and dining room at home, made a shopping list, and went to the nearby market to buy chicken breast, fish and shrimp, eggs, soy products, and plenty of fresh fruits and vegetables. After returning home, his mother cooked the first lunch using low-oil steaming and boiling methods, while Lei Mingxuan used a mobile app to record the types and portions of food. Starting from August 2, all three meals for five consecutive days strictly followed a high-protein, low-fat diet, with lunch and dinner consisting mainly of chicken breast salad, steamed fish, and boiled shrimp. At first, Lei Mingxuan felt slightly uncomfortable due to the bland taste and insufficient calories, experiencing hunger and cravings for rich dishes like braised pork belly. However, his mother gradually alleviated the discomfort by adding seasonings (such as lemon juice and black pepper) and adjusting the vegetable ratio. During this period, Lei Mingxuan kept recording his diet every day and encouraged his mother to try new dishes together.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - kitchen and dining room at home

subevent.name: Week 1 body measurements

Lei Mingxuan felt satisfied, took a photo for the record, and shared the results with his mother, which strengthened his confidence to keep going.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home bathroom.

Compared with a week earlier, his weight continued to drop by about 0.5 to 1 kg, and his waist had shrunk. He entered the numbers into his phone app and compared them with the data from the previous two weeks. Feeling the results were obvious, he gained more motivation to keep going.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home bathroom.

subevent.name: Week 3 Body Measurements

He posted the comparison data on Moments (only his status, without publishing photos), and friends gave likes and encouragement.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home bathroom.

Over the following three weeks, he and his regular training partner Han Dong did six systematic practice sessions at Pudong Billiards Club (about twice a week), gradually strengthening his skills from the break, position play, and long-shot offense to defensive transitions and handling special rack layouts. Han Dong recorded the entire sessions for review, while Lei Mingxuan also focused on arm stretching and energy management to avoid sports injuries. On September 20, he completed his final match-practice session.

subevent.name: Saw the competition notice and decided to participate
subevent.description: On the evening of September 1, 2025, Lei Mingxuan saw a notice for the "Pujiang Cup Amateur American Eight-Ball Open" released by the Shanghai Billiards Association in his WeChat groups for billiards enthusiasts on his phone (the Pudong Three Musketeers group and the Billiards Enthusiasts group). The tournament was divided into qualifiers and the main draw, open to amateur players. Thinking of his many years of billiards practice, he decided to register as a player to test his skill.
subevent.location: Shanghai – bedroom at home

subevent.name: Complete race registration
subevent.description: On the morning of September 2, 2025, Lei Mingxuan opened the registration page through the link from the competition's official WeChat public account, filled in basic information such as name, age, and contact information, and paid a 200 yuan registration fee, successfully completing the registration process for the Pujiang Cup Amateur American Eight-Ball Open.
subevent.location: Shanghai — home study (at the computer)

subevent.name: First billiards practice for the competition
subevent.description: At 7 p.m. on Wednesday, September 3, 2025, Lei Mingxuan and his regular billiards partner Han Dong met at Pudong Billiards Club (located near Zhangyang Road) for their first systematic pre-competition practice. They first spent half an hour on basic offensive and defensive warm-ups, then did targeted training on breaking, positioning, and long-range offense. Han Dong used his phone to record Lei Mingxuan's practice video. After practice, the two played back the video together, analyzing shot lines, power, and defensive positioning to complete a technical review. Before and after practice, Lei Mingxuan paid special attention to stretching his arm muscles and relaxing his shoulders, and reasonably allocated his energy to avoid sports injuries.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong Billiards Club

subevent.name: Second billiards preparation practice
subevent.description: At 3 p.m. on Saturday, September 6, 2025, Lei Mingxuan and Han Dong went to Pudong Billiards Club again for their second pre-competition practice. This session focused on continuous offense after the break shot and defensive transitions, simulating the pace of a match. Han Dong continued to record video, and during breaks the two reviewed the footage, focusing on correcting Lei Mingxuan's unstable center of gravity when striking the ball. After practice, Lei Mingxuan did his usual arm stretches and rehydrated and refueled to ensure sufficient energy.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong Billiards Club

subevent.name: Third billiards practice session for competition preparation
subevent.description: At 7 p.m. on Wednesday, September 10, 2025, Lei Mingxuan and Han Dong held their third practice session at Pudong Billiards Club. This session added a competitive match component: the two played five consecutive games of American eight-ball against each other, and after each game they reviewed video replays to discuss offensive and defensive strategies. At Han Dong's suggestion, Lei Mingxuan began practicing special shot types (such as frozen-to-rail balls and long-distance thin cuts). Before and after practice, they continued to do arm stretches and adjust energy distribution.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong Billiards Club

subevent.name: Fifth billiards competition preparation practice
subevent.description: On Wednesday, September 17, 2025, at 7 p.m., the fifth practice session was held at Pudong Billiards Club. The practice focused on consolidating defensive skills; the two practiced safety shots and cue ball control. Han Dong recorded videos from multiple angles to help Lei Mingxuan check whether his body posture was standard. After practice, they analyzed recent progress and areas that still needed improvement, and Lei Mingxuan did a full-body stretch to relieve muscle fatigue.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong Billiards Club

subevent.name: Sixth billiards practice session for competition preparation
subevent.description: At 3 p.m. on September 20, 2025 (Saturday), Lei Mingxuan had his last systematic practice session with Han Dong. This session was a full simulated match, including the break, offense and defense, and clearing the final eight balls off the table. Han Dong recorded the whole session and helped Lei Mingxuan summarize the technical improvements and tactical insights from the past three weeks. After practice, Lei Mingxuan fully stretched his arms, shoulders, and back, adjusted his pre-match diet and sleep schedule to avoid injury, and made final preparations for the competition.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong Billiards Club

name: Preparing for and heading to Hangzhou for university friend Wang Lei's wedding, and the return trip.
description: On October 18, Lei Mingxuan carefully selected and wrapped a trendy toy blind box gift for Wang Lei at home, and checked the car to ensure the next day's trip would go smoothly. Early on October 19, he drove from Pudong, Shanghai, along the Shanghai-Hangzhou Expressway, arrived at the wedding hotel by West Lake in Hangzhou at noon, met up with college classmates including Zhao Min, and gave the gift to Wang Lei on the spot. He then attended the wedding ceremony and banquet. During the feast, old classmates drank and chatted happily, reminiscing about their college days. Later at the banquet, Zhao Min brought up an exhibition planning project. The two discussed a co-branding promotion idea and agreed to talk more after returning to Shanghai. Late at night, Lei Mingxuan drove back alone to his home in Shanghai.

subevent.name: Wedding gift preparation and vehicle inspection
subevent.description: At home, Lei Mingxuan carefully selected and wrapped a designer toy blind box gift for his college friend Wang Lei, while also checking the private car's tires, fuel level, and navigation system to ensure a smooth road trip to Hangzhou the next day.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Drive from Shanghai to Hangzhou.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan set off from his home in Pudong, Shanghai, in the morning, drove his private car along the Shanghai-Hangzhou Expressway to Hangzhou, took a short break at a service area on the way, and expected to arrive at the wedding hotel by West Lake in Hangzhou before noon.
subevent.location: Shanghai-Hangzhou Expressway/Zhejiang

subevent.name: Arrived at the hotel to meet up with university classmates.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan arrived at the wedding hotel by West Lake in Hangzhou at noon and met his college friends Zhao Min, Wang Lei (the groom), and other old classmates. They exchanged greetings and took photos. Lei Mingxuan gave Wang Lei a designer toy gift, and the groom was pleasantly surprised.
subevent.location: A hotel in Xihu District, Hangzhou
