subevent.name: Attend Wang Lei's wedding ceremony and banquet
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan attended Wang Lei's wedding ceremony with college classmates including Zhao Min, witnessed the newlyweds exchange vows, and then joined the wedding banquet. During the meal, old classmates enjoyed drinks and lively conversation, reminiscing about college basketball games and marketing classes.
subevent.location: Banquet hall at a hotel in Xihu District, Hangzhou.

subevent.name: Discussed the cooperation plan with Zhao Min after the wedding banquet.
subevent.description: In the later part of the wedding banquet, Zhao Min brought up the new event plan for the exhibition company. Lei Mingxuan thought it could be combined with his clothing store for a co-branded promotion. The two discussed the initial idea in detail and agreed to refine the plan after returning to Shanghai.
subevent.location: A hotel in Xihu District, Hangzhou

subevent.name: Drove back to Shanghai late at night
subevent.description: Late at night, Lei Mingxuan said goodbye to his classmates, drove alone from Hangzhou back to his home in Pudong, Shanghai, and rested after arriving safely.
subevent.location: Shanghai-Hangzhou Expressway / Shanghai - Home

name: Met up with old roller-skating friend Song Jia by the riverside to catch up.
description: On November 23, Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to invite his former roller-skating partner Song Jia for a long-overdue roller-skating session on the Riverside Greenway. As they skated, they talked about the changes over the past year. Song Jia was pleasantly surprised by his new identity as a coffee shop owner and revealed that she had also started learning pour-over coffee. The bond between former playmates was elevated from mere shared hobbies to mutual appreciation and good wishes, drawing a satisfying close to the relationship with old friends.

subevent.name: Invite Song Jia and schedule a roller-skating catch-up
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan contacted his old roller-skating friend Song Jia via WeChat and said he wanted to go roller-skating along the Riverside Greenway on November 23 as a get-together. Song Jia gladly agreed, and they arranged to meet at the entrance of the Riverside Greenway at 2 p.m. that day.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

subevent.name: Prepare roller skating gear and travel arrangements.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan checked and maintained his roller skates, knee pads, elbow pads and other gear in advance to ensure they were safe and usable, and planned a cycling/subway route from home (Zhangyang Road, Pudong) to the Riverside Greenway, and confirmed the weather that day was suitable for outdoor roller skating.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

subevent.name: Go to the riverside greenway to meet up with Song Jia
subevent.description: On the afternoon of November 23, Lei Mingxuan took the subway from home to the Pudong Riverside Greenway with his roller skating gear, arriving at the agreed entrance around 1:50 p.m. to wait for Song Jia.
subevent.location: Shanghai – Pudong New Area Riverside Greenway.

subevent.name: Catching up with Song Jia while rollerblading along the riverfront.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan and Song Jia went roller skating together along the Pudong Riverside Greenway. As they skated by the river, they talked freely about how their lives had changed over the past year. Song Jia was pleasantly surprised to learn that Lei Mingxuan had transformed from a clothing store owner into a coffee shop owner, and she mentioned that she had also started learning pour-over coffee. In the river breeze and sunshine, the two rekindled their old roller-skating friendship, and their relationship grew from hobby partners into a deep bond of mutual appreciation and good wishes.
subevent.location: Shanghai – Pudong New Area Riverside Greenway.

subevent.name: Return after the event ends.
subevent.description: The roller-skating catch-up ended around 5 p.m. Lei Mingxuan and Song Jia said goodbye at the entrance to the Riverside Greenway, wished each other well, and agreed to meet again. Lei Mingxuan then took the subway back to his home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong.
subevent.location: Shanghai – Pudong New Area Riverside Greenway.

name: Follow up on the camping festival cooperation interest
description: On November 4, Lei Mingxuan proactively contacted the camping coffee equipment brand he had met at the camping festival to express his interest in cooperation. The two sides communicated via WeChat about consignment terms, profit sharing, and supply cycles. The brand recognized Lei Mingxuan's store model and agreed to send samples next week for evaluation. Lei Mingxuan plans to set up a dedicated display area after the store upgrade, and use this opportunity to enrich the product line in the coffee experience area.

subevent.name: Proactively contacted the brand
subevent.description: From his own clothing store, Lei Mingxuan proactively contacted Manager Liu, a representative of the camping coffee gear brand he had met at the camping festival, via WeChat. He expressed interest in cooperation and briefly introduced his store's positioning and upgrade plan.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Own Clothing Store

subevent.name: Discussing collaboration details
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan and Manager Liu, the brand representative, had a WeChat video call to discuss in detail the specific cooperation terms such as consignment conditions, profit-sharing ratios, supply cycles, and settlement methods. The two parties reached a preliminary consensus on the core commercial terms.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Own Clothing Store

subevent.name: Confirm sample shipment
subevent.description: Manager Liu, the brand representative, expressed high recognition of Lei Mingxuan's store model and business philosophy. The two parties agreed that next week the brand would send camping coffee equipment samples to Lei Mingxuan's store for him to conduct physical evaluation and in-store testing.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Own Clothing Store

subevent.name: Display Area Layout Planning
subevent.description: In his own clothing store, Lei Mingxuan, in light of the store's future upgrade plan, thought about how to set up a dedicated camping coffee equipment display area and integrate it with the existing coffee experience zone product line. He made an initial plan for the display area's spatial location and display approach.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Own Clothing Store

name: Back-to-school joint store promotion event
description: From August 28 to September 8, Lei Mingxuan planned and executed the back-to-school promotion 'New Semester Functional Renewal'. He designed the gift box plan, purchased materials, and promoted it in advance on August 30 through WeChat communities and Xiaohongshu. From September 1 to 7, he set up a coffee experience area in the store, where clerk Xiao Lin guided customers to experience the products and sold gift boxes, making additional purchases during the period based on sales. On the last day of the event, a discount clearance and customer appreciation were held. On September 8, Lei Mingxuan reviewed the results and decided to apply the cross-industry model to subsequent promotions. Total sales were approximately 32,000 yuan, with 70 gift boxes sold.

subevent.name: Designing the event plan and purchasing materials.
subevent.description: At his own clothing store, Lei Mingxuan designed a promotional plan for the 'New Semester Functional Refresh' event based on the back-to-school theme. He decided to package mountain-style functional clothing with stationery designer toys into gift boxes and add a coffee experience area. At the same time, he contacted Wang Lei, the stationery designer toy supplier, and Zhou Tao, the coffee bean supplier, to purchase gift box accessories and coffee tasting materials, and arranged logistics for delivery to the store.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Online teaser promotional push
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan used his phone in the store to create promotional posters and copy, and published the 'New Semester Techwear Revamp' event preview via WeChat communities (including the regular customer group and the trend enthusiast group) and the social platform Xiaohongshu, highlighting the gift box contents, how to get coffee tasting vouchers, and the event time, and encouraging group members to share. He also privately messaged a few regular customers (such as Qian Duoduo and Feng Xiaoyu) to help spread the word.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - home study

subevent.name: Event venue setup and gift box packing.
subevent.description: On the morning the event officially started, Lei Mingxuan and new clerk Xiao Lin set up the store: they placed a display rack for the "Functional Renewal Gift Box" at the entrance, set up pour-over coffee equipment, free tasting vouchers, and promotional signs in the coffee corner, and displayed the gift box samples in prominent positions. They also packed the pre-arrived stationery, designer toys, and clothing into customized combinations, making 50 gift boxes in inventory. They tested the coffee machine and prepared disposable cups.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: First-day reception and experience guidance for the event
subevent.description: After the store opened at 9:00 a.m., foot traffic was significantly higher than usual. Lei Mingxuan handled front-desk cashiering and gift box sales, while Xiao Lin proactively guided entering customers to the coffee corner according to the training plan, handed out free pour-over tasting vouchers, and introduced gift box pairing options. A total of 15 gift boxes were sold that day, and 40 tasting vouchers were used, generating about 2,000 yuan in add-on sales (such as separate clothing and designer toy purchases). After closing in the afternoon, the two took a quick inventory count.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Daily Operations and Ongoing Promotion for the Event
subevent.description: During the ongoing event, Lei Mingxuan and Xiao Lin maintained store operations according to the first-day routine: every morning they restocked gift boxes and calibrated the coffee equipment; during the afternoon peak hours, Xiao Lin guided customers to experience coffee and recommended gift boxes; Lei Mingxuan posted daily inventory updates and sales highlights in the WeChat group and replied to customer inquiries. Based on sales during the period, on September 4 they placed an additional purchase of 20 gift box accessories. Over the five days, cumulative new gift box sales reached 40 boxes, coffee experiences totaled about 200 person-times, and overall store revenue increased by about 60% compared with a normal week.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Event wrap-up and customer appreciation
subevent.description: On the last day of the event, Lei Mingxuan adjusted his strategy, putting the remaining gift boxes on clearance at a discount, and giving extra coffee bean samples to customers who spent 300 yuan or more during the event. Xiao Lin guided customers to scan QR codes to join the store's community group, accumulating users for subsequent marketing. After closing, the two cleaned the coffee corner equipment together, counted inventory, and unpacked the unsold gift boxes for storage. They tallied total sales for the event week at about 32,000 yuan, with 70 gift boxes sold and 500 coffee experience vouchers distributed.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Activity review and follow-up planning
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan stayed at home alone on the store's rest day, organizing sales data and consumer feedback from the event, analyzing the cross-selling rate between gift boxes and coffee experience, and writing a simple event summary document. He decided to use the 'trendy toys + drinks' crossover model as an alternative for future holiday promotions, and planned to conduct a satisfaction survey in the WeChat community to optimize the next event.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - home study

name: Participate in the autumn orienteering cross-country race to improve cardiorespiratory function and strengthen social connections.
description: On November 5, Lei Mingxuan communicated with his teammates online about pre-race strategy. On November 8, he led a team in the Shanghai Autumn Orienteering Race along both banks of the Huangpu River, which included check-ins at historical buildings. Thanks to coordinated teamwork and improved fitness, they finished fifth in their group. After the race, he posted a recap on WeChat Moments, received likes and messages from friends, which reinforced his commitment to outdoor sports and strengthened his social connections.

subevent.name: Pre-competition preparation and team communication.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of November 5, Lei Mingxuan communicated with his orienteering teammates via WeChat to confirm the meeting time, route strategy, and equipment preparation, including bringing maps, compasses, and water. He also briefly reviewed the spring race experience and did homework on the historical-building check-in points along the Huangpu River. Since he was unfamiliar with some locations, he looked up coordinate information on his phone in advance. His teammates included two old partners and a newly joined running buddy, and they all agreed to meet at 7 a.m. on the 8th at Expo Source Plaza.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Gathering and warm-up
subevent.description: At 6:30 a.m. on November 8, Lei Mingxuan left his home in Pudong and rode a shared bike to the assembly point at Expo Source Plaza on the east bank of the Huangpu River. He met up with his three teammates before 7:00, collected race number bibs and task cards, and did 15 minutes of dynamic stretching and a slow jog to warm up, checked that all gear was ready, and waited for the starting gun. During this time the team leader again emphasized safety precautions and the order of checkpoints.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New District - Expo Source Plaza

subevent.name: The orienteering race process
subevent.description: The race officially started at 8 a.m. Lei Mingxuan and his teammates followed the planned route along both banks of the Huangpu River, shuttling through historical check-in points such as the Bund, the Old Wharf, and Nanpu Bridge. They had to complete 10 checkpoint check-ins and 2 additional tasks. During the race, the four of them worked well together, and Lei Mingxuan used his sense of direction and physical strength to quickly locate points multiple times. They completed the entire course in 2 hours and 17 minutes and placed fifth in the group. The race ended around 11 a.m.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Huangpu River riverside (Expo Source - The Bund - Old Wharf-Nanpu Bridge section)

subevent.name: Post-match summary and WeChat Moments post.
subevent.description: After the race, Lei Mingxuan took group photos with his teammates at the finish area and used his phone to capture several exciting moments and check-in point photos during the race. Around noon, he returned home, organized the photos, and wrote a WeChat Moments post sharing his experience in the orienteering race, the team's fifth-place result, and his reflections on outdoor sports, specifically mentioning the improvement in his cardiorespiratory fitness. He then published the post with photos to WeChat Moments.
subevent.location: Shanghai - living room at home

subevent.name: Moments Interaction and Social Consolidation
subevent.description: After posting on Moments, Lei Mingxuan received likes and comments from several friends from the afternoon through the evening, including childhood friend Zhang Wei, roller-skating partner Song Jia, and billiards friend Han Dong. He replied to each comment, exchanging competition details and exercise insights with his friends, and said his confidence in sticking with outdoor exercise grew stronger. This interaction strengthened his social connections with sports enthusiasts and also attracted several friends who said they would like to join next time.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

name: Mother came to the store to help, had lunch together, and secretly provided financial support
description: On the morning of November 20, his mother Wang Xiuying came to Lei Mingxuan's clothing store on the second floor of the shopping mall on Century Avenue in Pudong New Area to help organize the goods. At noon, she brought a homemade nutritious lunch that was low in oil and high in protein. The mother and son ate in the rest area behind the store and talked at length. The mother asked about the business and encouraged her son to keep pursuing his dream. Before she left in the afternoon, when the store was empty of customers, she quietly slipped Lei Mingxuan 20,000 yuan of private savings, telling him, "Don't let your father know," giving him financial support in a quiet way. Lei Mingxuan was moved to tears.

subevent.name: Mother came to the store to help organize the goods
subevent.description: In the morning, his mother Wang Xiuying came to Lei Mingxuan's clothing store on the second floor of the mall on Century Avenue in Pudong New Area and began helping organize the clothes on the shelves, check inventory, and clean the storefront. Lei Mingxuan attended to customers nearby, and mother and son worked together in perfect harmony.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Century Avenue Mall, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (own clothing store)

subevent.name: Mother and son had lunch together and had a deep conversation.
subevent.description: At noon, Wang Xiuying took out from her bag a nutritious lunch she had carefully prepared at home, low in oil and high in protein, including a low-oil version of braised pork belly, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and a fresh fruit salad. The mother and son ate together in the rest area behind the store. During the meal, Wang Xiuying asked in detail about the store's operations; Lei Mingxuan shared recent sales performance and the difficulties he had encountered; and his mother expressed both pride and concern over his busy but fulfilling life, encouraging him to stick with his entrepreneurial dream
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Century Avenue Mall, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (own clothing store)

subevent.name: Mother quietly slipped her son some money from her private stash.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, when his mother was about to leave, she took advantage of the fact that there were no other customers in the store and quietly slipped Lei Mingxuan an envelope containing 20,000 yuan in cash, whispering, "Don't let your father know." She said this was money she had saved privately over the years, hoping her son could use it when he needed funds for cash flow, giving him financial support and emotional encouragement in a quiet way. Lei Mingxuan was deeply moved and hugged his mother tightly; both of them had moist eyes.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Century Avenue Mall, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (own clothing store)

name: Expand your network and attract customers during the competition
description: During the game, Lei Mingxuan exchanged contact information with several players from other clubs. One of them was interested in the store's trendy toys and later became an offline customer. Lei Mingxuan therefore realized that hobby circles themselves are a potential channel for driving business traffic, and this strengthened his conviction in a multi-channel social media strategy for the future.

subevent.name: Attend a billiards business exchange tournament to expand connections.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan participated in a billiards friendship match co-hosted by several clubs. During the match, he actively practiced skills and exchanged industry information with players from other clubs, proactively swapped contact information with several of them, and paid special attention to one player who had a strong interest in trendy toys, laying the groundwork for attracting customers later.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - a billiards club

subevent.name: Billiards match showdown and exchange of contact information
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan continued competing on the second day, playing several intense billiards matches against fellow players from various clubs in the group stage and knockout stage. After each match, he took the initiative to shake hands and chat with his opponents, sharing playing insights and industry anecdotes, and took the opportunity to exchange phone numbers or WeChat QR codes with a few players he got along with, successfully expanding his professional network and reserving contact channels for potential future collaboration or customer referrals.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - a billiards club

subevent.name: In-depth exchange with friends who share an interest in designer toys and ball sports
subevent.description: On the third day of the competition, Lei Mingxuan especially noticed a player from another court who showed keen interest in designer toys (named Liu Zihao). During a match break, Lei Mingxuan approached him and started a conversation, using his own Pop Mart blind box collection as the icebreaker, quickly closing the distance. The two had an in-depth exchange on designer toy market trends, popular IPs, and physical store operating experience. Lei Mingxuan took the opportunity to introduce his clothing store in Pudong and invited him to visit the store later. In the end, both happily exchanged business cards and WeChat IDs, establishing a personal connection for direct contact.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - rest area of a billiards club

subevent.name: Farewells at the close of the competition and maintaining connections
subevent.description: On the last day of the competition, Lei Mingxuan attended the awards ceremony and the closing ceremony. Although he did not win a place, he made full use of the opportunity to say goodbye to several new friends he had met. He reviewed the exciting moments of the matches one by one and agreed to practice or collaborate again in the future. He also exchanged brief pleasantries with the event staff and several club leaders, expressing his appreciation for the event and his willingness to participate in the future. In the evening, he organized all the contact information he had gathered over the past few days into his phone contacts and WeChat groups, and sent each person a short greeting message, strengthening the network he had built through the competition.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - a billiards club

subevent.name: Communicated online with billiards buddy Chen Jie and invited him to the store.
subevent.description: After the match, Lei Mingxuan proactively contacted via WeChat Chen Jie, a basketball buddy he had met during the competition who was interested in designer toys, and gave a detailed introduction to his store's distinctive designer toy products and business philosophy, warmly inviting him to visit the store in person. Chen Jie showed strong interest in the products and readily agreed to come to the store on October 5.

participant.name: Chen Jie
participant.relation: Billiard friends met at the competition.

subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - home / WeChat online

subevent.name: Billiards buddy Chen Jie visited the store and made a purchase
subevent.description: Chen Jie, a billiards buddy, arrived at Lei Mingxuan's clothing store in the mall on Century Avenue in Pudong as promised. Lei Mingxuan received him personally and showed him the latest batch of designer toy blind boxes, collaboration clothing, and trendy accessories in the store. Chen Jie picked several items and eventually spent about 800 yuan, becoming a new customer of the store. This successful offline conversion let Lei Mingxuan directly verify the feasibility of using interest circles to drive commercial traffic.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Review the experience in driving traffic and formulate a social media operations plan.
subevent.description: In his home study, Lei Mingxuan calmly reviewed the entire process from competition socializing to customer conversion, realizing that hobby circles are a natural channel for business lead generation. Drawing on his active presence in interest circles such as billiards, roller skating, and basketball, he drafted a preliminary multi-channel social operation plan. He planned to promote the store more proactively in various interest activities in the future, and organize small-scale offline networking events to attract new customers.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home Study

subevent.name: Continuously maintaining new customer relationships
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan regularly kept in touch with Chen Jie via WeChat, sharing new arrivals, trend information, and limited-edition release previews, and inviting him to weekend collectibles exchange events, in order to strengthen customer relationships and further expand potential customers through Chen Jie's social circle.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - home / WeChat online

name: Late-night snack for the camping festival celebration.
description: On the evening of November 2, Lei Mingxuan invited Qian Duoduo and Shen Jie to a Japanese izakaya to celebrate the success of their participation in the Shanghai Outdoor Camping Festival. He thanked both of them for the online pre-event promotion and on-site help. The three chatted about fun moments from the camping festival and customer feedback. Qian Duoduo suggested collaborating on a trend livestream in the future, while Shen Jie shared her insights as a fashion buyer, bringing them closer.

subevent.name: Reserved a Japanese izakaya
subevent.description: On the morning of November 2, Lei Mingxuan reserved a highly rated Japanese izakaya by phone or via an online platform, preparing for the evening celebration dinner.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Head to the izakaya
subevent.description: Around 7 p.m., Lei Mingxuan left home and took the subway or a taxi to the reserved Japanese izakaya, where he met up with Qian Duoduo and Shen Jie.
subevent.location: Shanghai - a Japanese izakaya

subevent.name: Celebration dinner at an izakaya
subevent.description: Inside the izakaya, Lei Mingxuan, Qian Duoduo, and Shen Jie sat around the table. Lei Mingxuan first thanked Qian Duoduo and Shen Jie for their online promotional efforts before the camping festival and their on-site help. The three enjoyed Japanese food while chatting about the fun moments and customer feedback from the camping festival. Qian Duoduo suggested collaborating on a trend-focused live stream in the future, and Shen Jie shared insights from being a fashion buyer. The atmosphere was lively, and their bond grew closer.
subevent.location: Shanghai - a Japanese izakaya

name: Before Double 11, exchanged fun collecting anecdotes with fellow collectors and prepared for the purchase rush.
description: On the evening of November 9, Lei Mingxuan had a lively discussion in the designer toy WeChat group with fellow collectors including Lin Jing about the design details of the steampunk collab edition and the chance of getting the hidden edition, sharing amusing stories about their collections in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere. During the day on November 10, Lin Jing suggested using two accounts to snap up the item at the same time to improve the odds. Lei Mingxuan took the suggestion and tested the network speed in advance. In the evening, everyone confirmed the operation details online again and reminded each other to log in on time, further deepening their friendship as collectors.

subevent.name: Double 11 eve discussion in the trendy toys group
subevent.description: On the evening of November 9, Lei Mingxuan logged into a trendy toys WeChat group at home via his phone and had a lively discussion with collector Lin Jing and other group members about the design details and hidden edition probability of the upcoming steampunk collaboration blind box. Everyone shared fun stories about their collections and encouraged each other. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant, deepening the friendship among collectors. Lei Mingxuan listened carefully to everyone's opinions on the collaboration edition and noted down key information.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Home in Pudong New Area (online WeChat group)

subevent.name: Adopt the strategy and test the network.
subevent.description: On November 10, during the day, Lin Jing suggested in the WeChat group that they use two accounts to snap up items at the same time to improve the hit rate. Lei Mingxuan adopted the suggestion and, in the afternoon, tested the speed and stability of his home broadband network in advance to ensure a smooth connection during the buying spree. In the evening, Lei Mingxuan again discussed the final purchase strategy with Lin Jing and other collector friends in the group, confirmed the operational details, and reminded each other to log in on time. The atmosphere remained relaxed and pleasant.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Home in Pudong New Area (online WeChat group)

name: Inspired by camping music videos and began initial exploration
description: On the evening of November 29, 2025, Lei Mingxuan watched a video of someone playing the ukulele by a campfire on Bilibili and developed a strong longing for camping music. That night he searched for camping-music-related content and equipment information. The next morning, he joined a camping music discussion group, chatted with like-minded people, and added each other as friends.

subevent.name: Watch camping music videos
subevent.description: On the evening of November 29, 2025, in his study at his home in Pudong, Shanghai, Lei Mingxuan logged into Bilibili on his laptop and saw a video on the recommendation page titled 'Playing Ukulele by the Campfire | Healing Camping Vibes.' He was deeply moved by the relaxed atmosphere created by the campfire, starry sky, and cheerful ukulele melody in the video. He watched it three times and clicked 'like' and 'favorite.'
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - home study

subevent.name: Search for camping music-related content
subevent.description: After watching the video, Lei Mingxuan developed a strong desire to incorporate music into camping. He immediately searched Bilibili for keywords such as "camping ukulele" and "campfire sing-along," browsed several related videos, and checked the equipment lists mentioned in the video descriptions, including entry-level ukuleles and portable Bluetooth speakers. He also opened the Taobao app and did a rough search for the prices and reviews of these items.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - home study

subevent.name: Join the camping music discussion group
subevent.description: The next morning, Lei Mingxuan found a link to a QQ group for camping music enthusiasts in the comments section of a Bilibili video, applied to join, and was approved. He briefly introduced himself in the group, said he had just gotten interested, and hoped to learn some beginner tips. Group members replied warmly, sharing photos of camping music events and ukulele learning resources. Lei Mingxuan and a few of the members added each other as WeChat friends.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Participate in community basketball games to maintain exercise habits.
description: On the afternoon of November 16, Lei Mingxuan participated in a community recreational basketball game, teaming up with Xie Fei and other ball friends for a match. During the game, he moved actively; though his stamina had dropped slightly due to an interruption in training recently, his shooting touch was good. After the game, the players agreed to meet again next month, and the activity continued their habit of exercising and socializing.

subevent.name: Pre-competition preparation and warm-up
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan did pre-game preparation at the outdoor basketball court of Yuanshen Sports Center in Pudong New Area, Shanghai. He changed into his basketball gear and warmed up with stretching, shooting, and other exercises with fellow players including Xie Fei, preparing for the upcoming community recreational basketball game.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area, Yuanshen Sports Center Outdoor Basketball Court

subevent.name: Participated in a community recreational basketball game
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan teamed up with Xie Fei and other basketball buddies to take part in a community basketball fun game. During the game, Lei Mingxuan moved actively and shot the ball. Although his stamina had dipped slightly due to interrupted training recently, he had a good shooting touch and made several nice baskets. The whole team played well together and enjoyed the fun of the sport.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area, Yuanshen Sports Center Outdoor Basketball Court

name: Re-planning the monthly budget after mother's financial support
description: On the evening of November 20, after Lei Mingxuan received 20,000 yuan of private money quietly given by his mother Wang Xiuying, he recorded the income in the family ledger that night and replanned the financial budget for late November and December. He deposited 10,000 yuan into a dedicated savings account as an emergency fund for store upgrades; the remaining 10,000 yuan was used to pay the final payment for the Double Eleven mystery boxes, the ukulele cost, and the remaining living expenses for the month. At the same time, he set a special spending limit for the development cost of the store's online mini-program next month to ensure a stable cash flow.

subevent.name: Received the private money my mother gave me.
subevent.description: At around 7 p.m., Lei Mingxuan returned to his home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai. His mother, Wang Xiuying, privately gave him 20,000 yuan in cash as her own money to support his store operations and personal expenses. Lei Mingxuan accepted the cash and thanked her.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Record income and plan the budget in the family ledger.
subevent.description: At the desk in the bedroom, Lei Mingxuan took out the family ledger and recorded the received 20,000 yuan in cash as extra income. He then replanned the budget for late November and December based on current financial status. He decided to deposit 10,000 yuan of it into a savings account as an emergency fund for the store upgrade, and use the other 10,000 yuan to pay the final installment for Double 11 mystery boxes, the ukulele fee, and remaining living expenses. He also set a specific spending limit for next month's online mini-program development cost.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Deposit 10,000 yuan into a dedicated savings account
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan used the mobile banking app to transfer 10,000 yuan from the 20,000 yuan he received into a dedicated savings account under his own name, as an emergency fund for the store's future renovation and upgrade. After completing the transfer, he confirmed the account balance and recorded it in his ledger.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Pay the remaining balance for the Double 11 blind box and the ukulele cost
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan opened the e-commerce platform app and the second-hand trading platform app on his phone, and from the remaining 10,000 yuan paid the balance for the previously pre-ordered Double 11 limited-edition blind box (about 2,500 yuan) and the cost of the second-hand ukulele he bought (about 800 yuan). After completing the payments, he took screenshots to save the payment receipts.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Plan the remaining living expenses and set next month's development spending limit
subevent.description: Based on his remaining funds (about 6,700 yuan), Lei Mingxuan updated his daily expense budget for late November and December, and separately noted in the ledger a special spending cap of 8,000 yuan for next month's store mini-program development costs to ensure a stable cash flow. After tidying the ledger, he put it in a drawer.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Started preparations for the multi-brand store upgrade
description: On November 12, Lei Mingxuan started preparations for upgrading the multi-brand store. After organizing the materials, he met with designer Liu Tao, and the proposed budget was 30% higher than expected. Due to the funding gap, he decided to apply for a bank loan on November 13. On November 14, the loan was rejected because of the unstable cash flow of his self-employed business, so he accelerated the development of the online mini program. On November 16, he adjusted the renovation plan to cut expenses. On November 18, he discussed a new order with supplier Zhou Tao, who asked for a 30% deposit in advance, putting further pressure on cash flow. On November 19, he sorted out the preparation progress and made a follow-up plan. His mother, Wang Xiuying, agreed to provide emergency support of 50,000 yuan.

subevent.name: Organizing materials for the store upgrade plan
subevent.description: On the morning of November 12, Lei Mingxuan, in the back office of his clothing store, organized the materials needed for upgrading to a brand collection store, including the store's existing floor plan, customer flow analysis, preliminary functional zoning concepts (clothing display area, trendy toy area, coffee experience area, small event area), and a budget framework, to fully prepare for the afternoon meeting with the designer.
subevent.location: Store owner's office, Shop A-208, 2/F, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Met with the renovation designer to discuss the upgrade plan.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of November 12, Lei Mingxuan met at the store with interior designer Liu Tao (a freelance designer) introduced by a friend, and the two had an in-depth discussion about the store renovation plan. After taking on-site measurements, Liu Tao proposed a full plan including custom display cabinets, a coffee bar, and a movable activity area, but the total budget was about 350,000 yuan, 30% higher than Lei Mingxuan's expected 270,000 yuan. Lei Mingxuan said he needed to reassess the budget before deciding whether to adjust the plan.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Calculate the budget and decide to apply for a loan.
subevent.description: On the evening of November 13, Lei Mingxuan recalculated the renovation budget and cash flow for the store upgrade in his home study. He calculated that the store's current working capital was about 100,000 yuan, plus 50,000 yuan in personal savings, leaving a gap of 200,000 yuan. After discussing with his father Lei Jianguo, he decided to apply for a small business loan of 200,000 yuan from the bank to cover the shortfall, and planned to submit the application materials the next day.
subevent.location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Went to the bank to apply for a small loan and was rejected.
subevent.description: On the morning of November 14, Lei Mingxuan brought his business license, the past six months of store cash flow records, and his personal credit report to a branch of SPD Bank in Pudong New Area to apply for a 200,000 yuan personal business loan. After review, the bank's credit manager believed that his self-employed business cash flow fluctuated greatly and lacked stable collateral, so the loan application was ultimately rejected. After failing to reach an agreement with the manager in the bank lobby, Lei Mingxuan decided to adjust his strategy, trimming some renovation projects and accelerating development of the online mini program to cut costs.
subevent.location: A branch of SPD Bank in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Communicated with the technical staff to speed up mini-program development
subevent.description: On the afternoon of November 15, Lei Mingxuan contacted Chen Lei, a freelance developer he had worked with before, via WeChat, asking to move up the launch of the brand collection store's online mini-program from the originally planned end of December to mid-December. The two discussed the adjusted functional requirements remotely (adding modules such as online reservation, member points, and designer toy pre-sale). Chen Lei quoted an additional 12,000 yuan in development costs; Lei Mingxuan agreed and they arranged to produce a detailed schedule on the weekend.
subevent.location: Home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Adjust the store renovation plan and reduce spending.
subevent.description: On November 16, Lei Mingxuan adjusted the renovation plan after his loan application was rejected. He called the designer Liu Tao and told him that he would turn the coffee experience area into a temporary pop-up spot (saving about 40,000 yuan), shrink the designer toy area and use low-cost shelving (saving about 20,000 yuan), and keep the total budget within 280,000 yuan. At the same time, he decided to pay in installments from his own working capital and the store's daily income, and to suspend non-essential custom furniture purchases.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Discussed order upgrade requirements with supplier Zhou Tao over the phone
subevent.description: On the morning of November 18, Lei Mingxuan had a phone call in the store with his main fabric supplier, Zhou Tao (partner of Hangzhou Taosheng Apparel Co., Ltd.). Lei Mingxuan explained that he planned to upgrade the positioning of the multibrand store, hoping to increase orders for high-quality fabrics and co-branded styles. Zhou Tao expressed support, suggested that Lei Mingxuan visit the Hangzhou factory in March next year to discuss cooperation details in person, and also required a 30% deposit on new orders. Due to tight cash flow, Lei Mingxuan said he needed to reconsider, and the two agreed to confirm the initial order quantity in early December.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Reviewed the upgrade preparation progress and made follow-up plans.
subevent.description: On the evening of November 19, Lei Mingxuan sorted out the week's preparation work for the upgrade at home and wrote a written summary, including adjustments to the designer's plans, financial responses after the loan was rejected, accelerated mini-program development, and results of communication with suppliers. He made a plan for the next week: finalize the renovation plan, contact other loan channels (such as online lending or small-loan companies), finalize the prepayment ratio with Zhou Tao, and start the mini-program UI design. At the same time, he discussed the recent financial pressure with his mother, Wang Xiuying, and she said she could temporarily provide 50,000 yuan.
subevent.location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai - living room at home

name: Moganshan Meditation and Yoga Retreat
description: From October 17 to 18, his cousin Shen Jie dragged Lei Mingxuan to a weekend Zen meditation and yoga retreat held at a meditation center in Moganshan. The activities included morning meditation, yin yoga, vegetarian meals, and silent walking. Lei Mingxuan resisted at first, feeling it was incompatible with his energetic personality, but while walking meditation in the morning mist, he unexpectedly felt a long-lost peace. He also became interested in a designer in the group who worked with plant-dye techniques, and they exchanged views on combining traditional crafts with clothing. Although he didn't end up loving yoga, he admitted it was a special experience and his relationship with Shen Jie became more harmonious.

subevent.name: Packing luggage before departure.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan packed his luggage at home (No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai) for the Zen meditation and yoga retreat at Mogan Mountain, preparing items including a change of clothes, personal toiletries, yoga wear, and so on, and briefly explained his itinerary to his parents.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Drove to Moganshan.
subevent.description: At 8 a.m., Lei Mingxuan drove his own car to pick up his cousin Shen Jie. They departed from Pudong, Shanghai, took the Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway to Mogan Mountain Scenic Area in Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province. The trip took about 2.5 hours, and they arrived at the retreat center parking lot at 10:30 a.m.
subevent.location: Shanghai to Moganshan, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

subevent.name: Check-in and camp orientation
subevent.description: After arriving at the Mogan Mountain Retreat Center, Lei Mingxuan and Shen Jie checked in at the front desk and received their room keys and activity handbook. They then attended the opening ceremony of the retreat, where the instructor introduced the two-day schedule and guidelines, including morning meditation, Yin yoga, vegetarian meals, and silent walking. At first Lei Mingxuan felt it didn't suit his personality and was somewhat resistant.
subevent.location: Mogan Mountain Retreat Center, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

subevent.name: Yin Yoga Class and Vegetarian Dinner
subevent.description: At 2 p.m., encouraged by Shen Jie, Lei Mingxuan attended his first yin yoga class, performing slow stretching and breathing exercises under the instructor's guidance. After class, the two, along with other students, enjoyed a vegetarian dinner prepared by the retreat center in the dining hall, tasting light and healthy vegetable dishes.
subevent.location: Zhejiang Province, Huzhou City - Mogan Mountain Retreat Center Yoga Room and Dining Hall

subevent.name: Silent walking and plant-dyeing exchange
subevent.description: At 7 p.m., the meditation retreat organized a silent walking activity. All participants walked silently along a mountain path in the twilight for about 30 minutes. After the walk, during free conversation in the rest area, Lei Mingxuan became interested in a designer named Chen Xiao who worked with plant-dyeing techniques. He took the initiative to strike up a conversation, and the two had an in-depth discussion on combining traditional plant-dyeing methods with clothing design. They exchanged contact information.

participant.name: Chen Xiao
participant.relation: A designer I met at the meditation retreat

subevent.location: Outdoor trail and rest area at Moganshan Retreat Center, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province

subevent.name: Morning meditation and walking meditation.
subevent.description: At 6 a.m., Lei Mingxuan, together with his instructor and other trainees, meditated on the lawn in the morning mist, and then practiced walking meditation (slow walking). In the quiet surroundings, he unexpectedly felt a long-lost inner peace and gained a new understanding of the experience.
subevent.location: Lawn of Mogan Mountain Retreat Center, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

subevent.name: Second day: Yin Yoga and free time
subevent.description: At 9 a.m., I attended the next day's Yin Yoga class and adapted better than the first day. After class, Lei Mingxuan and Shen Jie rested in the retreat center's tea room and ran into plant-dye designer Chen Xiao again. The three of them sat drinking tea and chatting, further discussing the possibility of craft collaboration. At noon, they enjoyed their final vegetarian lunch in the dining hall.

participant.name: Chen Xiao
participant.relation: A designer I met at the meditation retreat

subevent.location: Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province - Moganshan Retreat Center Tea Room

subevent.name: Check out and head back
subevent.description: At 1 PM, Lei Mingxuan and Shen Jie packed their luggage and checked out. They then drove back to Shanghai and arrived home around 4 PM. On the way, they talked about their impressions of the meditation retreat. Lei Mingxuan admitted it was a special experience, and his relationship with Shen Jie became more harmonious.
subevent.location: Huzhou, Zhejiang Province to Shanghai - on the return trip

subevent.name: Follow-up online communication with the designer
subevent.description: After returning to Shanghai, Lei Mingxuan contacted plant-dye designer Chen Xiao via WeChat to further discuss the feasibility of introducing plant-dyeing techniques into his clothing store, and they agreed to discuss cooperation details in depth next week.

participant.name: Chen Xiao
participant.relation: A designer I met at the meditation retreat

subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

name: Rushed to buy blind boxes at midnight on Double 11
description: At midnight on November 11, 2025, Lei Mingxuan, in his bedroom at his home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, operated both his computer and phone at the same time, placed an order on an e-commerce platform to snap up two boxes of co-branded blind boxes, and successfully completed the payment.

subevent.name: Rushed to buy blind boxes at midnight on Double 11
subevent.description: At midnight on November 11, 2025, Lei Mingxuan used both his computer and phone in the bedroom at home to place orders on an e-commerce platform and rush-buy two boxes of co-branded blind boxes, successfully completing the payment.
subevent.location: Home bedroom in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Improvisational theater temporarily put on hold
description: After October, the National Day tasting event, the blind box area operations, and the preparations for the November camping festival filled up his weekends, so improvisational theater was temporarily put aside. Lei Mingxuan occasionally tried a little humor while interacting with customers in the store, calling it [live improvisation].

subevent.name: Planning and execution of the National Day tasting event
subevent.description: During the 2025 National Day holiday (October 1 to 6), Lei Mingxuan organized and held a clothing appreciation event, including planning the event theme, arranging the venue, inviting regular customers and suppliers, hosting on-site interaction, and selling new clothing. The event took up most of the National Day holiday, causing the originally planned improvisational theater rehearsal to be put aside.
subevent.location: Clothing store on the 2nd floor of a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Tasting event theme planning and materials list preparation.
subevent.description: In his home study, using a laptop and phone, Lei Mingxuan set the theme of the appreciation event as "Autumn Story · Trend Appreciation," based on the store's autumn new-season styles (such as vintage workwear and Japanese-style minimalism). He listed the required materials: sign-in table decorations, fitting room signs, printed discount coupons, themed posters, and wine and dessert supplier information. He also referenced the fashion trend report sent by his cousin Shen Jie and made an initial design for the event segments (such as a limited-time outfit challenge and a VIP customer lucky draw).
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home Study

subevent.name: Invite regular customers and suppliers.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan used the store's work phone and his personal WeChat to contact key regular customers Qian Duoduo and Feng Xiaoyu one by one, inviting them to the tasting event and informing them of exclusive offers. Then he contacted suppliers Zhou Tao (fabrics) and Wu Fang (accessories) via WeChat voice calls, inviting them to attend and provide new product display support. Lei Mingxuan also posted a preview in his WeChat Moments and sent private messages to several old customers. During the process, he recorded each invitee's confirmation status and arranged times to confirm their visit slots.
subevent.location: Clothing store on the 2nd floor of a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Venue setup and material preparation
subevent.description: In the morning, Lei Mingxuan went to the nearby stationery wholesale market and bought materials for the sign-in wall, balloons, decorative bouquets, and small gifts. In the afternoon, he returned to the store and, together with his friend Xie Fei (a basketball buddy) whom he had called over on short notice, set about decorating: they arranged the new clothing by themed areas, set up a themed poster and sign-in wall at the entrance, placed a discount coupon lucky draw box next to the fitting room, and adjusted the Bluetooth speaker to play soft music. Lei Mingxuan also brought from home some pastries made by his mother Wang Xiuying (water chestnut cake) as part of the tea break, and ordered drinks from a nearby milk tea shop.
subevent.location: Clothing store on the 2nd floor of a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Tasting event day one: reception and interaction
subevent.description: The tasting event officially began. Starting from the store's 10 AM opening, Lei Mingxuan welcomed invited guests in the store — Qian Duoduo, Feng Xiaoyu, Zhang Wei, and other friends arrived one after another. Lei Mingxuan guided guests to sign in, introduced the design concept of the new items, and hosted the first limited-time styling challenge (guests were invited to style three pieces and take photos). During the event, Pop Mart blind boxes were given away as prizes via a lucky draw. That day's sales increased by about 50% compared with a normal day, and he collected styling feedback from several guests. At 5 PM, the event ended, and Lei Mingxuan compiled the list of new customers who had booked appointments and added him on WeChat that day.
subevent.location: Clothing store on the 2nd floor of a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Day after the tasting event: in-depth exchanges and sales.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan continued to receive customers for the second day at the store, including Li Na (a childhood friend) and Zhao Min (a college classmate) who had not come the previous day, as well as several new customers who had found the store through Moments. Supplier Zhou Tao brought samples of several new autumn/winter fabrics to the store and discussed fabric trends with Lei Mingxuan and a few regular customers. Wu Fang also sent new accessories for display. Lei Mingxuan arranged a round of exclusive VIP member discounts and filmed videos of the hot-selling items at the store, which he posted to Xiaohongshu and the store's WeChat group. Sales that day remained good, though some popular styles were missing sizes in inventory.
subevent.location: Clothing store on the 2nd floor of a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Tasting event wrap-up and customer follow-ups
subevent.description: In the morning, Lei Mingxuan removed the remaining decorative materials from the tasting event, cleaned the store, and restored the usual displays. In the afternoon, he sent thank-you messages one by one via WeChat to all the customers who had come to the store, attaching a store discount coupon (valid for one month), and asked them to fill out an electronic feedback questionnaire. He organized the contact information of more than 30 potential customers gained during the tasting event and entered it into the store's CRM system. In the evening, while having dinner with his parents at home, he briefly reviewed the event's results: the total revenue was even higher than a typical week, and the customer quality was high.
subevent.location: Clothing store on the 2nd floor of a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Exhibit at the Shanghai Outdoor Camping Festival.
description: From November 1 to 2, Lei Mingxuan participated in the [Shanghai Outdoor Camping Festival] as a small exhibitor. The week before the event, Qian Duoduo and Shen Jie ran pre-event promotion through online channels such as Xiaohongshu and WeChat groups. On the first day of the event, Lei Mingxuan showcased trendy outdoor outfits at the booth and set up a hand-brewed coffee experience area, attracting a large audience. A sudden rainstorm caused the booth to leak; he quickly covered it with a spare tarp and used the opportunity to demonstrate the functionality of outdoor waterproof fabric, which instead drew even more visitors. During the event, a camping coffee equipment brand became interested in his store's hybrid business model and proactively left contact information, saying they could offer a consignment cooperation. The two-day event attracted a large number of new followers to the store's social media and online groups.

subevent.name: Pre-exhibition online warm-up promotion
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan, together with his friends Qian Duoduo and Shen Jie, planned an online pre-promotion campaign. Qian Duoduo used her new media operations experience to publish the exhibition preview and trendy outdoor outfit guides on Xiaohongshu; Shen Jie leveraged her fashion buyer resources to share exhibition information in industry WeChat groups and Moments. The three carried out a week of interactive promotion through online channels to attract the attention of potential visitors and customers.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home/online work

subevent.name: Held an online pre-event planning meeting
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan, Qian Duoduo, and Shen Jie discussed the pre-exhibition online warm-up plan via a WeChat video conference. Qian Duoduo proposed publishing styling guides on Xiaohongshu, and Shen Jie suggested leveraging industry WeChat groups and Moments for promotion. The three confirmed their respective roles, content themes, and schedules, and developed a one-week interactive publicity rhythm. After the meeting, Lei Mingxuan organized the meeting minutes and sent them to the three-person group chat.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home (remote work)

subevent.name: Qian Duoduo published a teaser post on Xiaohongshu
subevent.description: Qian Duoduo published the first exhibition warm-up note on her personal Xiaohongshu account, titled "An Outdoor Outfit Guide Secretly Kept by a Shanghai Clothing Store Owner," based on the autumn/winter new arrivals from Lei Mingxuan's store and illustrated with several trendy outfits. She also added exhibition preview tags and related topics. Lei Mingxuan interacted and replied to user questions in the comments, while Shen Jie reposted the note to her own WeChat Moments and liked it.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Qian Duoduo's home / online

subevent.name: Shen Jie shared the exhibition information in industry group chats and on WeChat Moments.
subevent.description: Shen Jie used her connections in the fashion buying circle to send the electronic invitation and preview poster for Lei Mingxuan's store exhibition to 5 industry exchange groups (each with about 200-300 people), along with a brief recommendation. She also posted a photo-text post on her WeChat Moments introducing the exhibition highlights and the featured selections of Lei Mingxuan's store. Lei Mingxuan replied with thanks in the groups and invited friends to share.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at Shen Jie's home / online

subevent.name: On the last day of the event, carry out focused promotion and summarize the results.
subevent.description: On the last day of pre-promotion, Qian Duoduo released a preview video of new products for the exhibition day, along with the booth number and transportation guide. Shen Jie launched a "check in at the exhibition and get a small gift" activity on WeChat Moments, encouraging friends to come to the store and take photos. Lei Mingxuan compiled the online data from the past week (total exposure and engagement of Xiaohongshu notes, WeChat group interaction count, and number of private message reservations), conducted an online review with Qian Duoduo and Shen Jie, summarized effective strategies and areas for improvement, and prepared for the next day's exhibition.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home/online work

subevent.name: First day of the exhibition: booth operations and dealing with emergencies
subevent.description: November 1, 2025 was the opening day of the Shanghai Outdoor Camping Festival. Lei Mingxuan was at a booth outside a store in a mall on Century Avenue, showcasing carefully selected trendy outdoor wear items and setting up a pour-over coffee experience area, which attracted many visitors to stop and try. A sudden afternoon rain caused part of the booth to leak. Lei Mingxuan quickly covered it with a spare tent tarp he had brought, and took the opportunity to demonstrate the functionality of the outdoor waterproof fabric to the onlookers, which instead increased the booth's popularity. During this time, a camping coffee equipment brand became interested in the store's 'clothing + coffee experience' combination model, proactively left its contact information, and said it could offer a consignment partnership.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Shanghai Outdoor Camping Festival booth

subevent.name: Second day at the exhibition: continuous display and interaction
subevent.description: On November 2, 2025, the second day of the exhibition, Lei Mingxuan continued to showcase trendy outdoor apparel at the booth, kept the pour-over coffee experience going, and talked styling tips with new and existing customers. He actively collected visitor feedback, guided visitors to scan the store's QR code to join the online community, and sorted through the contact information of potential customers collected the day before. Over the two days, the store attracted a large number of new followers to its social media and online groups.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Shanghai Outdoor Camping Festival booth

subevent.name: Post-event customer follow-up and review
subevent.description: After the exhibition, Lei Mingxuan grouped the new followers and proactively contacted the camping coffee equipment brand that had left contact information at the exhibition to discuss details of a consignment cooperation. Meanwhile, he reviewed the exhibition results with Qian Duoduo and Shen Jie, summarized the strengths and weaknesses of the product display and interaction segments, and planned to integrate the hand-brewed coffee experience into the store's daily operations to enhance the appeal of its mixed-use business format.
subevent.location: Shanghai - in store / at home

subevent.name: Added fan group management at the expo.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan was in the store, using his phone and computer to organize the new customer information collected during the exhibition, grouping it by level of intent and interest tags (such as fashion, outdoor, coffee, etc.), and importing the data into the store's CRM system to prepare for subsequent precision marketing.
subevent.location: Shanghai - inside the store

subevent.name: Contact the camping coffee equipment brand manufacturer to discuss consignment sales
subevent.description: Based on the business cards collected at the exhibition, Lei Mingxuan proactively called the person in charge of a camping coffee equipment brand. Through a WeChat video call, he showed the store environment and the fit with the customer base. The two sides conducted initial communication on the terms of the consignment cooperation (supply price, settlement cycle, initial shipment quantity, return and exchange policy, etc.), and agreed on a time to later mail samples and sign the contract.
subevent.location: Shanghai - inside the store

subevent.name: Reviewed the exhibition with Qian Duoduo and Shen Jie and planned new business formats
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan invited regular customer Qian Duoduo and his cousin Shen Jie to his clothing store. The three reviewed the product display methods, interactive segments, and audience feedback from the exhibition. Qian Duoduo suggested strengthening short-video recording from a new media communication perspective, while Shen Jie pointed out highlights in product selection and styling from a fashion buyer's viewpoint. After summarizing, Lei Mingxuan discussed with them specific plans to bring the pour-over coffee experience from the exhibition into the store's daily operations (such as setting up a coffee corner, training staff, and cooperating with brands), and they formulated a trial plan for the following week.
subevent.location: Shanghai - inside the store

name: Billiards match with Han Dong to let off steam
description: After successfully grabbing deals during the Double Eleven shopping rush, Lei Mingxuan invited his regular billiards partner Han Dong to their usual billiards hall for a friendly match. The two shared the joy of scoring blind boxes while playing, and Han Dong was full of praise for the steampunk co-branded edition. Lei Mingxuan also mentioned his worries about upgrading the store, and Han Dong, drawing on his auto repair industry experience, advised him to [play it steady and first do well with the existing product categories]. The relaxed game eased the recent pressure of preparations.

subevent.name: Scheduled a billiards game.
subevent.description: After successfully grabbing what he wanted during the Double 11 (Singles' Day) shopping spree, Lei Mingxuan contacted his billiards buddy Han Dong via WeChat and arranged to play a game that afternoon at their usual billiards hall. He also shared his excitement about scoring a trendy blind box. Han Dong readily agreed, and the two decided to meet at 3 p.m. at the Feilong Billiards Club near Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home

subevent.name: Head to the pool hall
subevent.description: Around 2:30 p.m., Lei Mingxuan left his home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, and walked to Feilong Billiards Club. On the way, he was in a good mood, browsing close-up photos of blind boxes on his phone, and expected to arrive in about ten minutes.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Zhangyang Road

subevent.name: Billiards match and exchange
subevent.description: From 3 to 5 p.m., Lei Mingxuan and Han Dong started an American eight-ball match at Feilong Billiards Club. The two chatted while playing. Lei Mingxuan took out the steampunk co-branded blind box he had just managed to grab and shared it with Han Dong, who examined it carefully and was full of praise. Later, Lei Mingxuan brought up his worries about upgrading the store. Han Dong, drawing on his experience in the auto repair industry, suggested that he first stabilize the existing product categories before considering expansion. The relaxed match eased Lei Mingxuan's anxiety.
subevent.location: Shanghai-Pudong New Area-Feilong Billiards Club

name: After the personal training trial class, purchased a course and adjusted the spending budget.
description: On the evening of December 12, after a personal training trial session, Lei Mingxuan immediately decided to buy 10 personal training sessions and paid 4,800 yuan via WeChat. This expense accounted for 30% of his personal consumption budget for that month. He placed it under the 'health investment' category and reduced his other entertainment spending for the month. He planned to have personal training twice a week, combined with self-directed practice, to build a solid foundation for the Western Sichuan road trip and long-term health goals.

subevent.name: After the personal training trial class, decided to purchase the course.
subevent.description: On the evening of December 12, after completing a personal training trial session at a fitness studio in Pudong New Area, Lei Mingxuan discussed his health goals (self-driving in western Sichuan and long-term fitness) with the coach. After about 15 minutes of consideration, he decided to buy a package of 10 personal training sessions and confirmed the fee of 4,800 yuan.
subevent.location: A fitness studio in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Paid the personal training course fee via WeChat Pay.
subevent.description: That evening, Lei Mingxuan transferred 4,800 yuan to the fitness studio via WeChat Pay on his phone, purchased 10 personal training sessions, and took a screenshot of the payment receipt as proof. This expense accounted for 30% of his personal spending budget for that month, and he categorized it under 'health investment.'
subevent.location: A fitness studio in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Adjust the current month's personal spending budget
subevent.description: After completing the payment, Lei Mingxuan updated the December spending budget in his mobile bookkeeping app, increasing the 'health investment' category by 4,800 yuan while reducing the budget for entertainment and other non-essential expenses for the month (such as cutting one dinner with friends and the plan to buy designer toys), ensuring the total budget stayed within limits.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - home study

name: Completed preparations for the blind box sales area and officially launched it.
description: From October 1 to October 4, Lei Mingxuan planned the blind box area in the store, contacted regular customers to research the market, installed shelves and display props, and received and put on shelves popular designer toy blind boxes such as Pop Mart. On October 5, he officially launched the blind box selling area, promoted it through WeChat Moments and customer groups to attract National Day holiday traffic, and sales were booming on site.

subevent.name: Officially launched the blind box sales area
subevent.description: On October 5, Lei Mingxuan officially opened a blind box sales area in the store, neatly displaying the prepared blind boxes and placing eye-catching guide signs. At the same time, he posted messages on Moments and the customer WeChat group to announce the opening of the new area, attracting National Day holiday customers to come in and shop. That day, trendy toy sales in the store were booming, and Lei Mingxuan also introduced blind box series to customers on site and answered questions about collecting.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Personal trainer trial session and fitness assessment guidance
description: On the evening of December 12, Lei Mingxuan used the free personal training trial session included with his activated annual membership and received a fitness assessment and guidance from a professional coach. The coach evaluated his body fat percentage (27.04) and muscle mass, pointed out the risk of mild fatty liver, and tailored a plan combining strength and cardio for him, correcting his squat and deadlift form. Lei Mingxuan experienced the efficiency of systematic training and decided to purchase the course.

subevent.name: Going to the gym
subevent.description: On the evening of December 12, Lei Mingxuan left home or his shop and walked or drove to a gym in Pudong New District to attend a scheduled free personal training trial class.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - en route to the gym

subevent.name: Physical fitness test and health assessment
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan underwent a fitness assessment with a professional coach at the gym, including measurements of body fat percentage (27.04), muscle mass, and other indicators. The coach evaluated the results, noted that he was overweight and at risk of mild fatty liver, and recorded the data for future planning.
subevent.location: Body testing area at a gym in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Experiential training and sharing of reflections
subevent.description: Under the coach's guidance, Lei Mingxuan actually tried several core training movements (such as squats, deadlifts, bench presses, etc.) and experienced the muscle engagement and efficiency gains of systematic training. Through talking with the coach, he recognized the value of professional guidance and became confident in his fitness results.
subevent.location: Equipment area of a gym in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Decide to purchase the course and end the trip
subevent.description: After the trial class, Lei Mingxuan talked with the coach about the course price and plan, decided on the spot to buy follow-up personal training sessions, and completed the relevant purchase procedures. He then left the gym and returned home.
subevent.location: Front desk of a gym in Pudong New Area, Shanghai / home

name: Learning coffee brewing skills to improve the experience area
description: On November 19 and 26, Lei Mingxuan spent his evenings at a professional coffee studio introduced by a friend learning hand-drip coffee and basic latte art techniques. He hoped that improving coffee quality would boost the appeal of the store's coffee experience area, and combine it with the outdoor camping theme to prepare for upcoming activities. After the two sessions, he had basically mastered the essentials of hand-drip brewing, and planned to set up a permanent coffee corner after the store upgrade.

subevent.name: Contact a friend to inquire about a coffee studio and book a learning session.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan contacted college classmate Wang Lei via WeChat to learn more about the specific address, course schedule, and fees of the coffee studio Wang Lei had recommended, and booked a beginner hand-drip coffee course for the evening of November 19. Wang Lei provided the studio owner's contact information. Lei Mingxuan then spoke with the studio manager by phone and confirmed spots for the courses on the evenings of the 19th and 26th.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Learning pour-over coffee techniques for the first time
subevent.description: At 7 p.m., Lei Mingxuan arrived at the professional coffee studio in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, recommended by Wang Lei, and met the coffee trainer, Teacher Chen. Under Teacher Chen's guidance, he first learned the basics of coffee bean origins, roast levels, and grind sizes, and then focused on practicing the pouring technique, water temperature control, and blooming time for pour-over coffee. After about two hours of hands-on practice, Lei Mingxuan basically mastered the complete pour-over coffee process and tasted the first cup of pour-over coffee he made himself.
subevent.location: A coffee studio in Pudong New District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Second session learning basic latte art techniques.
subevent.description: At 7 PM, Lei Mingxuan returned to the same coffee studio and learned basic latte art techniques under Teacher Chen's guidance. He first practiced the essentials of frothing milk, including controlling milk temperature and the angle of the steam wand, then tried simple heart-shaped latte art on espresso. Through repeated practice, he successfully produced a basically shaped heart pattern. After class, Lei Mingxuan talked with Teacher Chen about combining coffee with outdoor camping themes, and took away some practice coffee beans and small tools, planning to try again when he returned to the store.
subevent.location: A coffee studio in Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Wisdom tooth extraction surgery.
description: On the afternoon of December 5, after a week of recurrent inflammation and pain in his right lower wisdom tooth, Lei Mingxuan booked a dental clinic appointment in advance and underwent surgery to have two wisdom teeth extracted. The surgery took about 40 minutes. Afterward, his face was slightly swollen, and the doctor instructed him to rest for a day and apply cold compresses. He recuperated at home that evening; his mother specially cooked soft noodles, while his father grumbled that he “should have had them pulled out long ago.” This visit forced him to pause his fitness routine for a week, but it also put an end to the hidden trouble of wisdom tooth inflammation.

subevent.name: Went to the hospital to have his wisdom teeth removed.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan went to the dental clinic at the scheduled time. After local anesthesia, the doctor removed two wisdom teeth from the right side of his lower jaw. The procedure lasted about 40 minutes and went smoothly. Afterward, the doctor told him to rest for a day and apply cold compresses to his face to reduce swelling, and prescribed anti-inflammatory medication. He paid the surgery costs out of pocket and left the hospital with slight facial swelling.
subevent.location: A dental clinic in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Recovered at home on the night after the surgery
subevent.description: After the procedure, Lei Mingxuan returned to his home on Zhangyang Road in Pudong New Area. His mother, Wang Xiuying, cooked him soft noodles. Following the doctor's advice, he applied a cold compress to his face and took anti-inflammatory medication. His father, Lei Jianguo, grumbled that he should have gone to get it pulled long ago, but was concerned about his condition. He went to bed early that night and paused his usual running.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - living room and bedroom at home

subevent.name: Post-surgery recovery and suspension of workouts.
subevent.description: During the week after surgery (December 6 to December 12), Lei Mingxuan continued to recuperate at home. His diet was mainly liquid and soft foods, avoiding spicy and irritating foods, and he applied cold compresses and took medication on time. He strictly followed the doctor's advice and suspended all fitness activities (including running, basketball, roller skating, etc.) to allow the wound to heal fully. During this period, he handled clothing store matters remotely via his phone or computer to ensure the store operated normally.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home

subevent.name: Day 1 of home recovery after surgery (December 6)
subevent.description: On the first day after surgery, Lei Mingxuan returned home from the hospital, with his mother Wang Xiuying helping arrange his meals. He had mainly liquid foods all day (rice porridge, clear broth), avoiding spicy and irritating food. He applied an ice pack to the wound area on schedule, 15 minutes each time, at 2-hour intervals, and took oral anti-inflammatory medication. In the afternoon, he logged into the store's backend system via his phone to check the day's sales data and communicated remotely with staff about inventory adjustments and customer feedback to ensure the store operated normally. In the evening, he rested in bed and moved around less.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home
