subevent.name: Day 2 of home recovery after surgery (December 7)
subevent.description: On the second day after surgery, Lei Mingxuan continued recuperating at home. Breakfast was steamed egg and rice cereal, lunch was soft noodles, and he stuck to a soft-food diet. He continued cold-compressing the wound and, as directed by the doctor, changed the frequency to once every three hours. In the morning, he handled the new fabric sample photos sent by Zhou Tao, the clothing store supplier, and decided to place a small trial order. In the afternoon, he had a video call with the shop staff and guided the setup of the weekend promotional activities. In the evening, accompanied by his father Lei Jianguo, he walked slowly in the residential compound for 10 minutes, but felt slight discomfort at the wound and immediately went back to rest.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home

subevent.name: Home recovery after surgery, day 3 (December 8).
subevent.description: On the third day after surgery, the pain in the wound was significantly reduced. His diet was adjusted to semi-liquid food, with steamed fish and tofu soup added. In the morning, Lei Mingxuan called his friend Zhang Wei, told him about his recovery from the operation, and politely declined the invitation to a weekend gathering. In the afternoon, he checked the store's online orders using his computer, found a large group-buying intention, and immediately contacted his regular customer Qian Duoduo to confirm the requirements. Afterward, he did some light stretching in the living room, avoiding pulling the wound. At night, he took his medication on time and went to bed early.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home

subevent.name: Day 4 of home recovery after surgery (December 9)
subevent.description: On the fourth day after surgery, Lei Mingxuan began trying to walk slowly indoors. After breakfast, he sat at his desk using a laptop to handle store accounts and check last month's sales profit. At noon, his mother made Shanghai-style braised pork (stewed until soft and tender), and he tried a few small pieces. In the afternoon, he chatted with his cousin Shen Jie on WeChat; Shen Jie recommended several new styles for next spring, and he planned to check them out after recovery. The wound no longer showed obvious redness or swelling; he stopped the medication but continued cold compresses twice a day.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home

subevent.name: Day 5 of home recovery after surgery (December 10)
subevent.description: On the fifth day after surgery, his recovery was going well. Lei Mingxuan's diet had basically returned to normal, but he still avoided spicy and overly hard foods. In the morning, he did simple rehabilitation exercises at home (such as slow walking and upper-limb stretching) for about 20 minutes. He chatted with his childhood friend Li Na on WeChat about recent news. Li Na suggested that he could take a short trip to Hangzhou to relax after the stitches were removed. In the afternoon, he remotely attended an online meeting organized by the mall property management for the Spring Festival event preparations, and discussed the storefront decoration renovation plan with the property manager Zheng Kai.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home

subevent.name: Post-surgery home recovery, day 6 (December 11)
subevent.description: On the sixth day after surgery, Lei Mingxuan felt his energy returning and spent more time active indoors. He used a mobile app to share his recovery progress with billiard buddies Han Dong and Qin Lang, and agreed to play together next week after he recovered. In the morning, he organized his designer toy collection, photographed several Pop Mart blind boxes and posted them to the collector group, and discussed recent market trends with Lin Jing. In the afternoon, he continued following up on store daily operations remotely and arranged for staff to adjust the shelves next week. The wound was healing well with no discharge, and he planned to contact the hospital the next day to have the stitches removed.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home

subevent.name: Day 7 of home recovery after surgery (December 12)
subevent.description: Postoperative day seven, also the last day of home recovery. Lei Mingxuan called the hospital in the morning to confirm the stitch-removal appointment (scheduled for December 13) and asked about post-removal precautions. He kept a light diet all day and reduced cold compress frequency to once. He carefully reviewed next week's store schedule and orders to ensure he could smoothly return to work. In the evening he chatted with his parents at home and thanked them for their care. He completely paused all fitness, running, basketball, and roller skating activities, planning to gradually resume after the stitches are removed.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home

name: Blind box arrival display drives sales
description: On November 15, the blind boxes arrived. Lei Mingxuan opened one and got a hidden edition, which attracted many collector friends asking about it. He placed one he kept for himself in the store's blind box sales area as a display, took photos styled with techwear and uploaded them to Xiaohongshu, attracting new collector customers. That month, sales of designer toys grew 15% month over month. This display continued until the end of the month, adding a new highlight to the store.

subevent.name: Blind box arrival and unboxing display
subevent.description: On November 15, 2025, Lei Mingxuan received a batch of blind boxes he had ordered earlier. While unboxing them in the store, he pulled a rare hidden figure. He kept the hidden figure for himself and placed it in a prominent spot in the store's blind box sales area as a display, and also took photos with his techwear outfit that day to prepare for a later Xiaohongshu post.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Sharing hidden items and outfits on Xiaohongshu
subevent.description: That afternoon, Lei Mingxuan edited the photos he had taken of the hidden-edition blind box and techwear-style outfits, uploaded them to his Xiaohongshu account, and added attractive captions and tags to promote the store's designer toy features and personal styling. The post quickly received likes and comments, drawing attention from online collectors.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Offline consultation and interaction with collector customers
subevent.description: Since posting on Xiaohongshu on November 15, for several consecutive days online collectors and in-store customers have expressed interest in the displayed hidden blind boxes, inquiring via WeChat or at the store. Lei Mingxuan warmly received them, shared his unboxing experience, and guided customers to notice the store's blind boxes and other designer toys. Some customers immediately bought other blind boxes or matching apparel, which drove related sales.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: First-day online collector consultations and in-store warm-up.
subevent.description: In the morning, Lei Mingxuan tidied up the blind box display area in the shop, placing the hidden-edition blind boxes in a prominent position, and updated his WeChat Moments and several designer toy collector groups to draw attention. In the afternoon, online collectors who had commented under the November 15 Xiaohongshu post gradually came to ask about the hidden-edition details via WeChat private chats. Lei Mingxuan replied to each one, sharing his excitement when unboxing and the detailed photos he took, and invited them to visit the store to see other designer toys and clothing when free. At the same time, a few passers-by were attracted by the blind boxes in the display area and came in to ask. Lei Mingxuan introduced them enthusiastically and took the opportunity to recommend matching designer toy T-shirts and hats, selling 2 T-shirts and 1 regular blind box on the spot.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Regular customers came to the store for in-depth conversations and purchases
subevent.description: Around 2 p.m., regular customer Qian Duoduo (Qianqian) saw the Moments post and made a special trip to the store. She and Lei Mingxuan had a detailed exchange for about 40 minutes about the craftsmanship, series background, and collection value of the hidden-edition blind boxes. Lei Mingxuan took out the actual item for her to handle and shared other series from his own collection. Qian Duoduo was very interested and immediately bought two regular blind boxes from the same series and a co-branded hoodie. After that, another collector who had made an appointment via WeChat (online collector B) arrived. Lei Mingxuan received them just as warmly, showed the hidden edition, and guided them to browse the newly arrived trendy accessories. That collector bought one blind box and a pair of earrings. In total, about 5 groups of customers were received during the day, 3 of which entered because of the blind box display.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Ongoing customer consultations and a peak in styling-driven sales
subevent.description: After the past two days of word spreading, more customers and collectors came to ask. In the morning, Lei Mingxuan replied to more than a dozen online collectors' questions via WeChat and set up a temporary blind box interest group, in which he shared more photos of the shop's designer toys and clothing. In the afternoon, the shop saw a small rush, including Feng Xiaoyu (Sister Xiaoyu), whom he had met before, who happened to be on a business trip in Shanghai and dropped by. Feng Xiaoyu was very interested in the design stories behind the hidden editions, and Lei Mingxuan gave a vivid explanation based on his own collecting experience. Although Feng Xiaoyu did not buy a blind box, she bought two new dresses as support. In addition, three unfamiliar young customers came in, all of whom had made a special trip after seeing the post on Xiaohongshu. Lei Mingxuan guided them through the store, focusing on matching blind boxes with the shop's trendy apparel. Two customers each bought a full outfit, and the other bought three blind boxes. Total sales for the day were about 1,200 yuan, with more than half driven by the blind box topic.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Online viral growth and offline interaction consolidation
subevent.description: In the morning, Lei Mingxuan organized the sales data and customer feedback from the previous days and rearranged the blind box area in the store, adding more designer toy merchandise and outfit-matching references. At noon, he launched a "share your purchase and get a gift" event in the blind box interest group, encouraging customers who had bought to share photos. In the afternoon, three group members (who did not know each other) met at the store. Lei Mingxuan organized a small meetup and shared more unboxing tips and collecting insights. Later, two young women who were first-time visitors were attracted by the lively atmosphere and, after learning more, each bought one blind box. About 10 customers came to the store throughout the day, and 7 of them had come directly because of the blind box topic. Lei Mingxuan also did a video call on WeChat with a collector from Hangzhou (a potential customer), showed the blind boxes in the store online, and recommended matching outfits for them. The other person said they would visit the store next time they came to Shanghai.

participant.name: H, a collector friend from Hangzhou

subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Event wrap-up and repurchase guidance
subevent.description: On the last day, online inquiries cooled somewhat, but there were still a few questions. Lei Mingxuan focused on following up with prospective customers who had asked earlier but not bought, sending each of them store coupons and a preview of new blind boxes. At noon, a friend of the previous customer Qian Duoduo (Ms. I) came to the store. Lei Mingxuan accompanied her throughout the shopping trip, and she bought four blind boxes and one coat. In the afternoon, Lei Mingxuan sorted and packed several blind-box parcels that had been sold, sending them to online collector friends elsewhere via same-city courier. At the same time, he placed a small message board in the store, inviting customers to write down their expectations for blind boxes and designer toys, and took photos to post on WeChat Moments as a memento of the event. Daily sales were about 800 yuan, and he also accumulated a customer list for the upcoming 'Christmas Designer Toy Theme Week' event.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Blind box display keeps attracting customers and driving new customer conversion
subevent.description: The hidden-edition blind boxes remained on display in the store's display area. With the store's lighting and layout, they became a major highlight. During this period, Lei Mingxuan continued to interact online, and through word-of-mouth from customers, more new customers were attracted to the store. This month, sales of designer toys grew 15% month-on-month, and the display method was kept until the end of the month.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Adjust the blind box display and lighting layout.
subevent.description: After arriving at the store in the morning, Lei Mingxuan personally adjusted the placement of the hidden-edition blind boxes in the display area, putting them in the most eye-catching spot. He also readjusted the spotlights so they focused on the blind boxes, highlighting their texture and gloss, and checked the stability of the display rack to make sure the entire display was clean and attractive.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Posted a blind box display and interacted online.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan used his phone to take beautiful photos and a 15-second short video of the blind box display area. After carefully retouching them, he posted them to his personal WeChat Moments, the designer toy community, and the store manager's dedicated customer group. The caption introduced the rarity and design highlights of the hidden edition. He then actively replied to comments and private messages, inviting interested friends to visit the store and see the display.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Received regular customer Qian Duoduo and her new friend visiting the store.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, regular customer Qian Duoduo came to the store with two new friends (Ms. Li and Ms. Wang). Lei Mingxuan greeted them warmly and personally showed them around the blind box display area, explained in detail the stories behind the hidden editions and their design details, and recommended several matching outfits and accessories. As a result, Qian Duoduo bought a new jacket, and the two new friends each bought a set of blind boxes.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Compile trendy toy sales figures and analyze growth
subevent.description: During his free time in the afternoon, Lei Mingxuan exported this month's (through November 28) designer toy sales data from the cashier system, compared it with October's data, calculated that this month's sales increased 15% month-over-month, recorded it in the store's business log, and analyzed that the growth was mainly due to the display of hidden blind boxes and online promotion.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Thanksgiving family reunion
description: From the afternoon to the evening of November 27, to spend Thanksgiving with his parents, Lei Mingxuan closed the clothing store early at 4 p.m. and bought fruit on his way home. From 6 p.m. to 7:30 p.m., the family of three enjoyed a hearty dinner prepared by his mother. Lei Mingxuan thanked his parents for their support, and his father gave him advice on the shop. After dinner, Lei Mingxuan helped clear the dishes, and then the family ate fruit and chatted in the living room. By 8:30 p.m., they each went to rest, and the family gathering ended on a happy note.

subevent.name: Closed the store early to get ready to go home
subevent.description: On Thanksgiving afternoon, in order to have dinner with his parents, Lei Mingxuan closed his clothing store early at around 4 p.m. After briefly telling his staff the next day's work arrangements and sorting out the day's accounts and merchandise, he set off from his store in a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, and walked home. On the way, he stopped by the fruit shop downstairs to buy a basket of fresh fruit his parents liked.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - clothing store in a mall on Century Avenue, and home on Zhangyang Road

subevent.name: Shared a Thanksgiving family dinner together.
subevent.description: From 6 to 7:30 p.m., Lei Mingxuan's family of three sat around the dining table at home and began to enjoy Thanksgiving dinner. His mother, Wang Xiuying, kept putting food on her son's plate, while his father, Lei Jianguo, ate and asked with concern about the shop's operations, offering some suggestions on adjusting the product mix and online promotion. Lei Mingxuan listened carefully and shared his recent plans. During the meal, the three chatted about family matters and neighborhood anecdotes, and the atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - dining room at home on Zhangyang Road

subevent.name: After-meal cleanup and family leisure
subevent.description: From 7:30 to 8:30 p.m., after dinner, Lei Mingxuan proactively helped clear the dishes and the table. Together with his mother, he put the leftover food into the refrigerator and washed the utensils. His father, Lei Jianguo, sat on the living room sofa and turned on the TV to play the news. After cleaning up, Lei Mingxuan cut fruit and brought it to the living room. The three of them chatted while eating fruit, after which Lei Mingxuan returned to his room to deal with some store messages on his phone, while his parents washed up and rested. The Thanksgiving family gathering came to a successful end.
subevent.location: Home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Farewell basketball game and closing the loop on old friendship
description: On December 20, Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to invite Xie Fei and other basketball buddies to play a farewell basketball game. After the game, he candidly said that during the critical entrepreneurship period in 2026, it would be hard to guarantee time for playing ball, but he thanked them for their years of companionship. Xie Fei hugged him understandingly and said, 'Basketball buddies for life.' The old basketball friends achieved reconciliation and closure in a warm way.

subevent.name: Contact and invite billiards buddies to a farewell match
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan contacted his basketball buddy Xie Fei via WeChat, explaining that due to the critical period of starting his business in 2026, he would no longer be able to play regularly, and hoped to organize a farewell basketball game. He asked Xie Fei to help notify the other regular playing partners, and agreed to hold the farewell game on December 20 at the outdoor basketball court of Yuanshen Sports Center in Pudong, thanking everyone for their companionship over the years.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home (contacted via mobile WeChat)

subevent.name: Heading to the court to gather and prepare
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Lei Mingxuan put on his jersey and basketball shoes in advance, took his basketball, and left home for the outdoor basketball court at Pudong Yuanshen Sports Center. After arriving, he met up with Xie Fei and other basketball buddies who arrived one after another, and began warm-up preparations.
subevent.location: Yuanshen Sports Center Outdoor Basketball Court, Pudong, Shanghai

subevent.name: Had a farewell basketball game.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan, Xie Fei, and their mutual friends split into two teams and played an intense farewell basketball game on the court. Both sides gave it their all, running, shooting, and defending, enjoying their last time playing together, with the court filled with laughter and sweat.
subevent.location: Yuanshen Sports Center Outdoor Basketball Court, Pudong, Shanghai

subevent.name: Candid exchange and warm farewell after the match
subevent.description: After the basketball game ended, Lei Mingxuan gathered Xie Fei and the other ball buddies in a circle and honestly told them that in 2026, because of the critical period of starting his own business, it would be hard to guarantee regular playing time. He also expressed heartfelt gratitude for their companionship over the years of playing together every week. Xie Fei stepped forward and hugged Lei Mingxuan, saying, 'Basketball buddies for life.' The others also came forward to shake hands, hug, and offer good wishes. The old basketball friends completed a reconciliation and emotional closure in a warm way.
subevent.location: Yuanshen Sports Center Outdoor Basketball Court, Pudong, Shanghai

name: Advance the preliminary work for the urban techwear pop-up exhibition.
description: From November 21 to 25, 2025, Lei Mingxuan carried out a series of preliminary preparations for the December urban techwear pop-up exhibition co-organized with his college classmate Zhao Min. On November 21, in his home study in Pudong New Area, he sorted out clothing and designer toy combinations that could be exhibited, made an initial list, and took photos. On the 22nd, the two met at a café in Jing'an District to discuss the plan in detail. Zhao Min suggested zoning and interactive ideas for the venue, and Lei Mingxuan presented the list. They finally clarified the division of labor, with Lei responsible for exhibit display and Zhao responsible for planning and execution, and set a timeline for progress. On the 25th, Lei Mingxuan organized the meeting minutes at his clothing store on Century Avenue, confirmed the division of labor with Zhao Min via WeChat, and began contacting suppliers for price quotes and going to the accessories market to gather decorative materials, officially starting the procurement preparation. This series of actions pushed the pop-up exhibition cooperation a big step forward.

subevent.name: Organize the list of items available for display
subevent.description: In his home study (No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai), Lei Mingxuan sorted through the store's clothing and designer toys suitable for the urban techwear theme, drew up a preliminary exhibit list, and took photos for reference, preparing for the next day's discussion with Zhao Min.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home Study

subevent.name: Met with Zhao Min to discuss the pop-up exhibition plan.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan arrived at a café in Jing'an District, Shanghai at the agreed time and met his college classmate Zhao Min. The two had a detailed discussion about the urban techwear pop-up exhibition to be co-hosted in December: Zhao Min, drawing on her exhibition planning experience, proposed suggestions for venue zoning, lighting design, and interactive check-in installations; Lei Mingxuan showed the exhibit list he had compiled and added ideas for pairing designer toys. The two finally settled on an initial division of labor (Lei Mingxuan responsible for the supply and display of exhibits and designer toys, Zhao Min responsible for overall planning and on-site execution) and an implementation timeline (material preparation starting next week, then meeting once a week afterward).
subevent.location: Shanghai - Jing'an District - Coffee Shop

subevent.name: Organize the meeting minutes and confirm the division of responsibilities.
subevent.description: During free time at the store (Store A-208, 2nd Floor, a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai), Lei Mingxuan organized detailed meeting minutes based on the November 22 discussion with Zhao Min, including the exhibit list, venue setup points, materials requirement list, and division of labor for each stage, and sent them to Zhao Min via WeChat for confirmation. At the same time, Lei Mingxuan began estimating the costs of the required materials to prepare for subsequent purchasing.
subevent.location: Clothing store at Century Avenue Mall, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Start preparations for material procurement.
subevent.description: Following the schedule set at the meeting, Lei Mingxuan started preparing materials for the pop-up exhibition that same day. He first contacted supplier Zhou Tao (Hangzhou Taosheng Apparel) to inquire about special fabric samples, then went to large stationery markets and advertising material stores near Pudong New Area to collect decorative materials and prop samples for the exhibition, as preliminary research for subsequent bulk procurement.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - shopping malls and surrounding accessory markets

name: Daily Japanese study check-in: moving on to simple conversations.
description: Throughout September, Lei Mingxuan kept up his daily Japanese study check-ins, steadily advancing from the Japanese syllabary to simple everyday conversation, and joined an online study group for mutual accountability. He integrated study into his commute and rest breaks, laying the groundwork for future coffee equipment treasure hunts and cultural exchanges in Japan.

subevent.name: Prepare Japanese learning resources and join a study group
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan bought the introductory Japanese textbook 'Standard Japanese' (Beginner level) on Taobao, downloaded learning apps such as Duolingo and HelloTalk from the phone app store, and joined an online study group called 'Japanese Study Check-in Mutual Aid Group' via Baidu Tieba, agreeing with group members to check in daily and supervise each other. At his desk at home, he also made a September study plan: focus on mastering the gojūon in the first two weeks, and practice simple daily conversations in the last two weeks.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Buy beginner Japanese textbooks
subevent.description: At his home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Lei Mingxuan opened the Taobao app on his phone, searched for “Standard Japanese Beginner Textbook,” compared store ratings and prices, chose a bookstore with a good reputation, ordered the two beginner volumes of “Standard Japanese,” and paid for the books.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Download a Japanese language learning mobile app
subevent.description: At his home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Lei Mingxuan used his smartphone to go into the Apple App Store and the Android app store, where he searched for, downloaded, and installed two Japanese learning apps: Duolingo for basic vocabulary and grammar practice, and HelloTalk for communicating with native speakers. After installation, he registered an account and briefly browsed the app interface features.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Joined a Japanese study check-in group
subevent.description: At his home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Lei Mingxuan opened Baidu Tieba on his computer, searched for the "Japanese Learning" forum, found the QQ group number for the "Japanese Learning Check-in Mutual Aid Group" in a pinned post, copied it, opened QQ, and requested to join the group chat. After joining the group, he posted a newcomer greeting, had a brief exchange with group members, and read the group announcement to understand the daily check-in rules.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Make a Japanese study plan for September.
subevent.description: At his desk at home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Lei Mingxuan took out a brand-new notebook and pen. Based on the textbooks he had purchased and the apps he had downloaded, and combining the experience of other learners in the study group, he made a four-week Japanese study plan for September: in weeks one and two, focus on mastering the gojūon (including reading and writing hiragana and katakana); in weeks three and four, practice simple daily conversations (including greetings, self-introductions, etc.). He also decided to check in on Duolingo for 30 minutes every day and have one conversation per week with a language partner on HelloTalk.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: The essay Alleyway Morning Mist was officially published.
description: On December 20, Lei Mingxuan received an email from the editor of Shanghai Literature magazine, informing him that his submitted essay “Morning Mist in the Alleyway” had been accepted and would be published in that month's “Urban Memory” column, along with a contribution fee of 600 yuan. He excitedly shared the news with his family. His mother held the magazine with slightly reddened eyes, while his father put on reading glasses and read it carefully. The essay delicately depicted the morning scenes of an old Pudong alleyway and incorporated the past stories his mother had told him, becoming the first formal publication in his writing career and gaining him a certain degree of literary recognition for his future long-form writing.

subevent.name: Received the prose acceptance email
subevent.description: On the morning of December 20, 2025, while checking his personal email on his phone in his clothing store in a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Lei Mingxuan found an email from the editor of Shanghai Literature magazine. The email informed him that his submitted essay "Morning Mist in the Longtang" had been accepted and would appear in that month's "Urban Memory" column, with a payment of 600 yuan. Lei Mingxuan was pleasantly surprised and excited, and quickly replied to the email to express thanks and confirmation.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2F, Century Avenue Mall, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (inside the clothing store)

subevent.name: Called his mother to tell her the good news
subevent.description: After receiving the acceptance email, Lei Mingxuan immediately called his mother, Wang Xiuying. He excitedly described the email to her and told her the news that his essay was about to be published. His mother, Wang Xiuying, was very happy on the phone. She said she would go to the newsstand to buy it as soon as the magazine was published, and urged Lei Mingxuan to come home in the evening to celebrate together. The call lasted about ten minutes.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2F, Century Avenue Mall, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (inside the clothing store)

subevent.name: Finished work in the evening and went home to prepare for a celebration
subevent.description: That evening, Lei Mingxuan closed the shop early. After tidying up the store, he took the subway back to his home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area. On the way, he stopped at a newsstand near the neighborhood and bought a copy of that month's Shanghai Literature magazine, confirming that his article had indeed been published. When he got home, he put the magazine on the dining table, waiting for his parents to look at it together.
subevent.location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (home)

subevent.name: Read prose with his parents and share the joy.
subevent.description: In the evening, Lei Mingxuan sat on the sofa in the living room at home with his father Lei Jianguo and mother Wang Xiuying. He opened the Shanghai Literature magazine and pointed out the essay "Morning Mist in the Alleyway" in the "Urban Memories" column to his parents. His mother Wang Xiuying held the magazine and read it carefully, her eyes slightly reddening, proud of her son; his father Lei Jianguo put on reading glasses, read it word by word, and nodded in approval from time to time. Lei Mingxuan told his parents about the process of submission and acceptance, and the three of them recalled memories of the old Pudong alleyways described in the essay. The atmosphere was warm and touching.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road (Home Living Room)

name: Year-end tidying, discovering mother's diary and reflections on A Fu's companionship
description: On the evening of December 28, 2025, while tidying his bedroom at his home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Lei Mingxuan accidentally found his mother Wang Xiuying's diary. Flipping through it, he relived childhood memories. At that moment, his pet cat A Fu jumped onto his lap and stayed quietly with him, making him realize the value of patience and responsibility and appreciate his daily moments with A Fu even more.

subevent.name: Tidying up the room
subevent.description: On the evening of December 28, 2025, Lei Mingxuan began tidying up his bedroom at his home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, sorting scattered clothes, books, and miscellaneous items into categories and storing them away to prepare for the new year.
subevent.location: Shanghai – bedroom at home

subevent.name: Found my mother's diary.
subevent.description: While tidying the bottom shelf of the bookcase, Lei Mingxuan accidentally found a diary from his mother Wang Xiuying's youth, its cover somewhat worn. Curious, he opened it and read her notes about childhood anecdotes and family trivia, feeling warmth and emotion welling up inside.
subevent.location: Shanghai – bedroom at home

subevent.name: Companionship with Afu and insights.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan was sitting at the bedside flipping through his diary when the family cat, A Fu, quietly jumped onto his lap, curled up, and fell fast asleep. He gently stroked A Fu's back, reminded of A Fu's silent companionship over the past year—from greeting him when he came home after the store closed to snuggling with him during solitary late nights. He deeply realized that his everyday time with A Fu had taught him patience and responsibility, and made him cherish even more the warmth this new family member had brought.
subevent.location: Shanghai – bedroom at home

name: Year-end store inventory and spring ordering
description: From December 14 to 15, Lei Mingxuan spent two days conducting a year-end inventory count of all goods in the store, accurately calculating sales and inventory turnover rates by category, and putting together a spring restocking list. Afterwards, he contacted Hangzhou supplier Zhou Tao via video conference from the store, reviewed new spring clothing samples, discussed ordering matters, and finally finalized ten key new products, laying the supply foundation for the store's spring refresh.

subevent.name: Year-end inventory count
subevent.description: In his clothing store at Booth A-208, 2nd floor of a mall on Century Avenue in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Lei Mingxuan spent the whole day conducting a year-end inventory of all items on sale. He checked one by one the quantities, sizes, and colors of various inventories including clothing, accessories, and designer toys, and precisely recorded each product's annual sales volume and inventory turnover rate, providing data support for subsequent clearance of slow-moving items and spring ordering.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Lei Mingxuan's clothing store).

subevent.name: Inventory data organization and ordering preparation
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan continued wrapping up the inventory count in the clothing store. He entered the previous day's count data into the computer system and generated detailed inventory reports and analyses of best-selling and slow-moving items. Then he sorted out a list of categories needing spring replenishment and previewed the electronic catalog of new spring clothing from Hangzhou supplier Zhou Tao, preparing for the afternoon product selection meeting.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Lei Mingxuan's clothing store).

subevent.name: Had a video call with supplier Zhou Tao to select products and finalized the spring order.
subevent.description: At the clothing store, Lei Mingxuan contacted Hangzhou supplier Zhou Tao via video conferencing software. The two reviewed the styles, fabrics, and prices of the new spring sample garments one by one online. Combining inventory data and the store's style, Lei Mingxuan selected ten key new items from dozens of sample garments, and negotiated order quantities, delivery times, and payment terms with Zhou Tao. In the end, they finalized the first batch of orders for spring 2026, laying the supply foundation for the store's spring refresh and upgrade to a multi-brand store.
subevent.location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, a shopping mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Lei Mingxuan's clothing store).

name: Household deep cleaning and discoveries of old items
description: On December 24, Lei Mingxuan's family did a thorough cleaning following Shanghai's custom of 'sweeping dust from the eaves.' Lei Mingxuan cleaned the living room chandelier and wiped the windows, his father tidied up old items in the study, and his mother scrubbed the kitchen. Shanghai opera played on the radio, and his father dug out his childhood award certificates and a mother-and-son photo, which sparked happy memories. While cleaning out the storage room, Lei Mingxuan moved out an old camphor wood chest containing his mother's old books and thread-bound notebooks. His mother smiled and put them away, saying, 'That's all ancient history.' He took note of it and left it aside for the time being. Finally, they hung up a Year of the Rat New Year picture, and the home looked completely fresh.

subevent.name: Cleaned the living room chandelier and windows.
subevent.description: Following Shanghai's 'dust sweeping' custom, Lei Mingxuan used a long-handled duster in the living room to clean dust off the ceiling chandelier, then wiped the living room window glass with glass cleaner and a cloth. Shanghai opera was playing on the radio as background music, creating a festive spring-cleaning atmosphere.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Organizing old items in the study and rediscovering memories
subevent.description: In the study, his father Lei Jianguo was sorting through old documents, books, and miscellaneous items on the bookshelf. He found Lei Mingxuan's elementary school certificates and a childhood photo of Lei Mingxuan with his mother. Smiling, he showed them to Lei Mingxuan, and the father and son recalled funny memories together, filling the home with cheerful laughter.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - home study

subevent.name: Scrubbing kitchen grease stains
subevent.description: Mother Wang Xiuying carefully scrubbed the grease off the stovetop, range hood, and cabinet surfaces in the kitchen with hot water, dish soap, and a cloth, put the kitchen utensils back in their places, and washed the floor, leaving the kitchen clean and shiny again.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home kitchen.

subevent.name: Cleaned out the storage room and moved out the old camphorwood chest
subevent.description: While cleaning the storage room at home, Lei Mingxuan found an old camphorwood chest in the corner and moved it out to the open area of the living room. Dust had settled on the surface of the chest; he wiped the dust off with his hand and opened it to take a look.
subevent.location: Shanghai, Pudong New Area - storage room at home

subevent.name: Appreciating mother's old notebooks and books
subevent.description: The camphorwood chest contained his mother Wang Xiuying's old books and a thread-bound notebook. After flipping through them, Lei Mingxuan asked with a smile. Wang Xiuying took the chest, smiled, put it away, and said, "It's all old history." Lei Mingxuan didn't press further, but he noted the chest's existence in his mind and set it aside for now.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Hang up the Year of the Rat New Year picture to finish the thorough cleaning
subevent.description: As the thorough cleaning was coming to an end, Lei Mingxuan took the Year of the Rat New Year picture he had prepared in advance from a drawer, and used transparent tape to stick it flat above the main door of the living room at home. Then he looked around the clean and tidy house, exchanged smiles with his parents, and the home looked brand new.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Father becomes a shareholder in a multi-brand store
description: On December 20, Lei Mingxuan prepared a detailed budget for the shop upgrade at home and identified a funding gap of 80,000 yuan. After dinner on December 22, he formally discussed the investment plan with his father Lei Jianguo in the living room and gained his support. His father agreed to take 50,000 yuan from family savings to invest as equity, and the two agreed to share dividends according to profit ratio. His mother Wang Xiuying also said the 20,000 yuan she had given earlier did not need to be repaid. On December 23, the two parties signed an equity investment agreement at home, specifying the capital contribution and dividend rights, and his father transferred the 50,000 yuan by bank transfer. This 50,000 yuan became an important funding source for the shop upgrade, and the rift between father and son over business philosophy was fully resolved.

subevent.name: Prepared the store upgrade budget sheet
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan used his computer and financial software in the study of his home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to prepare a detailed budget for upgrading the clothing store into a multi-brand boutique. He calculated the costs of renovation, purchasing stock, brand cooperation, and other items, identified a funding gap of 80,000 yuan, and made a phased investment plan. After the budget was ready, he printed two copies and planned to discuss it with his father the next day.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home Study

subevent.name: Formally discussed the investment with his father and received his support
subevent.description: After dinner that evening, Lei Mingxuan had a formal discussion with his father Lei Jianguo in the living room, bringing a detailed budget table. He explained in detail the upgrade plan for the brand collection store, expected returns, and the current capital gap of 80,000 yuan. After carefully reviewing the budget, Lei Jianguo was moved by his son's mature planning and immediately said he would take 50,000 yuan from family savings as an investment stake. The two agreed to share dividends according to the store's profit ratio. Mother Wang Xiuying added that the 20,000 yuan given earlier did not need to be repaid, and the family could think of other ways. At this point, the estrangement between father and son caused by different business concepts was completely resolved.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - living room at home

subevent.name: Receive father's capital contribution and confirm the agreement
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan and his father Lei Jianguo signed a simple investment agreement at home, specifying that Lei Jianguo would invest 50,000 yuan and hold a 10% profit-sharing right (based on profit proportion) in the upgraded multi-brand store. Lei Jianguo then transferred 50,000 yuan to Lei Mingxuan's account via bank transfer. Lei Mingxuan marked the funds as earmarked for a specific purpose and notified the suppliers and mall property management the same day. His mother, Wang Xiuying, witnessed the signing and urged her son to run the business well.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home

name: Urban techwear pop-up exhibition.
description: From December 19 to 21, Lei Mingxuan and his college classmate Zhao Min cooperated to hold a pop-up exhibition themed “Urban Function Style” in the mall atrium, displaying the season’s mountain-style clothing and camping coffee equipment, and setting up a pour-over coffee experience area. The event attracted a large number of customers, successfully drove traffic to the store, and also fulfilled the commitment to participating in the mall’s “Trend Market” made when renewing the lease. During this period, he discussed follow-up co-branded promotion plans with Zhao Min.

subevent.name: Event planning and supplies preparation
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan collaborated with his college classmate Zhao Min to plan the specific scheme for an urban-functional-style pop-up exhibition at Lei Mingxuan's clothing store and online, including determining the display styles, camping coffee equipment brands, and the process design for the hand-drip coffee experience area. They then split up to purchase the necessary supplies: Lei Mingxuan was responsible for contacting suppliers to allocate mountain-style clothing samples, and Zhao Min was responsible for purchasing coffee equipment and coffee beans, completing the gathering of all supplies before December 18.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store and online procurement

subevent.name: Working with Zhao Min on the pop-up exhibition plan.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan met with his college classmate Zhao Min in his own clothing store, and the two discussed and finalized the specific plan for the urban functional style pop-up exhibition, including the clothing series to be displayed, the selection of camping coffee equipment brands, the flow and layout design of the pour-over coffee experience area, and the overall marketing and promotional strategy.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store

subevent.name: Contacted the supplier to transfer clothing samples
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan contacted the main supplier Zhou Tao (Hangzhou Taosheng Apparel) via WeChat and phone, explained the needs of the pop-up exhibition, requested the allocation of a batch of newly arrived mountain-style clothing samples (including functional jackets, work pants, etc.), and arranged express delivery to ensure the samples arrived at the Shanghai store before December 18.
subevent.location: Lei Mingxuan's Clothing Store, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (online contact).

subevent.name: Purchasing coffee equipment and coffee beans.
subevent.description: Zhao Min, following the plan, went to a specialty coffee equipment store in Shanghai or purchased online the equipment needed for pour-over coffee (such as a gooseneck kettle, dripper, and server) and specialty coffee beans suitable for outdoor style, while considering budget and quality. After completing the purchase, she notified Lei Mingxuan.
subevent.location: Shanghai - urban area (specific location undecided)

subevent.name: Receive and inspect clothing samples.
subevent.description: At the clothing store, Lei Mingxuan received a courier delivery from Zhou Tao. He opened the package and checked all the mountain-style clothing samples for quantity, style, and condition. After confirming everything was correct, he sorted and hung them up, preparing them for the pop-up exhibition display. Meanwhile, he communicated with Zhao Min about the arrival of supplies.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store

subevent.name: Collecting supplies and setting up
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan and Zhao Min gathered at the clothing store, took an inventory of all purchased coffee equipment, coffee beans and transferred clothing samples, did a preliminary sort and categorization according to the exhibition area plan, and began setting up the display area of the pop-up exhibition to prepare for the upcoming activities.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store

subevent.name: Mall atrium venue setup
subevent.description: With the assistance of Zheng Kai, the mall property manager, Lei Mingxuan and Zhao Min set up a booth in the atrium of Century Link Mall, arranging clothing display racks, a camping coffee equipment display table, and a pour-over coffee experience area, hanging theme posters, and testing the coffee equipment to ensure the event area met the mall's safety and aesthetic standards, making preparations for the opening the next day.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Century Link Mall atrium

subevent.name: Pop-up exhibition Day 1 opening and showcase.
subevent.description: The urban techwear pop-up exhibition officially opened. Lei Mingxuan and Zhao Min showcased the season's mountain-style clothing and camping coffee equipment in the mall atrium, and provided on-site pour-over coffee tasting service, attracting a large crowd of customers to stop and experience it. They succeeded in bringing new customers to Lei Mingxuan's clothing store, while fulfilling the promise to participate in the mall's trend market when renewing the lease.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Century Link Mall atrium

subevent.name: Pop-up exhibition second day: interaction and discussion
subevent.description: The pop-up exhibition went on as Lei Mingxuan and Zhao Min received customers at the booth, introduced products, and discussed preliminary ideas for the follow-up co-branded promotion plan during breaks, including product combinations, social media publicity, and schedule arrangements, laying the groundwork for future cooperation.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Century Link Mall atrium

subevent.name: Event review and implementation of the co-branding plan.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan and Zhao Min met at a café in Pudong New Area, summarized the foot traffic data, sales conversion, and customer feedback of the pop-up exhibition, and worked out in detail the specific plan for the follow-up co-branded promotion, including selecting co-branded clothing styles, confirming partner brands for coffee equipment, assigning online publicity tasks, and setting an initial schedule.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - a certain café

name: Tried meditation for the first time and persisted in practice
description: Early in the morning on December 15, 2025, after training at the gym, Lei Mingxuan remembered the advice of his doctor and financial manager and tried a 10-minute breathing meditation on an app for the first time. His mind was scattered, but he stuck with it and finished. Over the next two days (Dec 16-17), he continued the morning meditation practice and gradually learned to focus. By the third day he experienced deep relaxation and was getting into the groove.

subevent.name: Morning gym routine training
subevent.description: At about 6:30 a.m. on December 15, 2025, Lei Mingxuan went to a chain gym near Century Avenue in Pudong New District, Shanghai, where he did about 45 minutes of routine exercise, including a treadmill warm-up and strength training, physically and mentally preparing himself for his later attempt at meditation.
subevent.location: A gym on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: First time trying meditation
subevent.description: After finishing his gym training (around 7:30), Lei Mingxuan returned to the bedroom of his home (No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai). He remembered that his doctor and financial manager Xu Feng had suggested meditation to relieve stress, so he decided to try it immediately. He opened a meditation app on his phone (such as Tide or Calm), chose a 10-minute guided breathing meditation, and sat on the edge of the bed with his eyes closed, following the guidance. At first his thoughts were scattered and he found it hard to concentrate, but he persisted through the whole session and decided to keep practicing over the next few days.
subevent.location: Home bedroom, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Continued meditation practice the next day.
subevent.description: Around 7:00 a.m. on December 16, 2025, after getting up, Lei Mingxuan opened the meditation app again in his bedroom at home and did his second 10-minute breathing meditation practice. Compared with the first day, his thoughts were still quite active, but he consciously tried to bring his attention back to his breath and gradually felt a sense of calm.
subevent.location: Home bedroom, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Third day: meditation, gradually entering a better state.
subevent.description: Around 7:00 a.m. on December 17, 2025, Lei Mingxuan persisted with his third meditation practice (in his bedroom at home). This time he felt obvious progress: fewer moments of wandering thoughts, he could return to his breath more quickly, and in the last two or three minutes he experienced a deep sense of relaxation. He gained confidence in meditation and decided to make it a daily habit.
subevent.location: Home bedroom, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Discovered my mother's diary, deepened my understanding of family love, and wove it into the novel
description: On December 28, while tidying up old belongings at home, Lei Mingxuan accidentally found his mother Wang Xiuying's diary from her youth, which recorded her inner struggles and hard-won journey after marrying into Shanghai from Nantong. Deeply moved after reading it, he took the initiative to share his reflections with his mother, and their relationship became closer as a result. Later, he decided to weave this true story into the new novel he was writing, as a way to commemorate and pass on family memories.

subevent.name: Found a diary while sorting through old things
subevent.description: While organizing items that had been stored for years in his home study, Lei Mingxuan unexpectedly came across an old diary with his mother Wang Xiuying's name written on the cover, and realized it was a personal item from his mother's younger days.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Deeply moved by reading his mother's diary
subevent.description: In the study, Lei Mingxuan carefully read his mother's diary and learned about her inner struggles and efforts after marrying from Nantong, Jiangsu, to Shanghai, facing an unfamiliar environment, family responsibilities, and the challenge of adapting to a new life. The diary recorded her loneliness, hard work, and devotion to the family, which deeply moved him.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Took the initiative to share his reflections with his mother.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan walked over to his mother Wang Xiuying, who was in the living room, holding his diary, and sincerely expressed his gratitude for her tolerance and understanding. The two had a deep heart-to-heart talk. Lei Mingxuan shared his reading feelings and admiration with his mother, and their mother-son relationship became closer as a result.
subevent.location: Shanghai - living room at home

subevent.name: Decided to weave the story into novel writing.
subevent.description: After talking with his mother, Lei Mingxuan sat down at the computer to write down this experience and his feelings, and decided to adapt his mother's true story from those years, incorporating it into the new novel he was writing about family and kinship, as a way to commemorate and pass on family memories.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

name: Begin learning basic Japanese.
description: On November 25, 2025, Lei Mingxuan downloaded a Japanese learning app in his bedroom at home and planned a five-day study goal. Starting that evening, he used his fragmented time after the store closed to study the Japanese syllabary on the app for two consecutive nights, repeatedly reading along and writing to gain initial familiarity with the sounds and forms. For the next three nights, he learned and practiced simple everyday phrases, such as greetings, thanks, numbers, and shopping expressions. The whole process lasted from November 25 to 29 and laid the foundation for more systematic learning later.

subevent.name: Prepare Japanese study materials
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan downloaded Japanese learning apps on his phone (such as Duolingo, Japanese Kana Charts, etc.) and briefly planned a five-day initial learning goal, focusing on mastering the kana syllabary and basic greetings.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - Bedroom at home

subevent.name: Learning the Japanese kana chart
subevent.description: After closing the shop for two consecutive nights, Lei Mingxuan used the fragmented time after getting home to repeatedly read aloud and write the Japanese gojūon chart (hiragana and katakana) on his phone app, getting a preliminary grasp of the pronunciations and letterforms.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - Bedroom at home

subevent.name: Learn simple everyday expressions.
subevent.description: During spare moments over the next three evenings, Lei Mingxuan used an app to learn and practice simple everyday Japanese phrases, such as greetings, thanks, numbers, and shopping expressions, and tried repeating them in Japanese.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - Bedroom at home

name: Annual Rock Climbing Review
description: On December 28, Lei Mingxuan checked the annual statistics on his climbing app at home in Pudong New Area: he had climbed 23 times throughout the year, with the highest grade being V3. Although he had neglected it somewhat during the busy work season, he kept it up, and he plans to challenge V4 after returning from western Sichuan next year.

subevent.name: View the annual stats in the rock climbing app.
subevent.description: After closing the clothing store, Lei Mingxuan returned to his home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, opened the rock climbing tracking app on his phone, and reviewed his 2025 annual climbing statistics, including 23 total sessions, the highest difficulty grade V3, and monthly distribution charts. He also recalled the regret of not being able to climb frequently during the busy work season.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Review and analyze the year's rock climbing activities
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan sat at the desk, scrolling through app data while mentally reviewing his rock climbing performance over the year: in spring he maintained a rhythm of once a week; in summer, due to the store's peak season, it dropped to two or three times a month; after autumn it recovered well, but he was unable to break through the V3 plateau. He felt that although there had been some neglect, he had kept it up overall and was basically satisfied with himself, while also noticing that his core strength needed strengthening.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home Study

subevent.name: Set next year's rock climbing goals and recorded them.
subevent.description: Based on the review, Lei Mingxuan decided to set his return from the Western Sichuan road trip (planned for the first half of 2026) as the starting point for challenging V4, and opened his phone's memo app to write: "After returning from Western Sichuan next year, focus on strength training and aim to nail V4!" He also shared a screenshot of his annual summary in the climbing enthusiast WeChat group to exchange insights with friends.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home Study

name: Mall floor renovation lease renewal negotiation
description: On December 10, the mall property manager Zheng Kai informed him that due to a full renovation, half of the floor would be converted to dining space. Lei Mingxuan had to choose between moving to a remote location (rent reduced by 30%) or renewing the lease at the original location (rent increased by 15%). The next day, he consulted the mall intermediary about moving costs and calmly analyzed the impact on foot traffic before deciding to renew the lease. After several rounds of negotiation, he eventually managed to reduce the rent increase to 10% by agreeing to participate in the mall's "Trend Market" event and prepaying half a year's rent, successfully securing his advantageous location.

subevent.name: Received notice of mall renovation.
subevent.description: On December 10, mall property manager Zheng Kai informed Lei Mingxuan that due to the overall renovation of the floor, half of the area would be converted to dining, and offered two options: relocate to a remote location (rent reduced by 30%) or renew the lease at the original location (rent increased by 15%). Lei Mingxuan communicated with Zheng Kai in the store to understand the renovation details and the specifics of the options.
subevent.location: Inside Lei Mingxuan's clothing store at Century Link Mall, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Consulting on migration cost assessment
subevent.description: That afternoon, Lei Mingxuan contacted the leasing agent in the mall by phone to ask about the relocation cost of moving to an out-of-the-way location, potential loss of foot traffic, and related administrative fees. He obtained detailed relocation cost data to support his subsequent decision-making.
subevent.location: Inside Lei Mingxuan's clothing store at Century Link Mall, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Analyze the impact of foot traffic and decide whether to renew the lease
subevent.description: On December 11, in his study at home, Lei Mingxuan calmly analyzed the impact on foot traffic of the two options, using the relocation cost information obtained the previous day. Considering the geographical advantage of the original location and the regular customer resources accumulated over the years, he concluded that relocating would cause greater losses. In the end, he decided to renew the lease at the original location and prepared to negotiate a rent reduction with the mall.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - home study

subevent.name: First lease renewal negotiation.
subevent.description: On December 12, Lei Mingxuan proactively contacted Zheng Kai, expressing his intention to renew the lease at the original location, but also stating that the 15% rent increase exceeded expectations. He hoped the mall would consider the negative impact of the renovation period on store operations and asked for a more moderate increase. The two parties had a preliminary discussion, and Zheng Kai said he needed to report to his superiors.
subevent.location: Property Management Office, Century Link Mall, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Propose conditions to negotiate rent reduction
subevent.description: On December 13, Lei Mingxuan met face-to-face with the head of the mall's leasing department. He proposed participating in the mall's upcoming 'Trend Market' event to attract more foot traffic, and was willing to prepay half a year's rent in exchange for a lower rent increase. The mall side said they needed to discuss internally.
subevent.location: Property Management Office, Century Link Mall, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Reached preliminary agreement on rent reduction
subevent.description: On December 14, Lei Mingxuan received feedback from the mall conveyed by Zheng Kai, agreeing to reduce the rent increase to 10%, on the condition that Lei Mingxuan participates in the "Trend Market" event and pays six months' rent in advance. Lei Mingxuan agreed, and both parties reached a preliminary intention.
subevent.location: Century Link Mall, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Signed the lease renewal contract
subevent.description: On December 15, Lei Mingxuan went to the mall management office and formally signed the lease renewal contract with the mall representative. Contract terms: rent increases by 10%; Lei Mingxuan agrees to participate in the mall's 'Trend Market' event and pays six months' rent in advance. He successfully kept his prime location.
subevent.location: Property Management Office, Century Link Mall, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Annual Review and 2026 Planning
description: On December 31, Lei Mingxuan conducted his year-end review: he reviewed store operations—designer toys contributed 12% of revenue, and the coffee experience area boosted foot traffic by 5%, while net profit only inched up 3%—and reflected on his personal fitness improvements. He then set key goals for 2026: a self-driving trip to western Sichuan in January, upgrading the store into a multi-brand store and launching a WeChat Mini Program, activating his gym annual membership with three check-ins per week, and completing a beginner Japanese course. He also planned the western Sichuan road trip itinerary in detail and checked his training progress, while researching options for the store upgrade and mini program, clearly anchoring direction for the new year.

subevent.name: Review store operations and personal situation.
subevent.description: Based on the compiled data, Lei Mingxuan reviewed the store's 2025 performance: the designer toy category contributed 12% of revenue, and the coffee experience area increased foot traffic by 5%, but renovation and marketing investments caused net profit to rise only 3%. He also reflected on his improved physical fitness and overall life condition.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home Study

subevent.name: Create a list of core goals for 2026.
subevent.description: Based on the review results, Lei Mingxuan set core goals for 2026: in January, complete an in-depth self-driving tour of western Sichuan, upgrade the store to a multi-brand store and launch a WeChat mini program, officially activate the gym annual membership and check in at least three times a week, and complete a beginner Japanese course. He wrote down the goals and anchored his direction.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home Study

subevent.name: Plan a self-driving trip to western Sichuan and review training
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan looked up self-driving travel guides for western Sichuan, finalized the general route and scenic spots, confirmed the January departure time, and checked his progress on the completed scientific training plan to ensure his fitness and vehicle were ready, making plans for the trip.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home Study

subevent.name: Check store upgrade and mini-program solutions
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan searched online for brand collection store cases and WeChat Mini Program development service providers, getting an initial understanding of the costs, timelines, and requirements for renovation and upgrading, in preparation for the 2026 store upgrade.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Home Study

name: Video-called with his cousin Yang Fan about the mini program
description: On December 12, Lei Mingxuan had a video call with his younger cousin Yang Fan. Yang Fan analyzed the cost advantages of a WeChat Mini Program mall from a technical perspective and said it was more suitable for the store's initial online expansion than third-party platforms. Lei Mingxuan was deeply inspired and became even more determined to expand online. From then on, he spent time every evening researching mini program cases and setup plans.

subevent.name: Research mini-program cases and formulate an online mall development plan.
subevent.description: After a video call with his cousin on December 12, Lei Mingxuan spent several evenings (about 1-2 hours each) from December 13 to December 19 systematically researching WeChat Mini Program cases and build solutions in his home study. On his computer, he browsed the interfaces and features of mini programs in industries such as shopping and food and beverage, compared the pros and cons of different templates and service providers, and recorded key points, making adequate preparations for the subsequent implementation of the store's online mall.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Browsing mini-program case studies in the clothing industry.
subevent.description: On the evening of December 13, 2025, after dinner, Lei Mingxuan turned on his computer in his home study and spent about 1.5 hours browsing mini-program cases in the apparel industry on WeChat. He searched for and clicked into the mini-programs of several well-known clothing brands, carefully examining their homepage layouts, product category displays, shopping processes, and promotional features, and recorded in his notebook the interface designs and interaction details worth learning from.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Compare mainstream mini-program template service providers
subevent.description: On the evening of December 15, 2025, Lei Mingxuan, in his home study, compared several mainstream WeChat Mini Program template service providers on the market, such as Shangxianle, Youzan, and Weimob. He examined each platform's retail industry templates one by one, compared prices, features, after-sales service, and user reviews, and organized key parameters into a table, noting the pros and cons of each service provider.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Learn about custom development and plugins for mini programs.
subevent.description: On the evening of December 16, 2025, Lei Mingxuan studied the WeChat Mini Program development documentation in his home study, gaining an in-depth understanding of the possibilities of custom development and the integration methods for common plugins (such as logistics tracking and customer service systems). He consulted relevant technical blogs and official tutorials, assessed whether he needed to ask a technical expert (such as his cousin Yang Fan) for help in implementing the customized requirements, and listed potential technical difficulties and solutions in his notebook.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Organizing store SKUs and pricing strategy
subevent.description: On the evening of December 17, 2025, in his home study, Lei Mingxuan combined his research on mini programs with his store's actual situation, sorted out a list of SKUs suitable for the online mall, and formulated an initial pricing strategy. He referred to the pricing systems of peer online stores, combined this with his own purchasing costs, and marked a suggested online selling price and promotional discount range for each product. He also thought about how to use the mini program for membership points and coupon distribution.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Design a page layout sketch for the mini program
subevent.description: On the evening of December 18, 2025, Lei Mingxuan, based on research from the previous few days, began drawing page layout sketches for the clothing store mini program in his home study. He sketched the structure of core pages such as the home page, product category page, product details page, shopping cart, and My Account, annotated the functions and display content of each area, and took photos to save for later communication with designers or service providers.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Selecting a service provider and formulating an implementation plan
subevent.description: On the evening of December 19, 2025, Lei Mingxuan finally consolidated all research results in his home study, compared options, and selected a template service provider with the best value for money, then drafted an initial implementation plan. He listed the materials to prepare next (such as product images, copy, and company qualifications), key milestones (such as launch testing and official release), and the possibility of seeking technical support from his cousin Yang Fan. After finishing, he saved the entire plan to the cloud and set himself a reminder to start executing the following week.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

name: Introducing a healthy eating plan
description: After consulting Old Zhou on October 22 about a self-driving trip to western Sichuan, Lei Mingxuan deeply realized the importance of physical fitness and began adjusting his eating habits. He cut down on takeout and greasy food, increased healthy ingredients like chicken breast, broccoli, and blueberries, and ensured 2 liters of water a day. His mother, Wang Xiuying, also made low-salt, low-oil home dishes such as steamed fish and boiled shrimp. On weekends, he tried making fruit salad instead of dessert.

subevent.name: Start the healthy eating plan
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 22, after finishing his consultation with Lao Zhou about a self-driving trip in western Sichuan, Lei Mingxuan deeply realized the importance of physical fitness reserves. He immediately talked with his mother Wang Xiuying about adjusting their dietary structure. He went to a FamilyMart supermarket near Zhangyang Road in Pudong New Area and bought healthy ingredients such as chicken breast, broccoli, blueberries, and whole wheat bread, and also cleaned out the snacks and takeout order records at home. Wang Xiuying expressed support and planned to start making low-salt, low-oil home-style dishes from that evening.
subevent.location: Home and nearby supermarkets in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Day 2 of daily routine execution
subevent.description: On October 24, Lei Mingxuan continued to stick to a healthy diet. For lunch he made a chicken breast salad, and for dinner his mother made steamed tofu and blanched choy sum. He kept up his habit of drinking 2 liters of water and felt his physical condition improving.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Weekend Healthy Meal Innovation
subevent.description: On Saturday, October 25, Lei Mingxuan decided to try a new healthy dessert alternative. In the kitchen at home, he made a fruit salad with blueberries, strawberries, yogurt, and a little honey, replacing his usual desserts and candy. After making it, he tasted it together with his parents, and it was well received.
subevent.location: Home kitchen in Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Continue following the diet plan
subevent.description: From October 26 to October 29, Lei Mingxuan followed a healthy eating plan for four consecutive days. Coordinating with his mother Wang Xiuying, he adhered to a daily diet that was low in salt and oil and high in protein and fiber, ensuring about 2 liters of water per day. During this period, he reduced dining out and gradually developed new eating habits, laying a foundation of physical stamina for the self-drive trip to western Sichuan.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: First day of executing the healthy diet plan.
subevent.description: At 8 a.m., Lei Mingxuan and his mother Wang Xiuying prepared breakfast together in the kitchen of their home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai: fried eggs in olive oil, steamed sweet potatoes, and blanched spinach with a dressing, served with unsweetened soy milk. His mother packed the pre-prepared chicken breast and broccoli into a lunchbox for lunch. Lei Mingxuan brought the lunchbox to the store on Century Avenue, and at noon heated it in the microwave in the store's rest area and ate it. During the day, he drank about 1 liter of mineral water and avoided ordering greasy takeout. At 7 p.m. he returned home, where his mother had prepared steamed sea bass, garlic lettuce, and brown rice. His total water intake for the day was 2.2 liters, and he did not attend any group meals.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Execute the healthy eating plan the next day
subevent.description: At 7:30 in the morning, Lei Mingxuan and his mother worked together in the kitchen: they cooked quinoa porridge with boiled eggs and blanched okra, while his mother packed mixed-grain rice and stir-fried zucchini with shrimp into plastic containers as lunch. Lei Mingxuan drank 1.5 liters of water by the counter in the store (0.7 liters in the morning, 0.8 liters in the afternoon), and at 12:30 he heated the lunchbox in the microwave and ate it. In the afternoon he drank a pot of goji berry and chrysanthemum tea. For dinner, he returned home and ate the tomato-braised beef brisket his mother had made (fat removed, low salt), stir-fried asparagus, and a small amount of purple sweet potato. He consumed enough protein throughout the day and felt energetic.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Day 3 of following the healthy eating plan
subevent.description: At 7 a.m., Lei Mingxuan prepared meals with his mother: she steamed corn, pan-fried salmon (with less oil), and cut up dragon fruit and kiwi as extra snacks. Lei Mingxuan packed his lunch box (black rice, stir-fried chicken cubes with bell peppers, and blanched lettuce) and brought it to the store. At 12:45 p.m. he ate in the mall's rest area, and took out his water bottle to drink several times, replenishing 100–200 ml every hour. After work, he went home and had dinner with his mother: mushroom and tofu soup, white shrimp, and steamed purple sweet potato. He drank about 2 liters of warm water all day, felt his stomach was light and clean, and his weight showed a downward trend.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Day 4 of following the healthy eating plan
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Lei Mingxuan prepared breakfast with his mother's help: whole-wheat sandwiches (with scrambled egg, avocado, and tomato) and a glass of almond milk. His mother packed a lunchbox (chickpeas, roasted pumpkin, and pan-seared chicken breast) into an insulated bag. During the morning, Lei Mingxuan drank about 0.8 liters of water between serving customers in the store and finished his packed lunch at 13:00. In the afternoon he added a snack of tomato and cucumber sticks. When he returned home in the evening, his mother had already made steamed eggs with shrimp, stir-fried spinach, and multigrain porridge. He strictly controlled salt intake throughout the day, with a total water intake of 2.1 liters. Lei Mingxuan declined a weekend dinner invitation with his sports buddy Han Dong on WeChat, sticking to his plan.
subevent.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Historical novel completed and publication intent
description: On December 21, his friend Liu Yang contacted a publisher and obtained an initial expression of interest in publishing Lei Mingxuan's novel about the history of longtang alleys. On December 25, the novel was officially completed and shortlisted for the platform's annual newcomer candidate list, opening new possibilities for his writing career.
