subevent.name: Historical Novel Final Chapter Update
subevent.description: On the web novel platform he was signed to, Lei Mingxuan published the final chapter (Chapter 120) of his historical novel set in a Shanghai longtang, along with an afterword thanking readers for their support. He carefully checked the consistency of the entire text, confirmed there were no logical holes, and then marked the work's status as “Completed”.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: View the platform's annual newcomer candidate list
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan logged in to the novel platform and found that his longtang historical novel had successfully made it onto the platform's annual newcomer candidate list. He excitedly browsed the list page, took a screenshot to save it, and shared the good news with his friend Liu Yang on WeChat.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Liu Yang contacted the publishing house to assess the possibility of publication
subevent.description: His friend Liu Yang (a game development engineer in Shenzhen) used contacts in his cultural circle to get in touch with Teacher Chen, the chief editor of a small publishing house called “Moxiang Culture.” On WeChat, Liu Yang gave a detailed introduction to the content features and completion status of Lei Mingxuan's novel, and sent the first three chapters and the table of contents, asking him to evaluate the feasibility of publication.
subevent.location: Shenzhen, Guangdong Province - Online (via WeChat)

subevent.name: Received preliminary publication interest from the publisher
subevent.description: Liu Yang forwarded the feedback from Chen, the editor-in-chief at the publishing house, to Lei Mingxuan: Chen expressed great interest in the longtang historical novel, believed it had local cultural value and market potential, was willing to offer a preliminary publication intent, and hoped to further discuss cooperation details. Lei Mingxuan was extremely excited after reading the message and replied to Liu Yang, thanking him for his help.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

name: Organize year-end camping to deepen friendship
description: On December 26, Lei Mingxuan contacted childhood friend Zhang Wei, cousin Shen Jie, and childhood friend Li Na, who was joining for the first time, and they agreed to set off the next day and buy camping supplies. From the 27th to the 28th, the four went camping at a country park. They worked together to set up tents, had a barbecue dinner, and socialized at night. Shen Jie showed off her new pour-over coffee kettle, and Li Na tried pour-over brewing for the first time. In the early morning, they sat together drinking coffee. Lei Mingxuan took photos and posted them to the group with the caption 'The outdoors tastes better with a group.' After the event, they packed up camp and returned home. On the 29th, Lei Mingxuan sorted out and shared the photos, and agreed with Zhang Wei and Li Na to go hiking in the future. Zhang Wei became interested in camping, Li Na reconnected with everyone, and their outdoor social circle expanded.

subevent.name: Camping supplies purchase and notification.
subevent.description: At his home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Lei Mingxuan contacted Zhang Wei, Shen Jie, and Li Na, confirmed that they would gather on Zhangyang Road at 9 a.m. on December 27 to set off, and went to nearby supermarkets and outdoor supply stores to buy camping supplies such as ingredients, barbecue tools, a tent, sleeping bags, and moisture-proof mats. On the phone, Shen Jie told him she had bought a new pour-over coffee kettle and planned to show it at the campsite. Lei Mingxuan checked the capacity of his car's trunk to make sure all the equipment would fit.
subevent.location: Home and nearby supermarkets in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Head out to the campsite and pitch the tent.
subevent.description: At 9 a.m. on December 27, Lei Mingxuan drove the family car, carrying Zhang Wei, Shen Jie, and Li Na, starting from Zhangyang Road and heading to the campsite at Pudong New Area Country Park on the outskirts of Shanghai. After arriving at the campsite around 10:30, the four divided the work: Lei Mingxuan and Zhang Wei set up two tents and a canopy; Shen Jie and Li Na laid out ground mats, arranged folding tables and chairs, and organized the food. By noon, the campsite was basically set up, and the four ate a simple lunch of sandwiches and fruit they had brought.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area Country Park Campsite

subevent.name: Camp dinner and evening socializing
subevent.description: From the afternoon to the evening of December 27, the four of them had a barbecue dinner at the campsite. Lei Mingxuan was in charge of lighting the fire and grilling the meat, Zhang Wei helped prepare the seasonings, and Shen Jie and Li Na made a vegetable salad and fruit platter together. During dinner, Shen Jie brought out her newly bought pour-over coffee pot and introduced how to use it. Li Na showed great interest, and they agreed to try it the next morning. After the meal, the four sat around the campfire chatting, recalling funny childhood memories and sharing recent life and work updates. Zhang Wei talked about his initial interest in camping, and Li Na remarked on the warmth of reuniting with Lei Mingxuan and Zhang Wei after so many years. After 10 p.m., they each went into their tents to rest.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area Country Park Campsite

subevent.name: Early morning pour-over coffee time.
subevent.description: At 6:30 on the morning of December 28, the four of them got up at the campsite. Shen Jie took out a coffee pot and freshly ground coffee powder, and Li Na, under Shen Jie's guidance, completed the first pour-over coffee of her life. Although she was a bit nervous, she successfully brewed enough for four people. Holding hot coffee, the four sat around a folding table in the morning light, chatting and enjoying the natural scenery around the campsite. Lei Mingxuan captured the warm moment with his phone and posted the photo with the caption 'The outdoors tastes better with a group' to the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' WeChat group and his Moments. Zhang Wei and Li Na liked and commented one after another, and the atmosphere was harmonious.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area Country Park Campsite

subevent.name: Break camp and return
subevent.description: At 9 a.m. on December 28, the four of them began taking down the tent, packing up sleeping bags, clearing away trash, and sorting and packing the leftover food by category. After packing their personal belongings, Lei Mingxuan drove, and they set off from the campsite around 11 a.m. to return to downtown Shanghai. They arrived at his home on Zhangyang Road at 12:30 p.m. Lei Mingxuan moved some of the camping gear into his home storage room. Zhang Wei, Shen Jie, and Li Na said their goodbyes and agreed to organize similar activities next time. Zhang Wei expressed a strong interest in camping and hoped to join Lei Mingxuan's outdoor circle. Li Na and Lei Mingxuan exchanged additional contact details and agreed to stay in close touch.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area Country Park and home

subevent.name: Organize and share event photos
subevent.description: On December 29, Lei Mingxuan sorted through the photos and short videos taken during the camping trip on his computer, selected his favorite nine photos for a nine-square grid, and used photo editing software to make slight color adjustments. He shared the photos to WeChat Moments and several friend groups (including 'Pudong Three Musketeers' and 'High School Classmates Group'), along with a short caption recording his reflections on the camping trip. Meanwhile, he also chatted privately with Zhang Wei and Li Na on WeChat to further discuss future outdoor activity plans. The three agreed to organize another short-distance hike after New Year's Day. Shen Jie commented in the comment section that she looked forward to the next gathering.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - home study

name: Daily ukulele practice
description: Starting on the evening of December 1, Lei Mingxuan spent half an hour every day practicing basic ukulele chords along with instructional videos. Despite sore fingers, his enthusiasm did not wane. He incorporated ukulele practice into his daily bite-sized learning plan and planned to bring it on the western Sichuan road trip in January 2026, playing and singing by the tent at night.

subevent.name: Practice summary and preparations for the Western Sichuan road trip.
subevent.description: On the evening of December 31, Lei Mingxuan finished the day's practice, marking the end of a month-long training period. Looking back at what he had learned over the 30 days, he could now switch smoothly among six basic chords—C, Am, F, G, Dm, and others—without looking at the fretboard, and he could play and sing complete excerpts of 'Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star' and 'The Meaning of Travel.' He felt satisfied. He then carefully wiped the body of the ukulele with a damp cloth, tuned the strings to standard pitch, put it into the gig bag, and tucked a chord book and spare strings beside it. These items were placed in the corner of the room, with the plan to load them directly into the car before the self-driving trip to Western Sichuan in January 2026, fulfilling his vision of playing and singing by the tent at night.
subevent.location: Home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Adjusting his diet in response to the personal trainer's suggestion.
description: Starting December 13, Lei Mingxuan adjusted his diet based on the coach's advice during a personal training trial class about body fat and the risk of mild fatty liver. He cut down on high-oil, high-sugar takeout, added healthy ingredients such as chicken breast, broccoli, and brown rice, had his mother help prepare fitness meals, and gave up his late-night snack habit. Although he felt some discomfort initially, after a week he felt more energetic and his body fat percentage dropped slightly.

subevent.name: Start the diet adjustment plan.
subevent.description: Based on the coach's advice in the personal training trial session about body fat and the risk of mild fatty liver, Lei Mingxuan discussed with his mother Wang Xiuying at their home in Pudong New District and decided to adjust his diet starting December 13. He listed in detail the high-fat, high-sugar foods to avoid and created a new healthy meal plan, including chicken breast, broccoli, brown rice, and more. His mother Wang Xiuying expressed her support and took responsibility for preparing his fitness meals every day. At the same time, Lei Mingxuan decided to give up his late-night snack habit.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home kitchen.

subevent.name: Dietary adjustment period
subevent.description: From December 13 to 19, 2025, with the help of his mother Wang Xiuying, Lei Mingxuan followed a new healthy eating plan and gradually adapted to a light taste. At first he felt strongly unaccustomed and missed fried food and midnight snacks; he relieved hunger by drinking plenty of water and eating a few nuts, and asked his mother to adjust the seasoning. His mother used low-fat seasonings such as black pepper, ginger, and garlic, and increased protein intake based on his feedback. During this period, he actively declined a late-night snack invitation from his childhood friend Zhang Wei, and his mother specially made pan-fried buns with less oil as encouragement; he ate only one to show self-discipline. A week later, mother and son reviewed the diet records together. Lei Mingxuan felt his body was lighter and his acceptance of light flavors had improved, and he planned to continue optimizing his diet structure the next week.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

subevent.name: Start following the diet plan
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan officially started his new healthy eating plan. His mother, Wang Xiuying, prepared all-day fitness meals in the kitchen and dining room of their home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai. Breakfast was oatmeal and boiled eggs, lunch was chicken breast salad with olive oil vinaigrette, and dinner was steamed fish with vegetables. He clearly wasn't used to the light flavors and especially missed fried foods and heavy late-night snacks, but he relied on willpower to stay in control and did not consume any food outside the plan.
subevent.location: Home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Managing hunger and adjusting taste preferences
subevent.description: On the third day, Lei Mingxuan felt intense hunger, especially craving fried food and late-night barbecue. At home, he temporarily relieved his hunger by drinking plenty of plain water and eating a small amount of plain almonds (about 10). At the same time, he talked to his mother Wang Xiuying and asked her to adjust the cooking seasonings. Based on his suggestion, his mother added low-fat seasonings such as black pepper, ginger and garlic, black vinegar, and lemon juice to her subsequent cooking to improve the taste.
subevent.location: Home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Recording diet and optimizing based on feedback
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan recorded all of that day's food intake in detail in the notes app on his phone, including 150g of oatmeal, 2 boiled eggs, 200g of chicken breast, 100g of broccoli, 150g of steamed cod, and so on. He felt a little tired, but his mental state showed no obvious change compared with before. His mother, Wang Xiuying, based on his feedback, added 100g of tofu to lunch and 50g of shrimp to dinner to increase protein intake.
subevent.location: Home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Self-motivation and resisting temptation
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan continued following his diet plan and actively browsed fitness bloggers' videos and articles to motivate himself. That evening, his childhood friend Zhang Wei invited him to play billiards and suggested barbecue for a late-night snack. He firmly declined, telling Zhang Wei that he was sticking to a health plan. His mother, Wang Xiuying, felt sorry for him and specially made pan-fried buns with less oil as encouragement. Lei Mingxuan ate only one to maintain dietary discipline.
subevent.location: Home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Weekly meal plan summary and planning.
subevent.description: On the last day of the dietary adjustment period, Lei Mingxuan and his mother Wang Xiuying reviewed the week's food diary together in the living room and analyzed the pros and cons of each meal. He felt that his body seemed slightly lighter and his acceptance of lighter flavors had improved. Although he still craved rich flavors, he was now able to control it. He decided to continue the meal plan next week and planned to add more varieties of vegetables and high-quality protein, while thanking his mother for her hard work over the past week.
subevent.location: Home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Diet adjustment results period
subevent.description: After the first week of adjustment, Lei Mingxuan gradually accepted the healthy meals. He began to clearly feel an increase in energy, no longer getting sleepy easily during the day, and his body fat percentage dropped somewhat. He continued to stick to the diet plan and recorded changes in weight and waist circumference. His mother, Wang Xiuying, also adjusted the dishes based on his feedback, adding more protein sources such as fish and shrimp. Lei Mingxuan was satisfied with the results and resolved to stick with it long term.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home

subevent.name: Make this week's healthy meal plan
subevent.description: At the dining table at home, Lei Mingxuan and his mother Wang Xiuying worked together to create a healthy meal plan for December 20 to 26, 2025, based on last week's feedback on their dietary adaptation. Lei Mingxuan suggested adding more high-protein foods such as fish and shrimp. Wang Xiuying took notes and adjusted the menu to ensure each meal's calorie count stayed within the recommended range. Lei Mingxuan used a memo on his phone to record the goals: daily protein intake ≥80g, vegetables ≥500g.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - dining table at home

subevent.name: Mother bought new ingredients and adjusted her cooking
subevent.description: Following the plan, his mother Wang Xiuying went to the market near Zhangyang Road in Pudong New Area in the morning and bought fresh sea bass, shrimp, chicken breast, broccoli, and other ingredients. After returning home, she cooked lunch according to Lei Mingxuan’s preferences, using steaming and boiling: steamed sea bass, blanched shrimp, and boiled broccoli with mixed-grain rice. Lei Mingxuan came home at 1 p.m., ate, and was satisfied with the dishes.
subevent.location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home kitchen.

subevent.name: Measure and record weight and waist circumference after waking up in the morning
subevent.description: After getting up early, Lei Mingxuan used an electronic scale and a soft tape measure at home to measure his weight and waist circumference on an empty stomach. The scale showed 79.2 kg (down 0.8 kg from a week earlier), and his waist was 89 cm (1 cm smaller). He recorded the data in his phone's memo app and filled in an estimated body fat percentage (about 24%) in the health diary app, while also taking photos for comparison. When he was done, he showed the records to his mother, who encouraged him to keep it up.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - Bedroom at home

subevent.name: Felt noticeably more energy throughout the day
subevent.description: After eight straight days on the healthy meal plan, Lei Mingxuan clearly felt more energetic while working at the clothing store in the afternoon. He used to get sleepy easily after 2 p.m., but today he was clear-headed and more efficient in handling store tasks. He noted this feeling in the memo app on his phone and shared it with his mother after getting home in the evening, saying he could stay focused in the afternoon even without coffee. His mother also noticed that his complexion looked better and less oily.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Measured again and found that body fat percentage had decreased.
subevent.description: Before lunch, Lei Mingxuan measured his weight and waist circumference again. Weight: 78.6 kg (down another 0.6 kg from five days ago); waist: 88 cm; estimated body fat percentage: about 23.5%. He used a body fat scale to double-confirm, and the readings were basically consistent. He organized the two sets of data in an Excel spreadsheet, drew a simple trend curve, took a photo, and sent it to his childhood friend Zhang Wei to share the results. Zhang Wei replied with praise and suggested adding strength training next week.
subevent.location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - Bedroom at home

subevent.name: Summarize the results of the two weeks and decide to stick with it long term
subevent.description: On the last day of 2025, Lei Mingxuan and his mother Wang Xiuying reviewed the two-week dietary adjustment together in the living room. Lei Mingxuan showed his weight change records: from 80.0 kg down to 78.6 kg, waist circumference reduced by 2 cm, and body fat percentage down about 1%. He also listed subjective improvements such as increased energy and less oily skin. His mother expressed support and promised to continue preparing healthy meals. Lei Mingxuan decided to make healthy eating a long-term habit, set a daily diet check-in reminder in his phone calendar, and wrote down his New Year's resolution: to bring his BMI below 24 within three months.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Meditation habit consolidation and year-end review
description: From December 23 to 30, 2025, Lei Mingxuan continued his daily meditation in his bedroom at home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, for 15–20 minutes each session. He felt calmer and his sleep improved. On December 31, he did a year-end review in his study, listed meditation as an important habit, and decided to stick with it long term.

subevent.name: Meditation habit consolidation and visible effects
subevent.description: During the second week of consolidation, Lei Mingxuan continued meditating every morning in his bedroom at home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, extending the session to 15–20 minutes. He gradually noticed changes: he felt calmer when dealing with customer complaints and business pressure, and his nighttime sleep quality improved noticeably. Even as year-end work pressure increased, he persisted without missing a day and internalized meditation as a habit. On the 14th day (December 29), he felt the results were significant and became even more determined to keep practicing.
subevent.location: Shanghai – bedroom at home

subevent.name: Daily meditation reinforcement (December 23)
subevent.description: At 7 a.m. on the morning of December 23, 2025, Lei Mingxuan sat cross-legged on the bay window cushion in his bedroom at his home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and began the first session of the second week's meditation consolidation period. He set a 15-minute timer, closed his eyes, and focused on his breathing. Although he occasionally got distracted by thoughts of year-end customer complaints and restocking pressure at the store, he quickly pulled his attention back. After finishing, he felt clear-headed, setting a calm tone for a busy day of business.
subevent.location: Shanghai – bedroom at home

subevent.name: Daily meditation consolidation (December 24)
subevent.description: On the morning of December 24, 2025, Lei Mingxuan continued his habit from the previous day and meditated for 17 minutes in his bedroom at home in Pudong. He tried to extend the timer and maintain a stable posture. Although he felt somewhat anxious because the mall needed to prepare for Christmas promotions that day, he deliberately observed his emotions without judgment during meditation. After finishing, he felt his stress had eased and had a more composed outlook on the busy schedule ahead.
subevent.location: Shanghai – bedroom at home

subevent.name: Daily meditation consolidation (December 25)
subevent.description: On the morning of Christmas Day, December 25, 2025, Lei Mingxuan did a 15-minute meditation in his bedroom at his home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai. Today was a critical day for the store's promotional event, so he got up half an hour early and finished meditating before going out. Amid calm breathing, he reviewed his composed handling of a customer complaint the day before, and felt gratified by the change meditation had brought him. Afterward, he changed into festive Christmas-themed clothes and headed to the mall full of energy.
subevent.location: Shanghai – bedroom at home

subevent.name: Daily meditation consolidation (December 26)
subevent.description: On the morning of December 26, 2025, Lei Mingxuan did an 18-minute meditation in the bedroom of his home in Pudong. After three consecutive days of consolidation, he found it easier to enter a focused state, and could return to his breath more quickly after his thoughts wandered. The year-end customer traffic peak took a physical toll, but his sleep quality improved noticeably after meditating, and he woke up this morning full of energy. As he meditated, he silently repeated that persistence is victory, strengthening his inner confidence.
subevent.location: Shanghai – bedroom at home

subevent.name: Daily meditation consolidation (December 27)
subevent.description: On the morning of December 27, 2025, Lei Mingxuan did a 16-minute meditation in his bedroom at his home in Pudong, Shanghai. Today was the year-end inventory review, and work pressure had reached a new peak, but during meditation he specifically spent 5 minutes on a body scan, relaxing tense muscles one by one from his toes to the top of his head. Afterward, he clearly felt much looser in his shoulders and neck, and his mindset became more steady—when faced with a supplier's price increase notice, he did not get impatient as usual, but calmly calculated the costs.
subevent.location: Shanghai – bedroom at home

subevent.name: Daily meditation consolidation (December 28)
subevent.description: On the morning of December 28, 2025, Lei Mingxuan did 20 minutes of meditation in his bedroom at his home in Pudong, Shanghai. Today was the weekend, so he slept half an hour longer than usual, but he still completed the practice. In the quiet environment, he tried loving-kindness meditation to wish himself and his family well, and his heart was filled with warmth. After meditation, he noticed that the number of nighttime awakenings had decreased significantly recently and his sleep depth had increased, which made him even more convinced of the benefits of meditation for the body.
subevent.location: Shanghai – bedroom at home

subevent.name: Daily meditation consolidation (December 29).
subevent.description: On the morning of December 29, 2025, Lei Mingxuan did 20 minutes of meditation in his bedroom at his home in Pudong. It was his 14th consecutive day of meditation, and he felt the effects were significant: when facing weekend crowd disputes at the shopping mall, he could immediately take a deep breath and calm his emotions; his time to fall asleep at night had shortened to within 10 minutes. He realized that meditation was no longer a task requiring deliberate persistence, but had become a natural habit as routine as brushing his teeth. After meditating, he wrote in his diary, "Day 14, I found my inner anchor," and resolved to keep it up long term.
subevent.location: Shanghai – bedroom at home

subevent.name: Daily meditation consolidation (December 30)
subevent.description: On the morning of December 30, 2025, Lei Mingxuan did a 15-minute meditation in his bedroom at his home in Pudong, Shanghai, marking the end of the second week's consolidation period. He reviewed the changes over the two weeks: from frequent mind-wandering at first to now being able to stay stably focused about 80% of the time; from tossing and turning before sleep to falling asleep instantly. During today's meditation, he focused on visualizing "sustained action" and felt a stronger sense of self-control. After it ended, he decided to elevate meditation to a lifelong habit and planned to keep practicing daily during the upcoming road trip.
subevent.location: Shanghai – bedroom at home

subevent.name: Year-end review and habit assessment
subevent.description: On December 31, 2025, Lei Mingxuan did his personal year-end review in the study of his home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai. He looked back on his 16-day streak of consistent meditation and specifically listed meditation as an important part of improving self-management. He felt this habit helped him stay calmer while handling customer complaints and business pressure during the busy year-end period, and also improved his sleep. He decided to keep meditation as a long-term habit and include it in his 2026 health goals.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

name: Execution of the gym training plan and improvement of physical fitness.
description: After activating his gym annual pass on December 3, Lei Mingxuan began planning regular training. On December 5, he paused for a week due to wisdom tooth surgery. On December 12, he resumed training and hired a personal trainer to correct movements such as squats and deadlifts. He then followed the plan to do mixed training (strength and cardio) at least three times a week, gradually increasing intensity. During training, his bench press load increased from 40 kg to 57.5 kg, and his running pace improved from 6:00/km to 4:50/km. On December 31, he took an end-of-month fitness test. His overall fitness improved significantly, laying a good foundation for a self-driving trip to Western Sichuan.

subevent.name: Training suspended for one week due to wisdom tooth surgery.
subevent.description: On December 5, Lei Mingxuan underwent wisdom tooth surgery. After the operation, he rested as instructed by the doctor and stopped all fitness activities for a week, doing only light indoor activities during that time to help the wound heal.
subevent.location: Home at Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Wisdom tooth extraction surgery
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan went to a dental hospital in Pudong New Area for wisdom tooth extraction. Local anesthesia was administered before the procedure, and the doctor completed the tooth extraction and placed hemostatic gauze. After the operation, the doctor gave post-operative instructions and prescribed anti-inflammatory and pain medication. Accompanied by his parents, Lei Mingxuan returned home on Zhangyang Road in Pudong New Area to rest.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area Stomatological Hospital

subevent.name: Rest and ice compress on the first day after surgery.
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan is resting at home on the first day after surgery. As instructed by the doctor, apply an ice pack every two hours to reduce swelling and take anti-inflammatory and painkillers on time. The diet is mainly liquid and soft foods (porridge, soy milk), and hot or irritating food should be avoided. Rest in bed or in a semi-reclining position all day, with no exercise or outdoor activities.
subevent.location: Home at Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Continuing to recuperate on the second day after surgery
subevent.description: Lei Mingxuan continued to recover at home. The swelling had eased slightly, but he still needed to apply ice. He took his medication on time and ate soft foods such as steamed eggs and noodles. He tried short indoor walks, but avoided bending over and strenuous movements. He chatted with his parents and watched TV, making sure to get enough rest.
subevent.location: Home at Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Returned to normal daily activities on the fifth day after surgery
subevent.description: On the fifth day after surgery, Lei Mingxuan's wound had basically healed, and he could chew soft food normally. He began resuming light daily activities, such as walking to a nearby supermarket to buy daily necessities. In the evening, he did simple stretching exercises at home. He had a video call with his cousin Shen Jie to discuss next week's plan for new products in the store.
subevent.location: Home and the surrounding area in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Post-surgery day six follow-up and recovery training plan
subevent.description: On the sixth day after his surgery, Lei Mingxuan went to the oral hospital for a follow-up. The doctor confirmed that the wound was healing well and removed the stitches (if needed). After returning home, he made a recovery training plan for the following week, starting with low-intensity aerobic exercise. He still avoided strenuous exercise that day, but felt energetic and was ready to resume his normal fitness routine the next day.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area Stomatological Hospital and home.

subevent.name: Resume training and hire a personal trainer to correct form
subevent.description: After recovering from his wisdom tooth surgery, Lei Mingxuan returned to the gym on December 12. He hired a personal trainer to focus on guiding and correcting his squat and deadlift form, and worked out a follow-up training plan.
subevent.location: A gym on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: At the end of the month, take a physical fitness test and record progress.
subevent.description: On December 31, Lei Mingxuan had an end-of-month fitness test at the gym. His bench press reached 50 kg, and his 5 km treadmill pace improved to 6 minutes per kilometer. His overall fitness improved significantly, laying a good foundation for the self-drive trip to Western Sichuan.
subevent.location: A gym on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
